༄༄༄/ /mdzad pa'i dbu tshad kyi bsdus chen sogs kyang yod do/ /khyad par du 'jam gsar shes rab 'od zer la mdo sngags mang po dang dus 'khor 'gro lugs kyi dbang bshad man ngag thams/ cad rdzogs par nos/ bla ma rwa 'bum seng yun ring du bsten nas dus 'khor rwa lugs kyi dbang bshad man ngag thams cad rdzogs par nos te rwa 'bro gcig tu 'dril ba'i zhal po yod do/ /gzhan yang 'di nyid kyi sku'i sras rgya gar grags dang slob ma gzhon nu rgyal mtshan gnyis byis pa chung ngur yod pa hor dmag gis khyer ba la sgrol ma btson 'don gyi cho ga mdzad pas/ sgrol ma'i sku nam mkha'i khyon tsam gyi lte khung na bu chung gnyis po mgo rug ge 'dug pa gzigs/ zhag gsum tsam nas khong gnyis thar/ snar bu'i dgon pa mdza sgang na bza' mi gnyis la bu lo drug lon kyang lkugs shing 'gro mi shes pa zhig yod pa la byin rlabs mdzad/ gos brjes ming btags pas de ma thag 'gro ba dang smra ba shes par mdzad cing / gzhan yang lkugs 'phye mang po la de ltar mdzad / thar pa na ston pa gzhon brtson zhes bya ba rma 'bras kyis rnag khrag zags pas glo snying phyi rol nas mthong ba zhig yod pa la ston pa rwa rtser ming btags nas/ ston pa gzhon brtson ston pa rwa rtser red/ ston pa rwa rtses mi kha re tho bsad/ ces pa sgo gong la bris pas de ma thag sos pa dang / de bzhin du so na ba la thab kyi ser ga bsubs pa dang / klad pa gzer ba la sgo'i gzer phyung pa dang / bud med bu ma thon pa la thad la' gyang la bug pa phug pas phan pa dang / smyu+o ba sangs pa sogs

snang ba la dbang bsgyur zhing rten 'brel la mnga' brnyes pa'i lo rgyus mtha' yas pa yod la/ rgong dkar la la byon pa'i tshe jag pa la lta stangs sdigs mdzub mdzad pa tsam gyis bros pa la sogs pa grub pa'i mtshan ma yang bsam gyis mi khyab cing / khyad par du dus 'khor gyi bshad pa yun ring du mdzad nas slob ma mkhas par gyur pa nyid kyi sku'i sras rnams dang / sku de nyid po ta lar gshegs pa'i man lung gu ru dang / lho pa grub seng / la stod chos ldan/ dbus pa tshul dar/ thang ston lo tsā ba la sogs pa dus 'khor la mkhas pa'i mchog tu grags pa mang po dang / 'phags pa dang / khro phu rin po che la sogs pa skyes bu dam pa'i slob ma mang po smin grol la bkod nas dgung lo brgyad cu bzhes pa chu pho rta'i lo cho 'phral chen po'i yar ngo'i chos gsum gyi snga dro ngo mtshar ba'i ltas du ma dang bcas te gshegs so/ /de la sras bzhi byung ba'i che ba rgya gar grags rab tu byang ba'i mtshan nam mkha' dpal bas dus 'khor la sogs yab kyi chos ma lus par mkhyen/she dben dmar gyi gdan sa bzung / gtsug lag khang dang rten gsum mang po bzhengs/ chos kyi bya ba rgya cher mdzod nas/ sras gcig bla ma shes ras seng ge gzhon nu nas dus 'khor sogs yab kyi chos rnams mkhyen/ dgung lo bcu drug pa la dus 'khor 'grel chen gsungs/ nyi shu di la thar pa ra byon/ dpyal pa'i chos rnam sa zhus/ nyer gnyis pa la sta ga sde se nga rgyal la phar tshad ma ngon gsum gas na/ khyad rdo ra tshad r+ya la mkhas par gyur te grwa skor mdzad/ sum cu pa la 'gro mgon

ra༅༅/ /'phags pa dang mchims nam mkha' grags la rab byung bsnyen rdzogs mdzad chos mang du zhus/ lo tsā ba grags rgyal gdan drangs nas 'phreng ba skor gsum la sogs pa mang du gsan/ dben dmar gyi gdan sa bzung nas dus 'khor gyi sagad pa yun ring du mdzad/ gzhan yang thar pa/ khro phu/ bsam yas/ stag lung / gzhu kun dga' ra ba/ shangs rtse gdong ston mo lung g.yus dka' ldan la sogs pa rnams su dus 'khor gyi bshad pa rgya cher mdzad / dgung lo zhe gcig pa la dben dmar gyi gdan sa bla ma rdo rje rgyal mtshan la gtad nas mu la sham 'bar gyi dgon pa btab ste/ gtsug lag khang dang gsung rab mang du bzhengs/ dus zhabor gyi bshad pa yun ring du mdzad pas/ ti shrī kun blo sku mched la sogs pa mi che ba'i slob ma du ma dang / lo tsā ba yar thar dpang gsum la sogs pa mkhas btsun bzang gsum gyi slob ma dang / khyad par dus 'khor la mkhas pa mang du byung / dgung lo drug cu rtsa lnga pa yos bu'i lo la sku gshegs te / lugs 'di'i bshad bka' yang rgya lo yab sras gnyis shin tu bka' phrin che'o/ /sras gcig slob dpon rnal 'byor gyis yul 'khor bskyangs/ sras gcig bla ma a ka ra sid+dhis dus 'khor rwa 'bro sogs yab kyi chos phal che ba mkhyen/ de'i sras bla ma rdo rje rgyal mtshan chu mo lug gi lo la 'khrungs/ gzhon nu nas rgya bod kyi yig klog du ma mkhyen/ dus 'khor la sbyangs nas dgung lo bcu drug la rgyud 'grel gsungs/ sa skya'i shar pa 'jam dbyangs rin rgyal dang / slob dpon sher

rgyal la mkhan slob zhus/ dge tshul mdzad/ dgung lo bcu drug nas dben dmar gyi gdan sa bzung ste/ dus 'khor gyi bshad grwa bskyangs/ bka' bzhi pa grags pa gzhonanu dang zhal snga mkhan po las bsnyen par rdzogs par mdzang / /lho+o sgra dang mngon pa gsang sngags mang du gsan/ khyad par bla ma sher seng la dus 'khor gyis gtso byas dbang bshad man ngag bum pa gang byo gsan/ dus 'khor la mi bde ba gang byung zhu yig tu bskur ba dang /dris lan gyi sgo nas kyang dus phyis kyi bar du gtan la phab nas shin tu mkhas par gyur to/ /gzhan yang bla ma mang du bsten/ mdo sngags du ma la mkhas/bla ma shes rab seng ge gshegs nas shang 'bar dang gnyis ka bzung / dus zhabor gyi bshad smo yun ring du mdzad/ de nas de nyid rgyal pos gdan drangs te rgya yul du byon/'grodo na rgya cher mdzad/ glang lo la rgya yul du sku gshegs/ de la bu sto na chos kyi rgyal pos gsan/'di ni gangs ri'i khrod du byung pa'i bstan tshon gcig la ma' bu 'an las bstan pa la bya ba byas tshul ches mchog tu gyur par kun la grags shing /rnam thar zhib pa zur du blta'o/ /gnyis pa 'gro'i brgyud pa ni/ kha che zla mgon gyis bod du byon/ kha rag gnyos yon to grags la babs/ rgyud 'grel bsgyur ba dang gser srang brgya 'bul bar 'chad pa las/ phyed tsam 'gyur ba na paṇ+ḍi ta bros / 'gyur byed 'phro bsna ma sa te 'phan yu la grab tu byon/ zhang pho chung bas bteg 'bro lo tsā ba shes rab grags bos te/ rgyud 'grel rdzogs par brgyu ra/ da /ba rag gnyos kyis thos

ra༅༅/ /te/ zhang la yi ge bskur khyed kyis nga'i bla ma phrogs pa yin pas/ wa pa'i gseb tu yungs shar rtsang nge ba zhig dgos na ma gtogs bla ma skyol zhes zer ba byas pas / zhang na re/ nga lha mo brgyas 'dzum bstan kyang mi chags / khro bo brgyas mche ba gtsigs kyang mi 'jigs pa yin zer nas ma bskyal bar yun ring du zhabs tog byas gser srang bco brgyad phul/ gzhan yang gnyi+os ston ye shes mchog gis gser srang bco brgyad phul/ grwa pa mngon shes kyis lo gsum chos ston drangs/ mjal res kyi phyag rten ma chag par byas/ jo btsun tshul rin gyis gser srang drug phul/ g.yo ru ba 'gar ston/ mang yul ba ston ma sri thar/ smon 'gro ba 'jam sgom la sogs pas kyang zhabs tog yun ring du byas kyang sor sdud tsam las ma gnang / 'phan yul grab tu sku 'khrangs pa'i sgom pa dkon cog bsrang zhes bya ba mngon pa dang sa sde dang sman dpyad la shin tu mkhas shing yon tan che bar grags pa des yo byad thams cad bsdus pas gser srang drug byung ba dang bdag nyid kyi ske la dar yug btags nas phul/ zhabazlo toka yun ring du mdzad de/ ji r+shar gsung ba bzhin bsgrubs pas shin tu dgyes nas sems 'grel skor gsum gzhung gdams ngag dang bcas pa ma lus par gnang ngo / /bla ma 'di'i phyi rten ring bsrel mang pa 'byung ba zhig 'phan yul rags ma'i nang na dus phyis kyi bar du yod ces zer la/ nang na phyag dpe dang rgyan drug sogs bzhugs pa'i phyi rten che ba zhig grab na bzhugs pa dus phyis zhig nas nang bzhugs rnams 'thor bar

zlugatsuso delasgroston gnam la rtsegs zhes byabasagasanate de ni 'phan zlul r+sha'i gre( 'brajes/ spyodagyeng lo nyer drug pa lo sdus sde'i bzhe bshesaloro'i drung du g.yu che chung 'dres pa phul gangabargyagasasukhyeranasabyonaskyedagyengalongabargyad pa'i bar du slob gnyer rgya cher mdzad pa na/ lo ro pa'i gsung gis mchims na sngags pa chen po zhiṅge yod pa 'di rdo rje 'dzin pa dang 'dra/ nga ba lang dang 'dra ba yod pa la/ dus phyis ngas kyang lo tsā ba chen po leng shwadzi bco+on 'grus/ 'brog mi shudzi ye shes/ 'gos khug pa lhas btsas rnams la thug pas rdo rje 'dzin pa dang 'dra bar song ste/ dus 'khor shes pa zhig dang thug na da dung ba lang dang 'dra bar 'dug gsungs pas bla ma gnam la rtsegs dus 'khor la shin tu dad par gyur te/ sus shes dris pas paṇ+ḍi ta so ma nā thas mkhyen zer nas de ma thag byon te/ gser srang bcu gnyis dang rta nag di+o gzhig phul zhabs tog yun ring du byas kyang sor spong tsam las ma gnang / sgom pa la gser srang nyung shas shig phul nas zhus kyang paṇ+ḍi ta'i bama' rgya yod gsungs nas ma gnang / paṇ+ḍi ta bal po mnga' ris su byon ring la/ snor bzangs su lo gsum dang yer par lo gsum sgom pa la mgo bteg byas nas zhus pas yongs su rdzogs par gnang / paṇ+ḍi ta phebs pa dang gzhan rnams kyis sgom pas/ sgro ston la/ chos tham/sa/ cang byin no zhus pas/ sgro ston la/ pa/ṇ+ḍi gari/ da shos chos sbyin gyi gsungs/ pa na/ sazhon dus/ ni cha/ gnang / da rgasari/ nga sku/ mi/ zhu zhus/ pa/sa/ lo dkon cos bsrung gi chos kyis ngom sa 'dug spre / de nga las ma byung na

ra༅༅/ /su las byung gsungs nas phyags pas/ bla ma chen po'i bka' drin lags mod zhus pas/ gang gang byin gsung / 'di dang 'di thob zhus pas/ nga la'ang de las med/ da gzhan la ster ri'i mna' skyol gsungs nas phyag phreng ske la bcug pa na bla mas ni ma gnang / sgom pa la zhus pa lags mod zhus pas/ ngan pa 'di gsungs nas dbu la bye ma btab/ da chud ma gsan gsung / de gsung mi 'tshal zhus/ mdor na des paṇ+ḍi ta dang sgom pa gnyis ka la rdzogs par zhus/ nyams rtogs phul du byung ba brnyes so/ /'di'i phyi rten mchod rten khang bu brtsegs pa zhig 'apa na yul sgro ris kyi gnas khang zhes bya ba na bzhugs pa zhig nas sa 'bum tsi ru gyur pa'i gseb nas ring bsrel brgya phrag du ma nar mar 'byung ba yod pa/ bar skabs su dge ba'i bshes gnyen 'ga' zhig gis sāts+tsha btab nang du bzhugs pa'i mchod rten khang brtsegs ma byas pa yod do zhes grags so/ /de la yu mos zhus/ de ni gangs ti se'i 'gram du 'khrangs pa'i 'brog pa yin te / rngam khro bo tshes bya ba la sras bzhi 'khrungs pa'i chung shos yin/ dgung lo bcu tsam la la stod lho ru byon/ lho mcher gnas su mkhan po stag lo gzhon byang la rab tu byung bas khyed rus pa rngam yin pa dad pa shin tu che bsna ga 'dug pas/ rngam bcun dad pa rgyal po zhes ming 'dogs so gsungs nas btags/ lo gnyis mkhan po'i drung du chos gsan/ de nas don mo rir byon te/ bse ston sgra gcan dang / dge gnas su bar ston thos pa dga' la phar mngon gsan/ de'i tshe lu mo zhis

mtshan yang rang nyid kyis btags/ de nas dpa' dge mthong dang stegs la dbu tshad gsan/ de nas lhan pa sor sog po tshul khrims bla ma la 'dul ba dang spyod phyogs dang gsang sngags 'ga' yang gsan/ 'dul ba legs par mkhyen nas mdo rtsa rdzogs par thugs la gsungs/ de dus grogs po zhig gis khyod dgun 'di ci byed zer ba la/ gsang sngags kyi dpe 'dra 'dri byas pas/ kho na re cha lag tshang na rdo rje snying pos mdzad pa'i kye rdor gyi 'grel pa 'dug zer ba mi 'dri'am/ zhes thos pa na sngon gyi bag chags kyis 'grel pa'i mtshan thos pas ba spu g.yos/ de nas dpe g.yar bas gtang nas bris/ gzigs pas dad pa dpag med 'khrangs/ 'di shes pa su yod dris bas so ma nā thas shes zer ba la sngon gyi mi zhig ka yin yong snyam ste rtsad ma bcad/ de nas dbus su byon/ khams pa lte'u ba la spyod phyogs nyan dus paṇ+ḍi ta bla mgon dgar chung na bzhugs pa gsan/ sngar gyi sgotam dran te des rdo rje snying 'grel mkhyen nam byas pas slob dpon na re/ der ma zad sems 'grel skor gsum/ khyad par dus 'khor cha lag dang bcas pa la mkhas par grags gsung / zhus na gnad ngam byas pas/ spyir bka' dog ste da lta bal yul du 'bron par chas pa la zhabs tog pa ma rnyed pa 'dug zer bas zhabs tog pa la 'gro nus na gnang 'ong gsung / der sproci+ob chen pos mjal du byon/ sum pa rdo rje sazhon nu la zhu sna bcol te phyin pa na/ paṇ+ḍi ta dang sgro ston kye rdo rje'i rtsa sngags dang yis brgya la zhus das mdzad cing bzhugs pa dang thus chos 'brel zhus pas

༄༄༄/ /sngags de gnyis la bshad pa mdzad/ chang gsol 'phro dkar yol gang gnang ba ma 'thungs pas gzhan gyis 'cha' ba dang phyis kha thug byung / paṇ+ḍi tas gser thig po dang gla rtsi'i rkyal pa mang po bstan nas 'di rnam/sa bal yul bar du 'khur nus shing mgotho na na de nas bod du 'ongs nas chos gang dgos sbyin no gsung ba la de ltar khas blangs/ sgom pa tshul grags la dpe cha bcol yod pa len du byon/ rgyu mtshan bsnyad pas paṇ+ḍi ta la sngar yang mang pos chos ma khugs pa zhig yin/ chos thams cad nged kyi bla ma snor bzang ba la yod pas der zhus pa mi 'thad dam byas pas blo 'gyur te kho la zhu sna bcol/ gser zho 'ga' dang dung chos legs pa gcig dang ka pa li gcig rnams phul te zhus pas bla ma mnyes te/ khyed kyi 'bul ba 'di rnams kyang la nye bzang / sog 'dul ba 'dzin pa de gang zag khyad par can cig yod 'dug pa/ khyed de'i thugs zin pa zhig yin zer bas khyed la yon ྾ zhig yod pa yin te gsungs nas chos gnang bar zhal gyis bzhes / bla ma dgung lo bdun cu rtsa gnyis pa dang mjal/ lo bzhi bar ma chad du bsten/ 'grel pa skor gsum bshad pa man ngag dang bcas pa dang / mtshan brjod man ngag gi bshad pa dang / gsang 'dus sgron gsal la sogs pa gnang ba'i dus su snyun bag re byung na'ang gtsang ston 'di la chos ma tshar gyi bar du nga ma gsod cig gsungs nas chos skyong la gtor ma btang chos thams cad rdzogs par gnang ngo / /de nas dgung lo lnga bcu pa la 'u yug tu byon/ nub ma'i mda' rgyal khab

ces byabaragazhi phab phu ru dben rgenas shig mdzad/ gag tshangs phu'i gra ga lung du yang sgrub pa mdzod pas grub pa thob ste/ dbang khrid skor gsum gyi bshad pa dang bcas pa/ mang du mdzad/ gsal sgron dang gces bsdus la sogs bstan bcos kyang mang du btsa mas/ mngon shes thogs med mnga'/ rang gi slob ma wa brag dkar ba'i brag khung 'gag tu skya ka ru spal nas skad sna tshogs sto na pas/ des kyang ngo shes nas bla ma rin po che bdag la de 'dra'i kyal ka mi mdzad pa zhu zhes zhus pa sogs rdzu 'phrul la dbang 'byor/ yon tan dpag med brnyes nas dgung lo brgyad cu'i bar du bzhugs te dus kyi 'khoraswā 'i dbang bshad man ngag gi srol rgya cher dar bar mdzad do/ /des dgung lo lnga bcu nga lnga pa la rigs kyi sras bskun pa'i cho ga mdzad pas yum gyi rdul stobs su gyur nas sras mo gcis 'khrangs pa ni ma gcig sprul sku jo 'bum du grags te/ lung rtogs dpag med mnga'/ 'grel chen thugs la rdzogs par gsung ba bod du 'di las ma byung bar grags/ de rjes sras gcig 'khrangs pa dharme shwa ra zhes grags/ chung ngu nas rgya bod kyi zlo+og yig mkhyen/ dgung lo bcu gnyis pa la dbang mdor bstan gsungs/ bcu drug pa nas 'grel chen gyis thog drangs sems 'grel mtha' dag gsungs/ gzhan yang spyod phyogs dpa dbu tshad dang / lam rim dang sngags kyi rgyung dang sgrab thabs mang po sogs la dgung lo sum cu'i bar du slob gnyer mdzad/ mkhas par sbyangs te gzhan phan rgya cher mdzad do/ /de la sras nam ma kha' rgyal/ ma zhes bya ba la stod

ra༅༅/ /gtsang gi 'u lung gi dgon pa se mo che zhes bya bar bzhugs grub pa thob pas grub thob se mo che zhes grags/ yab la dus 'khor sogs sems 'grel gsum gyi dbang bshad man ngag rdzogs par gsan/ sprul sku jo 'bum la yang 'grel chung pad+ma can dang sgrub thabs man ngag phran tshegs mang du gsan/ yab kyi bu chen khang gsar ba nam mkha' 'od zer la yang yab kyi chos kha yar gsan/ bla ma 'di ni ting nge 'dzin la mnga' brnyes dus gsum lung stan pa lkog gyur gyi don hor bod du 'byung tshul sogs gsungs pa rnams ji ltar lung bstan pa bzhin byung bar grags so/ /rang gi skye ba du ma dran pa rnams ras bris la bkod pa yod par byed do/ /de la chos rje 'jam gsar gyis gsan/ de ni mtshan nyid phyogs la shin tu mkhas/ phar tshad kyi ṭīk+ka khyad par can yod/ 'chad nyan bstan pa'i bya ba rgya cher mdzad/ 'jam dbyangs kyis zhal gzigs/ bdag rjes 'dzin gyi bla ma dang gdams ngag dang gnas la sogs pa gang na yod zhus pas/ grong chung du bla ma grub thob la dus 'khor zhus/ des lam bgrod par 'gyur zhes lung bstan/ dge bshes khyung la de'i gtam dris nas sos ka zhig gshegs par bzhed pa'i nub mo nam gung la nag phyogs mi ma yin gyi dmag tsho+ogs cher 'dus te/ cho 'phrul bsam gyis mi khyab pa stan du byung ba na/ dngos grub ster ba'i yi dam dang / /gnod pa ra sems pa'i 'dre gdon gnyis/ /mi bdag la ro mnyam khyad par med/ /ces sogs mgur ma bzhes chos thams cad du ma ro gcig gi don thugs la

chud pas cho 'phrul thams cad zhi/ g.yas ru grod chung du byon dus gakhong po'i gzhung la byon pas nam mkha' thams cad sangs rgyas byang sems kyis gang ba gzigs/ bla ma grub thob dang mjal ma thag phyag rdor gzigs/ snang ba 'gyur ba'i mos gus skyes/ mchog dbang zhus te sbyor drug gi khrid btab nas bsgom pas zhag gnyis la sor bsam gyi rtogs thams cad rdzogs/ yi/da ches sum ldan gyi don mngon du gyur/ de nas legs par bsgoms pas srog 'dzin la dbang thob/ yon tan dpag med mnga'/ des kun mkhyen chos sku 'od zer la dus 'khor gyi dbang gnang dus rdo rje zhugs su dngos su gzigs nas de ltar mthong /lags zhus pas/ nga rang gi snang tshul dang mtshungs par byung 'dug zhu cag dpon slob la bgegs kyis mi tshugs gsung ba sogs zhib par sgos kyi rnam thar na yod par 'dug pas der blta'o/ /sku 'khoshes/sa dus nga 'di nas lan cig bde ba can du 'gro/ zhing sbyong / sems can thams cad smin par byed gsungs nas/ nyang stod kyang 'dur du sku gshegs so/ /de la rong pa rgya los kyang rdzogs par gsan/ kun mkhyen chos sku 'od zer gyis kyang dzosas par gsan/ de la kun mkhyen 'phags 'od kyis gsan/ de la'ang bu ston chos rjes gsan/ de la chos rje bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyis gsan/ de la chos rje lo/ chen skyabs mchog dpal bzang pos gsan/ de la bdag li rtsa ba'i bla ma sems dpa' chen po nam mkha' 'od zer bas rdzogs par gsan/ 'di'i drung du bdag bis dus kyi 'khor lo'i zur bka' ma

༄༄༄/ /gtogs dbang bshad man ngag mtha' dag tshang la rdzogs par thob bo/ /yang bu ston rin po che la nyang stod gong gsum bde chen pa chos kyi dpal ba zhes pa ma nyid la'ang legs par sbyangs pa zhig phyis dus 'khor nyid la dril nas gzhan du+o'ang bslabs/ phyis bu ston rin po che la rgyud 'grel tshar bcu bdun gsan nas legs par sbyangs shing dus 'khor rang las mkhas pa'i bu chen du byed/ de la bdag gi rtsa ba'i bla ma rin che' bsod nams 'phel zhes bya ba/ zhwa lu na mkhas pa'i mchag tu grags pa des lo bcu gsum dus 'khor la dril nas gsan legs par sbyangs/ phyis the tshom cung zad 'khrangs na'ang 5/nal lam du byon nas snga sor dpo na slob gyis dpyad pa mdzad pa bsnyel pa zhig yin na bka' skyon cung zad dang bcas te gsung pa dang / de ma yin pa la mnyes bzhin du rgyu mtshan dang bcas te gsung zhes gsung dngos la sa thos la/ rgozhan yang mdo sngags mtha' dag la mkhas shing 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi cha la 'gran zla dang bral/ khyad par ting nge 'dzin gyi nyams rtags sku'i cha byed dang bkod pa la yang dpag par mi nus pa dang / lkog gyur mngon sum du mkhyen pa'i gsung sgros thol byung du 'byon pa sogs lung rtogs mtha' yas pa la mnga' 'byor ba de'i drung du kho bos dbang bshad man ngag lag len sa ris sogs zhwa lu pa'i lugs kyi yi ge na gcig ma lus pa rdzogs par thob pa yang dgyes bzhin du legs par stsal/ bstan pa spyi sgos kyi gnyer kha gtad pa yin no/ /de ltar na sangs rgyas nas rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar du dbang bshad kyi

rgyu' chad/ dam li gi sel ma zhugs/man ngag gi snyan brgyud ma chad pa yin no/ /de ltar na lugs 'di gangs ri'i khrod du dbang stod man ngag gi sgo nas legs par spel ba'i brgyud pa rnams kyi yo+o tsho rwa m+wa gos rkyol / yang gyi jo zla ba'i 'od zer gyis dus zhabs pa'i slob ma shrī bha dra bo dhi la masmo nas rgyud 'grel la gzhi 'gyur byas/lo chung rnams la sogs pa la spyod pa yun ring du mdzad/lo chung rnams kyis kyang rgyud 'grel dum bur bgos nas bsgyur ba khyo dus 'khor 'gyur mangs su grags mod kyi masgos shig nas de dag gi stod rgyun chad par byed do/ /dā na shrī'i slob ma rma dge ba'i blo gros kyis kyang gyi jo 'gyur gyi steng nas 'gyur bcos nas/mang 'or byang chub shes rab dang /blo gros snying po dang / bsod nams ye shes dang /'a zha rgya gar rtsegs rnams kyis kyang 'gyur bcos dang bshad pa byas kyang kod rgyun tshugs pa ma byung ngo / /tsa mi sangs rgyas grags ni/kha cig nyang stod smad mtshams kyi 'khris rtsa kha ba yin zer/ kha cig g.ye rong gi rtsa pa yin zer ba ni/ khong rang gis mdzad pa'i rgyud 'grel gyi 'gyur byang du byang phyogs mi kho yul du skyes par spyod pa dang 'gal pas/mi kho yin la/gzhon nu la rgya gar du byon/yun ring du bzhugs mkhas par sbyangs/rdo rje gdan gyi gdan sa mdzad/dus tsor rgyud 'grel bsgyur zhing gad/ de'i slob ma ding ri chos grags/ a bhā ya'i slob ma/ khe gad 'khor lo grags/ ga rod tshul khrims khong gnas dang /rong rlings lo tsā/ ra byid lo tsā/se lo tsā

༄༄༄/ /sogs kyis kyang tsa me la mnyan nas 'gyur bcos byas kyang gzhan rnams kyis bshad bka' ma zin/ se lo tsā bas gnyos 'od 'bar la bshad/ de la grub thob a rgyan par grags pa rin chen dpal gyis zhus nas dbang bshad khrid bka' rnams bskyangs/ da lta'ang a rgyan bsnyen sgrub tu grags pa rnams yin no/ /gzhong ston rdo rje rgyal mtshan ni/ la stod lho'i dpyad lung pa shar kha'i bong ra zhes bya bar 'khrangs/ bla ma go lung ba rdo rje rgyal mtshan la rgyud sde du ma dang phreng ba skor gsum sogs la sbyangs/ gar thig lnga bsdus gza' lnga g.yul rgyal sogs la mkhas par gyur nas gza' rnams gsal bar byed pa'i sgron ma la sogs pa'i bstan bcos du rmi mdzad/ mngon pa ba rin chen rtsemo'i bu chen stag sde ba seng ge rgyal mtshan la phar tshad mngon gsum dang gcod bsdus la mkhas par sbyangs/ der dus 'bor 'bro lugs kyi dbang bshad man ngag gi bka' thams cad rdzogs par gsan/ 'phags pa rin po che phong nas sa skyar phebs pa'i drung du bstod pa'i tshigs bcad spel legs pa phul/ lo tsā bslab tu 'gro bas rdzong bdar zhu zhes zhus pas/ de lta bu'i blo skye ba bzang / gzhung gsar pa 'gyur ba'i nus pa 'ong ba dka' na'ang paṇ+ḍi ta la dri gtugs dang slob gnyer legs par gyis/ kho bos kyang chos rje bsten yun thungs pas sdeb sbyor me tog gi chun po dang tshig gter la sogs pa mi go bar snang bas 'di rnams ris kyang shes pa zhig gyis la shog cig gsungs nas de dag gi dpe dang gser sung lnga dar yug bcu rnams gnang / rten

'brel— yod pas do nub rje btsun gong ma'i gzims khang du nyol gsung / khong gi thugs la nga skyes thob kyi shes rab ni che/ sbyor byung gi nan tan yang mchog tu gyur na legs bshad gsar pa mang du ci'i phyir bsgyur bar mi nus snyam du dgongs te / 'phags pa'i gzims g.yag pa blo gros rgyal mtshan dang 'grogs nas bal yul du byon te/ tsho paṇ+ḍi ta ma hā bha dra'i drung du sgra snyan ngag sdeb sbyor mngon brjod/ zlos gar te rig gnas chung ba lnga la sbyangs/ khyad par sgra rig la shin tu mkhas par gyur/ sa skyar byon nas dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud dang 'grel pa la shin tu rnam par dag pa'i 'gyur bcos mdzad/ slar yang ma hā bo dhi mchod pa sogs la rdo rje gdan du byon/ paṇ+ḍi ta chen po la: ka ra spyan drangs nas dpag bsam 'khri shing dang / klu kun tu dga' ba'i zlos gar dang snyan ngag me long dang / 'jig rten dbang phyug gi bstod pa brgya pa dang / 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi bstod pa bṛt+ta ma la'i stod dang / sgra tsan+d+ra pa'i mdo la sogs pa sngon bod du ma 'gyur ba rnams bsgar / a mar ko ṣa la sogs pa la'ang mchan bu gsal par bkod de rig pa'i gnas 'di dag shin tu dar bar mdzad/ de dang de'i gcung po gshong blo brtan gnyis ka la lo tsā ba mchog ldan gyis gsan/ de ni mang mkhar khra tshang du 'aḍūngs/ gzhon nu'i tshe 'phags pa rin po che la rab byung zhus/ mchog ldan legs pa'i blo gros dpung rgyan mdzes pa'i tog ces 'dogs par zhu zhes zhus nas ming de ltar btags/ bod du 'gyur ba'i bka' thams cad dang / bstan bcos phal

༄༄༄/ /che ba dang dbang dang man ngag phal mo che'i lung bzhugs/ de la bla ma dpal ldan seng gis gsan/ de la bu ston rin po ches chos dang dbang bka' mang du gsan na'ang rgyud 'grel gyi bshad pa ma gsan/ dka' gnas la gsung gleng dang dri gcigs mang du mdzad/ 'on kyang 'gyur mi 'dra ba bcu bdun 'dug pa de thams cad kyi nang nas gshong 'gyur nyid mchog tu dgongs nas bshad pa thams cad 'gyur de'i steng nas mdzad/ da lta'i bar du de ltar byed pas gshong ston 'di yang lugs 'di la bka' drin che'o/ /bzhi pa la mdo sde'i phyogs la brten pa'i bstan rtsis yongs grags bshad pa dang / dus kyi 'khor lo nas bshad pa'i bstan rtsis tshad grub bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ spyir bstan pa'i gnas tshad la bskal bzang gi yi ge kha cig dang / blo gros mi zad pa'i mdo'i 'grel pa dang / mdzoda'agrel gyi kha che ba'i rang lugs rnams su lo stong dang / snying rje pad dkar du phyed dang nyis stong / zla ba'i snying po'i mdor ni nyis stong / rdor gcod 'grel par phyed dang sum stong du gnas par gsung la/ bskal bzang gi yo ga kha cig las lnga stong dang / sangs rgyas drin lan babs pa'i mdo las/ bdun stong gnas rgyu la bud med rab tu byung bas nyis stong 'gribs par bshad pa dang mthun par yum gsum gnod 'joms las bshad cing / don se nas 'bum ṭīka tu'ang bshad/ gnod 'joms 'di ni dbyeg gnyen gyis mdzad par grags na'ang rnam bshad rigs pa sogs kyi mdo 'chad tshul dang mi mthun pa'i gnod pa mang du 'byung bas dbyig

gnyenagyis ma mdzad kyi girge ske nas byas pa'am/ lo tsā ba ye shes sdes byas pa gang rung du mkhas pa dag bzhed do/ /'on kyang slob dpon chen po 'jam dpal grags pas kyang lnga stong du gnas pa dang / de la lnga brgya pa phrag bcur phye nas / rtogs pa'i dang / sgrub pa'i dang / lung gi lnga brgya pa gsum gsum dang / rtags tsam gyis gcig tu phye nas/ gsungs pa bzhin 'bum ṭī ka las kyang 'byung bar kun la grags/ mdzod 'grel du/ kha cig rtogs pa'i ni stong yin gyi / lung gi ni de las ring bar yang gnas so zhes bshad do/ /de dag las lnga stong du gsungs pa nges don du byas nas/ gzhan rnams drang don du bzhed pa mang la/ sher phyin dang gsang 'dus sogs kyi rgyud sde 'ga' rer mdo rgyud de dag 'jig rten na ji srid spyod pa de srid du bstan pa gnas par bshad pa dang / byams pa lung bstan pa'i mdor tshe lo yar 'phel gyi drug brgya pa'i bar du bstan pa gnas par bshad pa sogs mang du 'byung ngo / /de lta mod kyi de dag ni/ lung rtogs thugs rgyud la ldan pa'i gang zag khyad par can re re tsam 'jig rten na bzhugs pa lta bu la dgongs nas gsungs pa yin pas lo grangs kyi gnas tshad gsungs pa dang dgongs gzhi mi gakhrig par nges so/ /'o na lo grangs kyi gnas tshad gsungs pa'i dgongs gzhi gang yin zhe na/ 'dul ba lung gi gleng gzhi las/ btsun pa ji tsam gyis na dam pa'i chos mchis pa zhes bsgo ji tsam gyis na zhig pa zhes bgri/ u pā li/ las kyang yod la nan tan byed pa yang yod pa'i bar du ste de tsam gyis na mchis pa

ra༅༅/ /zhes bya'o/ /las kyang med la nan tan byed pa yang med na dam pa'i chos zhig pa zhes bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar las mtshan nyid pa la brten nas dge slong gi sdom pa gsar du skye ba nam yod kyi bar du yod la/ de med pa nas zhig pa yin te/ thogs med kyis/ dam pa'i chos nub pa na las kyi mtha' rnams med pa'i phyir dge slong gi sdom pa ma blangs pa ni blang du med la tshungs pa ni mi gtong bar rig par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /de ltar na so so thar pa bstan pa'i rtsa bar gsungs pa yang de la dgongs la/ de 'dra'i las mtshan nyid pa 'grub pa la/ dge slong rnam dag grangs dang mtshan nyid tshang ba mtshams nang gcig tu tshogs pa dgos pas/ sngon dang phyis kyi mkhas pa dag gis dge 'dun gyi sde dang 'dul ba'i lag len la gtso bor mdzad pa yin pas gang dag nags khrod sogs su gcig pur gnas pas bstan pa 'dzin par 'dod pa ni bstan pa'i rtsa ba la gces spas med pa yin no/ /de ltar na gnas tshad ni rang lugs kyang lnga stong la bya'o/ /'o na lnga stong las sngar ji tsam 'das/ da ji tsam gnas snyam na/ 'di la snga rabs la grags pa ni/ rgyal ba 'das nas lo brgya dang so bdun na rgyal po dga' byedang/ de nas brgyad brgya na zla bsrungs/ de nas nyis brgya so brgyad na mdzod langs / de nas bdun brgya nyer bzhi na bal por chos kyi go cha/ de nas brgyad brgya bcu bzhi na 'od zer go cha/ de nas nyis brgya zhe gnyis na bod du mnga' bdag khri ral byung ste/ de yan chad la nyis stong dgu brgya dang nga lnga 'das sku+o tshes bal po lo

bcos dang bod kyi rgyal pos brtsis pa las 'byung / de nas brgya dang go bdun 'das pa me pho 'brug la lha bla ma yab sras kyis brtsis pas sum stong brgya re gnyis/ de nas so lnga 'das pa lcags mo yos la jo bo rjes brtsis pas sum stong brgya brgyad cu rtsa bdun/ de nas nga dgu 'das pa sa mo glang la lo chen blo ldan shes rab 'das pa'i phyis lo brtsis pas sum stong nyis brgya zhe drug de nas lnga bcu 'das pa lca gas pho 'brug la phya ba'i chos grwar brtsis pas sum stong nyis brgya go drug jo bo rje'i bzhed pas sangs rgyas shing pho nyi ba la lhums su zhugs/ glang la bltams/ sa mo phag la sangs rgyas/ shang pho spre'u'i ston zla tha chung gi yar ngo'i tshes brgyad la mya ngan las 'das par bzhed pas 'di'i rjes su 'brangs nas/ mchims nam mkha' grags kyis me mo sbrul la brtsis pas sum stong sum brgya go gsum song bar byas so/ /chos rje sa paṇa ltar na rgyal ba me mo yos la lhums su zhugs pa nas brtsi/ de'i dbang du byas nas rje btsun grags rgyal gyi gshegs rdzongs me po bri ba la mdzad dus brtsis pas sum stong sum brgya zhe dgu 'das/ de nas drug cu re gcig 'das pa me mo glang la chu mig chos 'khor du chos rgyal 'phags pas brtsis pas sum stong bzhi brgya dang bcu song / de nas zhe gnyis 'das pa sa mo lug la phar phyin bu ṭīka brtsams pa'i bar la sum stong ba'i brgya dang nga gnyis/ de nas brgya dang so drug 'das pa da lta'i shing mo phag 'di yin la sum stong lnga brgya dang gya brgyad 'das/ da stong dang bzhi brgya bcu gnyis lus par bya dgos pa yin no/ /paṇa

ra༅༅/ /chen shwakya shrīs khro phur yang brtsis/ sol nag thang chen du me mo yos la brtsis dus/ smin drug zla ba'i dkar phyogs kyi/ /tshas brgyad nam gung mnyam pa la/ /zla ba ri bo la nub che/ /thub dbang yongs su myo ngan 'das / /de rjes lo 3 stong phrag gcig /bdun brgya dang ni lnga bcu dang / /zla ba gnyis dang zla ba phyed/ /de bzhin nyi ma lnga rab 'das/ /lo 3 stong phrag gsum dang ni/ /nyis brgya dang ni bzhi bcu dgu/ /zla ba dgu dang nyi ma bcu/ /ma 'angs bstan pa'i lhag mar gnas/ /zhes lo de'i dbyed 'bring gi mos lnga la brtsis par bshad pa la/ chos rje sa paṇa gyis/ lugs nge ni rgya gar na wo thos sen dha ba rnams zhag re bzhin dus brjod pa'i tsha ston pa 'das nas 'di song brjod pa las/ma ga dha'i byang chub chen po de/ slob dpon tho btsun grub rje dang bde byed dga' bas mdzad par bzhed nas/tsan+dan gyi lde gu spungs pa las rang byung du byon pa'i nub mo nas byang chub chen po byon pa dang ston pa 'das pa'i dus gnyis no+or nas brjod pa'i 'khral pa yin pas/rgya bal kha che'i paṇ+ḍi ta mang po lugs de 'dod kyang legs pa ma yin te/lha mo dri ma med pa lung bstan pa'i mdor/ nga mya ngan las 'das nas lo nyis stong lnga brgya na gdong dmar can gyi yul du dam pa'i chas 'byung bar lung bston pa'i gdong dmar can bod la byed dgos pa dang /gzhan la yang klu sgrub sogs lung bstan pa'i lo grangs dang rgyal pa'i rabs la sogs pa brtsis na mi 'grig pas lugs snga ma legs so zhes gsung ngo / /gsung mod kyi la ji+og nas

〉 ste//ye grago5 rna na tu mi rigs pa'i phyir ro/ /'di ltar/sangs rgyas mya ngan las 'das nas lo stong du nye ba na thogs med sku mched tso+on par gsungs shing lad la/ stog gasto gyi slob ma blo brtan / de'i dngos slob dza na mi tra/ des bod du byon nas ska ā+o+o dang lo paṇa byas pa gang zhigaska tso+o khri ral gri dus kyi lo tsā ba yin/ de dus lo sum stong du zhe lngas chad pa song bar khyed rang gis khas blangs/ stog gyen 'das dus lo stong las ma song zhing /blo brtan sku tsha ring po ma byung bar grags shing grub pas/dzi na mi tras bod du byon dus lo nyis stong bzhes pa'i skyon du 'gyur/ de bzhin du slob dpon ye shes snying pos cog ro dang lo paṇa mdzad par dbu ma rtsa she sogs kyi mjug gis gsal la/de dang klu sgrub kyi bar na'ang legs ldan 'byed dang dpal sbas las med pas de gnyis kyis sku tsha stong stong bzhugs nas snga ma'i sku mo'i mthar phyi ma slob mar byung ba sogs khas len dgos par 'gyur/gzhan yang zla grags dang 'gos lo tsā ba'i bar na slob pa'i rdo rje/ nag po spyod pa/ btsun mo ༅ gsum las med pas de gsum gyis brgyad brgya re tsam bzhugs pa'i snga ma 'grongs khar phyi mas zin dgos par 'gyur la/de bzhin du mdo sngags kyi rgyud ris mtha' dag la rtog pa bcug pas shes pa'i phyir ro/ /sto par tsan+dan jo tsho lo rgyus sogs la brten nas dgag sgrab rgyas par zur du bkod pa ltar ro/ /des na lugs 'di ni rgya gar du sto po pā la lnga dang /se na brgyad la sogs pa'i rang la nyi ma ldog thengs re la lo re ru byed

ra༅༅/ /pa'i phyed lo brtsi ba yun ring du byung bar grags la/ de lta'ang de lta bu'i lugs yod par 'dug pas de 'dra ba zhig bar skabs su zhugs par gsal lo/ /des na bcom ldan chen po rig ral gyis kyang dus 'bor la brten pa'i bstan rtsis gtso bor mdzad la/ phyis kyi mkhas pa gzhan dag kyang de ltar du 'dod pa ltar kho bo yang 'das lo mdo rgyud la brten rgyu med par gtapa rgyu rnying pa'i rgyun la brtsi ba 'di bor nas dus kyi 'khor lo 'di nas 'di'i bar du 'di song nges pa can gyi lung dang / nyi zla gzas 'dzin dang gza' lnga sogs sa ris dang legs par mthun par rigs pas grub pa'i tshad ma la brten pa 'di khas len no/ /gnyis pa ni/ lugs 'di la bstan pa yun 'di srid du gnas zhes pa'i lo grangs sogs mdo sde'i phyogs bzhin du lung bstan pa dang gsal bar bshad pa med mod rdzi rgyal ba mya ngan las 'das nas lo drug brgya na 'jam dbyangs grags pa byung ba dang / de nas grags pa rang nyid kyis lo brgya dang bcas pa'i dgu brgya na kla klo 'byung ba dang / kla klo'i chos de lo stong brgyad brgya'i bar du 'jug cing / de nas 'khor lo can gyis kla klo bcom ste sangs rgyas kyi chos 'jog pa ra bshad pa rnams kyis 'dzam gling chung ngu 'di'i bstan pa'i gnas tshad rtogs par nus la/ de bzhin du sa dum bu re re la de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos 'jug pa dang / de kla klo'i chos kyis nyams par byed pa dang / de 'khor lo can gyis bcom nas rang gi chos kyang dum bu re la lo stong brgyad brgyar gnas par bshad pa rnams kyis 'dzam gling

chen por ji tsam gnas pa'i tshad kyang rtogs par nus so/ /'o na rigs ldan rgya mtsho rnam rgyal khri thog tu byon byon gyi bar rigs ldan shin tu bzang yan chod ni re res lo brgya brgya chos ston par shin tu gsal mod rdzi rgya mtsho rnam rgyal man chod kyi rigs ldan rnams kyis ji tsam chos ston pa mi gsal zhing / drag po 'khor lo can rigs ldan nyi shu rtsa lnga'i nang du bgrang ngam rtsa drug par byed la'ang mi mthun par smra ba mang bas the tshom za zhing / rtsa drug par byed na'ang rgya mtsho rnam rgyal man la bcu drug las med nga/sa/ kla klo'i lo stong drug brgya las mi rdzogs par 'gyur te/ drag po 'khor lo can gyis ni de ma thag tu kla klo 'joms pas so zhe na/ 'di la kha cig zhabor lo can rigs ldan nyer lnga par byas/ de rang gi lo brgya po brtsis kyang stong drug brgya las ma byung bas/ me mkha' rgya mtsho la rgya mtsho rnam rgyal dang de'i sras rgyal gas bgos nas/ ya ba la lag pa gdengs can zla ba dang / sras la nyis brgya nyer gcig sbyar nas de gnyis la brgya brgya'i nges pa mi sbyor/ gzhan thams cad brgya brgyar nges pa 'dod par byed do/ /de ltar na ding sang rigs ldan mtha' yas kyis chos bstan nas lo nyi shu rtsa brgyad 'das par 'dod do/ /'di ni lung rigs kyi sgrub byed gsal po med bzhin du 'dod pas sbyar ba'i rnam gzhag tu snang ste rigs ldan nyer lnga la gzhin rnams brgya brgyar nges nas de gnyis la zur pa 'ong ba'i rgyu mtshan med pa'i phyir ro/ /'bor lo can nyer lnga par byed pa'ang mi rigs te/ 'od zer bdun dang ri gza' thub rnams 'dir ni de bzhin snying stobs ldan

ra༅༅/ /pa lha yi skye gnas te/ /zhes go sla'i skabs su gsungs pa'i bdun dang ri dang gza' dang thub pa ste lha'i skye gnas bdun bzhi nyi shu rtsa brgyad mi tshang ba'i phyir ro/ /'di ltar rigs ldan nyer lnga'i steng du drag po 'khor lo can dang / de'i sras 'jam dpal dang 'jig rten dbang phyug bi sprul pa tshangs pa dang rgya byin rgyab dang mdun du ston par 'gyur par bshad pa gnyis dang bcas pa'i nyi shu rtsa brgyad la byed dgos pas so/ /'o na/ sum cu rtsa gnyis gdan gyi mthar ni lha min dgra bo tshe lo brgya pa phyag na 'khor lo ra 'gyur/ /zhes dang / de yi ngabs su gangan ni nyi shu rtsa lnga rim par yongs su bgrangs pa dag gi dus kyi mthar/ /rigs ldan rigs la lha yi dbang po lha ni mchog gis btud pa drag po'i rigs ldan 'byung bar 'gyur/ /zhes pas nyi shu rtsa lnga par bstan pa ma yin nam zhe na ma yinag te/ mtha' ni zad dang 'jug cha dang zhes bshad pas mjug gi cha sa mthar bshad pa'ang yod mod sri da lan zad pa la byed pa'i phyir ro/ /'o na pad dkar gyi rjes su khro bo bcu dang sems dpa' bcu gsum spel nas lung bstan pas/ drag po 'khor lo can la lung bstan med pa mi 'thad do zhe na/ med pa ma grub ste/ mtha' yas rnam rgyal rigs ldan no/ /de sras 'khor lo chen po can/ /rigs ldan drag po 'byung 'gyur ba/ /rigs ldan grags pa de nyid slar/ /grags pa rigs lngan de nas slar/ /'gyur byad yin/ zhes 'jam/ dbyangs sam grags pa nyid drag po 'khor lo can du bstan pas so/ /nyer lnga la mi gartogs na rigs ldan du mi 'thadado zhe

na ma nges te/'khor lo can gyis kla klo bcom nas tshangs pa dang dbang po mdun rgyab tu lo+o ston pa'i tshangs pa'i dus su mi lo stong brgyad brgyar 'phel ba dang /de'i phyed ni 'od srungs kyi'o zhesasogasatshalorim gyis lobanas la brgyad tsho mthar yang rigs ldan du gad pa'i phyir te/rigs ldan mthar ni ji srid brgya phrag gtsig gi lo yi grangs kyi skye tsho tsha ru rab tu 'gyur/ /zhes kod pas so/ /drag po byon ma thag tu kla klo 'joms pa'ang ma grub ste/de lta na byon ma thag tu bde ba'i gnas su gshegs par 'gyur te/rdzogs lda na mtshams su kla klo'i chos rnams mtha' dag srid pa gsum gyi bla ma dag gis bcad byas nas/ /bcad nas lo 3 brgyad brgya rnams su tshangs pa bzhag pa mdzad nas bde ba'i gnas sa 'gro bar 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /des na de'i sku tsha ni lo brgya yin par sum cu rtsa gnyis zhes pa'i rgyud tshig gis grub bo/ /'o na kla tso lo stong brgyad brgya la stong bdun brgya las ma tshang ngo zhe na/ma tshang mod kyi rags rtsam dbang bye bya'o/ /'di ni gling 'dir de bzhin gshegs pa'i bstan pa lo lnga stong gnas par mdo sde'i phyogs su rgyas par gsungs pa dang bstan pa'i ched yin nam snyam ste/'di ltar sangs rgyas mya ngan las 'das nas ma ga'i yul du kla klo byung gi bar la lo stong lnga brgya/kla blo'i chos byung nas rdzogs par bcom gyi bar la stong bdun brgya ste bsdoms pas sum stong nyis brgya ni bstan pa drag po 'khor lo can gyis ma gsos bar gyi lo grangs yan la/ de rjes kla klo bcom rjes su'ang sangs rgyas kyi chos

ra༅༅/ /lkog par yang yang gsungs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi chos ni sangs rgyas 'di nyid kyis bstan par byed dgos te/ de dag la 'khor lo can gya dus bzher spyod pa yod kyang da bstan 'dzan yan rgya stan pa ma yan pa' phyar ro / /de nas des gsos pa'i bstan pa'ang sa dum bu re la stong brgyad brgya re 'byung ste/de nas lo 3 stong phrag nyi shu lhag pa brgya dang bral bar sangs rgyas chos ni rab tu lkog /ces pa nyi khri chi+og stong drug brgya'i steng nas stango brgyad brgya gling chung 'dir kla klo bcom rjes su lkog la/ de bcad ting r+yā khrid snya brgyas chad pa gling gzhan rnams la khrug par spyod pa'i phyir ro/ /des na gling 'di'i stong brgyad brgya pa de nyid sngar gyi sum stang snya brgya dang bsres pos lngo stang nyido du legs par grub pas so/ /ma grub ste/kla klo rnams ni 'khor gyi skye bo dang bcas rab tu bcom nas mi rnams lo 3 brgya phyed na/rigs ldan grub par 'gyur te lha yi bkod pa'i pho brang mtho ba ka la sha yi rgyab tu 'o/ /zhes 'bar la can gyi la brgya i phyed na kla klo lngoms par kod pas so zhe na/ de ltar 'chad pa 'ga' re snang mod sri de ni de ltar ma yin te/kla klo 'joms mar de'i chos dar/sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dus bzhi'i nang nas rtsod dus kyang zer/skye tso tsha la rim gyiso 'grib nas tsha lo lnga bcu par gyur pa'i tsha na kla klo 'joms pa rdzogs zhes pa'i don du snang ste/ tshangs pa sogs la mi rnams la ni brgya phrag bco brgyad dang ldan 'di dag mi rnams dag gi tsha/ /de yi phyed ni'odasrungasakyi'o zhesaso/ da/ge

'khor lo can gyi rdzogs ldan du gyur nas tshe lo yar 'phel te/ de'i sras tshangs pa dbang po'i ming can 'jam dpal dang 'jig rten dbang phyug gi ring la mi rnams kyi tshe lo stong brgyadabargya deganyisakyirjesasu'obazlungasakyiringal tshe lo dgu brgya sogs te/ nya dang rus sbal phag pa sogs/ rdul gyi skye gnas brgyad kyi ring la rim gyis bri nas mthar tshe lo brgya par 'gyur bar bshad pas shes so/ /'di rnams ni sngon chad legs par 'chad shes pa ma byung bar snang bas rnam dpyod ldan pas legs par dpyad na spro ba skye bar 'gyur ro/ /de ltar na gling bcu gnyis po kun tu sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa ma gsos nga/ dang gsos pa zhes pa'am/ yang na snga dar dang phyi dar zhes brjod kyang rung ste/ gnyis gnyis byung bar rig par bya la/ gling bcu gcig tu ni snga phyi gnyis rka'ang lo stong brgyad brgya par mtshungs pa dang / 'dir kla klo ma zhugs gong gi phyed dang nyis stong po lhag pa dang / zhib par na 'di'i kla klo zhugs rjes kyi snga dar la stong bdun brgya las med pa rnams grub bo/ /de ltar snga dar bsdoms pa la nyi khri chig stong lnga brgya/ phyi dar bsdoms pa la nyi khri chig stong drug brgya'o/ /'dir gling kun tu sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa 'jug pa mi 'thad de/ mngon pa sogs nas sgra mi snyan pa dge sdig gi rten du mi rung bar bshad pas so zhe na / skyon spong sngar bshad zin pa bzhin mngon pa dang 'gal ba spong na shin tu mang po zhig spong dgos pas ha cang thal ba dang / ri gling mtha' dag mi bstan par nges bzhin du sgra mi/ snyan la dogs pa gcod don yang med la cis kyis smig

ra༅༅/ /na'ang / mngon pa nas gsungs pa lus ngag gtso bor gyur pa so thar gyi bstan pa dang / 'dir gsungs pa yid gtso bor gyur pa sngags kyi bstan pa'i dbang du byas pas ci zhig 'gal zhes kyang brjod par bya'o/ /da ni gsum pa tshig don gtan la dbab pa la/ rjod byed kyi tshig dang / brjod bya'i don gtan la dbab pa'o/ /dang po ni/ bsta na pa'i mthar thug 'di'i rjod byed kyi tshig ni/ bsdu na rtsa rgyud dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa dang / bsdus rgyud dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa gnyis su 'dus mod mi phye na drug tu dbyer yod pa dang / drug po de la mtha' drug tu byed de/ drug ni mdor bstan dang rgyas bshad gnyis/ rab tu mdor bstan dang rab tu rgyas bshad gnyis/ mdor bstan chen po dang rgyas bshad chen po gnyis/ mtha' drug ni mdor bstan gyi mtha' dang rgyas bshad kyi mtha' zhes sogs re re la sbyar ba'o/ /mtshan gzhi ni/ mdor bstan ni bsdus rgyud/ rgyas bshad ni rtsa rgyud/ bar pa gnyis ni rim pa ltar de gnyis kyi dka' 'grel / tha ma gnyis ni de gnyis kyi 'grel bshad so so'o/ /de skad du rtsa rgyud kyi dum bu dbang mdor bstan las/ rgyud ni mdor bstan rnam gsum dang / /rgyas par bshad pa rnam gsum/ 'gyur/ /mdor bstan rab tu mdor bstan che/ /rgyas bshad rab tu rgyas bshad gzhan/ /mdor bstan rgyas par bshad pa ni/ /bsdus dang yang dag rgyud yin no/ /rab tu mdor bstan rgyas bshad pa/ /dka' 'grel tshig ni 'byed pa po/ /mdor bstan chen po rgyas bshad pa/ /'grel bshad don kun

ston byed pa'o/ /de ni mngon shes thob rnams kyis/ /bya yi mkhas rnams kyis min nyid/ /de ltar mtha' drug rnams kyis dag /rdo rje'i rnal 'byor rnam bzhi dang / /rdzogs pa'i byang chub bzhi rnams dang / /phung khams skye mched rigs drug rnams / /dag pa 'jig rten khams la sogs/ /le 'u lngar ni 'dod rnams kyis/ /bden gnyis dang po'i sangs rgyas 'gyur/ /dus kyi 'khor lo mngon rjod byed/ khes pa gang gsungs pa 'dis dus 'bor gyi brjod bya rjod byed brjod tshul rnams bsdus nas bstan no/ /de la mdor bstan gyi mtha' ni bsdus rgyud/ rgyud phyi ma dang bcas pa yin la/ bsdus rgyud ni tshig rkang pa re la yi ge nyi shu rtsa gcig pa me rtog 'phreng 'dzin gyi sdeb sbyor gyi tshigs bcad gcig ma lus par bcings pa tshigs bcad kyi grangs ni sum cu lhag pa yi phyogs brgya zhes stong dang sum cur 'dod pa dang / stong dang sum cu lhag tsam du 'dod pa la sogs pa ni rags pa'i rnam gzhag tu gsal te/ mchog mi 'gyur du/ da lta'i rgyud na med pa'i rgyud tshig 'ga' re yang lung du drangs mod sri da lta'i rgyud la'ang tshigs bcad stong dang lnga bcu nga brgyad yod de/ 'jig rten khams le la brgya drug cu re dgu/ nang le la brgya bdun cu don bzhi/ dbang le la nyis brgya dang gnyis/ sgrub che/ la nyis brgya dang so bzhi / ye le la nyis brgya re gcig byung ba'i phyir ro/ /'o na 'phreng 'dzin gyi sdeb sbyor de ji lta bu zhig la zer zhe na/ rgyas par ni/ phyi rol pa'i mkhas pa dmar ser dang rgyal ba lha'i gzhung dang / de dag gi skyon rnams bkag nas rang lugs yon

ra༅༅/ /tan brgyad ldan du ston pa/ shān+ti pas mdzad pa'i rin chen 'byung gnas las shes dgos pa 'dir nyer mkho mdor bsdus brjod na/ spyir sdeb sbyor gyi lus la tshigs bcad dang rkyang pa gnyis su nges la/ dang po+o la bṛt+ta'am 'phel ba dang / dzā stu'am/ bskyed ma gnyis su nges shing / dang po la yi ge gcig pa dang lnga pa'i bar yang mi bzhed pa ma yin mod kyi/ dngos bstan rkang pa re la yi ge drug pa nas nyer drug pa'i bar la sdeb sbyor ming 'dogs so sa ba dang / nyer bdun pa yan gyi tshigs bcad la rgyun chags zhes ming 'dogs dang / de re re la yang nang gses kyi dbye ba mang po dang bcas pa mdzad pa'i yi ge nyer gcig pa yin la/ de la rin chen 'byung gnas kyi rtsa ba kho bos 'gyur bcos pa las / ma ra ba dang na na ba/ /ra ra ba rnams bdun gsum rdzi /sdod pa 'phreng 'dzin zhes byar 'gyur/ /zhes pas mtshan nyid bshad do/ /de yang thog mar yi ge bcu gnyis kyi ming 'dogs kyi brda chad shes dgos la/ bcu gnyis kyi nang nas ba dang ka gnyis ni ngal gso'i dang yi ge rir btags te/ ngal gso lci ba la ba zhes brjod/ ngal gso yang ba la ka zhes brjod do/ /la dang ga ni ngal gsor ba ma nges pa'i yi ge re re la btags te/ la ni yang ba gā ni lci ba'o/ /bha dang dza dang sa dang ma dang / ya dang ra dang ta dang na rnams ni tshigs bcad kyi nang gi yi ge gsum gsum la ming du brtags shing / 'dir yi ge bgrang ba ni dbyangs bgrang ba'o/ /zhes pas dbyangs kyi yi ge la bya'o/ /dbyangs kyang yang lci'i sgo nas shes par

bya la/ yang lci yang / yi ge so so la 'greng bu na ro ring cha klad kor mtha' brten rnams med pa ni yang ba dang yod pa ni lci ba'o/ /de yang yi ge gsum po'i thog ma lci ba ni bha/ bar pa lci ba ni dza/ tha ma lci ba ni sa/ kun lci ba ni ma'o/ /de bzhin du thog ma dang bar dang / mtha' dang kun yang ba ni rim pa bzhin du/ ya dang ra dang ta dang na rnams so/ /de ltar na 'dir rkang pa bakhrig la yi ge nyer gcig yod pa la bdun gsum yod pa'i bdun dang po ma ra ba ste/ sum tshan gnyis kyi dang po kun lci ba dang gnyis pa'i par pa yang ba dang / bdun pa ngal gso lci ba yod pas so/ /bdun bar pa na na ba yin te/ kun yang ba sum tshan gnyis dang bdun pa snga ma bzhin yin pas so/ /bdun tha ma ra ra ba yin te/ sum tshan gnyis dbus yang ba dang / bdun pa ngal gso lci ba yod pas so/ /dper na gling gzhi'i rkang pa dang po/ thams cad mkhyen pa ye shes sku dang nyin mor byed pa'i sku ste pad+ma'i 'dab ma rgyas pa'i spyan/ /zhes pa'i saṃ skṛ ta la/ sarba dz+nyā dz+nyā na kā yaṃ di na ka ra wa pu ṣi pad+ma patā ya tā r+ghaṃ/ bud+dha sau hā sa na māṃ su ra ba ra na mi rta ma sta ke na pra ṇa my-i/ dz+radz+nyā rā dzā su tsan+d+raḥ ka ra ka ma la pu ṭaṃ s+thā pa yī tot+ta mālha/ yo gi shrī kā la tsakri ka li yu ga sa ma ye musti he te t+na rā ṇi/ zhes pa lta bu'o/ /rkang pa thams cad lci yang la sogs pa de ji lta ba bzhin du gnas pas shin tu ngo mtshar te yi ge mangs su dogs pas snying po tsam zhig bkod do/ /yang lci'i brda chad ni/ pra sdur zhes pa 'khyog yod med ṅko ri mos shes te/ 'a'akhyog po rnams lci ba dang drang po rnams yang

ra༅༅/ /ba dang / klad ni+or can rnams ngal gso'o/ /de dag ni yi ge bgrang ba bṛk+ṣa dper brjod skabs su bab pa yin la/ zhar la dzā ti ni phyi mo bgrang bar bshad pa'i phyi mo ni/ yi ge'i gcig yun/ gnyis yun/ gsum yun sogs so sor bgrang ba ste/ dgrangs thung ngu ni phyi mo gcig pa/ ring po ni phyi mo gnyis pa/ shin tu ring po ni p+lu ta'i ming can gyi phyi mo gsum par bshad do/ /de ltar byas na da lta'i rgyud 'di la tshigs bcad stong dang nga brgyad/ rkang pa bzhi stso nga nyis brgya so gnyis/ yi ge brgyad khri brgyad stong brgyad brgya don gnyis/ phyi ma ni rkang pa re re la phyi mo bcu gnyis re lhag pas tshigs bcad re la zhe brgyad re lhag po bsdoms nas lnga khri bdun brgya gya bzhi lhag po bsnun pas phyi mo 'bum sum khri rdogu stong drug brgya nga drug tu 'gyur la/ p+lu ta ni re re tsam yod srid kyang mang po yod par ma mthong zhing gang yod kyi phyi mo re re lhag pa yang bsnan dgos so/ /de ltar na rgyud 'di sdeb sbyor nges pa can gyi tshigs bcad ma lus pa bcings pa ni 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi mkhyen rab la shin tu gus pa skye ba'i rgyu yin te/ gzhung lugs gang la'ang tshigs bcad rnams yi ge'i grangs mnyam pa srid kyang sdeb sbyor gcig gis gzhung ma lus par bcings pa re re tsam du zad pa'i phyir te/ 'dul ba sum brgya pa yi ge bcu gcig pa'i bye brag dbang po'i rdo rje dang / nyan thos zhi tshol gyi tshigs bcad gcig po yi ge bcu dgu pa stag rnam rtsen dang / bshes pa'i spring yig dzā ti la 'phags ma dang ro langs can dang / phyi mo mnyam pa'i dzā ti gsum yod pa'i

'phags ma'i bye brag gis bcings pa lta bu sid tsam las mi snang ba'i phyir ro/ /de ltar na sdeb sbyor nges pas bcings pa'i dgos pa ni mkhas rlom dag gis chos la tshig don gyi lhad khrug pa mang bas demichagapa'ichedayinate//sdebalo pa dang tshigs bcad kyi grangs nges pa mdzad pas yi ge sa:ga kyang 'dzud par mi nus pa'i phyir ro/ /yang sgra'i rnam dbye la dang po ngo bo brjod pa/ gnyis pa las brjod pa/ gsum pa byed pa/ bzhi pa dgos ched/lnga pa 'byung khungs/drug pa 'brel pa/ bdun pa gnas gzhi brjod pa ste bdun dang / de re re la gcig tshigaganyis tshigamang tshig ste gsum gsum dang / kha cig bod pa dang brgyad du 'dod kyang bod pa ngo bo brjod pa'i nang du 'du ste/ de ltar rnam khu nges pa med na brdzod bya gsal bar mi rtogs te/bod skad la'ang shing /shing la/shing gis/shing gi ched/shing las/shing gishing la gnas zhes pa rnams nyams pa'am gzhan dang gzhan du brjod na don mi rtogs pa yin no snyam pa lta bu/sgra la mkhas pa'i nga rgyal can rnams la/chig la mi rton gyi don la rton dgos pa tshig grogs dang skabs thob sogs la don go na tshig la zhen mi dgos so/ /zhes bstan pa ri nga / sgra la mkhas pa'i snod min dag gis glegs bam mthong na gas la bar rtogs kyi dogs pas kyang rgyud 'di la rnam dbye rnams ni nyams pa dang gzhan dang gzhan du bstan par gsungs so/ /rgyud byi ma ni sngar gyi 'gyur 'di rwa 'gyur ngan pa zhig tu yo da pa sa/ rkang pa re re la yi ge bcu dgu pa tshigs bcad kyi grangs kyang nges po mi

ra༅༅/ /'dug pas nges pa ༅ gyis legs par bcos nas bshad par bya'o/ /dbang gi rab dbye dang rgyud kyi snying po la sogs pa ni bsdus rgyud 'di nyid kyi dbang la dgos pa dang /rdzos/sa rim la dgos pa rnams zur du phye nas slob dpon dā ri ka pa sogs kyis 'grel pa byas pa yin pas rgyud zur pa min no/ /gnyis pa rgyas bshad kyi mtha' rtsa ba'i rgyud la nges don gyi rtsa rgyud ni/mas brjod yin la/'di ni rgyud kyi rgyal po sgyu 'phrul drwa ba khri drug stong pa'i le'u zhe gsum pa rdo rje gyur blangs kyi le'u yin par gzhung gzhan nas spyod mod sgo gzhung lu gas 'dir de 'dra'i nges pa ma byung ngo / /'on kyang de nas dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang / /zhes pa nas/ ye shes sku nyid khyod la 'dud/ /ces pa'i bar gyi tshigs bcad brgya dang ri gnyis kyis dbang bzhi pa'i ye shes kyis sku bstan par ni yang dang yang du gsungs so/ /de la tshigs bcad kyi grangs de ltar yod pa ni rgya dpe kun las le'u so so'i mtshams su tshigs bcad kyi grangs bshad pa yod pa bzhin du mchog mi 'gyur du bshad de/zhus pa'i tshigs bcad bcu drugalan gyi drugarigs drug la gzigs pa'i gnyis/sgyu 'phrul drwa bas byang chub pa'i gsum/rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor chen po'i bcu bzhi/chos dbyengs ye shes kyi long pas dman pa'i ter lnga/me long ye shes gyi long pa lhag pa'i bcu/sor rtog ye shes kyi she gnyis/mnyam nyid ye shes kyi nyer lnga/bya grub ye shes kyi bco lnga/ ye shes lnga la phyag 'tshal ba'i lnga rnams yod pas so/ /de rnams kyi mtshams ni/lus btud nas

ne spyan sngar 'dug gi bar dang / de nas bcom ldan de ni legs zhes gsol gyi bar dang / de nas cher gzigs nas kyi bar dang / de nas na maḥ 'i bar/ theg pa chen po'i tshul gyi mchog gi bar/ de nas rdo rje lcags kyu logs pa che'i bar/ de nas sgra dang ldan pa rnams kyi mchog gi bar/ de nas 'od rab gsal gyi bar/ de nas rin chen tog gi bar/ de nas 'jam dpal dpal dang ldan pa'i mchog gi bar/ de nas ye shes sku nyid khyod la 'dud kyi bar ro/ /de nas/ sgrub le'i mjug tu 'di ltar sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das nas ye shes sku nyid khyod la 'dud kyi bar la brgya re gnyis yod par bshad pa 'dra mo yod pa ni/ brgya re gnyis po'i nang nas nges don pa'i 'go 'dzugs pa ngos bzung ba'o/ /rgya dpe la lar rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor dang / mnyam nyid ye shes la tshigs bcad re re/ lhag par mar la brgal nas bgrangs pa ni/ yo ga'i 'grel pa 'ga' re dang bstan pa'i bshad pa yin no/ /de ltar brgya dang re gnyis po ni/ nang skyes bu'i lus la gtsug tor / dgral ba/ mgrin pa/ snying ga lte ba/ gsang ba rnams su rim pa bzhin rtsa'i zhalor lo 'dab ma bzhi dang / bcu drug dang / so gnyis dang / brgyad dang / re bzhi dang so gnyis rnams bsdoms pas brgya dang nga drug 'khor lo drug bi dbus drug bgrangs pas brgya dang re gnyis po rngams dag pa dang / gzhan la pad+ma gdan can gyi lha brgya dang nga drug phyag rgya drug rnams snam par dag pa'o/ /pad+ma gdan can gyi lha ni nang ler/ nus ma rnams dang khra bo rnams ni rim pas bcu ru

ra༅༅/ /rab tu 'gyur te zhes sogs kyis bstan te/ nus ma bcu/ gshegs pa gshegs ma bcu/ sems dpa' sems ma bcu gnyis/ khro bo bcu/ lha chen bcu gnyis/ rnal 'byor ma dang / klu dang gtum mo rnams brgyad brgyad de bdun cu don brgyad po yab yum gnyis gnyis su bgrangs pa'o/ /de nas phan yon gyi le'u drug dang / sngags kyi bstod pa tshigs bcad gsum dang / bsnga ba mthar phyin pa'i bya ba tshigs bcad lnga po rnams ni bsdu tshig yin mod kyang nges don dngos su mi ston pas dag pa sogs kyang mi skyor la bshad pa yang ma mdzad do/ 'di yang tshigs bcad kyi yi ge brgyad pa yi/na mod zhi rjes sngags kyi sdeb sbyor sgu nges pa med do/ /drang ngas thun mong gi rtsa rgyud ni byang sham+bha la na bzhugs pa / rgya bod du dum bu re tsam las ma byon pa/ rjes sngags kyi tshigs bcad stong phrag bcu gnyis/ rkang pa bzhi khri brgyad stong / yi ge sum 'bum brgyad khri bzhi stong gi bdag nyid do/ /'di'i rjes sngags ni/ bṛt+ta yi ge brgyad pa'i tshigs bcad kyi spyi ming yin la/ dbye na 'dra mtshungs dang / gzhal dpag dang / rkang bkra dang / glog phreng dang / bram ze'i bu ste lnga/ de lnga'i mtshan nyid ni/ gdang la tshar bzhi spel ba ste lci yang spel mar gnas pa dang / la dang ga spel ba ste/ yang lci spel mar gnas pa dang / bha ga dang ga bsgrigs pa lan gnyis te/ gsum gyi thog ma lci ba'i rtsar lci ba gcig bzhag pa lan gnyis su gnas pa dang / ma dang ga spel ba lan gnyis te/ yi ge brgyad ka lci ba dang / bha dang ta dang lag gnyisna

rnams bsgrigs pa ste gsum gyi thog ma lci ba dang /gsum gyi tha ma yang ba dang / yang ba dang lci ba rnams su gnas par gad de/lci yang bzhi pa de 'dra mtshungs/ /la ga bsgo pa degazhaladapag /gal te bha ga gnyis /kha brnya/ / ga zung klog phreng / /bha las ta dang la dang ni/ /ga rnams yod pa bram ze'i bu/ /zhes so/ /de ltar na rtsa rgyud ni/ rjes sngags lnga po de gang rung zhig tu yod dam/ nges med ci rigs su yod ni rgya dpe ma mthong zhing gzhan gyis gad pa yang ma mthong bas khong du ma chud do/ /rgya bod du byon pa'i rtsa rgyud kyi cha shas kyi gtso bo ni dbang mdor bstan yin te/ dus zhabs pa dang / dpal nā ro pa'i 'grel pa dang bcas pa yod do/ /'di la ye ge brgyad pa'i tshigs bcad brgya dang don bzhi bzhugs la/rtsa rgyud kyi 'jig rten khams kyi le'u'i dum bu re tsam las ma byon la/ rjes sngags kyi mtshan nyid stong phrag bcu gnyis gsungs shing / dbang bcu gcig gi rnam gzhag cig mgo ru gsungs nas/rtsa yi kun spyod rtsol ba po/ /mdor bsdus pa yis khyod la bshad/ /ces pa ltar rtsa rlung thig le'i rnam bzhag rgyas/ pa dang bcas nas sbyor ba yan lag drug tsos bu dang bcas pa rgyas par gsungs so/ /gzhan yang khri rgyab kyi rgyan sna drug ston pa'i dum bu sogs phran tshogs 'ga' re yang mthong la/ spo bor 'grel chen rnams kyi lung du drangs pa ste/k+ṣu snying 'grel dang phyag rngor stod 'grel gto su bgrangs pa 'di na med pa yang 'ga' re snang zhing / 'grel 'a 'di na bgrangs pa la la mas la na tshigs bcad gya

ra༅༅/ /bzhe/ nang le na bcu gnyis rkang pas chad pa/ dbang le na zhe bzhi/ sgrub le na don dgu/ ye le'i mdor bsdus dang po na nyer gsum/ gsum pa na so gcig bzhi pa na lnga ste bsdoms pas lnga bcu nga brgyad / bsdoms pas nyis brgya dang don gsum tsam snang ste/le'u snga phyi na bldabs pa re re tsam dang /rtsa rgyud kyi lung yin min cung zad the tshom za ba'ang 'ga' re yod do/ rab tu mdor bstan dang rab tu rgyas bshad kyi mtha' gnyis kyi mtshan gzhi ni lugs 'ji la sngar ma grags so/ /dus zhabs pas byas pa'i bsdus rgyud kyi dka' 'grel pad+ma can lta bu ma yin nam zhen/ma yin te/mtha' drug tu bsdu ba'i 'grel pa yin na/mngon shes dang ldan pa'i byang chub sems dpas mdzad pa'i yin dgos pa'i phyir te/ de ni mongon shes thob rnams kyis/ /bya'o mkhas rnams kyis min nyid/ khes 'byung bas so/ /de dag la brten nas ni mkhas pa gzhan gyis byar rung bas na/ rje btsun red mda' pas/mngon shes med pas rgyud la wod pa gto byar mi rung bar ga nas dgag pa byas pas ni/phyogs snga ma dgongs par zad do/ /mdor bstan chen po'i mtha' ni bsdus rgyud kyi 'grel chen stong phrag bcu gnyis pa 'di yin la/rgyas bshad chen po'i mtha' ni rtsa rgyud kyi rgya cher 'grel stong phyag drug cu pa sham+bha la na bzhugs pa de yin no/ /de yang 'grel chen 'dis ni bsdus rgyud dbyangs so gnyis dag pa'i mdor bsdus so gnyis kyis 'chad la/ stong phrag drug cu pas ni rtsa rgyud dpe byad brgyad cu dag pa'i gnas pa brgyad

cus 'chad pa yin no/ /des na mkhas pa chen po bu ston gyis bsdus rgyud rtsa 'grel gnas pa dang sbyar nas bsdus don nan gyis mdzad pa bzhin du mkhas pa gzhan gyis sbyar ba ni bsgrig par dka' ste/ bsdus rgyud du gnas pa rnams stod smad phyed tshal byas pa dang rim pa dkrugs pa sogs du ma yod pas so/ /yod tshul mdor bsdus gnyis par gsungs pa'i gnas pa rnams dang sbyor tshul la bltas pas shin tu gsal bas ma spros so/ /de yang gnas pa gya bakhrig tu gsal ba ltar byed na gang la brgyan rgyu'i sku dang rgyan byed dpe byad brgyad cu dang bcas par bya la/ brgyad cur byed na sgrub le'i gnas pa dang po gnyis gcig tu bgrang bar gsal te/ brjod bya rjod byed shin tu nyung bar snang bas dbye rin mchog pa'i phyir dang / dag pa sbyor ba'ang zur bdun dang skye bdun lta bu la sbyar dgos pas mi 'grig la/ gnas pa drug tu byas na bskyed rim la ༷grib bya rigs drug dang rdzogs rim la yan lag drug dag par byas pa sa shin tu bde ba'i phyir ro/ /de ltar na sgrub le'i gnas pa drug gis dag pa ni de ltar yin la/ khams le'i nyer bzhi ni/ dus sbyor bcu gnyis dang rten 'brel bcu gnyis dag pa'/ /nang le'i bco brgyad ni/ nang gi mdzod drug dang / 'khor lo drug dang khamatha drug rnams dag pa'o/ /dbang le'i bcu gnyis ni dbang bcu gcig pa la drang nges gnyis su phye ba dag pa'o/ /ye le'i nyi shu ni/ rnam pa nyi shus byang chub pa dag pa'o/ /de bzhin du bsdus rgyud rtsa 'grel gyi mdor bsdus so gnyis las/ khams le'i bcu ni/ phyi nang gi rnam bcu dbang ldan

ra༅༅/ /dang / nang le'i bdun ni/ drug tshan re re ba'i steng du rten lus tsam bgrangs pa dang / dbang le'i drug ni/ dag bya khams drug dang / sgrub le'i lnga ni bsgrub bya rigs lnga dang / ye le'i bzhi ni rdo rje bzhe rnam par dag pa'o zhes bshad par bya'o/ /gnyis pa la phyi nang gzhan gsum so sor dang / thun mong du bshad pa'o/ /dang po la/ phyi 'jig rten khams kyi rnam gzhag 'jig 'byung gnas gsum gyi sgo nas dang / nang rdo rje lus kyi rnam gzhag skye 'jig bsrung gsum gyi sgo nas dang / gzhan dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i rnam gzhag smin grol 'bras gsum gyi sgo nas bshad pa'o/ /dang po la/ nges don don dam gyi dang / drang don kun rdzob kyi 'jig rten khams bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ khams le'i tshigs bcad lnga pa la sogs pa'i don te/ 'di la/ brjod bya'i don dang / rjod byed kyi sngags la sbyar ba gnyis kyi dang po la/ rnam bcu dbang ldan la dang / stong chen yig lnga la dang / rdo rje'i zla nyi la sbyar ba'o/ /dang po ni/ ma yang dag par brjod pa'i chos dbyings ye shes kyi bstod pa'i bstod nas/ pha rol phyin bcu thob pa ste/ zhes sogs nas gsungs pa'i phar phyin bcu dang sa bcu dang shes pa bcu dang / stobs bcu dang / dbang bcu'i rang bzhin rnam bcu dbang ldan ni nges don gyi 'jig rten yin te/ phyi nang gi 'jig rten bcu po gang nas 'byung ba dang gang du sdud pa'i gzhi yin pa'i phyir/ 'di'i tshul la/ jo nang pas phyi nang gzhan gsum re re la yang kun rdzob drang don gyi 'khrul pa'i dang / don dam nges don 'od gsal gyi

rlung la sogs pa bcu bcur phye nas/ 'dir don dam 'od gsal gyi 'jig rten bcu po de kun rdzob 'khrul pa'i 'jig rten bcu po 'byung sdud kyi gnyere 'dodal don dam de rtag brten ther zug cha med kun 'gra'i dngos por khas len no 'di rme dngos po dang / rtag pa'i dang / cha med kun 'gro'i gzhi mthun khas blangs pa nyid kyis rang tshig 'gal ba'i skyon dang rigs pa du mas gnod do/ /rang lugs ni/ dag ma dag gi snang ba mtha' dag rang gi shin tu phra ba'i rlang sems chos ngabyings dang bcas pa las 'byung zhing der sdud pa yin la/ 'dir rnam pa bcu ni/ brtan pa'i rnam pa lnga dang / g.yo ba'i rnam pa bzhi dang kun la khyab pa sgra gcan gyi ming can nam mkha' rnams yin te/ brtan pa ni rlung me chu sa riji ba/ g.yo ba ni 'ang nga gzugs gzhig tu byas pa dang / lha mthong ba mi bskyed pa gzugs med dang / bar snang gi zla nyi gnyis rnams yin/ 'di rnams gzhan dkyil 'khor la bsgom pa ni/ brtan pa lnga rang ming dang / g.yo ba ri rab kyi steng gi pad+ma/ zla ba/ nyi ma / sgra gakhon rnams yin zhing / khyab byed kyi nam mkha' ni chos 'byung yin la/ gzhan yi ge ni /k+ṣamalawaraya rnams mas bgrangs pa bdun gyi steng du zla phyed dang / thig le gnyis te dgu dang / kun gyi srog a yig rnams yin pas de dag nang la sbyar ba na/ sgrub ler mngal skyes kyi ma'i lus dang sbyar ba'i skabs su ma'i dpral mgrin snying ga lte ba rnams rlung me chu sa lte ba ri rab/ gsang gnas pad+ma/ mas sna'i rtsa gsum zla nyi sgra gcan lus rim pa kun gyi khyab byed du byas so// /

༄༄༄/ /'ad na phya dang gzhan gnyas dang go grim shin tu 'grig la/ nang ler lus kyi sra ba/dro ba/ gsher pa/ g.yo ba rnams 'byung bzhi/ sgal tshigs ri rab/ lus kyi stod smad bar gsum mtho ris sa 'og mi yul gsum tsam du dang / snying ga'i rtsa brgyad dang bug pa dgu gza' dang sbyar ba tsam las med pas mi gsal la/ ye le'i re gsum par/lus la rnam pa bcu bshad pa'i skabs su skya dang ba spu nam mkha'/sha dang pags pa rlung / khrag dang dmar cho me / rngul dang dri chu chu/rkang dang rus pa sa/rtsa dang rlung rnams ye shes/ro rkyang gnyis/ dbu ma'i yas sna dang mas sna rnams/nyi ma zla ba sgra gcan dus me ste rdo rje bzhi dang sbyar nas bshad de/ ri rab dang bcud kyi sem sa can la sbyar ra / /de ltar na yang phyi dang gzhan kun gyi 'byung sdud kyi gzhi ni nang lus la gnas la/ de'i yang rtsa ba mthar thug ni shin tu phra ba'i sems dang rlung dang thig le rnams ngo bo gcig tu gyur pa gzhom med gzhi'i dus 'khor/ cha med kun 'gro'i chos dbyings kyi rten du gyur ba 'di nyid yin la/ 'di'i steng na lus kyi sgyung sogs khams rags pa bzhi dang / de rnams 'dus pa'i rtsa rlung rags pa dang / nang gi rtsa khams sra ba/ dkar dmar rnam shes ye shes bzhi dang /kun la khyab pa'i nam mabasna la nus pa khyad par ba'i cha bcu/ rang rang gi chos dgrangs dang bcas pa yod pa ni/ nges don gzhi'i rnam bcu dbang ldan yin la/ de rnams las yi ge bcu 'grub ste/ de yang phra rim gyis 'grub pas na g.yon skor du brtsams

te / thig le dang / tshes drag dang / a yig dang / i dang / ṛ dang / u dang / lo dang / ma dang / k+ṣa dang / ha rnams dgod par bya la/ mya k+ṣa ha gsum gsal byed srog med yin pas gsal byed dbyangs med pa pha rol yi ger drang ngo zhes pas ha srog med k+ṣa'i steng du dang / de gnyis srog med ma'i steng du drang / der rting / tsan+d+ra par/ ṛ sha'i a na ra la dag go /tshes dang / ka lā pa ra/ e'i yi ge 'dra ba'i yi ge ma yin pa la yā ste pha rol dbye ba yang ma yin no/ /u'i yi ge 'a'o/ /ṛ'i yi ge ra'o/ /lo'i yi ge la'o zhes pas lam̐ yig pha rol gyi u mthong bas la ru bsgyur/ de bzhin du u lnga dang / ṛ ne+e dang / i yā rnams su bsgyur zhing de rnams kyang sngar bzhin gyi phyi ma'i steng du drangs shing thams cad a yig gi rnying du drangs pa ste a yig srog tu bcug pa'i steng du tsheg drag zla phyed du byas/ de'i steng du thig le nā das mtshan pa bsnan pas rnam bcu dbang ldan gyi yi ge 'grub pa'o/ /de bcu las sngar bshad pa'i brtan g.yo bcu po tha snyad tsam du 'grub cing / de rnams kyang mthar yi be bcu dang / de yang gzhi'i nges don gyi rnam bcu dbang ldan la dang / de yang shin tu phra ba'i rlung sems chos can du gyur pa la bsdus nas de tha snyad du thog mtha' med par gnas pa dang / las kyi nus pa smin res kyi sngar ba'in 'gyub pa dang / 'phen pa tshar gcig li nus pa zad pa na sdad pa yin la/ don dam du de yang spros bral chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin las ma 'das pas/ 'khor 'das don dam du gzhi med dang / tha snyad du 'khrul pa'i gzhi dang

ra༅༅/ /gnyis ka med bzhin du blun sgom byed pa ma yin par legs par grub pa yin no/ /'o na 'khral pa gzhi bcas yin na bzlog par mi 'gyur ro zhe na/ dmigs pa'i gzhi bcas yin kyang 'dzin stangs bden grub tu dang / rags par 'dzin pa gzhi med yin pas skyon med do/ /de ltar gang gis yang dag rig pa de ni phyugs min zhes me+e blun po min pa shin tu mkhas pa yin la/ snod bcud dang spyi don bden 'dzin gyi sems kyi kun tu rtog pa dag las gol te / rags snang gi rtsa ba rang gi rlung sems la thug par legs par grub pas so/ /gnyis pa ni/ phyogs bzhir zur bdun bkod nas/ de stong chen yig lnga la dang / de yang dbus kyi gzhom med la sdud cing 'byung 'jig byed par bsgrub pa yin la / zung bdun gzhir ma 'dus pa'i phyi nang gi 'jig rten yang med pa yin no/ /de'i tshul ni/ phyogs rer bdun tshan re re yod pa/ phyogs gnyis bsdoms pas zung bdun yod pa la zung bdun du grags pa yin no/ /de yang tshigs bcad drug pa bdun pa'i don bsdu na/ dbus su sngags mtshan gnyis pas bshad pas stong chen yig lnga ste/ e waṃ gnyis kyi nang nas waṃ yig gi cha shas lnga 'god pa yin la/ de yang dbus su rnam shes sgrib bral chos dbyings ye sheg kyi rang bzhin/ wa yig gi khog pa gri gug gi rnam pa nam mkha'i khams dang / g.yas sam lho ru tshor ba sgrib bral mnyam nyid ye shes kyi rang bzhin zla phyed kyi rgyu tsheg drag me'i khams dang / g.yon nam byang du 'du shes sgrib bral sor rtog ye shes kyi rang bzhin thig le chu'i

khamasadang mdun nam shar du 'edu byed sgrib bral bya grub ye shes kyi rang bzhin wa'i rkang pa dbyug pa'i rnam pa rlung gi khams dang / rgyab bam nub tu gzugs phung sgrib bral me long ye shes kyi rang bzhin wa'i mgo bor thong gug gi rnam pas khams rnams dgod/ de rnams bsdus pa las waṃ yig zlum po 'grub pa ni dbyangs dang zla ba'i chos mtha' dag bsdus pas thabs gtso bor gyur pa dang / zhar la khams drug gi rang bzhin gsal byed sde pa drug gi re re la mtshon byed stong pa'i thig le dbyug pa'i rnam pa re re ste drug 'byung / drug po sa rlung gnyis/ chu me gnyis/ nam mkha' rnam shes gnyis rnams zung gsum du byas te gzhibs pa gsum 'byung ba rtse sprad pas e yig gru gsum 'grub pa ni/ gsal byed dang nyi ma'i chos thams cad 'dus pas shes rab gtso bor gyur pa ste rgya gar d+ngha ri'i yi ge la e waṃ gyi dbyibs/ 'di bzhin du yod pa legs par 'grub pas 'di'i nang nas da lan e yig nam mkha'i khams thams cad kyi ga'i ru byas nas/ waṃ yig gi yi ge so so ba lnga po dbus dang phyogs bzhir bkod pa'i de ma thag tu lnga po rang rang gi 'od zer/ byang du dkar po 'bar ba/ lho ru dmar po 'bar ba/ shar du nag po 'bar ba/ nub tu ser po 'bar ba rnams dgod pa dang / g.yon du sgra gcan/ zla ba/ lhag pa / pa sangs/ mjug ring / char pa chu rnams/ g.yas su dus me/ nyi ma/ mig dmar/ phur bu/ spen pa/ glog me rnams dgod pa'i sa bon/ nang nas g.yon g.yas gnyis gnyis nas sbyar te/ i aḥ u ṛ/ lū rī/ a

ra༅༅/ /ar/ e+o ār/ wa ra/ wā rā rnams yin pa'i bar la su yang rtsod pa med la/shar nub kyi zung bdun la rtsod pa shin tu che ste/ rwa pa snga mas nub tu sa gsum dang rlung bzhi/shar du rlung gsum dang sa bzha ste spel nas bgrangs/ de la 'bro pas/ g.yas g.yon gnyis me chu so sor nges pa bzhin du/ nub tu sa dang shar du rlung yong rgyu la spel bas nor zhes dgag pa byas/ rwa pa phyi ma rdo rje rgyal mtshan pas/ 'bro pa'i dgag pa la dag pa byin/ rang lugs nub tu skar ma phra rags gnyis/ sa phra rags gnyis/rdo phra rags gnyis te drug las dgod rgyu ma rnyed pas/ rlung nor las rgyal bsnan/ de rlung yin yang nub tu dgod smo te/ ma ning du bshad pa'i phyir/ de yang ma ning la pho mo gnyis sha'i chags pa yod cing bya ba byed pa bzhin du sa dang rlung gnyis ka yin pas sa'i nang du bzhag go zhes zer ro/ /'bro pa snga ma dang /shong pa dang /jo nang pa rnams kyis ser po 'bar ba dang nor las rgyal bgrangs nas gzhan lnga la/ skar ma phra rags gnyis / lha gzhu/sa rdo gnyis rnams bgrang ste/ rgyud du rnam bzhi gnyis kyi dbye bas so zhes bshad pas/ rnam bzhi ni ser po 'bar ba/ skar ma phra rags/lha gzhu rnams yin/ gnyis ni sa rdo yi na pas so zhes zer// bu ston ren po ches de thams cad 'gog ste/ rwa pa phyi mas lha gzhu la phra rags gnyis byas pa mi 'thad de/ rgya dpe la gcig tshig tu yod skya gnyis kyi rnam dbye med pas so/ /'bar ba grangs su 'gro ba mi 'thad de/phyogs gzhan gyi 'bar ba la'ang mtshungs pas

so / /nor las rgyal bgrang pa mi 'thad de/ ma ning la mtshan gnyis 'byung ba bzhin du de'i sa bon k+ṣa yig yin la/ de zung bdun gyi sa bon las logs su bshad pas dang / bi bhu ti mi bgrang bar bshad pas so/ /des na snye mdo bas/ sa la sa phra rags gnyis dang / rdo la rdo phra rags gnyis te bzhi/ skar ma la phra rags gnyis te rnam bzhi gnyis su dbye nas lha gzhu bsnan pa shin tu legs par gsungs pa 'di 'dir yang rang lugs su khas blangs par bya'o/ /'o na jo nang phyogs pas / nor las rgyal mi bgrang na khams kyis ma bsdus pa dang / stong chen yig lngas de la ma khyab par 'gyur ro/ /zhes skyon brjod pa ji ltar spang zhe na/ 'o na lus dang snod rags pa'ang der thal lo/ /skyon med de/ 'dir bshad pa snams su 'dus so zhe na/ mtshungs pa nyid do/ khor du ni rlung mnyam gnas dang / gyen rgyu dang / khyab byed dang / rus sbal dang / klu dang / rtsangs pa dang / lha sbyin rnams 'god la/ rlung bcu'i srog 'dzin nam mkha'i khams sa steng du dang thur sel ye shes yin pas 'og tu 'god/ nor las rgyal ni shi ba'i lus la'ang 'byung bas ma ning yin pa'i phyir skabs 'dir grangs su mi 'dzud pa yin no/ /steng 'og gi rlung gnyis kyi sa bon ni ha hā yin la/ shar nub kyi zung bdun gyi sa bon nam / shar dang nub kyi dang po nas re re spel te rim pa bzhin/ a ā/ i lo/ ā+oṃ lī/ e a la/ e ā la/ ya la/ yā lā rnams yin la/ 'di'i mthar k+ṣa yig byung ba na sngar bshad pa ltar nor las rgyal gyi sa bon yin te/ sa bon

ra༅༅/ /'di rnams bshad pa'i sngon de ma thag tu rlung bcu bgrangs pa'i phyir ro/ /des na kha cig nor las rgyal gyi sa bon ma yin sgo 'og tu rdo rje sems dpa'i yul la yig lnga waṃ yig dang yig drug e yig yin pa bzhin du rdo rje yan lag med pa'i yul la yig lnga haṃ yig dang yig drug k+ṣa yig tu bshad pa'i k+ṣa yig yin no zhes zer ba mi rigs te/ de lta na sa bon 'di rnams kyi nang zhig tu haṃ yig kyang 'byung bar rigs te/ rgyu mtshan khyad med pa la k+ṣa yig byung 'dug pas so / /des na ma ning ma yin pa rnams kyi sa bon thams cad dbyangs su 'dug pa/ ma snang de'i sa bon gsal byed 'dus pa'i k+ṣa yig de byung bar gsal lo/ /de ltar phyogs bzhi'i yi ge nyer brgyad po thims cad res gza' bdun gyi lhag pa'i lhar bshad de/ nyin zhag phrugs gcig gi thun mtshams bzhi la gling bzhi ru 'char ba'i phyir te/ gling 'dir de ring res gza' spen pa la yod pa'i do nub mtshan phyed kyi dus su gza' nyi ma shar lus 'phags po na shar te/ de na snga dre'i dus yin pas so / /'di'i nam langs pa'i dus na lho ru shar te/ gling rang rang gi res gza' shar ba'i dang po nam langs yin pas so/ /'dir nyi ma phyed pa'i dus nub tu shar te/ ba lang spyod kyi snga dro yin pas so/ /'dir sa sros kyi dus su byang du 'char te / sgra mi snyan pa'i snga dro yin pas so/ /de bzhin du zla ba sogs drug la'ang sbyar ro/ /'dis res gza'i 'pho mtshams nam phyed kyi dus yin pa bstan zhes lho pa grub seng zer yang mi 'thad de/ 'dzam bu gling gi nam phyed na shar lus 'phags por

des gza' dang po shar ba'i phyir ro zhes par so nga la/ de lta na nyin phyed dang sa sros mtshams yin par yang 'gyur te/ 'di'i dus de gnyis la rim pa bzhin ba lang spyod dang sgra mi snyan du dang po shar pas so/ /des na 'dis gling rang rang gi res gza' rang rang gi snga dro dang por 'pho zhes bstan la/ gling bzhi ma'i bsdo mas na zhag gcig la res gza' dang por 'char dus bzhi yod ces bstan no/ khiñtsags la sa dum bu bcu gnyis la bltos te bcu gnyis su yang 'gyur modi de/ 'dir zung bdun gyi sa bon nyer brgyad res gza' bdun gyi 'char dus bzhi la sbyar ba yin no/ /de yang nyi ma'i bzhi la rim pa bzhin du/ a āḥ ā e/ de bzhin du zla ba'i i ṛ lo tha// mig dmar gyi/ ā+o rī hṝ lū/ lhag pa'i e ar al a / phur bu'i de bzhi ring po/ pa sangs kyi ya ra la wa/ spen pa'i de bzhi ring po rnams sbyar ro/ /de ltar zung bdun gyi rnam gzhag gi nges don bstan bya'i gtso bo gang yin zhe na/ dngos su khyab bya/ phyogs bzhi'i rlung me chu sa/ snye nga 'og gi nam mkha' ye shes rnams kyis bstan pa'i chos sum cu la khyab byed gzhom med kyi stong pa lnga po 'od zer dang bcas pas khyab ste/ gzhom med kyi brda'i yi ge lnga pos sa bon gyi yi ge sum cu po thams cad la khyab pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes pa'i don ni kun tu ye shes dang ni stong pa zhi ba gnas dang bcas pa zhes pas ston no/ /ston tshul/ kha cig 'dis dbus kyi yi ge lnga las wa yig grub tshul bshad zer ba dang / kha cig sngags kyi sa bon rnams la thig les brgyan pa dgos par bstan la/ des bskyed

ra༅༅/ /rdzags rkya gnad chan po bstan zhes pa zer yang ma yin te/ 'grel par/ phyi rol gyi yi ge'i chos thams cad la rkang pa dang mgo bor rlung dang sa dag grangs ji lta ba bzhin no zhes bshad pas/ dbus kyi waṃ yig mtshan ma'i yi ge lnga las bsgrubs nas mgo bos rkang pa rlung / lus kyi khog pa nam mkha' steng gi zla phyed me/ thig le chu/ nā da ye shes su yod pa bzhin du zung bdun steng 'og gnyis dang bcas pa'i sa bon gyi yi ge sngar bshad pa rnams la yang de ji bzhin byas pas zla phyed dang thig les brgyan par gyur pa'i dper brjod dngos su bstan pa yin no/ /de ltar na khyab pa'i don/ des de la dbang basmar zhes pa tsam dang / thams cad mthar waṃ yig la sdud ces pa tsam min pa/ ngobo gcig pa'i tshul gyis khyab pa yin la/ de ltar bshad pas nges don bzhi'i ye shes lnga pos gzhi'i khams lnga'am drug gis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad kyi rang brgan 'di gsal la ngo bo dbyer med du dang / lam dang 'bras bu la yang de bzhin du sbyar bas/ snod bcud du dang lam 'bros kyi snang ba thams cad ye shes lnga'i rnam rol dang 'od zer 'phro ba las byung zhing / gzhom med kyi 'gyur med lnga'i rtsa ba can du rtogs nas spyir tha mal gyi snang zhen phra rags dang khyad par can snod bcud kyi ma dag pa'i snang ba la mtshan mara'adzin pa lag nasna rdo rje'i rnal 'byor gyi stong chen yig lnga'i rang bzhin mngon du byed par 'dod pa'i don gnyer khyad par can bskyed pa'i ched du kho bos rtogs so/ /gsum pa ni/ phyi nang gzhan gsum thams cad bden don bcu gnyis

sto da igyekhyoganasatephyi ma nyi ma'i khyim bcu gnyes dang dus sbyor bcu gnyis/ gling bzhi spyi la gnas dang nye ba'i gnas sogs bcu gnyis/ sgos 'dzam bu gling la sa dum bu bcu gnyis/ nang la lte ba'i rtsa 'dab bcu gnyis/ bu ga bcu gnyis/ rlung 'pho ba bcu gnyis/ rten tshol bcu gnyis/lus la gnas sogs bcu gnyis mang du sbyar ba/rdo rje snying 'grel nas sems can skye ba la rten 'brel bcu gnyis/ gzhan bskyed rim la steng sgo dang sgo 'khyud rta babs sogs bcu gnyis/ brten pa la rten 'brel bcu gnyis sbyar ba/ bsnyen sgrub bzhi la dman 'bring mchog gsum du dbye ba/ rdzogs rim la'ang nga dang sbyor drug la stong gzugs dang bde chen yul yul can du khu ba sogs 'bras bu la sa bcu gnyis rdzogs pa sogs yin pas so/ /de thams cad la nges don gyi rdo rje nyi ma snang ba ches khyab pa dang / yang phyi la zla ba'i cha bcu drug des bzhag pa'i mos bcu drug nang na thig le'i gnas bcu druga'apho mtshams bcu drug de gnyis kyis bzhag pa'i thig le bcu drugartsa so gnyis la dkar phyogs dang nag phyogs su phye bas bcu drug pa gnyis/ spu/ pags pa/sha khrag rus pa rtsa rkang khu ba rnams la phra rags gnyis gnyis te khams bcu drug mtshan phyed nas nyin phyed kyi bar du rlung rgyu ba rnams dkar phyogs ste rim gyi 'pho ba bco lnga dang / de'i mthar bcu drug pa/nyin phyed nas mtshan phyed kyi bar nag phyogs kyi 'pho ba bco lnga ste rlung 'pho ba bcu drug dbang dang lam la dga' ba bzhi la re re yang bzhi bzhis phye ba'i bcu drug

༄༄༄/ /dang / stong pa nyid dang de kho na nyid dang / snying rje rnams bcu drug 'bras bu la sku bcu drug la sogs pa yin la/ de thams cad la nges don gyi rdo rje zla ba dri med 'od kyis legs par khyab pa'i tshul ni tshigs bcad brgyad pas 'chad la/ de'i tshul ni dang por rdo rje zla ba'i chos bshad na/ dkar nag re re la'ang cha bcu drug bcu drug ste/ mos dga' ba/ bzang po/ rgyal ba/ stong pa/rdzogs pa ste lnga ni/ nam mal/'a rlung me chu sa'i rang bzhin rim pa ltar yin la/ de lnga yar nga la tshar gsum dang / mar ngo la tshar gsum 'char ba rnams la/ dang po/ gnyis pa/ gsum pa zhes bya ste/ dper na yar ngo'i tshas gcig ni yar ngo'i dgazha ba dang po/ mos drug ni yar ngo'i dga' ba gnyis pa/ bcu gcig ni yar ngo'i dga' ba gsum pa zhes bya la/ de bzhin du bzang po sogs la'ang sbyar zhing mar ngo la'ang 'don pa spo'o/ /de dag ni cha rags pa bco lnga yin la/ gnyis ma'i mtha' ru cha bcu drug pa re re byed pa ni cha bcu drug pa ste/ 'di brtag gonyis su/ gang phyir bcu drug cha med pas/ /'bad pas kun gyis lhag ma spang / /zhes bdag me da lha mo bco lnga las mi yong pa'i rgyu mtshan du bshad pa'i dngos bstan lta bus 'bral nas don steng na med kyi blos bzo ba yin no/ /zhes zer pa mang sdad rdzi dan la yod de/ tshas bco lnga'i zla ba nub ba lang spyod kyi dbus drang po rang du ma sleb tsam na nyi ma'i dkyil 'bor shar lus 'phags po'i dbus drang por re 'ga' yang ma sab pa yod pas/zla ba'i shar du nyi ma'i 'od zer cung zad phog pas

ma gang la/ de nas nyi ma rlung 'gros mgyogs pas zla bas nub kyi drang por sleb pa na/ nye mas kyang shar gyi drang por slob nas nyi ma'i 'od zer cung zad kyang mi reg pa'i tshe nya gang ba'i mthar thug pas tshes bco lnga legs par rdzogs/ de nas nyi mas 'a/ra lho'i zur du sleb pa na zla bas nub byang sgi zur du sleb ma nus par zla ba'i nub zur na nyi ma'i 'od zer phra mo phog ma thag nag po'i tshes gcig gi 'go rtsom la/ de gnyis kyi bar du ri rab kyis nyi ma bsgribs nas zla ba la nyi ma'i 'od zer phog 'phro rdzogs nas ting ma ma phog pa'i bar skabs yod pa'i phyir dang nag phyogs la yang nyi zla ya yo med par drang thad rang du nam slebs ma thag nag po'i bco lnga zad cing / yang nyi ma mgyogs pas nub tu cung zad thal/ zla ba'i nub tu rang gi kha khyer gyi grib ma shin tu phra ba'i 'go brtsams ma thag nas dkar phyogs kyi 'go brtsams pas/ de gnyis kyi bar skabs de nag po'i bcu drug par grub pa'i phyir dang / spyir cha bcu drug pa phyi na med na nang lus la yang cha bcu drug pa med par 'gyur la/ de gnyis med na gzhan yi ge la dbyangs bcu drug pa dang / lam la snying rje sogs bcu drug pa dang / 'bras bu la sku dang ye shes bcu drug med par yang 'gyur bas sasna/ /'o na brtag gnyis sogs su med par bshad pa ci zhe na/ de ni tshes gzhan bco lnga po dang yun tshad mnyam pa'i rags pa med pa la dgongs nas rags rtsis mdzad pa'o/ /de ltar na dkar phyogs kyi cha rnams khams dang yi ge bskyed rim gyi mthar thig le dang / nag phyogs kyi cha rnams sdud rim gyi mthar rnam bcad sbyar te yar ngo zla ba

༄༄༄/ /dang mar ngo nye ma'i chos yin sri sa so/ /de yang yar nga'i yi ge thung ngu dang / mar nga'i ring pa'o/ /yar nga'i lnga tshanagasum yang rim pa bzhin du mun pa dang rdul dang snying stobs kyi rang bzhin yin pas rtsa ba rang byung gi yi ge a i ṛ u '-i/ de'i yon tan a e zhor a zhol/ rtsa ba'i ya ṇaro bsgyur ba ha ya ra wa la rnams rim pa bzhin du sa bon du 'gyur zhing / mar ngo'i lnga tshan gsum ni yon tan gsum yang ldog pas/ yan ring po lnga dang / yon tan gyi 'phel ba lnga dong / rang byung ring po lnga rnams te/ lā wā rā yā hā/ āl a skar e ā/ lī lū hṝ ā+o ā rnams so/ /slar yang yon tan gsum po re re yang chung 'bring chen po gsum du bya zhing / dkar phyogs la ru/na pa gsal ba zhes pa dang / nag phyags la mun pa 'jug pa zhes pa'i tha snyad byas la/ tshes re re yang bu mo dang gzhon nu dang lang tsho dang gon mo dang smin pa zhes pa lnga lnga tshang ba dang / de re re la yang chung ngu dang 'bring dang chen pa'i tshad gsum gsum rdzogs pa na nub nas phyags gzhan gyi cha dang por 'jug pa yin no/ /dper na tshes gcig gi zla ba'i dkar cha gyu tsam de nyid tshes gcig la mun pa'i mun pa bsal ba chung ngu'i bu mo/ tshes gnyis kyi nyin mun pa'i mun pa bsal ba chung ngu'i gzhon nu ma/ de bzhin du sdogagasumabazhi lnga rnams la dezhi lang tsha rgan mo smin pa zhes bya la/ tshes drug nas bcu'i bar la 'bring po'i lnga/ bcu gcig nas bco lnga'i bar chen pa'i lnga rdzogs nas mar ngo'i tshes gcig la de nyid snying stobs kyi mun pa 'jug pa dang po'i bu mor
