'gyurazhing sngar bzhin du sbyar rmerme yar ngo'i tshes gcig shar ba na sngar gyi de nyid du ldog go /de bzhin du tshes gnyis la sogs pa re re nas sbyar te/ tshes drug gi zla ba'i cha kho rang gi thob cha de nyid/ tshes de la rdul gyi mun pa bsal ba chung ngu'i bu mo sogs sbyar nas tshes nyi shu la rdul gyi mun pa bsal ba chen po'i smin par gyur nas nyer gcig la rdul gyi mun pa 'jug pa chung ngu'i bu mor gyur pa sdong / tsherme bcu gcig gi cha de nyid tshes de la snying stobs kyi mun pa bsal ba chung ngu'i tshad kyi bu mo yin pa sogs sbyar bar bya'o/ /de ltar na zla ba'i dkar cha ni nub nas rim gyis bsags nas shar du cha rdzogs par 'gyur zhing / cha bcu drug pa rtsom nga/ dang mnyam du sgra gcan 'jug pas zla ba gzas 'dzin na shar nas 'dzin pas khyab rngu ra bu ston rin po ches gsung ba ni legs la/ bla ma des nag cha shar nas bsags nas nub tu rdzogs pas/ nyi ma nub nas 'dzin pas khyab ces gsu/nga ba ni mi rigs te/ tshes gcig gi cha de zla ba'i nub nyid na je gsal du song nas gnas yod pa de/ tshes bcu drug nas mun pa 'jug pa yin par rang gis bshad pa'i khas blangs dang de las ma 'das pa'i rig pa dang 'gal bas so/ /des na rang lugs ni dkar cha nag cha gnyis ka rtsom pa nub dang rdzogs pa shar du khyad med pa yin no/ /zla ba'i nag cha nub tu rdzogs na nyi shu dgu'i zla ba'i gras kha'i sgur de nub tu bstan 'ing nyi ma'i phyogs la sgur gyi kha bltas yong bar thal ba las mngon sum gyis gsal lo /kha cis gong bi cha bcu drug nga/'i sgrub byed mi 'thang de/ nyi mas sa gzhi la gling bzhi'i phyeng

ra༅༅/ /las lhag pa gsal me nus pa bzhin du nam mkha' la yang rgyu skar gyi phyed las lhag pa gsal mi nus pas tshes bco lnga la nyi glu 'i 'ong zla ba reg par 'dod pa mi 'thad pas so zhe na skyon med de/ sa gzhi la gling bzhi'i phyed las gsal mi nus pa nam mkha' dang sa gzhi'i bar 'gyangs ches pa yin pa'i phyir te/ nyi ma'i gnas nas drang thad kyi sa gzhi'i bar la yang rgya skar 'khor la'i phyed kyi thag tsa 4 ski+o rnga pas so/ /'o na zla ba 'phel 'grib tu snang ba'i rgya ci yin zhe na / chos mngon pa las/ nyi ma dang nye ba las rang gi grib ma che ru 'gro bas sgrib la/ nyi ma'i 'od zer phog pa'i cha mthong bar bshad zer ba rdeng / kha cig nyi ma'i 'od zer phog pas mthong na bco lnga'i mtshan phyed na nyi mar ri rab kyi sdung drang thad nas yod pa min par 'gyur pa dang / skar ma nyin bar mthong bar gsal ba sogs kyis gnod pas/ zla ba'i kha khyer gyi grib ma phog pa'i cha de mthong la/ nyi ma dang nye ru song nas grib ma de je chung du 'grib pas gnam gang la nyi ma'i 'od zer rdzogs par babs pas mi mthong ba yin no zhes 'dod pa dang / la cig de gnyis ka la nyi mas rgyu skar gyi 'khor le'i phyed las lhag pa mi mthong ba'i rigs pas gnod pas me long gi steng du nyi bu'i ras ma bcu drug rim gyis bsgrigs nas bzhag pa bzhin du sa'i rdul lta bu'i rdul gyis sgrib pa chos nyid kyi rigs pa ma gtogs rgyu mtshan med ces zer ba yang / de thams cad kyi nang gi rgyu mtshan cung zad kyang ma 'byor pas/ kho bo ni 'di ltar sems te/ spyir snang ba thams cad nang gi rtsa rlung dang des sad

thore yo ne zlo gis yin la/ khyad par zla ba'i 'char nub lta bu ni 'gro ba kun la mtshungs par med de/ lha phal cher la nyi zla mi snang zhing snang ba rnams la'ang zla ba'i 'phel 'grib med pas mi dang sa 'tsho sgos chos yin/ mi yang 'dzam gling chen po las kyi sa pa'i yin gyi/ nang gi gling drug gi mi la nyi zla'i 'char nub med par bshad do/ /de nas las kyi sa pa'i khams drug ldan la zla ba 'phel 'grib tu snang ba ni rlung la sbyar na g.yas g.yon gyi 'pho rlung gi steng nas ye shes kyi rlung zhag re la drug brgya don lnga re chad pa'i steng nas/ zla ba'i bu lon la ye shes re bzhi cha de'i re las med kyang nyi ma'i bu lon la so gnyis cha yod par bshad la/ nang gi nyi ma ni g.yas 'pho dang / g.yon snapo ni zla ba yin pas de gnyis kyi myar bul gyi khyad kyis phyi ru yang de ltar byung ba yin no/ /de las kyang nang gi dkar cha'i 'phel 'grib kyi dbang gis yin te/ nang gi zla ba ni dkar cha dang dmar cha 'di nyi ma yin par kun la grags shing / phyi'i nyi ma'i nye ring gi dbang lis zla ba rle 'phel 'grib 'byung ba 'di yang nang gi nyi mas zla ba nyams par byas pa yin la/ de'i tshul ni sgrub le'i brgya nyer lnga par bshad pa bzhin du lus kyi g.yon phyogs kyi gnas bco lnga la thig le mas rim gyis yar 'gro ba dang / g.yas kyi gnas bco lnga la yas rim gyis mar 'gro bar gzhung sazhan nas kyang bshad la/ de yang 'jam dpal 'al lung sogs nas tshwal gzhan du bshad kyang 'dir rkang pa'i sor tshigs gsum/ long bu/ pus mo/ dbyi'i tshigs gsum / lag pa'i sor tshigs

༄༄༄/ /gsum/ mkhrig ma/ dpung pa/ phyag pa'i tshigs gsum/ snying ga mgrin pa/ dpral ba'i tshigs rnams ni gnas bco lnga ste/ de yang yar ngo'i tshes gcelge la rkang pa g.yon pa'i tshigs tha ma/ tshes gnyis la tshigs bar ma sogs rim gyis sbyar nas tshes bco lnga la dgal bar slebs nas nya gang ba'i mthar cha bcu drug pa la gtsug tor du 'gro zhing bcu drug pa rdzogs pa na gtsug tor nas 'ongs nas mar ngo'i tshes gcig la dpral ba gnyis la mgrin pa sogs sngar gyi lugs ldog g.yas la 'ongs nas tshes bco lnga la rkang pa g.yas kyi tshigs tha mar slebs nas gnam stong rdzogs pa'i mthar cha bcu drug pa la sen mo'i rtse'i bar du 'gro zhes gsungs pa 'di'i steng nas legs par shes dgos so/ /de yang 'di ltar/ gnas de dang der 'gro zhes pas thig le ril bu lta bu zhig gnas gnyis par 'phos pa na/ dang pa'i gnas su gtan med du song ba lta bu ni 'ong don meng de/ de lta na yar ngo la 'phel ba dang / mar ngo la 'grib pa'i khyad par mi 'thad pa'i phyir ro/ /des na yar ngo'i tshes gcig la rkang sor gyi tshigs tha mar tshes gcig si zla ba'i cha tsam skya khyug pa zhig shar ba de/ tshes gnyis la gnas de dang tshigs bar pa gnyis mar du tshes gnyis kyi zla ba'i dkar cha tsam re shar/ tshes/ gsum sna de gnyis dang rtsa ba'i tshigs gsum char du tshes gsum gyi dkar cha tsam du 'gyur ba nas bzung ste/ tshes bco lnga la dgral ba'i bar gyi gnas bco lnga po thams cad du nya gang ba'i tshul gyis rdzogs shing / zla ba phyed po de'i bar du g.yon

phyogs kri/ dkar charnams rim gyis 'grib shime / g.yas phyogs dmar cha kho nas gang nas dkar cha mi mngon par gyur pa yin no/ /de nas cha bcu drug pa/ rdzogs pa'i mthar dkar cha g.yas kyi phyogs la babs bar brtsams pa na/ dpral/ bar dkar cha'i cha cung zad nyams pa dang dus mnyam du rkang pa g.yon gyi tshigs 'phreng tha ma'i cha nas kyang cung zad nyams te/ tshes bcu drug li zla ba bzhin du gyur/ de bzhin du g.yas phyogs kyi dkar cha mar babs rim gyis chung du 'gyur ba bzhin du g.yon gyi dkar cha yar 'dzegs rim gyis je chung du gyur te/ gnam gang la lus kyi phyogs gnyis pa'i dkar cha rnams dmar chas non nas mi snang bar 'gyur te/ nyi ma kho na 'byung la 'di'i mthar dmar cha la dang / snga ma'i mtharadakar cha la nang rgi sgra gakhon dbu ma la 'jug pa'i skabs khyad par ba zhig yo nga ba yin par sems so/ /de lta na gnam gang la gnas thams cad dmar chas gang ba ba'in du bco lnga la dkar chas gang bar rigs mod/ bco lnga 'u/sa kyi g.yas phyogs mtha' dag dmar po mi 'thad do zhe na/ de nyid kyis tshes bco lnga'i nub mo gling bzhi'i phyed nyi mas khyab cing zla ba mthong ba yin la/ gnam gang li nyin zhag la ni gling bzhi mtha' dag na zla ba mi snang bar 'grub pa yin pas/ nang gi nyi zla'i 'char nub kyi dbangari gis/ci phyi rol/ gyi nyi zla'i 'char nub dang 'phel 'grib 'grub pa yin te/ sngon chang gangs ri'i khrod du rma ngon du ma gyur pa'i phyi nang li rngo rje nyi zla'i snam par bzhig pa 'di lnga dang bla ma la gsol ba btab pas/ legs par rnyed pa ni skal ba bzang zhes

sngar〉༅ /gtam du brjod par bya'o/ /'dis mtshon nas las mthun snang du bsags pas bag chags mthun zhing de'i dbang gis nang gi rlung dang byang se/mas kyi gnas tshul mthun pa dag la phyi rol gyi snang ba mthun par 'char pa yin no zhes yid ches par bya ste/ rgyas par spos pas chog go /de ni rdo rje nyi ma'i chos bcu gnyis kyi 'phel 'grib dang sa bon gyi yi ge cung zad brjod na/ zla ba'i chos de nyid bcu drug zla ba re re la sbyar dgos pa bzhin du nyi ma'i chos bden don rnam pa bcu gnyis lo re la gtso bor sbyar dgos spros/ lo gcig la khyim mam dus sbyor bcu gnyis/ de re re la zhag sum cu sum cu ban+do mas pas zhag sum brgya drug cu/ de yang bsdu na byang bgrod dang lho bgrod kyi bgrod pa gnyis su 'dus te / bgrod pa re la khyim drug re dang zhag brgya dang brgyad cu re yod pas so/ /de yang khyim gyi rnam gzhag rgyas pa zhig 'og tu 'chad dgos pas/ 'dir skabs su bab pa tsam brjod na/ shar seng bu mo gsum/ srang sdig gzhu gsum po lho bgrong kye khyim yin te/ dbyar nyi log nas dgun nyi ldog ldog gi bar gyi khyim yi na pas so/ /chu srin bum pa nya gsum/ lug glang 'khrig gsum/ rnams byang bgrod kyi khyim/ yin te/ dgun nyi log nas dbyar nyi ldog ldog gi bar yin pas so/ /de yang da lta dus sbyo ra gyi rtsis dang nyi ma ldog mtshams/ ma mthun pa 'byung ba ni/ gzhung nas bshad pa kai lā sha'i dbang du byas la/ 'dir bod kyi nyi ma ldog mtsham sa ma mthun pa yin la/ zhib par na 'dzam gling la yul dum bu drug dang de rnam/sa la nyin mtshan

'phel 'grib kri yurme med byang nas rim pa bzhin du lnga cha dang / drug cha dang bdun cha dang brgyad cha dang dgu cha dang bcu char bshad pa'i khyad par yin la/ dum bu drug ni/ gangs ldan chen po dang / sum+bha la'am/ kai lā sha dang / rgya nag dang / li yul dang / bod dang / 'phags yul rnams so/ /de ltar lho bgrod drug la gsal byed ka tsa ṭa pa ta sa rnams kyi sde pa re re bzhin lnga pa nas bgrangs pa'i yi ge re re la dbyangs a i ṛ 'a/ t+pa e ste drug drug sbyar/ de yang gsal byed re re pa la dbyangs thung ngu zhugs pa ste/ dper na/ da di rdar du blo ngo zhes sogs sde pa re re'i sum cu sum cus zla re spyod la / byang bgrod drug la/ dbyangs thig le can gyi tshab tu tsheg drag can bcug la/ dbyangs rirngo por byas pa snga ma las ldog nas sdud rim bzhin dang / gsal byed kyang sa sde nas mgo bo btsugs shing / re re'i yang dang po nas sdud rim du byas pa'i gsal byed nyis brtsegs bya ste/ dper na/ 6ཿ (lāḥ smaḥ (spyi smi: smaḥ zhes sogs sbyar ba'i sum cu pa drug gis zla ba drug gi zhag re la spyod pa yin te/ ma/dor na lho bgrod la dbyangs gsal thams cad spro rim dang / byang bgrod la sdud rim du sbyar ba'o/ /de'i rgyu mtshan yang spyir nyin zlotshan gnyis3 ) mtsharno mo sh+lau ba'am thabs kyi chos dang / nyin mo nyi ma/'am shes rab kyi chos yin la/ lho bgrod la mtshan mo 'phel zhing / byang bgrod la nyin mo 'phel ba'i phyir dang / zla ba'i chos la spro rim dang nyi ma'i chos la sdud rim du 'byung ba'i nges pa yin phyir dang / gsal byed kyang re re la zla ba

ra༅༅/ /dang / nyis brtsegs nyi ma yin zhing dgengs kyang thung ngu zla ba dang ring pa nyi ma yin zhing / zhar la shin tu ring po gsum yun can lta bu rnams sgra gcan yin/ spyir dbyangs zla ba dang gsal byed nyi ma yin pa/ sogs nges pas gsal byed gcig la dbyangs thung ngu zhugs pa zla nyi sbyar ba yin kyang dbyangs thung ring la bltos pa'i cha nas zla ba rkyang pa/ gsal byed nyis brtsegs la dbyangs ring po zhugs pa nyi ma rkyang pa/ des mtshon nas gzhan la'angasbyar bar bshad do/ /de ltar sa bon nam yi ge rnams tshes de dag la 98 char zhing sa bon byed ces pa'ang 'og dbyangs 'char nas 'byung ba bzhin du tshes de dag gi dus kyi nang gi rlung rnams de ltar 'char bar bshad pa bzhin du nang gi rlung gi byed las phyi ru spyir dus sbyor che chung 'char zhing khyad par khyim rnams kyi tshes kyi yi ge 'char baṅge/ gtso bor gzhan yi ge dang phyi nang sbyar ba'i phyi nang gzhan gsum gyi rnam gzhag yin la/ 'dir zla nyi sgra gcan gsum po thung ring shin tu ring por bshad pa la/ bu ston rin po ches / 'di rnams kyi nor gyi cha rnams ldog nas gnas kyang / bu lon gyi dbang gis yin te zhag re'i ye shes cha'i drug cu rtsa bzhi cha dang / so gnyis cha dang / bcu drug cha rim pa bzhin gyi bu lon du yod pas so/ /zhes gsungs nas de'i rgyu mtshan ma bshad kyang / de'i rgyu mtshan ni/ g.yon dang g.yas dang mnyam rgyu'i rlung gsum rgyu ba dal myur dang shin tu myur pas yin no/ /de ltar na phyi'i dus sbyo ra dang nang gi dus sbyor thams cad gtso bor khams drug dang yi ge'i nang nas gsal byed

gtso che bas stong pa yig drug gtso che zhing / snga ma rdo rje zla ba'i chos ni phung po dang dbyangs gtso che bas stong chen yig lnga gtso bor gyur ba yin mod kyi snga ma la bcu drug cha yod pas gnyis ka sbyor ba bzhin du 'di la'ang dbyangs dang phung po'i chos kyang yod pa sa gnyis ka sbyar bar shes par bya'o/ /de ltar na 'di gnyis kyang stong chen yig lnga dang thig le yig drug gis khyab bya las ma 'das so/ /de gnyis ka la sbyar du rung ba'i zhag re'i chu tshod drug cu la ni ha ya ra wa la lnga la dbyangs sngar gyi bcu gnyis po spro rim dang / sdud rim du sbyar nas mtshan mo 'phel ba la dbyangs thung ngu spro rim sbyar ba sum cu/ nyi ma phyed nas mtshan phyed kyi bar gyi chu tshod sum cu la spyod cing / nam phyed nas nyin phyed kyi bar la yang de nyid bskyar nas spyod la/ nyin mo 'phel pa la dbyangs ring po sdud rim gyi mtshan phyed nas nyin phyed kyi bar la spyod cing / de bzhin du bskyar nas spyod de/ 'o na zhag re la nyin mtshan gyi chos dang zla nyi dang thabs shes ma tshang bar mi 'gyur ram zhe na/ thung ngu thabs kyi cha yang lus kyi sgo nas yin gyi bsam pa'i cha nas shes rab yin la/ ring po de las ldog pas so/ /de ltar na zhag re la yang nyi zla dbyangs gsal thabs shes sbyar bas gzhi'i rdo rje zla nyi legs par gnas pa yin la/ nyi zla'i 'char nub dang 'phel 'grib phyi nang du 'byung ba'i phra rags 'di thams cad kyang rdo rje rnal 'byor gyi rlung sems kye 'pho 'gyur ma tha' dag bcom pa na/ sgrib bral gyi rdo rje nyi zla dang e waṃ dang rnam bcu dbang lngan mngon du 'gyur bar shes par bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ dgrangs gsal gyi

ra༅༅/ /khams dang 'byang sa'i gnas rnams gang zhe na/ 'dir tshigs bcad dgu pa dang / sgab le'i snga gas bzlas pa'i rnam gzhag li skabs dang / ye le'i tshigs bcad drag rnga/ sogs kyis gsungs pa'i don bsdu na / dbyangs kyi a yig bis de rang rgi rirjo po dang yon tan dang 'phel ba dang ya ṇar bsgrar ba thams cad mtshon par byerdo pas 'byung sa'i gnas dang khams rnams gcig ste/ dper na/ a dang de'i greng po ā dang yon tan a e ar a zhol gyi nang tshan gyi a dang / 'phel ba ā e ār a āl gyi nang tshan gyi ā dang / ya ṇarngo bsgyur ba ha ya ra wa la'i nang tshan gyi ha ring thung rnams gcig pa'o/ /de bzhin du zhos kyang ā+oṃ dang e dang e dang ya ring thung sogs so/ /de bzhin du u ta kyi sde dang bcas pa'o/ /zhes bshad pas/ ku zhes pas ka sde dang / tsu zhes pas tsa sde sdud pa sogs yin la/ sa sde so sor phral nas sbyor dgos pas/ bsdoms tshig tu brjod na/ a ku ha zla mgrin pa las/ /i tsu ya sha rkan las 'byung / /ṛ ṭa da ṣa spyi bo las/ /u pu wa ba mchu las 'byung / /la tu la sa so las te/ /rjes su sna ldan sna las kyang / /zhes par 'bul/ 'di la ni ya ṇar bsgyur ba rnams byang a yig sogs las zur du byas pa'o/ /rjes su sna ldan ni sde pa'i lnga pa rnams dang klad kor gyi ming yin la/ tsheg drag ni ka dang kha'i ste nga du bzhag pa ni/ thaka zhes pa lce rtsa can du grags la/ pa dang pha'i steng du bzhag pa ni/ zhes pa mchu can du grags pa ste/ de gnyis gang nas 'byung ni bshad zin

la / tsheg drag can gzhan rnams ni grogs kyi dbang gis ra dang sa gang rung du 'dus pa yin/ de dag gi khams ni/ mgrin pa dang / rkan dang / spyi bo dang / mchu dang / so las 'byung ba rngams rim pa bzhin du nam mkha' rlung me chu sa'i khams yin la/ spyir sa sde zur du bgrang na ye shes kyi khams dang dbyangs gsal gyi ha sogs lnga yang ye shes kyi khams su bshad la/ gnas kyi rtsa ba ni/ mgrin 'byung sogs sde lnga po rim pa bzhin du/ gtsug tor/ snying ga ma grin pa / dpral ba/ lte ba rnams kyi 'khor lo rnams yin par gsungs te/ bzlas pa byed pa'i tshe skye gnas dang khams kyi steng nas rang gi ming yig dang po dang dgra grogs phal gsum brtsi bar bya la/ bsgom pa'i tshe 'khor lo de rnams su skye rim gyi phung po lnga dang khams lnga'i lhag pa'i lha gshegs pa gshegs ma sogs dang ldan par kha dog rim pa bzhin ljang nag dmar dkar ser pa dang / khams drug pa byed na sngon po gsang gnas kyi 'khor lo bsgom par bya la/ de ltar gnas dang yi ge khams ma 'khrags par 'og gi yan lag drag kyang 'god dgos par 'dir gsungs pas/ sang dag yan lag drug dgod 'og ma mi 'dod pa mi rigs sesgo/ /'ji dag gi rnam gzhag rgyas par sgra ka lā pa'i spyi don chen mor bshad zin cing / thun mong ma yin dro rnam sa 'og dbyangs 'char wang bcas pa'i ske bas su bshad par bya'o/ /da ni gnyis pa/ kun rdzob drang don gyi 'jig rten bshad pa la gsum/ chags zin ji ltar 'jig tshul/ zhig nas ji ltar chags tshul/ chags pa ji lta ra

༄༄༄/ /gnas tshul lo/ /dngapo ni/ spyir rgyad sde gzhan rnams sbyang gzhi sbyor ba sogs kyi 'jig rten 'jig 'byung gnas pa'i tshul ni/ chos mngon pa dang bstan par rnam gzhag rim pa dang man ngag snye ma sogs nas bshad la / 'dir ni ru stegs rdul phran 'dod pa rnams rjes su bzung ba jong / rdo rje slob dpon thos pas rgan par byed pa la nyan thos kyi sde snod shes dgos la/ de khyim pas rdzogs par slob tu mi rung bas slob dpon gyi gtso bo dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa la gus pa bskyed pa'i phyir du/ bye brag smra ba 'dod pa ltar gyi rdul phran tsam zhig 'jig 'byang gnas pa'i rgyur khas len par khams le dang ye le gnyis mar du gsungs shing / de yang khams ler 'byung ba'i rgyu gtso bor gsungs la/ ye ler thog mar 'jig pa'i rgyu gsungs pa dang bstun nas bshad par bya ba la/ spyir stong pa'i rdul/ grags pa/ khams rang rang gi phra ba'i mthar thug pa drug ste/ sa chu me/ rlung nam mkha' ye shes kyi stong rdul drug 'de+od kyang / 'jig byed kyi rdul ni rigs pa bzhi'i steng nas bshad la/ de yang mngon pa dang 'jig byed mi mthun te/ mngon pa nas/ me yis bdun no chu yis gcig /de ltar chu bdun thal nas kyang / /ma yis bdun no de nas kyang / /mjug tu rlung gis 'jig pa yin/ /zhes 'jig byed me chu rlung gsum du nges pa dang / de yang mes 'jig nga drug la chus 'jig bdun rdzogs pa dang / kun gyi mjug tu rlung gis 'jig thengs gcig las/ mi 'byung ba dang / 'jig cha yang mes 'jig la bsam gtan dang po man dang / chus

'jig la gnyis pa dang / rlung 'jig la gsum pa man 'jig go /bzhi pa yan chad 'jig byed kyis mi 'jig pa sogs sagad kyang 'dir dag pa'i 'jig rten las kyis ma bskyed pa rnams mi 'jig par mngon pa bzhin du bshad/ ma dag pa las nyon gyis bskyed pa mtha' dag 'jig byar bshad cing / 'jig byed dang / 'byung byed dang / gnas byed mtha' dag rlung gi steng nas 'jog la/ de yang 'jig byed la/ brtan pa'i dang / g.yo ba'i rlung rdul gnyis su bshad pa'i dang po ni/ nam mkha' de nyid du mi mngon par gnas pa dang / gnyis pa ni/ rnam par ces pa'i chos can yin pas zhing gzhan du 'egro ste snga mas snod 'jig 'byang dang phyi mas bcud 'jig 'byang gi rgyu byed do/ /de gnyis kyang sems can gyi thun mong dang so so'i las kyis bskyed pa ste/ rtsa ba'i rgyu ni las nyon kho nar rnam pa kun tu gsungs so/ /de yang spyir las kyi mthu las nang du srog gi rlung bcu 'grubakā bzhin du phyi rol yang rlung bzlos bya ba byed la/ de'i tshul ni/ chags pa'i tshe srab byed kyi rlung gis khams thams cad sra bar byas nas gnas pa de spyi mthun gyi la sa zad pa na/ snod 'jig byed kyi rlung rdul des dang po/ra sa'i rdul las chu sogs phye nas gsil bur gnas pa de chu la lan tshwa bzhin du 'ju bar byed cing / de las chu/ la phye ba de me yis bar+sāms pa dang / de las phye ba'i me de rlung sis sasod cing / rlung rdul de nyid nam mkha' la mi snang bar gnas la/ 'di bye brag pa rtag par 'dod kyang 'dir mi rtag pa dang / da gzod 'jig rten chags pa'i rgyur khas len no/ /de ltar na mu

ra༅༅/ /stegs kha cig 'og nas dus kyi me zhes bya ba'i lha zhig gis 'ongs nas des 'jig rten za bar 'dod mi rigs so thes bkag nas/ 'jig byed kyi rlung rdul de la dus me zhes 'dogs na ni mi 'gog par gsungs so/ /g.yo ba'i rdul de ni sems dang ngo bo gcis pa'i rlang yin pas/ de nyid zhing gzhan du song ste sems can rang rang li lus 'grub par byed la/ de'i tshe dag pa'i zhing khams mi 'jig pa'i tshul yang dag pa'i rdul phran stong gzugs kyi rang bzhin sa bcu po rnams la brten nas gnas pa ste/ ji sring sems can gyi tshogs gnyis mngon du ma gyur gyi bar du nam mkha' chos sku'i tshul gyis bzhugs pa dang / las bzang po mngon du gyur pa na gzugs ska snang bar gsungs te/ ye le'i brgya re lnga re drug pa rtsa 'grel du shes par bya'o/ /de yang sno da zhig pa'i rjes su rnam par shes pa'i chos can gyi rlung ma dag pa'i zhing gzhan du 'gro bar gsungs pas/ snod bcud rags pa'i khams rnam/sa mnyam du zlojig par grub bo/ /gnyis pa ni/ spyir snod bcud kyi 'jig rten sdug bsngal gyi bden pas bsdas pa 'di'i dngos kyi rgyu ni stong pa'i rdul phran drag po yin te/ ye shes khams kyi stong rdul ni/ chos nyid la rdul du ming btags pa yin pas chos can thams cad chos nyid kyi dbang gis 'byung bar mdo sngags gzhan nas 'byung ba bzhin du kun gyi khron mong gi gzhi'am rgyu yin la/ nam mkha'i r+shams kyi stong rdul 'di la bsdus pa 'di'i dngos kyi rgyu ni gzugs can kun gyi sgo 'byed pa'i nam mkha' la bzhag pa zhig dang / sgra'i yon tan gcig pu

dang ldan pa'i nam mkha' gzugs med khams pa'i rgyur 'gro ba zhig kyang khas len dgos pa ne dngos su ma bshad kyang rigs pas 'grub cing / rlung rdul sogs bzhi pos 'jig rten rags pa rtsom tshul khams le'i tshigs bcad bzhi pa'i 'grel par 'byung ba bzhin rlung rdul nam mkha' la ma 'byar ba'i dbang gis mi snang bar gnas pa rnams las kyi nus pas 'dab 'byar du gyur pas rlung gi dkyil 'khor dang / de dang me rdul 'byar ba phrad nas me ste glog dang / de dang chu rdul 'byar ba phrad pas char pa dang / de dang sa rdul 'byar ba phrad pas 'ja' tshon rnams dang por 'grub la de nas rim gyis rlung rdul 'phel ba 'dzin byed dang srub byed dang dbyebs byed pa'i rlung gsum du gyur pa'i dang pos mi ltang bar nam mkhar 'dzin/ gnyis pas lan tshwa'i chu nyi mas gdungs pa bzhin du sra bar byed/ gsum pas stong pa'i rdul gyi dbus su snod bskyed pa la chu la lan tshwa bzhin du dang / bcud bskyed pa la sgo nga'i dbus su sgong skyes kyi lus dbyibs rim gyis dod pa bzhin du sgrub par byed pas / snod kyi dkyil 'khor chen po bzhi dang ri rab lhun po dang gzhan ri bdun dang / gling bdun dang / rgya mtsho bdun dang / rgyu skar dang / nyi zla gza' skar dang / drang srong bdun gyi gnas la sogs pa grub cing / bcud kyi lha klu 'byung ngo / dud 'gro mi dang dmyal ba sogs 'grub par byed do/ /'dir dud 'gro skye gnas rnam pa bzhi zhes pa'i skabs su rdzus te skyes pa ni ljon pa la sogs pa ste sa'i skye gnas so shes gsungs pa la brten nas/ kha cig gis/ ljon shing dud 'gro'i

ra༅༅/ /skye gnas su bstan pas sems ldan yin zhes zer/ kha cig de gcer bu pa'i lugs dang khyad med pas dus 'khor skyon bcas su grub zer/ bu ston rin po che/ 'di rwa pas shing du bsgyur cing shing gi skad dod yod med kyi ljon pa rta mgo can nam/ ljon pa'i ming can dud 'gro mi gzugs can nam/ yang na mdo sde 'dzangs blun nas shing la srin bus zos pas shing nyen skad 'don par bshad pa lta bu nyi tshe ba'i dpyal ba yin gsung / bla ma dam pa ljon pa rta mgo can dud 'gror sdud pa yin gsung ngo / /'di ni mi 'thad de/ rgya bod gnyis sha'i skad la shing du yod kyang shing ma yin zhes par 'dug pas 'grel pa 'gog par gsal la/ de ltar bkag na gnas skabs mang por 'grel pa 'gog dgos par 'gyur te /ci 'og tu lha min gdengs can 'byung po'i skye gnas zhes pa'i 'grel par/ 'byung po'i skye gnas ni sngar brjod pa bzhin no/ /brtan pa'i skye gnas ni lhun po dang shing la sogs pa ste/ de dag thams cad sngags kyi ming gis ming can du byas pa'i sngags su 'gyur ro zhes bshad pa dang / sgrub ler dngos po'i skye ba rnam pa brgyad kyi skabs su de ltar sa'i skye ba ni shing la sogs pa brtan pa rnams so/ /zhes pa rnams kyis shing thams cad rta mgo can nam/ dud 'gro'am/ dmyal bar sdud dgos par 'gyur ro/ /khyad par 'di sa'i skye gnas su bshad pa 'di dmyal ba yin zhes gsung ba ni mi 'thad pa shin tu che ste/ skye ba brgyad kyi skabs su sa chu me rlung gi bzhi dang / nam mkha'i skye ba la zla ba'i skye ba klu dang lha min/ nyi rma 'i skye ba lha

dang 'byung po gnyis/ rnam shes kyi skye ba la sgra gcan gyi skye ba gzugs med/ dus me'i skye ba dpyal bar bshad pas/ dpyal ba skye gnas phra ba'i mthar thug de rags pa'i mthar thug tu mdzad pas so/ /bla ma dam pas kyang de bzhin ro'iskye gnas ni rdzus te skyes pa yin no/ /zhes pa ro'i skye gnas kyi mtshan gzhi sgrub ler bshad pa'i gzugs med la mdzad pa 'di yang mtshan gzhi'i gtso bo ma zin te/ ro zhes pa nam mkha' la zer bar khas blangs nas rnam shes kyi skye ba mtshan gzhir bzung bas so / /des na jo nang phyogs pas 'dir brtan g.yo gnyis ma'i skye gnas ngos bzung ba yin pas ljon pa dang lhun po sgra drang thad yin la/ de da lta yongs grags kyi rdzus skyes dang mi gcig ces bshad pa legs mod sgo des kyang de ma thag pa'i rdzus skyes chen po 'di rtsa tshig gis ma bstan zhes bris pas/ ljon shing dud 'gro skye gnas rnam pa bzhi zhes pa'i nang du bsdus pas ljon pa de dud 'gro'i gzhi mthun du khas blangs so/ /des na brtan pa'i skye ba 'di zhar byung yin la/ mo'i skye ba 'di la dud 'gro rdzus skyes dang / 'gro ba gzhan gyi rdzus skyes la skye ba brgyad kyi nang gi nam mkha'i gnyis dang rnam shes kyi gnyis po thams cad bsdus te/ mdor na dud 'gro la mtshan gzhi gtso bor sbyar ba'i 'gro ba kun gyi skye gnas bzhi dang / zhar la snod 'grub pa yang rdzus skyes bzhin du nam mkha' la rang 'khrungs lta bur yong bas rdzus skyes dang 'dra bas rdzus skyes te de yang sa'i rdzus skyes yin pas so/ /des na ljon shing la sogs dud 'gro'i skye bar bsdus/ 'di ni gcer bu pa yi lugs bzang

ra༅༅/ /yin/ /zhes pas skyon med de/ dud 'gro'i skye bar ma bsdus pa'i phyir te/ rtsa bas kyang dud 'gro'i skye gnas rnam pa bzhi dang / zhes ma gsungs zhi dud 'gro skye gnas rnam pa bzhi zhes gsungs pa dang / 'grel pa'i dgongs pa yang ji skad bshad pa bzhin gnas pas so/ /yang 'di rnams su sa'i skye gnas sogs bshad pas 'khral nas/ 'gro ba 'byung ba'i skye gnas can du bshad/ /'di ni tshur rol mdzes pa'i gzhung lugs yin/ /zhes zer ba'ang mi 'jug ste/ rgyang phan/ sa sogs rnam shes kyi nyer len du 'dod la/ 'dir lhan cig byed rkyen du 'dod pas so/ /jo lta min na mngal skyes sgong skyes kun la grags pas/ mngang lo dang sgo nga rnam shes kyi nyer len du 'gyur ro/ /gsum pa la don dam par tshad dang dbyebs nges pa med pa/ kun rdzob tu tshad dbyibs nges pa'i rgyu/ 'dir bstan gyi snod rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ skabs 'di lta bu la sogs pa rnams su don dam dang kun rdzob bshad pa'i don ni/ 'jig rten pa'i las snang ngam 'bral snang la kun rdzob dang / las snang las grol ba'i gzugs kyi snang ba don dam du byas pa yin no/ /des na don dam par nges pa med de/ nges pa zhig yod na/ 'jig rten gyi tshad dbyibs mtha' gcig tu nges dgos la/ nges na tshad dbyibasaca mi 'dra ba gsungs pa rnams kyi gang rung zhig las gzhan pa rnams tshad mas ma grub pa'i drang don 'ba' zhig tu 'gro dgos pas so/ /'di la gong du brjod pa ltar kha cig mngon pa nas gsungs pa nges don dang 'dir bshad drang

don / kha cig ldog ste smra ba dang / kha cig gzhi tha dad du smra ba dang / kha cig snang ba sems su ston pa yin pas gnyis ka la don med par smra ba sogs mang du byung yang / las snang mi mthun pa la ni gnyis ka yang mi snang la/ las snang mthun pa so so la ni gzhi gcig tu gnyis ka snang ba mi 'gal zhing / 'phral gyi 'khral rgyus ma bslad pa'i las snang brtan shos kyis mngon sum la tshad mar ma bzhag pa na/ tha snyad pa'i tshad ma mi rnyed pas na/ tha snyad pa'i tshad ma'i don 'di grub la 'di ma grub pa'i rnam dbye med la las snang sa bon dang bcas /'i skyon las grolarā 'i sangs rgyas la ni/ 'di la snang ba 'di shar 'dug na'ang 'di la de dang mi mthun pa 'dir shar 'dug ces pa'i ye shes kyi gzigs pa thogs med du zhugs nas rang rang gi snang ba dang mthun par chos ston gyi rang dbang gi snang ba gcig tu nges pa cung zad kyang med par ye shes le'u'i re dgu pas legs par bstan no/ /de bzhin du mdo dang bstan bcos du ma las snang ba ngan pa thams cad mi dge ba dang / bzang po thams cad dbe ba'i dbang gis 'char bar mgrin gcig tu gsungs pa bzhin khams le'i mdor sngas brgyad pa'i mgor yang khra lnga pa'i sa phug tu 'khor los sgyur rgyal sde dang bcas pa yangs dog med par shong ba de der bzhugs byang sems lta bu'i ye shes kyi mthu dang / 'khor los sbyar ba'i bsod nams kyi mthus yin pa'i rigs pa dang / mjug tu rtsa rgyud kyi lung gis rlogs par bsgrubs so/ /gnyis pa ni/ 'o na mngon pa dang mi mthun pa'i tshad gsungs pa'i rgyu mtshan dang dgos pa ci the

ra༅༅/ /na/ sangs rgyas pa'i mdzod dang rig byed kyi grub mtha' sna tshogs nas tshad dbyebs sna tshogs gsungs pa rnams las snang so so'i dbang gis mi 'gal yang / 'dir 'bum phrag bzhi pa'i 'jig rten 'di nyid ston cing tshangs pa'i yul la dpag tshad bye ba'i khyon 'gog pa'i rgyu mtshan/ nang lus dang gzhan dkyil 'khor dang dag pa'i chos mthun nam sbyang gzhi sbyong byed sbyor ba na 'di kho na ltar gnas la/ gzhan la de ltar mi 'grig pas so/ /des na 'dir/ ji ltar phyi rol de bzhin lus/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir 'jig rten gyi khams kyi tshad 'jig rten gyi khams dkyil 'khor gyi don dang lus kyi tshad lus kyi dkyir/ 'bor gyi don du ste/ lus ni dkyil 'bor zhes brjod do zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes pa'i 'grel tshig 'gyur cung zad bcos te/ lus kyi don gyis dkyil 'bor lus kyi tshad dang / dkyil 'khor gyi don du 'jig rten khams kyi tshad kyis 'jig rten gyi khams te zhes par shin tu gsal lo/ /dgos pa ni/ tshangs pa'i yul la dpag tshad bye ba'i khron yang las snang mthun pa la mi 'gal mod sgo de ltar 'dod pa de nyi ma'i shing rta sogs kyi dgag yul yin pas/ de dang mthun par 'gog pas bstan na de dag yongs su smin cing lam dang 'bras bu chen po la 'god pa'i dgos pa gzigs pa ste bshad kyang zin to/ /de ltar na rgyu mtshan sbyang gzhi 'grig pa dang dgos pa drang srong 'dul ba'i phyir na/ kun rdzob las snang mthun pa la skabs 'dir 'di kho na bshad par bya'o/ /gsum pa la/ las dang longs spyod kyi 'jig rten

spyi'i rnam gzhag bsdus te bsten/ las sa gco bor gyur pa'i 'jig rten gcig rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ ye ler/ dbyibs kyi rlung srog thur la sogs pa bcu yis sangs rgyas kyi zhing mtha' yas pa dus gcig tu chags par byed pa'i gling bzhi pa so so ba thams cad khor yug gi ri bo chen po gcig gis bskor nas gnas te/ nang gi rlung bcus lus kyi rtsa du ma chags par byed la thams cad kyi mtha' pags pa dang ba spus bskor ba bzhin du gnas pa dang / rtsa'i nang nas gtso bo a ba dh+ra tī sogs gsum steng 'og gi lam drug dang bcas pa dbus na gnas pa lta bu ni las sa gtso bor gyur pa'i gling bzhi pa 'di yin la/ rtsa lhag ma rlung mi rgyu bar khrag gis gang ba lta bu ni gling bzhi pa gzhan rnams longs spyod kyi sa yin par bstan no she /'dir a ba ñtsi tī gcig ji lta ba bzhin no zhes pa ni/ gzhan rnams khrag gis gang ba'i rtsar bshad pa'i shugs kyis 'khor dang bcas pa la dgongs par byed dgos te/ gzhan du na ro rkyang nas rlung mi 'bab par 'gyur ro/ /'di dag gis ni bcom ral la sogs pas 'jig rten gyi khams rgya chad du bshad ces mngon pa nas 'byung ba'i stong spyi phud la sogs pa'i rnam bzhag dang mthun par 'jig rten mtha' med du ma bshad do zhes/ zer ba rnams legs par bkag ste/ dgag sgrub byed pa kun gyis gzhung lugs/ de'i stod smad kun la gzigs long yod pa re mdzad du gsol/ 'di ni mdo sde 'ga' zhig tu stong gsum mi mjed 'di yi nang tshan gyi gling bzhi pa gzhan mang po dag pa'i 'jig rten dang / gling bzhi pa 'di ma dag pa'i 'jig

ra༅༄/ /rten du bshad pa dang mthun par snang ngo / /gnyis pa la/ snod bcud spyi'i rnam gzhag thun mong du bstan/ 'dzam gling chen po'i rnam gzhag khyad par du bshad/ 'dzam gling chung ngu'i rnam gzhag bye brag tu bstan pa'o/ /dang po la gang du zhabor ba snod kyi 'jig rten gang zhig 'khor ba bcud kyi sems can/ ji ltar zhabor ba dus bzhi'i rnam gzhag go /dang po la snod zlum po'i tshad dbyebs rgyas par bshad pa/ de nang dang gzhan gyi tshad dbyebs la sbyar ba'o/ ri/dang po la dngos dang / 'jal byed bshad pa'o/ /dang po la dkyil zhalor bzhi ri rab dang bcas pa'i dang / ri mtsho gling bdun gyi tshad dbyebs sogs/ dang po ni/ 'og nas rlung me chu sa'i dkyil 'khor bzhi dang / sa'i steng gi ri rab dang bcas pa thams cad dbyibs zlum po/ rgya dpangs gnyis tshad mnyam pa ste 'bum phrag bzhi bzhir mnyam pa'i phyir te/ rgya la rlung gi shar mtha' nas nub mtha'i bar la dpag tshad 'bum phrag bzhi yod pa bzhin/ rlung gi 'og mtha' nas ri rab kyi skra rtse'i bar la yang de yod pa'i phyir te/ dkyil 'khor bzhi'i mthug rngams la 'bum phrag phyed phyed de/ ri rab kyi sa mtshams bar la yod cing / ri rab kyi lus dpung pa'am mgrin phreng 'og ma'i bar la gcig dang / mgrin phreng ngam dpung pa nas yar bcal ba'i maborwa 1 la gcig yod pa 'i phyir te/ gdong la stong phrag lnga bcu dang / mgrin pa dang skra gnyis la nyer lnga re yod pa rnams bsdoms pas sa mtshams yan lag gnyis yod pas so/ /'dir mgrin pa dang gdong la sogs pa rnams kha cig

lha de rnams kyi gnas so so la de ltar btags pa yin sgo mgrin pa sogs kyi dbyebs su med ces zer/ kha cig dbyibs dang rgyu la sogs pa ji bzhin yin zer/ nang gzhan gnyis dang sbyar dgos pas dbyebs ni ji bzhin la rgyu bshad pa ni dpung pa man gyi dbang du byas rdzi yan chod rgyu'i khams je phra je phyar gyur pa der gnas pa'i lha'i khams dang mthun pas so/ /dkyil slakhor bzhi'i mthug rngams kyang sa'i dkyil 'khor ni 'bum phrag phyed pa nyid du nges la/ gzhan rnams ni mchod rten gyi bang rim bzhin du med par mtha' rnams phyi ma phyi mas nang ma nang ma rnams skyor ba'i tshul du gnas pas brtsegs pa'i mthug rngams 'bum phrag phyed par nges kyang mtha' rnams ni tha dad de/ rlung gi mtha'i rngams la 'bum phrag gnyis dang / me la phyed dang gnyis dang chu la gcig yod pas so/ /ri rab ni phyi dbyibs zlum po la dkar yol kha bslang ba lta bu rtsa ba'i thad shar stong phrag bcu drug dang / stong gi thad kur lnga bcu pa zlum po thams cad mtha' sum 'gyur du nges pa ltar gnas pa/ steng rgya 'di yang skyes bu'i lus dbyibs su gnas pa'i dpung pa'i thad kyi dbang du byas pa ste gzhan 'phrul dbang byed rma na chad kyi gnas yin no/ /mgrin pa'i sor bzhi yan chad khams gong ma gnyis kyi gnas su bshad la mgrin pa'i smad sor gnyis ni 'thab bral man chad 'dod lha'i gnas su bshad pas/ mngon pa nas tshangs pa'i 'jig rten yan chad gling bzhi pa las rgya che bar bshad pa bzhin du 'dir mi 'dod do/ /de rnams kyi rgyu la/ dkyil 'khor bzhi ni gtso bo'i dngos la chung ba'i dngos

༄༄༄/ /rnams gnas par lan mang du gsungs pa bzhin du khams rang rang gtso che ba rdul rdzas brgyad 'dus pa ste/ mngon pa nas chu dang khams la kun rdzob dang / don dam bden par bshad pa dang mthun no/ /ri rab ni shar in+d+ra nī la/ lho pad+ma rā ga nub brke ta ser po/ byang zla ba chu shes dkar po/ dbus ma shar ljang gu ste/ ya ra wa la ha rnams kyi rang bzhin no/ /khyad par ri rab kyi dbyibs dbus su lhun po stong pa'i rnam pa zhes pas 'khrul nas khong stong du 'dod pa dang / stong pa gcig pa gcig ni khor yug tu bshad pa ri rab kyi pags pa'i 'thug rngams su 'dod pa rnams la ni/ ye ler/ ri rab kyi dbus ljang khur bshad pa dang / steng du dus kyi 'khor lo'i dkyil 'bor bzhugs par bshad pas khegs so/ /de na stong pa'i rnam pa zhes pa ni/ khams thams cad 'dus pa nam mkha'i khams yin pa la dgongs so/ /ri rab kyi rwa lnga bshad pa la 'dod pa mi mthun pa shin tu mang ste/ rwa pa ka ba la phub lnga je chung du brtsegs pa bzhin du steng du gtor ska'i rnam par 'dod pa dang / bi bhū ti dang / tsa mi rwa gcig ri rab kyi steng du dang bzhi zur bzhi nas gangs can gyi steng du zug zer ba dang / kha cig rdza ma dang rdza lung gi tshul du 'dod pa rnams la/ rwa gangs ri la reg par bshad pa dang / snya ma dus thams cad du rwa la reg par bshad pa rnams kyis gnod la/ rang lugs ni/ rwa gangs ri la reg pa dang rwa bzhi'i nang du gling drug shong bar bshad pas/ sder ma kha 'phyang lnga je cher song ba brtsegs pa'i phyi rol 'og phyogs bzhin

du mtha' khor yug tu gnas pa'i nang ma 'og ma 'gram stegs stong phrag gakhrig pa garjig khor yug tu yod par bshad pa dang mnyam zhing / phyi ma gangs ri dang mnyam por kha sbyar ba bzhin du gnas pa bar ma gsum gyi 'og na gling drug mtsho drug ri lnga rnams gnas pa yin no/ /gling de rnams la nyi zla'i bya ba med kyang longs spyod kyi sa pa'i mi rnams gnas pas rang 'od kyis 'tsho ba yin no/ /gnyis pa ni/ de ltar ri rab kyi rtsa ba'i 'gram skyor lta bu'i khor yug dpag tshad stong phrag gcig po de'i phyi nas gling zla ba dag 'od dkar dang / ku sha dang / mi'am ci dang / khrang khrang dang / drag po ste longs spyod kyi sa dang / bdun pa las kyi sa 'dzam gling chen po ste bdun/ gling re re'i mthar rim pa bzhin/ sbyang rtsi dang / mar dang / zho dang / 'o ma dang / chu dang / chang dang / lan tshwa'i rgya mtsho ste bdun༄/ zlotsho re re'i mthar rim pa bzhin/ 'od sngon dang / man+da ra dang / ni ṣa ṭa dang / nor bu'i 'od dang / dro ṇa dang / bsil ri'am gangs ri dang / rdo rje'i ri ste ri bdun rnams gnas pa'i ri tha ma 'di la rgya dpangs kyi tshad ma bshad pas rta gdong gi me dang gcig par 'dod do/ /mtsho phyi ma ni/ 'bum phrag phyed kha zheng la yod la/ gling phyi ma ni stong phrag nyi shu rtsa lnga kha zheng la yod cing / gzhan drug gsum bco brgyad po ni rags rtsis/ dpag tshad brgyad brgya brgyad cu gya dgu re zheng la mnyam por yod par rgyud nas gsungs la/ zhib tu rtsi na stong phrag bcu drug la bco brgyad kyis bgos pa'i thob nor yin te/ bgo byed ri gling mtsho gsum re re la drug drug ste

ra༅༅/ /bco brgyad yod la/ bgo bya la ri rab kyi dbus nas 'dzam gling chen po'i bar la stong phrag nyer lnga yod pa'i stong nas ri rab rang gi rtsa ba stong phrag bcu drug pa'i phyed dang / 'gram skyor gyi stong phyag gcig ste dgu po bcad pa'i lhag ma bcu drug yod pas so/ /'di zhib por brtsis na dpag tshad brgyad brgya gya brgyad/ rgyang grags gsum/ gzhu stong dang brgya dang bcu gcig sor bcu/ nas lnga/ shig gnyis/ ske tshe lnga/ sgra rtse gnyis/ rdul phra mo lnga dang / phra mo'i sum cha gcig rnams re re la 'byung ngo / /skabs 'dir/ de yi phyi rol stong pa gcig pu srid pa gsum bral yon tan med cing de nyid kyis dman pa'o/ /zhes pa'i 'grel par rdul phran so so'i ngo bo khams lnga pa stong pa gcig pu'o/ /nam mkha' ni min te/ thams cad la khyab par byed pa'i phyir stong pa gcig pur rtogs par mi bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don la/ stong pa gcig pu'i rdul 'di rdul phran so so bzhi/ bskal pa chags pa'i tshe yang 'byor mi srid pa'i cha nas nam mkha'i rdul dang mtshungs kyang nam mkha'i rdul ni khams lnga pa min te/ nam mkha' gcig pu'i khams yin pas so/ /srid pa gsum dang ma bral te/ gzugs med khams kyi snod bcud nam mkha'i khams kyis phye bas so/ /sa sogs kyi yon tan med cing de nyid kyis dman pa min te/ sgra'i yon tan dang ldan pas so/ /gnas nges pa med de gzugs can gar yod na yod pas so/ /'di ni nam mkha'i rdul la med pa thams cad khyad chos su ldan la/ gnas 'bum phrag bzhi pa'i 'jig rten

gyi phyi rol na rwa gur gyi tshul du gnas pa yin la/ tshad dngos su ma bshad kyang / ye ler 'khor lo sdom chen gyi dkyil 'khor 'jig rten gyi khams 'bum phrag lnga pa dang dag pa sbyar bas/ phyogs re stong phrag lnga bcu pa'i tshad can du bya zhes bu ston rin po che gsung ngo / /bla ma dam pa ni khyab par byed pa'i phyir zhes pa 'di'i khyad chos yin te/ khams lnga po thams cad la khyab pa yin la/ nam mkha' khams gzhan la ma khyab ces gsung ste/ gong du stong rdul drug pa ni/ chos kyi dbyings te thams cad la khyab par byed pas so/ /zhes gsungs pa de dang bstun par snang ngo / /spyir na mngon pa nas bshad pa'i rdul phran ni/ 'dir 'byung bzhi rdul phran nyid yin la/ nam mkha'i rdul dang stong pa gcig pu'i rdul 'di lta bus ni mngon pa nas bshad pa'i rdul gyi go mi chod la/ don smra gnyis kyis don dam du grub par 'dod pa'i rdul phran cha med kyang don steng nas 'grub thabs med pas blos phye nas 'jog pa las ma 'das la/ blos phye ba'i rdul phran ni khams phra ba la'ang bzhag tu rung ngo snyam du dgongs par gsal byu/ rdul phran gyi sgras 'khral nas nam mkha'i khams bem po'i gzhi mthun gyi grub mtha' khas blangs par mi bya'o/ /nam mkha' tsam dang bem po'i gzhi mthun ni mngon par yang bshad de/ mngon par skabs yod ces pa rgyan nam mkha' dang bu ga nam mkha' la bzhag pas rlo+o/ /gnyis pa ni/ chos mngon pa las rdul dang ni/ /lcags chu ri bong lug dang glang / /nyi zer rdul dang sro ma dang / /de las byung dang de bzhin nas/ /sor tshigs zhes bya gong bdun

ra༅༅/ /bsgyur/ /zhes dang / lung rnam 'byed las/ de rnams snga ma las phyi ma drug 'gyur du bshad ces pa'ang yod kyang / 'dir phra rab dang / phra mo dang / skra rtse phra mo dang / ske tsha dang / shig dang / nas dang / sor rnams snga ma las phyi ma brgyad 'gyur du bgres pa'i sor mo nyir bzhi la khra dang / de bzhi la gzhu byed pa ni kun mthun la/ gzhu lnga brgya la rgyang grags dang / de brgyad la dpag tshad du mngon pa nas bshad cing / 'dir gzhu nyis stong la rgyang grags te rgyang grags la bzhi 'gyur gyi khyad yod pa mdzad nas/ rgyang grags dro'i la dpag tshad du gsungs pas mngon pa'i dpag tshad las nyis ldab kyis ring ba yin no/ /de ltar na mngon pa nas bshad pa'i gling bzhi pa'i 'jig rten la mngon pa rang lugs kyi dpag tshad 'bum phrag so drug lhag pa yod kyang 'de'i dpag tshad bco brgyad lhag pa las mi 'byung la/ 'di la rang lugs kyi 'bum phrag bzhi las med kyang / ma/ngon pa'i 'bum phrag brgyad du 'gyur bas/ bzhi ldab cung lhag las khyad med do / /gnyis pa ni/ spyir phyi ru 'jig rten khams la dpag tshad 'bum phyag re dang nang lus la khra re mag bsdos sbyar nas lus la rags rtsis khra bzhi mchu zheng mtshungs pa bzhin du/ 'jig rten 'bum phrag bzhi bzhir mchu zheng mnyam pa dang / gzhan dkyil 'khor la yang sku dkyil gyi rtsa thig nas rtsa thig gi bar la slob dpon gyi khru bzhi 〉chu zheng mnyam par bshad la/ dkyil 'khor lakhro bya kho na'i dbang du byas nas phyi 'jig rten dang nang lus gnyis ma'i rgya dang dpangs gnyis ka

dkyil 'bor gyi rgya kho na la bskyar nas sbyar mod kyi shugs la/ bsgom pa dang blos slongs kyi dpangs kyang rgya dang dpangs mnyam par 'grub ste/ sku dkyil gyi dzo'i phyed kho rang gi dpangs la bya zhing / de dang mnyam pa'i rdo rje'i sa gzhi dbus 'bur ba'i steng du sku dkyil gyi dpangs phyed gsung dkyil bya/ de bzhin du byas nas thugs dkyil la gsung gi byed/ thugs kyi nang gi ye shes 'khor lo phyur bur gyur pa'i dpangs ni thugs dkyil nyid kyi rgya dang mnyam por byas pas/ dkyil 'khor la yang dpangs rgya dang mnyam par 'grub bo/ /skyes bu'i lus 'dom gang gru bzhir bshad pa yang mchu zheng gab pa'i gang zag so skye khyad par ba'i dbang du byas rdzi ci rigs nas zhib tu brtsis na ma nges te mi phal pa'i 'dom la sor ngagu bcu go drug yod kyang dpangs la brgyad cu gya bzhi las med pa dang / de nas las rlung rim gyis 'gags te/ rdzogs par 'gags pa'i sangs rgyas kyi longs sku khra lnga gru bzhi mnyam pa dang / khra re la'ang rang sor nyer lnga re ste bsdoms pas sor mo brgya nyer lnga yod pa dang / sa bcu gnyis po re re la sor mo phyed dang gsum re tsam 'phel bar 'gyur ba'i rnam gzhag gsungs te/ lha'i phyag tshad rgyas par gzharno du bshad zin cing 'og tu'ang droshad par bya'o/ /'jig rten gyi dbyibs kyang rags rtsis nas nang dang gzhan la sbyar nas gsungs te/ mi dang sangs rgyas kyi sku skyil mo spung du bzhugs pa'i lte ba man chod lta bu ni ri bar kyi sa mtshams man gyi dkyil 'khor gzhi brtsegs yin la/ lte ba yan chad lta bu ni ri rab ste/ lus kyi khos pa lto ba nas

ra༅༅/ /dpung pa'i bar du je sbom du gyur pa dang / de nas mgrin pa dang gdong dang sgra la sogs pa'i dbyebs dang 'dra par gnas pas so/ /de bzhin du chos ska'i rten mchod rten gyi phyag tshad dang dbyebs kyang dri med 'grel pa sogs nas 'byung ba lta bu'i mgrin rings dang bre chung ngur mi byed sgo ste ba man dang ri rab kyis mtshams man chad lta bu ni bang rim rtseg tu bya la/ lte ba'i thad la bum gdan dang / shedapung pa'i bar la bum pa stod je sbom du gtong ba dang / mgrin pa phra ba lta bur bre'i mgrin pa phra ba dang / smin mtshams bar gyi gdong pa je sbom du song ba lta bur bre'i gdong dang / de nas gtsug tor dang / ral pa'i thor ci+og dang / ri rab kyi skra je phrar song ba ltar gdugs dang char khebs bya bar gsungs pas las mthun snang du bsags pa la legs par snang ba'i 'jig rten 'di ni phyi nang gzhan gsum thams cad la tshad dbyibs legs par 'grig pas chos mthun dang sbyang gzhi sbyong byed shin tu 'phrod pa'i 'jig rten yin no/ /gang dag mu stegs kyi gzhung nas bshad pa don la med pa'i drang don yin no zhes sma bar byed pa dag gis ni/ sbyang gzhi dang mthun yul dang de dang sbyar ba'i nang dang gzhan gyi chos mthun mtha' dag drang don du khas len dgos pas dus kyi 'khor lo la nges don cung zad kyang med pa zhig tu smra dgos par 'gyur ro/ /gnyis pa bcud skye sems can la/ dbye ba dang / gnas dang / tshe tshad do/ /dang po ni/ rgyas par dbye na/ srid pa sum cu rtsa gcig tu gsungs te/ 'dod pa na bcu gcig gzugs na bcu drug gzugs

med na bzhi'o/ /dang po ni/ dam la ba yi dwags dud 'gro/ mi dang lha min 'dod lha rigs drug rnams te/ drug ni rgyal chen bzhi/ sum cu rtsa gsum/ 'thab bral/ dgazha ldan/ 'phrul dga'/ gzhan 'phrul dbang byed do/ /gzugs bcu drug ni/ tshangs ris/ tshangs pa mdun na 'don/ tshangs chen/ 'od chung / tshad med 'od/ 'od gsal/ dge chung / tshad med dge dge rgyas/ sprin med/ bsod nams skyes/ 'bras bu che rnams mngon pa bzhin byas nas gnas gtsang la mi che/ mi gdung / shin tu mtho/ 'og min te bzhi las mi bgrang bar bcu drug tu byed pa yin gyi bye brag tu smra ba/ tshangs chen dang / mdun na 'don gnas gcig tu 'dod pa lta bu ni min no/ /gzugs med bzhi ni/ nam mkha' dang rnam shes dang / ci yang med pa dang / 'du shes med/ 'du shes med min skye mched te skye mched bzhi'o/ /'di dag gi sgra don sogs ni 'dir ma bshad kyang mngon pa dang 'dra bar bya la/ rgyu tshogs ni/ gzugs med bzhi po zad par nam mkha' bsgom pa dang / gzugs kyi gnas bzhi mtshan bzhir ni/ bsam gtan dang po dang gnyis pa dang gsum pa bzhi par byas pa'i bzhi pa nas yas rim bzhin zad par rlung me chu sa bsgom pa dang / thun mong du tshul khrims kyi stobs dang / 'dod lha drug po sbyin pa dang / sngags bzlas pa'i stobs dang / lha min yang sbyin pa'i stobs dang / mi dge mi dge'i las kyi stobs dang / mi dge ba chung 'bring chen pos dud 'gro yi dwags dpyal ba rnams su skye bar bshad do/ /de rnams kyi sa bon nam

ra༅༅/ /ming yig ni/ gzugs med bzhi'i/ a ā i āḥ rlung bzhi'i/ i ā+o e i/ me bzhi'i/ ṛ dzā ar ār/ chu bzhi'i/ u lū a e+o/ sa bzhi lo hṝ zhol skal/ 'dod lha drug gi ha hā ya yā ra rā / lha mir dang mi'i/ wa wā/ dud 'gro dang yi dwags kyi la lā/ dpyal ba'i k+ṣa yig go /srid pa so gcig po de bsdu na/ 'gro ba rigs drug tu bshad/ stod smad mang por ro'i 'gro ba zhes yang yang gsungs shing / nang le'i lta ba rtag par 'gro pa ni drug ste zhes gsungs pas so/ /mngon pa nas lha min zur du mi bgrang bar 'gro ba lngar bshad pa ltar 'dir yang bsdu na lngar bzhed de/ lha min ni/ spyir lha dang khyad par rgyal chen bzhir bsdus pas so/ /de las kyang bsdu na/ khams gsum dang / srid pa gsum dang / yang srid gsum mtha' dag dus kyi sbyor ba dag las zhes pa'i 'grel par/ mtho ris dang / mi yul dang / sa 'og dang gsum du yang bsdus nas gsungs so/ /gnyis pa ni/ gzugs med bzhi po ri rab kyi gtsug tor nas skra mtshams/ rlung bzhi po dpral ba/ me bzhi po sna/ chu bzhi po kos ko sa bzhi po mgrin pa'i sum gnyis/ 'dod lha drug gi bzhi/ mgrin pa'i sum cha/ dpag tshad brgyad dang sum cha la cha bzhir bgose nas sumacu rtsa gsum ri rab kyi steng rgyal chen bzhi dpung pa man nas sa mtshams kyi sa bar te/ mngon pa bzhin du 'di'i gnas mang ngo / /ri rab khong gseng 'og gi gling drug la longs spyod kyi sa pa'i mi dang / 'dzam gling chen po la las kyi sa pa'i mi rnams

gnas so/ /'og gi dkyil 'khor bzhi po re re yang phyed mar byas pa'i gnas brgyad kyi dang po steng ma ni rin chen snang ba'i gnas zhes bya la/ de la phyed ma byas pa'i phyed gong ma la lha min dang 'og ma la klu gnas so/ /de 'og bdun la dpyal ba bdun te/ sa'i dgral ba gcig dang / chu me rlung gsum gyi gnyis gnyis rnams so/ /dang po ni/ gseg ma'i chu'i/ gnyis pa gnyis bye ma'i chu'i dang / 'dam gyi chu'i/ de nas gnyis/ mi bzad pa'i du ba'i dang me/'i/ de nas gnyis / mun pa'i dang / ngu 'bod chen po drag po'i rlung gi dpyal ba'o/ /dang yig gis rdo rje'i dpyal ba zhes bya ba rtsa ltung dang po dang ldan pa rnams kyi gnas te/ 'jig rten gyis ma bsdus pa'i rdo rje'i me lce dang bcas pa la dmyal ba brgyad pa rdo rje'i khab rtse me stag tu 'bar ba gzhung gzhan nas mnar med du bshad pa'i dod do/ /gsum pa ni/ lo'i tshad ni 'og tu 'chad cing 'dir dgos kyang mi dgos te/ mi los 'jal ba'i tshe tshad med pas so/ /des na bskal pa'i tshad dgos la/ de yang sdig pa'i dbang gis ngan nu+ok+to+ong dang / dge ba'i dbang gis mtho ris su bskal pa du mar gnas par gsungs so/ /bskal pa ni bzhi ste/ bskal pa chung ngu dang / bar ma dang / mchog dang / chen po rnams yin la/ bskal pa chung ngu ni / mchu zheng gnyis ka la dpag tshad gcig pa'i dod gcig skra )zlum pos bkang pa las lo brgya brgya na re re bton pas ma lus par stongs pa'i yun la zhag de sum cu la zla ba de bcu gnyis la lor byas pa'i lo brgya ni bskal pa chung ngu'i tshad yin

ra༅༅/ /la/ de la zhag gcig sogs/ brtsis pa'i rang lo rang lo brgya ni bar ma dang / de la zhag gcig sogs brtsis pa'i mchog gi bskal pa dang / de la zhag tu byas nas brtsis pa'i lo brgya ni bskal pa chen po yin la / 'jig rten cha gas nas gnas pa'i yun ni bskal chen las kyang ring ste/ klu'i gnas dang dmyal ba dang por bskal pa chung ngu'i tshe tshad/ de nas dmyal ba gnyis bar pa dang / de nas gnyis mchog dang / de nas gnyis bskal chen dang / dpyal ba brgyad pa 'jig rten sdud pa'i tshad du bshad do/ /mi dang / lha min dang / dud 'gro yi dwags kyi tshe tshad ma bshad la/ 'dod lha drug po bskal chung gcig nas drug gi bar gyi tshe tshad do/ /gzugs dang gzugs med kyi tshe tshad la chos bzang dang / tshangs pa dang / 'jig rten 'das pa dang / dpal dang / dkar po'i bskal pa rnams gzugs med nas yas rim gyis sbyar/ rang rang gi mas rim nas gcig dang gnyis la sogs par sbyar dgos pa lta bur bstan pas gzugs kyi mi rnams mi gsal yang / gzugs med kyi bzhi po bskal chen du gsungs shing / mas rim nas gcig gnyis gsum bzhi sbyong bar gsal bar bshad pa dang / 'dod lha'i tshe bskal chung du bshad pas gzugs la bar ma dang mchog gnyis sbyar dgos la/ de yang 'og ma brgyad la bar ma gcig nas brgyad kyi bar dang / gong ma brgyad la mchog bskal gcig nas brgyad kyi bar sbyor ba las ma 'das so/ /gsum pa la/ rtsom byed nyin zhag gi dang / des brtsams pa'i dus

bzhi'o/ /dang po ni/ 'dir nyin zhag gi tshad gcig tu ma nges te/ srog chags bdun po rang rang gi dbugs nyis khri chig stong drug brgya la rang rang gi zhag re byed pas so/ /srog chags bdun ni shig la sogs pa'i lus skyes phra mo dang / mi dang / yi dwags chen po dang / lha dang / lha min dang / nus pa'i ming can 'og min pa dang / gco bo'i ming can srid rtse pa rnams so/ /de rnams kyi dbugs ni mi'i dbugs 'byung rngub gcig gi nyis khri chis/ stong drug brgya cha gcig dang / mi'i dbugs 'byung rngub gcig nyid dang / de sum brgya drug cu ste chu tshod gcig dang / dbugs nyis khri tshig stong drag brgya ste zhag gcig dang / de sum brgya drug cus lo gcig dang / lo de nyis khri chog stong drug brgya ste dus bzhi gcig rnams rim pa bzhin du bdun po'i dbugs yin la/ dbugs rang rang gi nyis khri tshig stong drug brgya re ni rang rang gi zhag dang / de sum brgya drug cu ni rang dang gi lo yin pas phra mo'i lo gcig la ni chu tshod gcig las med pas zhag re la lo drug cu re lon par 'gyur ro/ /yi dwags chen po'i zhag gcig la nyin zhag sum cu yong bas/ mngon par zla ba nyin zhag gi lnga brgya/ /zhes dang / bshes sping du/ lnga stong dag dang khrir yang 'chir mi 'gyur/ /zhes bshad pa rnams kyis kho rang gi nyin zhag gi yun ni 'ji dang ma'um po yin la/ 'dir rang lo lnga brgya'i nges pa ni ma bshad do/ /de ltar na de'i lo gcig la ni mi'i nyin zhag khri dang stong brjed brgya 'byung bas mi lo sum cu'o/ /lha'i nyin zhag gcig la mi lo gcig dang lo gcig la mi

ra༅༅/ /lo sum brgya drug cu/ lha min gyi zhag gcig la mi'i nyin zhag nyis khri chig stong drug brgya ste mi lo drug cu/ lo gcig la mi lo nyis khri chig stong drug brgya'o/ /nus pa' zhag gcag la mo yo ltas khre chag stong drug brgya ste lo gcig la sa ya bdun bdun 'bum bdun khri drug stong / gtso bo'i zhag gcig la mi lo bye ba gnyis/ sa ya lnga/ dgu 'bum/nyis khri yod de/ de'i lo gcig la ni zhag gcig gi lo grangs de sum brgya drug cus bsgyur bas mi lo ther 'obum dgu / dung phyur gsum/bye ba gsum/ sa ya gcig 'bum phrag gnyis rnams yong ba yin no/ /'on kyang 'di ni gtso bo chung ba gcig yin par phyed dgos te/ 'di'i dbugs gcig la mi lo stong dang nyis brgya las mi 'byung bas sa/ /'dir dngos su bstan pa'i gtso bo'i dbugs gcig la mi lo nyis khri chig stong drug brgya yong bar bshad pa ste/ zhag tu longs na mi lo dung phyur bzhi/ bye ba drug sa ya drugalnga 'bum drug khri rnams yong bas so/ /des na gtso ba chung ba 'di nam mkha' mtha' yas pa yin nam brtag par bya'o/ /rang rang gi dbugs drug la chu srang dang / de drug cu la chu tshod dang / de drug cu la i zhag dang / de bco lnga la phyogs dang / de gnyis la zla ba dang / zla ba gnyis la dus drug gi duso gcig dang / zla ba gsum la dus bzhi'i dus gcig dang / zla ba bzhi la dus gsum gyi dus gcig dang / zla ba drug la bgrod pa dang / de gnyis la lor byed pa ni kun la 'dra bar shes par bya'o/ /'dir rig byed kyi gzhung las skyes bu tsha la brgya pa

dbang po brgya pa zhes bshad pa la lung rigs kyi nges pa med de/ mi rnams kyi mchog gi tshe lo brgya'o zhes pa ni rtog pas spros shing btags pa ste/ rdzogs ldan gyi tshe lo brgya las shin tu mang ba'i phyir ro/ /des na gtso bo chung ba'i 'pho chen g.yon pa la tshe lo brgya pa dang / g.yas pa la dbang po brgya pa zhes bya ste/ 'pho ba gnyis la nang gi zla ba gnyis dang / dus drug gi dus gcig yong bas so/ /ji ltar na rang rang li spyi'i chu tshod drug cu la zhag dang / chu tshod nyis khri chig stong drug brgya la lo yong ba bzhin du nang gi lo zla dbugs la chu tshod du byas nas byed pa'i phyir te/ dbugs drug cu la nang gi zhag gcig dbugs dgu brgya la phyogs stong brgyad brgya la zla bar bya la/ 'dis skyes bu rang rang gi 'pho ba re 'gro zhing / sum stong drug brgyas dus gcig 'grub pas so/ /de bzhin du mi lo nyis brgya la yang sbar te/ mi lo nyis brgya'i chu tshod kyi grangs dang dus bzhi chen po'i lo grangs mnyam pas so/ /'dir bu ston rin po che dus bzhi chen po'i lo grangs dang gtso bo chung ba'i rlung dkyil 'khor bcu'i dbugs kyi grangs mnyam zhes gsung ba shin tu mi 'drod de/ kho rang gi dkyil 'khor lnga la kho rang gi dbugs grangs sum stong drug brgya las lhag pa yong mi srid la/ srog chags gzhan gyi dbugs grangs ni de'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbugs grangs la sbyar don med pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ spyir gyi dus bzhi zhes bya ba ni rdzogs ldan dang sum ldan dang gnyis ldan dang rtsod ldan zhes bya ba bzhi la byed la/ 'di'i rnam gzhig lugs 'dir ma zad gzhung gzhin nas kyang 'byung

ra༅༅/ /ste/ skyes rabs las rdzogs ldan gyi sprin bzhin du gyur to zhes sogs dang / ston pa shwakya thub pa rtsod dus kyi sangs rgyas su bshad pa sogs yod pas so/ /'di'i dus bzhi ni sngon gyi 'bor los sgyur ba lnga'i dus lta bu tshe lo dpag med nas cung zad kyang ma bri ba las dge ba bcu ka rdzogs par spyo da cing / mi dge pa bcu ma tshang ba'i skabs ni rdzogs ldan dang / de nas tshe lo 'grib pa'i mgo brtsams te dge ba bcu'i bzhi cha nyams pa dang / phyed nyams pa dang / bzhi gsum nyams pa rnams sum ldan gnyis ldan rtsod dus su byed par gsal lo/ /gzhung 'di nas 'byung ba la phal cher dus bzhi che chung gnyis bstan te/ che ba ngh+ru ba stong pa la 'jug pa'i dus lo grangs sa ya bzhi dang sum 'bum nyis khrir gsungs pa 'di dang / chung ba 'khor los sgyur ba 'khor ba'i dus lo grangs nyis khri chig stong drug brgya par gsungs pa gnyis yin la/ 'di la sangs rgyas bstan pa'i dus bzhi gcig dang / phye dang drag po 'khor lo can nyid kyi dus bzhi gnyis su dbyer yod kyang gnyis gas dum bu rer stong brgyad brgya par mnyam pas lo grangs mnyam par 'dod do/ /kho bo ni 'di gnyis mi mnyam ste/ snga dar sangs rgyas bstan pa'i lo grangs la kla klo ma zhugs gong gi lo stong lnga brgya po lhag pas so/ des na bstan pa snga dar gyi dus bzhi/ phyi dar 'bor lo ༅ gyi dus bzhi/ d+dha ba stong pa la 'jug pa'i dus bzhi ste gsum du bya'o/ /'di'i bar pa ni bsdoms pa'i lo grangs nyis khri chig stong drug brgya dang / re re lnga stong bzhi brgya par mnyam la/ de yang dum bu re

rer dus bzhi lo grangs phyed dang lnga brgya par mnyam par 'byung pa rnams bsdoms pa yin la/ snga ma'i phyi ma gsum de dang 'dra/ de rdzogs ldan la drug stong dgu brgya yod pa yin no/ /'khor los sgyur ba'i zhabor tshul gyi skabs su drag po 'khor lo can rang nyid kyi dus bzhi kho na bshad pa ma yin nam/ ji ltar sangs rgyas pa'i bstan pa snga dar la dus bzhi bya zhe na/ rgyal po'i rgyab tu sum ldan zhes pas rgyal po rang nyid kyi sum ldan rtsod pa'i dus kyang mdun dag tu zhes pas/ sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rtsod ldan dngos su bstan la/ shugs la de'i sum ldan sogs kyang dngos su nges par grub pas so/ /rgyas par 'og tu bshad par bya'o/ /dus bzhi chen po ni/ bsdoms pa'i lo grangs sa ya bzhi dang sum 'bum nyis khri yin la/ de gtso bo chung ba'i pho chen gnyis kyi yun tshad yin pas/ phyed mar bgos pas sa ya gnyis 'bum drug khri de ni 'pho ba re'i yun du 'gyur zhing / bsdoms pa'i lo grangs la bcus bgos pa'i bzhi 'bum sum khri nyis stong ni 'pho chung re re'i yun tshad yin / 'pho chung bcu po'i steng nas bzhi dang gsum dang gnyis dang / gcig rnams rim pa bzhin du rdzogs ldan dang sum ldan dang gnyis ldan rnams kyi yun tshad de/ grangs ni 'pho chung re re ba'i tshad de nyid bzhi dang gsum dang gnyis kyis bsgyur ba dang ma bsgyar ba'i grangs so/ /'dir bsdoms pa'i lo grangs de bsgrub pa'i tshul ni/ gza' brgyad kyi rgyu skar rdzogs par 'khor ba'i yun tshad la/ gza' rang gi zhag gcig tu byas pa'i zhag phyed dang gnyis la mi lo brgya yin pas zhag gsum la

ra༅༅/ /nyis brgya/zla gcig la nyis stong / lo gcig la nyis khri bzhi stong 'byung la/ de ltar na gza' rnam sa kyi lo brgya'i yun tshad de mi lo brgya tham pas bsgyur ba la/ sa ya gnyis dang bzhi 'bum 'byung la/ 'di gco bo 'pho chen gcig gi yun tshad du byas na bcu chas lhag pa'i skyon yod pas bcu cha sbyong ba'i phyir du gnas gnyis su byas pa'i 'og ma bdus bgos pa'i thob nor gyis gong ma sbyangs pa'i lhag ma la/ sa ya gnyis dang 'bum drug khri 'byung ba 'di gtso bo'i 'pho 'a gcig gi yun yin pas de gnyis kyis bsgyur bas sa ya bzhi dang /sum 'bum nyis khri po 'byung ba yin no/ /de ltar na gza'i lo brgya pos mi la dgu bcu bsnas bas chos rgyu yi na pa la brgyas ༷sgyur nas bcu cha sbyong ba ni rgyud kyi sdeb sbyo+or gyi ched yin nam rgyu mtshan gzhan rnyed par dasha'o/ /gnyis pa/ 'dzam gling chen po bye brag tu bshad pa la drugs bzhi la dum bu bcu gnyis/ nam mkha' la khyim 'khor bcu gnyis/ de gnyis la 'khar byed bcu gnyis/thun mong du dus sbyar bcu gnyis/ dus sbyor la rten 'brel bcu gnyis/ de dag la blang dor bcu gnyis so/ /dang po ni/ gling bdun pa phyi nas lan tshwa'i rgya mchos 'khor zhing nang gangs can chen pos non pa'i lhag mar gyur pa/ zheng du dpag tshad nyis khri lnga stong / phyi'i mtha' skor la sum 'bum/ nang gi mtha' skor la de'i phyed long pa 'di la mchu zheng ma nyam pa'i dum bu bcu gnyis byas pas re re'i phyi mtha' la stong phrag brgyad/ sum brgya so gsum cha re/ nang mtha' la de'i phyed yod pa pad 'dab lta

bu bcu gnyis yod pas lho gling gsum/ nub gling gsum/ byang gling gsum/ shar gyi gling gsum du gnas la/ dbus gling bzhi la/ 'jom bu gling dang / nub ba lang spyod dang / byang sgra mi snyan dang / shar lus 'phags po zhes dngos su bshad cing / gling g.yog brgyad la/ mngon pa nas rnga yab dang rnga yab gzhan/ g.yon ldan dang lam mchog 'gro/ sgra mi snyan dang sgra mi snyan gyi zla/ lus dang lus 'phags zhes bshad pa bzhin gyi ming 'dogs dang gling dngos las chung bar bshad pa sogs mi 'dod pas che chung mnyam po dang / ming la'ang lho gling shar ma dang nub ma zhes sogs kyi tha snyad las mi 'dod do/ /gling dbus ma bzhi'i dkyil na shar du rlung zlum po/ lho ru me gru gsum/ byang du chu zla gam/ nub tu sa gru bzhi rnams la rim pa bzhin du dpag tshad stong phrag bdun dang / brgyad dang / dgu dang / bcu'i tshad du gsungs na'ang 'og tu 'grel pas shar zlum po phyed pa dang / lho gru gsum dang / byang zlum po dang / nub gru bzhi rnams nang lus kyi dbyibs dang sbyar nas gsungs te/ mngon par shar gyi lus 'phags zla gam 'dra/ zhes sogs dang tshul 'dra la/ 'on kyang byang dang nub gnyis go ldog go /rtsa ba'i rgya dper yang / glu: pā yudhe srir+sha bha ba ti/ zhes 'byung ba'i adhe phyed la 'jug pas rtsa ba dang dngos kyi 'grel par rlung zlum por bshad pa mi legs so/ /gnyis pa ni/ rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa bdun gyi skar ma gnyis dang bzhi cha re la khyim du byas pa'i khyim bcu gnyis nam mkha' la 'khor ba la nam mkha'i khyim 'bor zhes bya bar

ra༅༅/ /grags pas khyim gyi gzhi ni rgyu skar la bya'o/ /des na thog mar rgya skar gyi rnam gzhag btsad na tog gzungs nas/ drang srong skar ma la dga' bas skar ma/'i mtshan nyid dang byed las bshad/ rma bya chen mo las/ smin drug nas bzung nas bdun tshan bzhi dang / shar dang lho dang nub dang byang phyogs rnams bsrung zhing skyong bar bshad/ garga'i mdo la sogs pas/ skar ma rnams re re bzhin re rer brgyud/ grangs/ dbyebs/ rtag longs/ kha zas/ rigs kyi lha dang drug drug gis bshad pas/ tha skar ni/ rgyud drang srong rta len gyi/ grangs skar ma gsum/ dbyebs rta'i mgrin pa lta bu/ skar khongs la rtag longs yud tsam sum cu/ kha zas sbyang rtsi dang sha lha ni dri za la lhar 'dzin dri za'o bur yang bshad do/ /rgyud gzhan nas skar ma 'di rnams lha mor bshad do/ /bra nye ni/ bha ra'i brgyud/ skar ma gsum/ dbyibs mo mtshan/ rtag longs snga ma bzhin/ kha zas til 'bras/ lha gzhin rje'o/ /smin drug ni/ garga'i brgyud grangs drug dbyibs spu gri/ longs spyod sngar bzhin/ zas zho/ lha me lha'o/ /snar ma ni/ go'u ta ma'i/ grangs lnga/ dbyibs shing rta/ longs spyod yud tsam so lnga/ zas zho dang sgrad/ lha ni skye rgu'i bdag po/ mgo ni/ ba ra d+ngha tsha'i/ grangs gsum/ dbyebs ri dwags mgo yud tsam sum cu/ zas ri dwags kyi sha lha zla ba'o/ /lag ni/ ljang sngon sgo gangs gcig dbyibs sog po/ yud tsam bco lnga/ lha drag sdos can no/ /nabs so ni/ gnas 'jog

gi skar ma gnyis/ dbyibs khang pa'i gdung / yud tsam so lnga/ zas mar dang khu ba/ lha nyi ma'o/ /rgyal ni/ garga'i/ skar ma gsum/ dbyibs ril pa/ yud tsam sum cu/ sbyad dang yos/ lha phur bu'o/ /skag ni/ mdza' bo'i/ drug gam lnga/ sprul mgo bco lnga/ sprul sha sprul lo/ /mchu ni/ ser skya'i/ lnga'am drug chu go sum cu/ ti la/ lha spen pa'o/ /gre ni/ go tam/ gnyis/ rtsig pa/ sum cu/ 'bras/ til/ khyab 'jug go /dbo ni / e ta'i/ gnyis khre ltar 'phred la gnas pa/ zhe lnga/ khre/ nyi ma dang gshin rje'o/ /me bzhi ni/ 'od srung gi lnga/ lag pa/ sum cu/ bya sna tshogs kyi sha me lha'o/ /nag pa ni/ ka t+ya'i/ gcig pad+ma'i snying po/ sum cu / shing ton nyi ma can no/ /sa ri ni/ ka t+ya'i bu chen po'i/ gcig nor bu rin po che/ bco lnga/ phyed dang til thug rlung lha can no/ /sa ga ni/ ka t+ya'i bu gon pa'i/ bzhi/ ra'i rten mgo zhe lnga/ til dang me tog rgyo sran/ dbang po dang me lha can no/ /lha mtshams ni/ spen pa'i/ bzhi/ glang po'i sna/ sum cu/ chang dang sran chung / nyi ma can no/ /snron ni/ legs byed rdzi gsum/ them skas/ bco lnga/ sā lu dang 'bras thug dbang po'o/ /snabs ni/ ka t+ya na'i/ gsum/ seng ge'i ral pa/ sum cu/ nags kyi rtsa ba sogs/ sngom pa can no/ /chu stod ni/ ka t+ya'i/ bzhi/ ma chod rten/ sum cu/ n+ya gro ta'i zas/ chu lha la'o/ /chu smad ni/ stag gu'i/ grangs bzhi/ gormi pa g.yon pa'i

ra༅༅/ /rjes/ so lnga/ sbyang yos/ kun+da lhar 'dzin pa'o/ /rgyu skar nyer brgyad byang ba'i tshe dgas pa byi bzhin/ sred med bu'i/ gsum/ glang mgo drug rlung za/ tshangs pa'o/ /gro bzhen ni/ go dpal gyi / gsum/ rnga lta bu/ sum cu/ mar sar/ khyab 'jug go /mon gre ni/ gnas sa'i bzhi/ bya lta bu/ sum cu/ byi ba'i sha nor lha'o/ /mon gru ni/ de brtse'i/ brgyad dam gcig me tog gi phung po/ bco lnga/ ra sha chu lha'o/ /khrams stod ni/ skyo ba'i las rdzi gnyis/ shing rta/ sum cu/ lug gi sha ra 'ba' zhig 'tsho ba'i lha'o/ /khrams smad ni/ nor rgyal sgo gnyis/ shing rta/ zhe lnga/ bal sran/ sprul lhar 'dzizha pa'o/ /nam gru ni/ drang srong dbang po'i༄/ so gnyis te gcig dang 'brel ba/ gru/ sum cu/ sha dang bye/ nyi ma'o/ /brgyud 'di rnams ni drang srong shar+sha ga go /de rnams las tha skar/ mgo nabs so/ /dbo/ me bzhi/ nag pa/ sa ri rnams rlung / bra nye/ smin drug rgyal/ mchu/ gre/ sa ga khrams stod rnams me/ lag skag sgrubs/ chu stod/ mon gre/ khrams smad/ nam gru rnams chu/ snar ma/ lha mtshams/ snon/ chu smad/ byi bzhin/ gro bzhin/ mon gru rnams sa khams yin par drang srong gargas bshad mod zhi ༄skar ma 'di rnams kyi dbyibs dang khams la sogs pa rgyud 'grel 'dis mi gsal lo/ /de ltar rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad du grags kyang / byi bzhin ni/ longs spyod nyung bar bshad pa ltar skar khongs kyang gro

bzhin dang gang sngon la yod mi shes pa lta bur mig skar la mngon sum gyis grub pas dor nas nyi shu rtsa bdun du byas pa'i steng nas khyim 'jog la/ de yang skar ma gnyis gnyis dang bzhi cha re khyim rer byas nas/ tha skar bra nye/ smin drug gi rkang pa gcig rnams lug khyim/ de'i bzhi gsum/ snar ma/ mgo'i phyed rnams glang khyim/ de'i phyed/ lag nabs so'i bzhi gsum rnams 'khrig pa'i khyim/ de'i bzhi cha/ rgyal/ skag rnams rkarka ṭa'i khyim/ mchu/ gre/ dbo'i bzhi cha rnams seng ge'i khyim/ de'i bzhi gsum/ me bzhi/ nag pa'i phyed rnams bu mo'i khyim/ de'i phyed/ sa ri/ sa ga'i bzhi gsum rnams srang khyim/ de'i bzhi cha lha mtshams/ snon rnams sdig khyim/ sgrubs/ chu stod/ chu smad kyi long pa gcig rnams gzhu khyim/ de'i bzhi gsum/ gro bzhin/ mon gre'i phyed rnams chu srin gyi khyim/ de'i phyed/ mon gru/ khrams stod kyi bzhi gsum rnams bum pa'i khyim/ de'i bzhi cha khrams smad/ nam gru rnams nya'i khyim du bshad pa rnams ni / gling dum bu kun tu khyim gyi ming 'dogs dang skar ma dang / rkang pa de rnams la khyim de rnam sa su byed pa ni khyad par meshe rmi+od sgo khyim gyi yun tshad la chu tshod mang nyung dang / de yong dro yang skar ma so so'i longs spyod mang nyung dang / de yang ska ra khongs ya ngas dog mngon sum gyis grub pa dang mthun par 'byung ba dang / gong gi garga'i ska ra ma 'i bstan bcos nas longs spyo da mang nyung bshad pa 'di rnams ni gling chung dum bu 'di ga'i dbang du byas pa'i rnam gzhag yin no/ /de bzhin du

ra༅༅/ /dgrar nyi marka ṭa dang dgun nyi chu srin du ldog par bshad pa yang gling dum bu 'di'i dbang du byas pa dang / 'di'i nang nas kyang kai lā sha'i dum bu'i dbang du byas pa yin par shes dgos so/ /de ltar na gling chung 'di'i dbang du byas nas lug khyim la chu srang mkha' dgu lag ste chu tshod bzhi dang chu srang lnga bcu/ glang la mkha' dus mig ste chu tshod bzhi dang chu srang nyi shu/ de ltar de gnyis la chu tshod phyed kyi khyad/ 'khrig pa la mkha' mkha' gnyis te chu tshod gsum dang chu srang nyi shu/ de ltar na de gnyis la chu tshod gcig gi khyad/ kur seng bu mo gsum la rim pa bzhin du chu tshod lnga dang / drug dang / phyed dang bdun te/ de ltar 'khrig shar la chu tshod gcig dang chu srang bzhi bcu/ kur seng la gcig seng ge bu mo la phyed kyi khyad zhugs pa dang / srang sogs drag po snga ma'i lugs ldog tu gnas te/ de ltar na de khyim bar yangs pa drug ni rkarka ṭa nas gzhu'i bar dang / dog pa drug ni chu srin dang 'khris pa'i bar drug yin te/ yangs pa drug la sdoms pa'i chu tshod so lnga/ dog pa drug la nyi shu rtsa lnga 'byung ba 'di ni/ chu gtor srog dang chu srang me ni nyin zhag so so'i dus su 'phel 'grib bgrod pa'i yan lag gis/ zhes pa drug cu'i snga chas 'phel 'grib byed pa sham+bha la'i dbang du byas kyi 'grib pa dang 'phel ba drug chas so zhes pa drug cu'i drug chas 'phel 'grib byed pa 'dzam gling chung ngu 'di'i yul dum bu drug gi nang nas gnyis pa kai lā sha'i dbang du byas nas gsungs pa yin zhing / dbyangs 'char gyi rgyud las dus sbyor chu tshod 'dir bshad

pa dang ma mthun pa yang dum bu gzhan gyi dbang du byas pa yin pas gling chung 'di'i dum bu rnams kyang dus sbyor gyi yun tshad dang nyi ma ldog mtshams mi mthun pa yin pas dus sbyor dum bu drug tu grags pa'i brtsi tshul legs par shes dgos pa yin no / /'di dag cung zad zhib par 'dzam gling chung ngu'i khyad chos kyi skabs su bshad par bya'o/ /de ltar spyir gling so so dang khyad par yul so so la khyim gyi longs spyod mi 'dra ba yong ba ni rang rang so so la snang ba'i skar khongs yangs dog gi dbang gis de la nyi zla sogs kyi spyod pa bul myur dang / 'char ba'i skar yongs rdzogs pa bul myur gyi yin pa las ma 'das shing / rgyu mtshan des na/ khyim skar 'di dag kyang nyi ma'i go la bzhin du mtho dman du byas nas 'khor te/ dper na/ gling chung 'di'i dgun nyi ldog dus nyi mas skor ma phul dang 'grogs te 'di'i nam mkha'i shar nas nub kyi bar du phyin pas/ srod la nub tu bya sbo gzhug gam gro bzhin mon gre nub ri'i rtse dang / mgo lag rgyal gsum shar ri'i rtse la/ de'i bar ni/ de ring nyi mas spyad pa'i khyim drug po yin zhing / de rnams khyim bar dog pa'i mthar thug drug po yin pas nyi ma thung ba'i mthar thug pa dang / mtshan mo nabs so nas gre'i bar skar khongs yangs pa'i khyim drug po shar nas nub kyi bar la bgrod dgos la / de rnams khyim bar yangs pa'i mthar thug yin pas mtshan mo ring ba'i mthar thug 'byung zhing / nyin zhag de nyid la sgra mi snyan gyi nyin mtshan go ldog pas na/ 'dir khyim bar dog par snang ba drug po gling nger yangs par snang ba las ma 'das

༄༄༄/ 'ang / de ltar 'byung ba yang rang rang gi nam mkha' la sgar por byas nas mtho ba'i tshe yangs pa dang / gshong mor byas nas dma' ba'i ri+odo ga par snang ba las ma 'das so/ /'di yang phal cher mngon sum gyis grub ste / dog pa'i mgo lag rgyal gsum dang / phul sbo gzhug gsum sogs skar ma che ba dang gsal bar snang zhing / yangs pa'i wa nas phul gyi bar phal cher skar ma chung bar snang la/ che chung yang nam mkha' nyid na che chung mnyam pa zhig yod kyang / mtho dman gyi snang mkhan la nye ring gis che chung du snang bar grub ste/ zhi gza' gnyis la skar chen du grags la/ mig dmar spen pa skar chung du snang ba yang dma' ba dang mthon pa'i gzar bshad pa bzhin mtho dman gyis yin pa bzhin no / /gsum pa la/ sa gzhi la dus dang rgyal po gnyis 'khor tshul dang / nam mkha' la gza' chen po bcu 'khor tshul lo/ /dang po la/ dus 'khor tshul dang / 'khor los sgyur ba 'khor tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ da ltar dang sngon gyi mngon pa ba kha cig gling bzhi'i dus bzhi thams cad mnyam po yin te/ 'dzam gling na dbyar nyi ldog pa'i nyin zhag de nyid la gling bzhi ga'i dgrar nyi ldog pa dang / 'di na ston nyin mtshan mnyam pa dang dgun nyi ldog pa dang / dbyed nyin mtshan mnyam pa'i nyin zhag de nyid la gling gzhan gsum na'ang de rnam sa yod pa yin te/ de lta min na/ nam phyed nyi ma nub pa dang / /nyi ma phyed dang 'char dus gcig /zhes pa mi srid pas so zhes zer ro/ /'di ni shin tu mi rigs te/ nyin mtshan gyi rnam gzhag la

sogs pa mngon sum dang mthun pa'i rgyud 'di dang shin tu 'gal ba'i phyir dang / 'di dang mi bstun na'ang / mdzod nyid kyi 'grel bshad du/ 'di ni ston dbyed nyin mtshan mnyam pa'i dus kyi nyin zhag gnyis la srid kyi gzhan la mi srid par bshad pa dang 'gal ba'i phyir dang / gtso bo rigs pas gnod pa'i phyir te/ gling 'di'i nyi ma nub nas sang shar shar gyi bar dang / byang sgra mi snyan gyi nyi ma shar nas dgongs mo nub nub kyi bar yun mnyam mam ma mnyam/ mi mnyam na rtsa ba'i dam bca' dang 'gal / mnyam na dgun nyi ldog khar 'dir nyin mo yud tsam nyi shu rtsa bzhi las med cing mtshan mo yud tsam so drug yod pas/ byang sgra mi snyan gyi nyin mo la 'di'i mtshan mo dngamanyam por byung bas gling thams cad kyi dgun nyi ldog kha'i nyi ma thung mnyam yin pa'i dam bca' la gnod tshabs shin tu che ste/ blun po'i blo'i 'jug pa la dgag pa rgyas par bya mi dgos so/ /yang mngon pa ba kha cig 'grel bshad kyi lung gco bor bzung nas lho byang dbyar mnyam dang / shar nub ston dpyid dang / de mthun du 'khor ba'i sgo nas nyi ma'i go la lcags sgrog gam mtshon cha'i 'khor lo bzhin du 'khor te/ mtshon cha'i 'khor lo bzhin du rgya/ zhes me bya chen mor bshad pas kyang ngo zhes zer ro/ /'dis kyang gling 'di'i dbyar kha byang bgrod mthar thug li nyin mo yud tsam so drug byas pa'i mtshan gang de la byang sgra mi snyan gyi byang bgrod mthar thug nyi ma ring mtha' yin pas yud tsam so ༷ga yod par khas blangs pas 'di'i nyi ma shar nas kyang yun ring por byang sgra mi snyan gyi nyi ma mi nub pa

ra༅༅/ /dang / 'di'i ma rgas gong du byang du 'char ba sogs su 'gyur ba dang / 'di'i byang bgrod las lho bgrod mthar thug nyi ma 'char snga ba dang 'char sa sogs mtho bar 'gyur ba'am/ yang na lho bgrod kyi dus su 'char nub kyi 'gram du yol bas bsgribs pa'i phag nas nyi ma 'gro dgos par thal ba sogs kyis gnod cing / gtso bor ni/ 'dir sa dum bu bcu gnyis la dus bzhi rim can du 'khor ba dang nyin mtshan mnyam pa dang bgrod pa gnyis kyi mthar thug rim gyis 'khor bar gsungs pa dang 'gal bas/ las snang so so'i dbang gis gnyis ka srid par khas len na ma gtags lugs de dag ni 'dir mi 'dod do/ /'o na 'di'i rang lugs kyi dbyar dgun ston dbyed sogs kyi dus rnams g.yas su 'khor ram g.yon du 'khor zhe na/ 'di la dus kyi 'khor lo'i tshul khong du chud par rlom pa'i mkhas rlom kha cig ni/ 'og gi sa'i go la'am dus bzhi yang g.yon du 'khor te/ nam mkha'i nyi mas khyim la bskor ba'i dbang gis sa gzhi'i dus 'khor ba gang zhig nyi mas khyim la g.yon du bskor ba'i phyir te/ rang 'gros g.yon du bskor ba'i phyir dang / khams le'i nga gsum pa'i 'grel par/ 'dir shar gyi phyed du lug go /dbang ldan du glang ngo / /byang gi phyed du 'khrig pa'o/ /zhes sogs g.yon du bskor nas shar gyi phyed du nya'o zhes pa ni 'og la khyim dgod pa'o/ /zhes dang / tshigs bcad drug cu pa'i 'grel par/ lhun po'i lho yi dum pa 'dir lug la nyi ma gnas pas dbyed kyi dus su sa ga'i zla ba byed do/ /me yi zur gyi phyed dun/

bu gnyis pa la/ snron gyi zla ba byed do/ /de bzhin du me'i zur gyi phyed dum bu gsum pa la chu stod kyi zla ba byed do/ /zhes sogs g.yon du bskor nas/ bden bral gyi zur gyi phyed gzhan gyi dum bu la nag pa'i zla ba byed do/ /zhes sogs gsalabar bshad pas so/ /zhes zer ro/ /'di ni shin tu mi rigs te/ tshigs bcad nga lnga nga drug pa rtsa 'grel gyis legs par bkag pa'i phyir te/ gang phyir ri la skye bo rnams kyi i mtshan mnyam par 'gyur te lug nyi srang gi nyi ma la'o/ /zhes pas dum bu so so nas bcal ba'i bdun pa de dang rang rang phan tshun bltos nas gcig tu dbyed nyin mtshan mnyam pa'i zhag de la bdun par ston nyin mtshan mnyam pa dang / gcig tu ston nyin mtshan mnyam pa'i zhag de la bdun par dpyid nyin mtshan mnyam par 'gyur zhes spyir rnam par bzhag nas so so la sbyar ba na/ gling chung 'dir lug khyim du dbyed nyin mtshan mnyam pa'i zhag de la byang sgra mi snyan du ston nyin mtshan mnyam pa dang / 'dir srang khyim du sto na nyin mtshan mnyam pa na byang du dpyid mnyam pa dang / de bzhin du cung zad bden bral gyi zur du gnas pa dang dbang ldan gyi zur phyed kyi char gnas pa la yang / zhes de gnyis glang dang sdig pa la sbyar ba nas g.yas su bskor te/ bcu gnyis pa me'i zur gyi phyed gzhan la gnas pa dang / rlung gi zur gyi phyed gzhan la gnas pa la/ nyi ma nya dang bu mo la gnas pas nyin mtshan mnyam pa gnyis su 'gyur te/ zhes tshigs bcad nga lnga par nyin mtshan mnyam pa la sbyar ba'i mjug tu nga drug pas nyi ma ldog mtshams la sbyar nas kyang g.yas skor du

ra༅༅/ /gsal bar gsungs pas 'di na da lta dbyed gnas pa de 'di'i dbyar slebs pa na nub tu 'apo zhing / 'di'i ston sleb pa na byang du 'pho nas nub tu dbyar gyis sleb/ de'i dgun sleb pa na dbyed shar du sleb nas byang du dbyar dang nub tu ston 'byung ba'i tshul gyis g.yas su 'khor ba yin no/ /'o na snga ma'i lung rigs kyi don ci yin zhe na/ rigs pa ni 'gal bas khyab pa yin la/ lung gi don ni/ 'khor tshul g.yas su 'khor yang da lta yod tshul g.yon skor du yod pa yin te/ 'di'i dbyed kyi dus de nyid na shar na stor dang byang na ston dang nub na dgun yod pa dang / zla ba yang 'di'i dbyed zla tha chung gi dus de nyid na/ 'di'i me zur gyi dum bu na dbar zla ra ba dang / de'i shar ma na ༅ra zla 'bring po dang / shar drang po na dbyar zla tha chung la sogs pa g.yon skor du gnas yod pa gsal bar gsungs pa yin pas/ 'khor tshul dang gnas tshul 'khral pa'i grub mtha' 'di lta bu yang rnam dpyod zhib mor rlom pa'i rtsing po yin no/ /des na 'dir snon gyi zla bar byed do/ /sa ga'i zla ba byed do zhes sogs ni lo tsā bas don 'gyur byas pas 'khral gzhi bzos pa yin te/ dbyar zla ra ba byed do/ /daspyod zla tha chung byed do zhes sogs su 'gyur gzhan la yod pa ltar sgra drang 'gyur byas nas 'khral gzhi med par gnas pa la shong gi mkhas khyad kyi skabs 'dir 'grul gzhi bzos shing / 'dularā rtsa 'grel du skar ma'i ming gis zla ba bstan yod pa rnams dbyar zla 'bring po'i nya'i'o zhes sogs bod la grags che ba la dgongs nas cog ros bosna 'gyur

byas pas 'dul 'dzin la 'khral pa bskyed pas/ mkhas pa'i mkhas pa la yang 'khral pa cung zad 'byung bar nges so/ /de ltar gnas tshul dang 'khor tshul 'bral ba ni nam mkha'i khyim 'khor la yang mang du byung snang ste 'og tu bshad par bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ bcom ral sgros rtsod dus 'khor los sgyur ba 'byung bar bshad pas rmingon pa ba dang 'gal zhes bkag pas 'jigs nas/ kun mkhyen bu ston sgros kyang 'khor los sgyur ba 'khor bar bshad pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'khor ba yin zhes gsungs la/ kha cig bstan pa lnga stong du gnas pa 'dzam gling chen po mtha' dag gi lo grangs bsdoms pa'i dbang du byas par thag bcad nas/ dum bu dum bur zhabor bar yang yang bshad pa rnams khyad du bsad de/ mi 'bor bar dus gcig la dum bu thams cad du kla kle 'ug car du 'dzems par 'dod cing / rgyal po'i rgyab tu sum ldan zhes sogs kyang / rgyab kyi sa'i dum bu la mi byed kyi/ rgyab phyi ma dang don gcig pas rgyal po'i phyis zhes pa dang / mdun zhes pa sngon du zhes par bsgyur nas 'chad par byed do/ /skabs 'di'i mdun rgyab ni/ bu ston rin po che dang bla ma dam pa yang sugi rgyab dang phyi ma gnyis ka la 'jug pa las phyis zhes bshad par bya'o/ /zhes gsung ngo / /'di dag ni rang dga' dang 'dod rigs kyis bshad pa kho nar snang ste/ mdun gyi tshig mnyam po la kla klo rnams kyang g.yul du bcoms te rang gi chos la dgod par byas nas mdun du rnam par rgyu/ thes pa'i mdun 'di sngon du zhes par bshad ma shes nas rang sor 'jog dgos kyi 'dug pa'i

༄༄༄/ /phyir dang / 'di dang le'u 'di'i mjug dang / nang le sogs su kla klo dang 'khor lo can gnyis ka sa'i dum bu la 'khor bar yang yang bshad pa dang / dum bu dam bur zhes dang / dum bu gang du zhes sogs kyi tshig thams cad nus med du 'gyur te/ cig car du 'khor ba'i phyir ro zhes dang / dus rnams dag gi lo'i grangs ni zhes sogs dang / sa gzhi dag la dus bzhi nus pa'i tshad du 'jug /ces dro+o gas don med du 'gyur te/ sa gzhi la dus bzhi'i lo grangs la phan rgyu stong brgyad brgya las med pa'i phyir ro/ /sa re re la dus mnyam du stong brgyad brgya pa re yod pa bsdoms pas nyis khri chig stong drug brgya 'byang ngo zhe na/ 'o na 'dzam gling chung ngu la yu la dum bu drug yod pas lo gcig kyang 'dzam gling chung ngu ril po la bltos te lo drug tu khas blangs na gnod byed med par 'gyur ba dang / grong bye ba phrag dgu bcu rtsa drug yod pas de stong du rāgyur ba sdong / dpe nus pa'i zhag gcig pa kho rang gi dbugs skad cig rim/ can du 'byung ba stong brgyad brgya las med par 'gyur ba sogs dang / nang gi spang bya'i las rlung dang gnyen po'i ye shes kyi rlung lte ba'i rtsa 'dab bcu gnyis la cig car du rgya bar 'gyur ba sogs kyi skyon mtha' ya sa so/ /'on kyang bu ston yab sras mi 'bor bar mi bzhed par 'dug mod rdzi 'bor mkhan rgyal po min pa dang / mdun rgyab snga phyir 'gyur 'chos par snang la / bla ma dam pas/ 'og tu tshangs/ pa rgyab sdu dum bu gcig la zhes par rgyab kyi don rmo na la ma dzad par snang bas stabs gang bde byed par

zad do/ /des na rang lugs ni gong du bshad pa ltar/ dum bu thams cad du gzhom bya dang por sangs rgyas kyis bstan pa dang / de rjes kla klo'i chos dang / de rjes 'joms byed drag po 'bor lo can rnams rim can du 'bor zhing thams cad kyi chos rnams dum bu rer lo stong brgyad brgya re rim pa can gnas la/ 'dir dmigs bsal cung zad sngar bshad pa bzhin no/ /'jug tshul ni/ dum bu gzhan du sangs rgyas kyi chos dang kla klo'i chos lo gcig gi snga phyi'i cha tsam byas nas zhugs te / stong brgyad brgya'i bzhi cha ni shar du gling gi shar nub sogs sa'i cha tha dad nas gnas pas chos gnyis mi phrad pa'i bar bstan pa'i rdzogs ldan dang / de nas bzhi cha'i bar du phrad kyang bzhi cha las nyams mi nus pas sum ldan dang / de nas bzhi cha 'i bar du phyed 'joms pas gnyis ldan dang / de nas bzhi cha'i bar du bzhi gsum 'joms pas rtsod ldan du 'gyur te/ de'i mthar zhabor lo can/ gling 'dir ni mngal skyes ji skad bshad pa'i yab yum can gling gzhan du sprul nas kla klo bcoms te slar yang lo de nyid la dum bu gzhan du chos snga ma gnyis 'pho ba'i tshul gyis 'jug par 'dod do/ /dum bu gcig tu dus mnyam du zhugs nas mi gnod pa mi 'thad do snyam na/ dum bu 'dir yang ma ga'i yul du kla klo zhugs nas lo me mkha' rgya mtsho'i bar du ni kla klos dus 'khor rna bas kyang ma thos te/ kla klo rgya gar nub na yod pas so/ /grub pa'i mtha' rnams nyams zhes pa'i 'grel par yang / mu stegs kyi grub mtha' nyams pa yin gyi byang sham bha lar dus 'bor nyams pa ni ma yin no
