dbu ma pas rig cing / dmigs med snying rje dang / dmigs bcas stong nyid rtogs pa'i blo gnyis blo rdzas gcig tu 'dus pas gnyis su med par smra ba po ni phyogs gang gis kyang nyams par mi 'gyur ro/ /gsum pa la/ kla klo dang bcas pa'am mu stegs 'ga' zhig tshe 'di'i bde sdug snga ma'i las kho na la rag las sgo tshe 'dir bcos su med par 'dod la/ 'di na da ltar yang 'ga' zhig smra ba ni skyes rabs su yang bkag cing / 'dir yang de lta na las rtag par thal ba tsam gyis dgag pa mdzad do/ /rgyang phan ni/ 'byung ba 'dus tsam las lus srog grub par 'dod na ljon shing sogs la'ang der thal bas bkag go /zad byed pa ni/ srog lus kyi tshad du 'dod na/ rkang lag bcad pas srog gi cha shas chad par 'gyur ba dang / lus sbom phras de sbom 'phrar 'gyur la/ srid gsum dang thar pa bem po'i gzugs can yin pas rdul phran gyis bskyed pa'i phyir rtag par mi 'thad cing / rdzas dang rnam grangs la rtag mi rtag gi khyad par mi 'thad de/ de gnyis rang bzhin gcig pa'o/ /mi gcig na snam bu la snal ma med par 'gyur ro/ /ljon shing la srog yod na/ gcig gam du ma yod/ gcig yod par mi 'thad de/ ljon shing du ma yin pa'i phyir dang / bur shing gcig kyang dum bur bcad na du mar 'gyur bas so / /du mar song yang gcig la srog gnas mi gzhan rnams stong ngo zhe na ma yin te/ dum bu so sor btsugs pas myu gu skye ba'i phyir ro/ /rgyas par dbu tshad kyi gzhung la bslabs nas sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa dang 'gal ba rnams dgag

ra༅༅/ /cing mthun pa rnams gzhug par gsungs so/ /'on kyang snang zhugs spang ba ni/ phyi nang gi grub mtha' thams cad sems can gyi bas chags la gzigs nas/ rgyal bas gsungs pa dang / chos dang chos min du byed las phan gnod kyis bzhag dgos pa dang / de la blang dor byas nas zab rgyas sgom dgos pa dang / de ltar ston pa po la gus byar gdams pa ltar bka' drin dran nas phyag bya ba rnams te/ rjes 'jug gis kyang 'di lta bu'i shes bya mtha' dag gi blang dor ston pa po la/ drin du bzo bar bya'o/ /zhes dgongs pa'o/ /de ltar na phyi nang gnyis ni gzhi gtan 'bebs yin pas shin tu rtogs dka' zhing gal che na'ang / lam rim gnyis bsgom dgos pas de gnyis la go ba bskyed par bya'o/ /phyi nang gi spros pa la dga' ba dang pha jo sogs kyi bslab bya yin no snyam du sems pa mang du snang bas legs par bshad nus pa ma byung ba'i phyir kho bos rgya cher bshad pa yin no/ /nang gi le'u rgyas pa bshad zin to// //dge'o// ra༅༅/ /gzhan dus kyi 'khor lo'i spyi don bstan pa'i rgya mtsho bzhugs// na mo mañdzu badz+ra ya/ phyi nang 'byung chos las snang rags pa'i khams/ /lam gyi thabs bsgyur phyi nang dri ma kun/ /sbyangs pas phyi nang las gzhan bden gnyis rdzi /phyi nang dkyil 'khor ston mkhas de la 'dud / /gsum pa gzhan dus 'khor dkyil 'khor shākhor lo'i rnam gzhag la/ smin byed dbang dang / grol byed lam bshad po'o/ /dang po la spyi dang / bye brag tu bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ bdag po la dbang por bshad pa'i in+d+ra'i sgra

dang / bsgyur bya la dbang du bshad pa wa shaṃ gi sgra las drangs nas bshad par bya ba ma yin grin se ka la nye bsgyur a bhi sngon du sbyar ba a bhi ṣe ka ta'i sgra las drangs nas bshad par bya ba ste/ de la yang yi ge phyis bsnan byas nas/ a bhi dang ka ta phyis nas tsa dang na bsnan zhing / byings kyi dang po'i ṣa sa ru bsgyur bas/ se tsa na 'thor ba'am 'khra ba ste/ tha mal gyi snang zhen phra rags 'khra zhing sbyong ba'o/ /de bzhin du phyis bsnan byed tshul shes par byas nas ni ra ṣik+ta lugs su blug pa ste / khams phal pa bzhu nas lha'i rnam par bsgyur ba'o/ kho.ā sta pa ti nus pa 'jog pa ste/ sprul hūṃ sogs sku bzhi'i nus pa 'jog wa shaṃ ka sno ti dbang bar byed pa ste/ rim gnyis bsgom pa dang / dam chig rnams bsrung ba la dbang / mcha pāk+ṣa ti 'bras bu mngon du byed pa ste/ sku bzhi dang rdo rje bzhi la sogs pa'i 'bras bu rnams dbang po so sos ji ltar 'tsham par mngon du byed pa'o/ /de yang bya ba de dang des sems la 'gyur ba khyad par ba bskyed nas sems kyi steng du thob bya khyad par can gyi nus pa gsar du 'jog pa ni dbang gi don yin la/ de yang bya spyod man chad du nus pa nyid la dbang du ngo sprod cing / rnal 'byor rgyud du 'khyud pa'i dang / bla med du thabs de las kyang gong du gyur pa las byung ba'i bde ba dngos la dbang du ngo sprod pa ste/ thams cad la min byed rgyu'i dang / grol byed lam gyi dang / thob bya 'bras bu'i dbang rnams yod do/ /nus pa la dbang gi sgra yangs par khyer ba tsam ni 'dul ba las kyang 'byung ste/ dge tshul gyi rtags sdom de/ rdzogs pa'i byang

༄༄༄/ /chub dpal nod dbang bskur yin/ /zhes so/ /de bzhin du mdo sde'i phyogs las kyang mang du 'byung la/ khyad par sa bcu pa'i mdor/ sa bcu pa'i byang sems la phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyis 'od zer chen po'i dbang bskur sbyin tshul rgyas par gsungs pa ni/ rnam snang mngon byang dang rtsa rgyud de nyid 'dus par phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis dbang bskur te 'tshang rgya tshul thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa gsungs pa rnams dang rjes su mthun par dri ma'i lhag ma dbang gis sbyangs nas thob bya don gyi dbang thob par byed pa'i thabs su shes par bya ba yin te/ yi ge mangs su dogs pas mi spro'o/ /rgyud sde bzhi'i dbang gi rim pa ni ye shes thig le sogs kyi rgyud las 'byung ba ltar gong du bshad zin pa nyid do/ /khyad par blamed kyi dbang bzhis sku bzhi'i nus pa 'jog pa dang / lam bzhi bsgom pa dang dam tshig bzhi bsrung ba la dbang ba sogs ni kun la gsal la/ bye brag tu kye rdo rje las/ dbang bzhi rme brten pa'i bzhi tshan gyi lam rim rgyas par 'byung ba dang / yang sgos 'di pa'i dbang bcu gzhig li nus pa gang 'jog pa dang / dbang gang gi lam gyi spang rtogs ji tsam bsgrub pa ni mdor bsdu smon lam rnams su brjod zin la/ rgyas par 'og tu bshad par bya'o/ /gnyis pa la gang gis bskur ba'i slob dpon/ gang la bskur ba'i slob ma/ nam gyi tshe bskur ba'i dus/ ji ltar bskur pa'i cho ga de ltar du bskar pa'i dgos pa'o/ /dang po ni/ spyir rang rgyud theg pa thun mong bas sbyangs pa dgos shing / gdul bya

mchog dman mtha' dag rjes su gzung dgos pas/ phyi ru nyan thos spyod pa skyong / /nang du gsang ba 'dus la dga'/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar yon tan thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa mtha' dag tshang ba dgos pa'i phyir na/ 'dul ba'i dbang du byas na/ tshul khrims ldan zhing 'dul ba'i cho ga shes/ /nad pa snying brtse 'khor ni dag pa dang / /chos dang zang zing phan thogs brtson pa dang / /dus su 'doms pa de dag bla mar bsngags/ /zhes sogs rten mkhas btsun bzang gsum gyi yon tan dang / theg pa thun mong gi dbang du byas na/ bshes gnyen dul ba zhi ba nyer zhi pa/ /yon tan lhag par brtson byas lung gis phyug /de nyid rab tu rtogs pa smra mkhas ldan/ /brtse ba'i bdag nyid skyo ba spangs la bsten/ /zhes sogs dang / theg chen gyi dbang du byas na/ byang chub sems dpa' thos mang dang / /bden mthong smra mkhas brtse ba can/ /skyo med skyes bu dam pa ni/ /chen po yin par shes par bya/ /zhes sogs dang / rtag par dge ba'i bshes gnyen ni/ /theg chen don la mkhas pa dang / /byang chub sems dpa'i brtul zhugs mchog /ces sogs so/ /rgyud sde gong 'og las slob dpon gyi mtshan nyid rgyas par gsungs pa rnams mkhas mchog dpa' bos bsdus te/ bla ma lnga bcu par/ snying rje med cing khro la gdug /khengs shing chags la ma bsdams dang / /spyoms dang bcas pa mi bya 'o/ /zhes sogs kyi skyon dang / brtan zhing dul la blo gros ldan/ /bzod ldan drang la g.yo sgya med/ /sngags dang rgyud kyi sbyor ba shes/ /snying rjer ldan

༄༄༄/ /zhing bstan bcos mkhas/ /de nyid bcu ni yongs su shes/ /dkyi5 'bor 'dri ba'i las la mkhas/ /gsang sngags 'chad pa'i sbyor ba shes/ /rab tu dang 'ing dbang po dul/ /zhes sogs yon tan bshad pa ni/ /'grel chen 'dir yang lung du drangs pas dus 'khor rtsa ba'i rgyud kyi tshig tu mngon no/ /de la spyoms pa ni/ sems rgyud kyi yon tan dang dge ba sngar byas mi sbed par yang yang sgrog pa'o/ /sngags kyi sbyor ba ni/ ming don/ spel tshig rdo rje'i tshig sgra spangs pa'o/ /rgyud kyi sbyor ba ni/ gser 'gyur dang 'dod pa'i sgya rtsa la sogs so/ /de nyid bcu ni/ rong pa sher seng / brtan zhing dul ba sogs bgrang yang / rdo rje snying po rgyan gyi rgyud las/ phyi'i dang / gsang ba'i de nyid bcu bcu bshad cing / rang gi lta ba'i 'dod pa mdor bstan du/ dkyil 'khor dnge ni ting 'dzin dang / /phyag rgya bya ba 'dug stangs dang / /gtor ma sbyin sreg rab gnas dang / /spyan drangs gshegs su gsol ba 'o/ /zhes gsungs pa rnams so/ /'di'i tshigs bcad gnyis pas yon to dang / gsum pas skyon gyi mtshan nyid rnams bshad do/ /de yang yon tan ni/ dam tshig dang ldan nas/ rdo rje sems dpar grags pa'i thar phyin gnyis las/ slob ma la lam sbyin pa dang / dmyal ba'i 'jigs pa 'phrog pa dang / bdud 'joms pa dang / rdor sems su grags pa rnams gzhan don dang / gzhan rnams rang don gtso che la/ de yang ma chags pa dang dri ma bral ba gnyis spang bya spangs pa/ gzhan rnams thob bya thob pa'i yon tan

no / /skyon ni nga rgyal nas 'dod ldan gyi bar du bcu gnyis te/ thos pa med pa dang / sems nyams pa dang / dbang ma thob pa gsum/ thob bya ma thob pa dang / gzhan rnams dor bya ma dor ba'i skyon te/ de la yang sems kyi skyon dang / lus ngag gi skyon sogs su bsdu tshul dpyad nas sheg par bya'o/ /de yang yon tan mtha' dag dang ldan zhing skyon mtha' dag dang bral ba ni dus kyi dbang gis rnyed par dka' bas/ yon tan shes che ba tsam la yang brten dgos par gsungs te/ don dam bsnyen pa las/ rtsod dus dbang gis bla ma skyon dang yon tan 'dres/ /rnam pa kun tu sdig pa med pa yod ma yin/ /gang zhig yon tan lhag pa yang ni legs dpyad nas/ /bu rnams kyis ni de la brten par 'gyur ba 'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro / /de yang rab dge slong / 'bring dge tshul/ tha ma khyim pa ste sa thob ma gtogs pa'i khyim pa la rab byung dang rgyal po sogs kyis bkur sti mi bya ba dang / des kyang slob dpon gzhan gnyis sa phyogs de na yod bzhin du dbang dang rab gnas sogs rdo rje slob dpon gyi las mi bya ba sogs la nan tan cher gsungs pa ni/ bstan pa'i rtsa ba so sor thar pa la gces spras mchog tu mdzad pa ste/ don 'di la sems 'grel gsum ka na shin tu nan tan che bar mdzad pas rab byung spyi dang khyad par dang tshugs tshul bzhin du byed pa'i rababyung gang yin nyan thos theg dman yin zhes smra ba'i gsang sngags par rlom pa dag ni/ spyir rang 'byor lnga'i gnas la dad pa ma tshang zhing / khyad par rdo rje 'chang dang sa bcu'i byang sems kyi dgongs pa las

ra༅༅/ /rgyab kyis phyogs pa'o/ /yang 'di la ma mkhas pa kha cig slob dpon yon tan blang bya yi/ /skyon ni nam yang min pa nyid/ /ces pas 'khral nas/ skyon yon gyi brtag pa byar mi rung ngo zhes zer ba ni/ rgyud sde kun tu slob dpon gyi skyon yon rgya cher gsungs pa dang 'gal lo zhes bkag cing / dbang mchog thob gang zhes pa/ dbang bzhi bskur ba'i slob dpon so skye tha mal par lusarā la/ slob ma sangs rgyas zin pas kyang phyogs bcu nas dus gsum du byon te phyag byed par bshad pa ma yin nam snyam pa na/ nges don du dbang mchog ni mi 'gyur ba'i bde chen nyi khri chig stong drug brgya'i ska cig tha ma yin la/ de byang chub shing drung du thob pa'i rgyal ba shwakya thub pa la phyogs bcu'i byang sems rnams kyis phyag byed pa na dbu rgyan la gnas pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis kyang phyag byed pa yin la/ drang don la slob dpon phal pa la phyogs bcu'i slob mas phyag byed pa na de dgagi phung po rnams de bzhin gshegs par phyogs phyag byed pa'o/ /zhes gsungs shing / 'dir bum pa dang gsang ba dang shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur ba rnams kyi mdun du zhes pa/ a gra mchog tu bsgrar rgyu mdun du bsgyur ba'i skyon te/ dbang bskur ba rnams kyi mchog phyag rgya chen mo zhes bsgyur dgos te / dbang mchog thob gang zhes pa'i bshad pa yin pa'i phyir dang / rnam bshad rigs par/ mchog gi sgra ni gtso bo dang / /dang po rtse rmo mdun gyi don/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /'dir phyag byed pa'i tshe dbu rgyan mi 'bud par yang bstan

to / /yang rab byung dang dge slong gtso bor bya ba'i don du/ khyim pa dang gsar bu la phyag byed dgos pa byung na glegs bam sogs mdun du byas nas de la phyag byed pa ltar ma byas na 'jig rten pas smod par yang gsungs so/ /de yang chos 'chad pa'i tshe bya'i/ skabs gzhan du phyag mi byed la/ rang las bslab pa rgan pa'i dge slong rdo rje slob dpon la nyin re lan gsum du phyag dang maṇ+ḍal bya zhing / mi byed na rmongs pa dang sdig can gyis gtso bor dang / mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i rdo rje slob dpon ni rdo rje 'chang nyid de'i cha byad bstan nas 'jig rten du 'byon pas/ de mnyes mi mnyes las lha mnyes ma mnyes su 'gyur tshul ye le'i mjug tu gsungs shing / rgyud gzhan du yang / gal te lha ni mnyes 'dod na/ /'bad pas bla ma mnyes par bya/ /zhes sogs rgyas par gsungs la/ de lta na yang / gsar bu dang khyim pa la slob dpon yin yang phyag dang rkang pa bkru ba sogs mi byed pa ni/ yid kyis shin tu gus par byed dgos mod mi lus ngag gis gus tshul ches na le lo'i dbang gis sdom pa gong ma la ched cher mi byed pa'i rkyen du 'gyur zhing / bstan pa spyi'i bsnyen bkur gyi rim pa la gnod par dogs te/ 'dul bar yang / gnas bla ma rang las bslab pa gzhon na 'dud pa 'ba' zhig ma gtogs so zhes phyag mi bya bar bshad pa dang mthun no/ /gnyis pa ni/ 'dul bar/ slob dpon la gus tshul khrims yongs dag dang / /bsam gtan dang ni 'don la rtag brtson dang / /grims shing dul la bzod dang ldan pa ni/ /sdom brtson gnas pa'i chos ldan shes par

༄༄༄/ /bya/ /zhes sogs dang / rgyud las/ de ltar slob ma snying rje gtong / /tshul khrims bzod pa'i yon tan ldan/ /zhes sogs gsungs shing / 'dir zab cing rgya che la sems sogs yon tan dgu po yongs su rdzogs na rdzogs rim dang shas cher rdzogs na bsod nams kyi rgyu bskyed rim dang / phal cher ma tshang na re zhig dge bsnyen gyi bslab pa la sogs pa byin nas smin par byed du gzhug go /de yang kye rdor las/ dang por gso sbyong sbyin par bya/ de rjes bslab pa'i gnas bcu byin/ /de la bye brag smra ba bstan/ /zhes sogs nas/ /sngags kyi rim pa kun shes nas/ /de rjes kye yi rdo rje bstan/ /zhes sogs ltar/ gang la gang 'tsham/ gyi sgo nas bsdu ba ni/ spyir sangs rgyas kyi thabs mkhas dang / khyad par rdo rje theg pa'i yang rtse rnams las kyang gsungs pas/ bsdur d+me rung ba'i snyom ma med do zhes rong pa'i ngag rgyun la 'byung ba ches legs pa yin gyi/ sngags kyi snod du re zhig mi rung ba rnams la snang smras kyis 'dor zhing / smod par byed pa ni slob dpon gyi bya ba ma yin no/ /des na spyir gzhan phan gyi bsam sbyor lhur len mkhan dang / khyad par rdo rje slobi dpon mtshan nyid dang ldan pa zhig yin na/ gdul bya mchog dman mtha' dag gang la gang 'tsham gyi lam gyis rjes su bzung ba'i brtse sems khyad par can dang thabs la mkhas pa'i sbyor ba la brtson par bya'o/ /de ltar na gang zag la dri ma glo bur ba'i cha nas mchog dman shin tu che ba dang / de la bltos nas gsungs pa'i gsung rab kyi dngos bstan la yang mchog

dman shin tu che ba'i tshul la yang nges pa rnyed pa zhig dang / gang zag gi rang bzhin rnam dag dang gsung rab kyi sbas don shugs bstan la mchog dman med par chos dang gang zag gi mnyam pa nyid thams cad khong du chud nas chags snang dang blang dor med pa'i dad gus ro gcig gi nyams len la nges pa rnyed pa gnyis tshogs pa ni shin tu rnyed par dka' ba'i nyams len yin par shes par bya'o/ /sngags la 'jug pa'i gang zag gi yon tan yang spyir btang la skyes bu gsum gyi lam thun mong bas rgyud sbyangs nas 'jug pur gsungs kyang / mtha' gcig tu ma nges te/ gsang ba spyi rgyud las/ la la gsang sngags bsgrub don gnyer/ /'di na dkyil 'bor 'jug par byed/ /bsod nams 'dod pas de las gzhan/ /gzhan dag 'jig rten gzhan don gnyer/ /zhes sogs/ kun slong tha ma tshe 'di'i nad zhi sogs/ 'jing phyi ma lha mi tsam/ rab sangs rgyas don gnyer gsum las/ dang po gnyis dor nas phyi ma bcos nas kyang bskyed pa'i kun slong 'chos tshul gsungs la/ rgyud tshig de dag bla med kyi dkyil chog khungs thub du mar yang drangs nas bshad cing / lam thun mong bas rgyud 'byongs pa la kun slod gsar du 'chos don med pa'i phyir ro/ /slob ma'i grangs kyang / spyi rgyud du/ gcig nas nyi shu rtsa lnga'i bar/ /zung du ma gyur slob ma gzung / /de la lhag pa'i slob ma dag /yongs su bzung ba mi shis so/ /zhes dang / kha 'cham na/ grangs kyi kha skong ming byang tsam la brten nas kyang byed tshul bshad pa bzhin bla med kyi nang nas da ri ma'i bde mchog dkyil

ra༅༅/ /chog tu bshad la/bod kyi bla ma mang po yang 'dir mi rung ba'i dam tshig skad du mdzad nas/slob ma'i grangs cung zad lhag pa rnams la snang smras mang du byed pa dag snang mod rdzibya rgyud kyi yang 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud du slob ma'i grangs brgyad du gsungs shing /spyod rgyud rnam snang mngon byang las/slob ma dad cing rigs btsun pa/ /de bzhin dkon mchog gsum la dad/ /zab mo yi ni blo dang ldan/ /spro ba che zhing tshul khrims ldan/ /bzod dang ldan zhing ser sna med/ /dpa' ba yi dam brtan pa ni/ /bcu 'am brgyad dam bdun nam lnga/ /gcig gnyis bzhi las lhag kyang rung / /dpyad mi dgos par gzung bar bya/ /zhes bshad cing dkyil chog rdor 'phreng du/gcig gam gnyis sam mang po dag kyang rung ste zhes bshad la/'dir ma la ya'i skyed mos tshal gyi gzhal med khang chen po ra 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis nyi ma'i shing rta la sogs pa'i tshangs pa'i drang srong bye ba phrag phyed dang bzhi dus gcig la dbang bskur bar gsungs pas/snod du rung na grangs la nges pa med cing / de yang 'jug pa tsam gyi snod la sdom pa mi 'dzin kyang / sngags la mos pa nges par dgos la/slob ma dang slob dpon gyi dbang gi snod la rim pa bzhin/byang sems kyi sdom pa tsam dang / de dang sngags sdom gnyis ka 'dzin nus nges par dgos so/ /gsum pa ni/ dus kyi nang nas lo la/rgya nag lugs la/ mche ba can gyi lo bzhi la drag las bya bar bshad pa sogs lo 'di la 'di bzang gi rnam gzhag cung zad bshad kyang /rgya gar lugs la de

ltar bshad pa ma mthong na'ang / sangs rgyas lhums su zhugs pa dang / sku bltams pa dang / sangs rgyas pa rnams chu mo phag dang / shing phe ༷rnge ba dang / sa mo phag rnams yin pas/ bya ba chen po rnams de dag la byas na bzang bar gsal zhing / khyad par dgung lo joni brgyad pa/ lcags pho 'brug rdzogs/ lcags mo sprul la dpal ldan 'bras spungs kyi mchod rten du dus kyi 'khor lo gsungs pas lo de ni lugs 'di la mchog tu bsngags shing / de bzhin du shing pho spre'u la sham+bha la'i ma la ya'i skyed mos tshal du 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis nyi ma'i shing rta la sogs pa tshangs pa'i drang srong bye ba phrag phyad dang bzhi la dus kyi 'khor lo'i gzhal med khang du dbang bskur zhing sdus rgyud bsdus pas lo 'di yang mchog tu bsngags so/ /de bzhin du rab byung gi lor grags pa me mo yos la rgya gar du dus 'khor phebs pas lo de yang ngo / /lo'i cha shas kyi dus ni/ gsang ba spyi rgyud sogs nas ston zla 'bring po nas brtsams te/ dbyed zla tha chung gi bar zla ba bdun ni dngos grub sgrub pa'i dus dang / dbyar gyi dus nad gdon zhi ba sogs kyi las bsgrub tu rung bar bshad la/ 'dir ni spyir chu srin sogs byang bgrod kyi zla ba drug 'od zer gyi lam zhes bya ba nyi ma steng nas steng du 'gro bas gnas 'og ma nas gong mar 'gro ba dang mthun pa'i phyer na sangs rgyas pa'i dus zhes bya ba yin pas dge ba'i las rnams shes shing / garka ṭa sogs drug de las ldog pa du ba'i lam zhes bya ba kla klo'i dus yin pas sdig pa dang sdig pa/ ltar snang ba'i las rnams kyi dus su bshad

ra༅༅/ /cing / 'phral du'ang dgun nyi log pa la dga' snang dang / dbyar nyi log pa la mi dga' ba'i snang ba phal cher la myong bas grub pa'i phyir na bshad pa snga ma ni ston lo thog gi 'bras bu la longs spyod pa tsam gyi sgo nas bshad par mngon no/ /khyad par lug glang 'khrig gsum lta bu dus sbyor sum tshan rnams la brtan g.yo mnyam gsum bshad nas g.yo ba la bya ba bsgrubs na myur ba dang / brtan pa la bul ba dang / mnyam pa la 'bring du gsungs pa'ang yod la / khyim zla bcu gnyis kyi zhing bdag gi gza' lngar bshad pa ltar/ res 'ga' bdun po rim pa bzhin/ seng ge dang / sharka ṭa dang / lug sdig dang / 'khrig pa bu mo dang / gzhu nya dang / glang srang dang / chu bum gyi bdag po yin pas zla ba rab dang / nyi ma dang zhi gza' gnyis 'bring dang / drag gza' gsum gyis zhing bdag byed pa'i khyim zla de la dbang dang rab gnas sogs 'dzem dgos shing / 'on kyang rgyal gyi nya la rgyal po dang / nag pa'i nya la sangs rgyas dbang bskur ba'i dus yin pas 'di pa'i dbang bskur ba'i dus dang / bdud bcom pa'i nyin zhag sa ga'i nya la'ang de bzhin gsungs shing / de dag la ma grub na nya gzhan la sbyor ba dang / gza' skar bzang na tshes gzhan la'ang bya bar gsungs so/ /gsang ba spyi rgyud dang rab gnas kyi rgyud du tshes grangs dang gza' skar gyi nges pa'ang gsungs te/ de dag dang sngags rim dang rab gnas kyi cho ga dge legs rgya mtsho sogs las shes par bya'o/ /bye brag tu phur sangs nyi ma la nub pa'i dus su bag ma dang rab

gnas 'dzem par gsungs so/ /bzhi pa la/ rnam gzhag spyir bstan/ lag len so sor bshad pa'o/ /dang po la/ rgyud sde spyi dang / bye brag gi cho ga'o/ /dang po ni/ bya ba spyi'i cho ga gsang ba spyi rgyud nas/ slob dpon gyis bsnyen pa bya tshul dang /0 de rjes/ rnam dpyad dang po sa gzhi bzung / /gnyis pa la ni sta gon bya/ /nub gsum pa la 'jug pa shis/ /zhes sa chog sta gon dngos gzhi mjug chog dang bcas pa phal cher rgyas la gsal ba gsungs pa ni rgyud sde gong ma'i dkyil chog tshad ldan rnams su yang thun mong ba rnams phal cher drangs shing / dbang chog la chu dang cod pan tsam las med pa rnams kyi steng du spyod rgyud rnam snang mngon byang dang / phyag rdor dbang bskur sogs nas rdor dril ming gsum bsnan zhing / yo ga'i bshad rgyud rtse mo dang bcas pa'i rtsa rgyud du rig pa'i dbang lnga rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang gsang dbang rjes mthun pa dang bcas pa gsal la rgyas par gsungs pa rnams la bla med kyi rgyud sde kun tu zhal 'phangs mdzad de/ brtag gnyis su/ mang du smos kyang ci zhig bya/ /ji ltar de nyid bsdus pa yi/ /dkyil 'khor cho ga bzhin du bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /bla med kyi dbang chog ni/ bshad rgyud rdo rje phreng bar cho ga nyi shur bsngas nas gsal bar gsungs shing / slob dpon klu sgrub zhabs kyis mdzad par grags pa'i dkyil chog nyi shu pa ni bod kyi rdzus mar snang mod 7 klu byang gi cho ga nyi shu pa ni/ rgya bod kun gyis tshad ldan du byed cing / khyad par 'phags yul gyi rdo rje slob dpon chen po a bha yā ka ras shes byed kyi gtso bor

༄༄༄/ /mdzad cing / mar me mdzad bzang po'i bzhi brgya lnga bcu pa yang kun gyi khungs su byed pas/ sa ra ha'i sangs rgyas thod pa'i dkyil chog sogs kyang yod mod rdzi rgya gar mkhas pa'i dkyil chog gi gzhung gi gtso bo ni klu byang gi nyi shu pa dang / mar me mdzad kyi bzhi brgya lnga bcu pa snyas dang / yo ga'i kun snying gi rdo rje 'byung ba rnams dang / de rjes a bha ya'i rdo rje 'phreng ba dang / de'i rjes 'brang gi bi bhu ti dang / rat+na rak+ṣi ta dang / khyad par me long dga' ba'am dar paṇa ā tsār+ya'i kṛ ya sa muts+tsha rnams la legs par bslab par bya ba yin no/ /de la klu byang gi cho ga nyi shu ni/ gzhung der ji skad du/ dang por sa ni sbyang ba dang / /de nas sa yongs 'dzin pa dang / /phyi nas bgegs ni nyer zhi zhing / /thod le kor gyi thig gdab dang / /de nas sa lha sogs lhag par/ /gnas dang de nas gsol gdab dang / /phyi nas slob ma lhag gnas dang / /nam mkhar thig ni gdab pa dang / /tshon sna lnga yi cho ga dang / /de nas tshon ni bkye ba dang / /lha rnams spyan drangs nyid dang ni/ /de nas slob ma gzhug pa dang / /khras kyi dkyil 'khor cho ga dang / /de nas sangs rgyas dbang bskur dang / /de nas phyag mtshan dbang bskar dang / /lha dang bla mar yon gnyis dang / /rjes su gnang ba sbyin pa dang / /de nas gshegs gsol cho ga dang / /dkyil 'bor las byerdo phur bu dang / /skud pa bsdu ba nyid kyang ste/ /rab bshad cho ga nyi shu yis/ /ji lta ji ltar rgyas shes pa'i/ /rdo rje slob dpon mkhas pa yis/ /rdul tshon dkyil 'khor bri bar

bya / /zhes gsungs pa rnams te/ bshad rgyud rdor phreng dang go rim cung zad mi mthun yang grangs dang rnam gzhag mtha' dag rgyud sde de la brten pa'o/ /slob dpon a bha yas de dag gi steng du rdo rje slob dpon gyi bya ba gzhan 'dra yang bsnan zhing dbang la dbye ba mdzad nas slob dpon gyi bya ba thams cad cho ga lnga bcur bsdus nas gsungs pa ni/ gtsug lag khang la sogs pa'i mchod yon dang / mchod yon la sogs pa 'bul ba'i mtshan nyid dang / sngon du bsnyen pa'i dgos pa dang / slob ma bsdu ba dang / sa brko ba dang / sa sbyang ba dang / sa yongs su gzung ba dang / bgegs la phur bus gdab pa dang / nor 'dzin ma lhag par gnas pa dang / bum pa lhag par gnas pa dang / lha lhag par gnas pa dang / dkyil 'khor gyi thig gdab pa dang / tshon bkye ba dang / bum pa dgod pa dang / dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa dang / lha rab tu gnas pa dang / sku gzugs la sogs pa 'i rab gnas dang / rdzing bu la sogs pa'i rab gnas dang / a ma'i skyed mos tshal la sogs pa'i rab gnas dang / slob ma lhag par gnas pa dang / slob dpon 'jug pa dang / slob ma gzhug pa dang / phreng ba dang / chu dang / cod pan dang / rdo rje dang / dril bu dang / ming gi dbang dang / dam tshig gsum sbyin pa dang / slob dpon gyi dbang dang / sngags sbyin pa dang / mig sman dang / me long dang / mda' 'phang ba dang / gsang ba dang / shes rab ye shes ngang / dbang bzhi pa dang / ris pa'i brtul zhugs dang / rdo rje'i brtul

ra༅༅/ /zhugs dang / spyod pa'i brtul zhugs dang / lung bstan pa dang / rjes su gnang ba dang / dbugs dbyung ba dang / rang dbang bskur ba dang / sbyin sreg dang / dkyil 'khor bsdu ba dang / yid kyi dkyil 'bor dang / gtor ma dang / bgegs bsal ba dang / rdo rje dril bu'i mtshan nyid dang bzung ba ste/ cho ga lnga bcus bsgrub par bya'o/ /zhes so/ /slob dpon dga' ba'i me long gis/ sa yongs su brtag pa dang / sa'i sel dbyung ba dang / sa sel la thig gdab pa'i mtshan ma dang / mchod yon gyi cho ga dang / rnying pa gso ba dang / mchod yon la sogs pa sbyin pa'i nges pa dang / sngon du bsnyen pa'i dgos pa dang / slob ma bsdu ba dang / dkyil 'khor gyi khang pa bya ba dang / sa yongs su bzung ba dang / bgegs la phur bus gdab pa dang / nor 'dzin ma lhag par gnas pa sogs gsum dang / thig skud lhag par gnas pa dang / nam mkha' la thig gdab pa dang / dkar pos thig gdab pa dang / dkyil 'khor la thig gdab pa dang / tshon gyi bzlas pa dang / tshon bkye ba sogs gsum dang / dkyil 'khor gyi lha thams cad bsdus te bsgom pa dang / sku gzugs la sogs pa'i rab gnas dang / bgrang 'phreng gi ma nyid dang / rgyal mtshan gzugs pa dang / rdzing ba la sogs pa'i rab tu gnas pa sogs gnyis dang / dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa la sogs pa dang / dbang bskur ba dang / rang gis dbang blang ba dang / rtsa ba'i ltung ba dang / sbom po'i ltang ba dang / sbyin sreg dang / yid kyi sbyin

sreg dang / tshogs kyi bza' ba dang / dkyil 'khor nyer bsnga sogs gsum dang / gza' yum la sogs pas bde legs su byed pa dang / bgegs bsal ba dang / sku gzugs kyi mtshan nyid dang / khams kyi yon tan dang / shing la sogs pa'i sel dbyung ba dang / mchod rten gyi dang / rdo rje dril bu'i mtshan nyid dang / rdor dril bzung ba dang / kha ṭaṃ ga dang ḍa ma ru la sogs pa sna tshogs pa'i mtshon cha'i mtshan nyid dang / nags tshal gyi ltad mo dang / khra'i tshad dang / gaṇ+ḍi'i mtshan nyid dang / mchod rten la sogs pa'i srog shing gzugs pa dang / sgo'i shing gzugs pa dang / ka ba gzugasi pa dadzo / gtsug lag khang la sogs pa'i rtse mor shing gzugs pa dang / dri gtsang khang la sogs parā dang / tshad kyi 'jal ba'i dang / rgya phibs la sogs pa'i dang / bsam gtan gyi khang pa la sogs pa'i mtshan nyid dang / shi ba'i rus bu dag par byed pa'i cho ga ste/ cho ga drug cu rtsa bzhis bsgrub par bya'o/ /zhes bshad de/ rgyud dang klu byang gis ni dkyil chog rkyang pa'i dbang du mdzad la/ phreng ba dang kṛ ya sa muts+tsha gnyis kyis ni de dang 'brel ba'i bya ba spyi'i dbang du mdzad pa ste/ de gnyis kyang bsdus rgyas kyi khyad par yin zhing / phyi ma la gza' yum nor rgyun ma rnam rgyal gsum so sor bgrangs/ rdor dril so sor bgrangs/ci na cho sa drug cu rtsa bzhi yo/da do /de dag kyang bo bos byas pa 'i bde dgyesku gsang 'dus so gso/ kyi dkyil chog rnams dang / rnam gzhag spyir bstan nas la ga le na dus 'khor la gtso bor sbyar ba'i rten gsum bzhengaris tshul dpa la 'byor

ra༅༅/ /rgya mtsho/ rab gnas cho ga dge legs rgya mtsho/ sbyin sreg cho ga dngos grub rgya mtsho/ tshogs 'khor cho ga bdud rtsi rgya mtsho/ lho sgo'i cho ga sgrib pa kun sbyong rnams las legs par bshad pas de dag la bslab par bya'o/ /khyad par bla med kyi dbang gi rnam gzhag ni/ rgyal po in+d+ra bhu ti'i dbang gi man ngag rin chen 'bor lo dang / mkhas pa chen po ye shes rdo rje zhes grags pa/ rgyal po rab gsal zla ba'i sras kyi gtso bo bzhi/ kun snying gi bla ma bzhi'i nang nas kyang mchog tu gyur pa des mdzad pa'i rtsod pa'i dang / sngags kyi lam gyi rim pa ste rim pa gnyis pa zhes grags pa'i bstan bcos las legs par bshad pa'i bod kyi mkhas pa snga phyi la cher ma grags pa gnyis snang bas/ 'di gnyis las gsungs pa rnams 'dir mdor bsdus te/ go sla bar bri bar bya'o/ /de yang dang pos dbang bzhi ga yang don nyi shu nyi shus legs par bshad de/ gleng gzhi dang / gnas dang / dus dang / slob dpon dang / slob ma dang / dkyil 'khor dang / der 'jug pa dang / dbang bskur ba dang / dbang gi rnam grangs dang / bskur ba'i lus kyi gnas dang / thabs dang / sbyang bya'i sgrib pa dang / thob bya'i sa dang / nyams len gyi lam dang / rtags dang / brda dang / dbang rdzas dang / bsam don gyi dgongs pa dang / byed las kyi nus pa dang / 'bras bu rnams so/ /de la bum dbang gi gleng gzhi ni/ rgyal ba sku bltams dus klu'i rgyal pos bum chu blug pa dang / 'khor los sbyar rgyal du lung bstan pa dang / 'tshang rgya

khar sa'i lha mos bkra shis pa'i rdzas dang bum pa phul ba la sogs pa'o/ /gsang dbang gi gling gzhi ni/ dpal 'dus pa la sogs pa'i rgyud kyi thog mar rdo rje 'chang 'dod chags chen po'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas gzungs ma rnams spal te bde chen la rol nas byang sems rnams la dbang bskur ba'o/ shes rab ye shes kyi gling gzhi ni/ yang rgyud der sngags kyi spyod pa khyad par can bstan pa dang byang chub sems dpa' rnam sa ngus te brgyal zhing rmongs pa las bslang ste sbas ldon bstan pa'o/ /bzhi pa'i gling gzhi ni/ rgyud der 'khor gyi byang sems rnams kyis gsang ba'i yi ge mthong ba'i skal ba bdag cag la med do zhes dus pa na/ ston pas yi ge rnam par dag ces yi ge las dben rma 'i mtshan nyid gsungs pa'o/ /de bzhin du dbang bzhi'i gnas ni rim pa bzhin/ phyi rol gyi ri dang sman ljongs dang dkyil 'khor gyi khang pa sogs lus kyi khams yid dang rjes su mthun pa dang / phyi'i rig ma ma tshan ldan gyi lus kyi phyi'i dbyibs dang / nang gi rtsa 'khor dang / mthar thug si gnas lugs la bzhugs di 'i sangs rgyas pa'i bde chen gyi ye shes rnams so/ /dus bzhi ni/ bla mas gnang / slob ma 'dod/ chos 'byang zhing bsgrab pa'i dus dang / bum dbang rdzogs/ rig ma zla mtshan dang ldan de dang bla mas gnang ba'i dus dang / dbang gnyis rdzogs/ rig ma dgyes shing bla mas gnang ba'i dus dang / blang dor gzung 'dzin dus gsum sogs me da pa'i byer+sha chen po'osko/ /slob dpon bzhi ni/ dbang thob dam tshig ldan pa sogs kyi ma

ra༅༅/ /nyid rdzogs pa dang / thabs bla ma/ shes rab rig ma/ gnyis med thugs 'dres pa ste gsum dang / phyi bla ma/ nang rig ma ste gnyis dang / gnyis med rang rig chen po'i de kho na nyid mthong ba'i rang sems so/ /slob ma bzhi ni/ sngags dang rgyud la mos pa sogs kyi mtshan nyid spyi tshang ba/ rtsa ba'i sngags ci rigs pa sngon du bzlas pa dang / bum dbang rdzogs shing snying po bzlas pa nang gi brtul zhugs dang / dam tshig la mos pa dang / dbang gnyis rdzogs shing sbas don khyad par can la mos/ nye snying bzlas pa dang / dbang gsum rdzogs don dam tha snyad kyi gnas lugs gnyis dang bsam gyis mi khyab pa la mos pa rdo rje sems dpa'i spun no/ /dkyil 'khor ni/ bumyo/ dbang la slob ma rab 'bring tha gsum la rim pa bzhin/ ting nge 'dzin/ me tog rdul tshon no/ /gzhan yang lugs ma 'bur ma bris ma glegs bam/ mchod rten bla ma'i lus zhes pa bshad pa'i phyi ma gsum mas rim bzhin/ lus dkyil/ blos slongs/ gzungs thang rnams su gsal lo/ /de dag bsgrub pa la sngon du bsnyen pa/ sa sbyang / bgegs bsal/ sa bzung / sta gon bzhi/ thig gdab/ tshon dgye rgyan bkod/ dgug gzhug mchod pa rnams bshad/ dam tshig pa bskyed pa mi gsal yang sogs/ ji ltar grags pa'i cho gas bya/ /zhes pa kha skong gang dgos ston no/ /gsang dbang li phyag rgya mtshan ldan rnams kyi phyi'i lus kyi mdun rgyab g.yas g.yon bzhi ni zur bzhi sogs rdzogs pa ste/ de la yang brtag blang sbyang gzung byin

rlabs tshogs 'khor rnams rgyud bzhin no/ khes rab ye/ shes kyi rig ma mtshan ldan snga ma ltar sbyang shing byin gyis brlabs pa'i nang rgi rtsa 'khor drug gam bzhi/ khyad par gsang ba'i chos 'byang ste/ de yang brtag blang sbyang gzung byin rlabs rgyud bzhin no/ /bzhi pa'i dkyispo 'khor bzhi ni/ sangs rgyas kun gyi byang chub sems/ /bla na med pa'i thugs chud pa/ /gnyis su med pa'i ye shes gang / /de ni dkyil 'khor snying por brjod/ ༄/ces gsungs so/ /dkyil 'khor de rnam sa su 'jug pa'i cho ga bzhi ni/ rim pa ltar/ sta gon sngon du 'gro bas chas 'jug nas dkyil 'khor ston pa'i bar spyi 'gro bzhin dang / bum chus bkru/ yol bas bcad/ gsol ba gdab/ mig dar bcing / me tog gtad/ nang du drangs/ skor ba dang phyag bsdus pa byed du gzhug nang gi dam gzhag ye shes dbab/ me tog dor/ mig dar phye/ lus dkyil rdzogs par bstan pa rnam/sa dang / ga'an de ji ba'in la / mis dar phye nas mar me bteg ste rig ma'i mtshan dpe dang / chu skyes bstan / yid ngar rtsa 'khor bstan pa rnams dang / dbang bzhi pa'i gsung rab thos pa dang / don rtogs pa dang / de goms pa dang / mngon du gyur ba rnams/ mig phye ba dang dkyel 'khor mthong ba dang / der zhugs pa dang dngos grub thob pa rnams su gyur pa rnams so// /dbang bskur ba'i ni rim pa bzhin/ me tog phreng ba/ rig pa'i dbang l+ya brtul zhugs gsum byin pa dang bcas pa'i slob dpon/ dbugs nga:nga lu/nga bstan pri ra me lngog pa rngams dang / yab yum gyi dkar ngamar

ra༅༅/ /spel ba phreng ba/ rlon pa chu/ spyi bor reg pa cod pan/ lce thog rdo rje bzhag pa rdo rje/ hūm̐ sgrog pa dril bu/ a ho su kha ming / lces blang pa brtul zhugs/ mig lam du mi snang ba lung bstan/ bde ba thob pa dbugs dbyung / longs spyod kyi rlabs btsir ba phyir mi ldog pa rnams dang / chags pa 'phel ba phreng ba/ chu byung ba chu/ lan bu bzung ba cod pan/ pad+mar rdo rje bcus pa/ de bskyod pa/ ha skad rnams rngor dril ming / slar yang ltas dgod 'khyud gsum dam tshig gsum/ nu ma mnyed pa/ 'o byed pa/ pad+ma bsdams pa rnams lung bstan sogs gsum rnams dang / bzhi pa'i ye shes dngos su nyams su myong ba rnam sa so/ /dbang bzhi pa'i rnam grangs ni rim pa bzhin/ bum dbang la phyi nang sbas gsum/ phyi la pha rgyud man la grags pa'i bum chu dang / de la sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga bsres pa gnyis thun mong ba dang khyad par gyi bum pa'o/ /nang gi bla med la grags pa'i nang dbang / sbas pa la thangs kyi sbas pa/ spyi bo nas byang sems babs pas thugs sha'i ye shes sems dpa' mnyes pa/ shes rab kyi sbas pa yum dang mkha' gsang sbyar bas rdo rje nor bu sbyangs pa'o/ /de ltar bum dbang nyid la dbang bzhi'i kro snyad sbar te/ phyi sa/nyis re re nang dang sbas pa gnyis gcig de gsum yod med las grol bar rtogs pa rnams bum pa'i bum pa/ bum pa'i gsang ba sogs so/ /gsang dbang la yang byang sems khar byin pa phyi/ mgrin pa'i rtsa 'dab gang ba nang /nga 'og sgor bde ba skyes pa sbas pa'o/ /dbang bzhi dang sbyor

tshul / mkha' gsang nas chu 'bab pa dang / gas nga rdzas nyams pa dang / bde ba skyes pa dang / mi rtog par gyur pa rnams gsang ba'i bum pa sogs so/ /gsu/ma pa la yang rig ma gtad pa/ rtsa nang du bde ba myong ba/ lhan r+sās rdzogs pa rnams phyi nang sbas pa/ lus la lha dgod pa/ mkha' gsang reg pa/ bde chen myong ba/ gnyis snang nub pa rnams gsum pa'i bum dbang sogs so/ /bzhi pa la yang gzhin la dbang sbyin pa'i nus pa thogs med dang / theg pa rarā 'byams kyi dbang gi rnam grangs shes pa dang / nges don du dbang bsam mi khyab tu rtogs pa rnams so/ /'di la bzhi sbyor tshul ma gsungs so/ /dbang bskur ba'i lus kyi gnas bzhi ni/ spyi mgrin snyi nga gsum dang gnas mi dmigs pa rnams so/ /thabs bzhi ni/ slob dpon sbyin blang bsam pa mthun pa dang / bla ma yab yum gyi sbo gsum dag par mthun pa dang / rig ma'i bde ba dang por sems dang phyi nas lus kyis myong ba'am ma mtha' longs spyod kyi rlabs btsir ba dang / dmigs med ye shes chen po la/ sgyu 'phrul drwa ba mi 'gog pa'i thabs dang thabs byung bsam yas rnam/sa so/ /sbyang bya bzhi ni/ lus kyi gsu ma/ ngag si bzhi/ yid kyi gsum / rang rig ye shes rgyal ga nyid 'khor bar snang ba la sgrib pa rnams so/ /thob bya bzhi ni/ bum dbang li dkyil 'khor mthong ba tshogs lam/ 'phreng ba sbyo ra lam/ chu cod pan sa dang po/ gzhan gsu/ma brgyad pa'i bar/ brtul zhugs sogs/ lhag masas bcu snam sa so// /mchog dbang gsum ni/ sangs rgyas kyi sa

ra༅༅/ /dang po dang / gnyis pa rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa dang / ye shes tha snyadakun mkhyen gyi yul las 'das pa gnyis su med pa'i sa rnams thob bo/ /lam bzhi ni/ dkyil 'khor bri bsgrub sogs slob da ponagyi bya ba dang / bskyed rim las tshogs dang bcas pa sogs te/ mdor na rgyad kyi 'chad tshul mtha' drug li nang nas drang don dang sgra ji bzhin pa dang / dgongs min gsum/ tshul bzhi'i nang nas yig don spyi don gnyis/ bshad pa gnyis kyi nang nas tshogs bshad kyi lam rnams bskyed rim gyi smin byed bum dbang gi larmo/ nges don sgra ji bzhin pa min pa/ dgongs pa can te gsum dang / sbas don la mthar thug gi don gnyis dang / slob bshad kyi lam rnams ji+o gas rim smin byed mchog dbang gsum gyi lam ste/ de yang 'dir gsang sngags la/ gsang ba dang sbas don zhes pa tsam dang / gsum pa la yul can sems kyi 'od gsal gzung 'dzin 'gog pa'i lam/ steng sgo rlung dang 'og sgoli ga le'i lam zhes bsdus nas rlung bcu la brten pa'i rdor bzlas sogs gsungs shing / bzhi pa la rang bzhin gyis ni 'od gsal zhing / /rdzogs pa chen po mthar thug pa/ /man ngag kun gyi mchog gi mchog /de sgrub thabs su gsungs par bshad/ /ces gsungarme te/ gsum pa la thig le bde chen gyi lam gtso bor ston pa dang sbrel nas rtsa rlung gsungs par zad 7 rtsa rlung gzugs sku'i sgrub byed rnams gsang dbang gis lam du mi bzhed pa ma yin no/ /rtags bzhi ni/ dngos grub kyi rtags so shing / rmi lam dang snang gi

kha dog sogs dang / pho mo/'i bde ba che chung dang / smig rgyu du ba sogs mtshan ma lnga dang / glang po rnyed nas rjes kyi mtshon mi dgos pa ltar/ rang ris ma ngon gyur rtags dang bral ba rnams so/ /brda bzhi ni/ lus brda lnga bsdus rtse mnan dang / /mthe bos srin lag ma/nan pa dang / /de gnyis legs sbyar lus brda dang / /ngag brda dbang rang rang bi skabs su bab pa 'i dpa' bo dpa' mo'i skad du sma ba rnams dang / ba'i pa brda dang brda min thams cad las grol ba'o/ /dbang rdzas bzhi ni/ me togaci li 'dre nga ba dang / bum chus dbu rgyan sogs te/ pha rgyad das ma rgyud la rin po che dang / thod skam so sor sogs spyi 'gro bzhin dang / rmedzā long mig sma na/ 'khor 'i dung glegs sogs so/ /bya spyod sogs dang thun mong ba rin chen sna bdun dang bkra shis brgyad nye ba'i dbang bcas pa rnams dadzo / dbugs dbyung la yon tan/ lung bstan la chos gos/7 phyir mi ldog la de kho na nyid rnams bum dbang gri sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga gsang dbang / slob ma'i byang sems/ rig ma'i 'dod yon lnga ga tshogs 'khor gyi rdzas rnams gsum pa'i/ snang srid rdo rje gsum la spang blang dang bral ba'i ye shes bzhi pa'i'o/ /dgongs pa'am bsam don ni/ slob ma/ la dmigs pa spo ba dang / dag pa sogs kyi dbang don ngo spro da par byedang rnam/sa kun slong spyi ratshad med bzhi/ sgos dbang rang rang rgi lam dang /'bras bu snyem sbyo ra /'dod kyis bskyed pa rnams spyi /snagro yo ngas gras/sa bzhin dang / khyadaparametob/phrengabalalhadangametogaslob mal thim par bsam pa

༄༄༄/ /dang / dbang gsum la slob ma'i rtsa 'khor drug gam bzhi la dbyangs gsal gyi yi ge 'god pa dang / dmar cha gyen du 'bar pas bsregs/ sna sgo nas thon pas rgyal ba me/na gyi yon tan bkug nas zhugs/ dkar cha mar babs pas sos/ ñtsi tīr dkar dmar 'dres pa la brten par bzung nas lhan skyes bskyed tshul/ zhal lung grol thig a la pa ti sogs dang mthun pa dang / bzhi pa rang rig rjod bral la ngo sprod pa rnams so/ /nus pa bzhi'i bum dbang sogs re la/ dri ma bkru/ sdig pa sbyang / las byed/ 'bras bu la sbyor/ bdud bzhi 'joms pa ste lnga lnga bshad la/ bum dbang la/ phreng ba dang chu cod pan/ gzhan gsum/ slob dpon 'khor bcas rnams kyis rim pa bzhin ma dad pa dang / gnyis snang / rnam g.yeng lnga dang g.yeng ba phra mo'i dri ma rnams 'khra/ mos spyod dang / sa dang po dang / brgyad pa'i bar dang / bcu pa'i bar gyi sgrib pa sbyong / 'dod lha mnyes/ rigs gnyis kyi dang / gsum gyi nga rgyal bskyed / snga cha/ rnams brtan par byed pa'i las bzhi byed la/ de yang brtul zlurgis gnyis kyis phreng ba/ phyag rgyas chu cod pan/ lung bstan sogs kyis rdor dril ming gsum brtan par byed ces so/ /'bras bu mthong lam/ sgom lam/ mthar phyin sangs rgyas pa rnams la phyogs par byed/ bdud/ phung po/ nyon mongs/ 'chi bdag lha'i bu'i bdud rnams 'joms pa'o/ /gsang dbang gis/ ngag gi dri ma 'khru/ sa bcu gcig pa'i sgrib pa sbyong / thabs shes rab dang bde stong

dbyer med nges par byed/ sa bcu gcig pal phyogs/ bdud bzhi ni/ thabs dang / shes rab dang / gnyis med dang / sems 'phro ba rnams kyis rim pas 'joms so/ /gsum pa'i nus pa ni/ sems kyis dri ma 'khra/ rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sgrib pa sbyong / phyag rgya bsten nus par byed/ rdo rje 'dzin pa la phyogs/ bdud bzhi ni/ yas rim rtsa 'khor bzhi 'am/ dga' ba bzhi'am/ mkha' gsang reg bcug bskyod/ bde ba babs pa rnams kyis rim pas so/ ༄/bzhi pa ni/ snga ma rnams kyi spang gnyen shin tu phra ba rnams sbyong zhing bstod pa'o/ /nyi shu ba 'bras bu bzhi ni/ spyir re re la/ bdag 'bras/ rgya mthun/ rnam smi na/ byed 'bras/ bral 'bras te lnga lnga yin la/ bum dbang gi phreng ba/ chu cod pan/ rdor dril / ming / (rtan byed rnams kyi de lnga rim bzhir+sha no/ /gsang dbang gi lnga ni/ yab yum tshogs pa/ byang sems rgyas the/ lces myangs pa/ bde ba skyes pa / stong pa nges pa rnams so/ /gsum pa'i lnga ni/ yab yum sbyor ba lte snying mgrin dpral rnams su byang sems bab pa'o/ /bzhi pa la ni/ rgyu 'bras kyi tha snyad thams cad dang bral ba'i rgyas ma/chog rgi mchog go /de ltar dbang bzhi don nyi so/sa ston pa chos rgyal in+d+ra ghā ti'i rin chen 'khor lor bsdus te bshad pa yin pas rgyas par de nyid du blta'o/ /gnyis pa/ slob dpon ye shes rdo rjes ri/ spyir rgyud sde tham sa/ cang kṛ ya/ rmi+o sa rnal 'byor chen po// rnal 'byor bla med/ rgyud sde ba'ir bsdus la/ tse yang bya spyong/ sacis tu byas/ nga dang rnal/ 'a༅ོzari rgyud

ra༅༅/ /dang / bla med kyi pha rgyad ma rgyad rnams so/ /de bzhi rim pa bzhin skye gnas/ rdzus/ drod/ mngal/ sbo nga bzhi dang / nyon mongs/ nga rgyal/ gti mu/ga phrag dog zhe snang rnams sbyang / skyed chog gsum bskyed/ lnga bskyed/ mngal 'byirno/ rterno dang brten pa cig car bskyed pa'o/ /skyed chog gi rgya mtshan ni/ mtshan brjod kyi/ so sor rang rig mi g.yo ba/ /sogs rkang pa gnyis dang / sangs rgyas sku lnga'i sogs gnyis dang / sangs rgyas tham sa cad bskyed pa po/ /sogs gnyis dang / thig le chen po yi ge med/ /sogs tshirges bcad gsum rnams so/ /dgos pa ni/ snga ma gnyis la ma sbyar zhing / phye ma gnyis la/ mchod pa chen po chags pa che/ /sogs gnyis dang / ma rig sgo nga'i sbubs 'byed pa/ /sogs gnyis so/ /yang skyed chog bzhi po re re la yang / skye gnas bzhi tshang ste/ bya spyod kyi tshogs zhing rdzus skyes/ gsum bskyed sgo nga / sa bon bskul ba drod/ gnyis me nga sde ru twe shes mngal lo/ /lnga bskyed kyi bsnyen pa/ rnal 'byor chen po/ dang po sbyor ba/ dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog rnams rim pa bzhin/ rdzus sgong drod mngal/ rnal 'byor chen po'i rnal 'byor dang rjes su rnal 'byor dang / shin tu rnal 'byor dang / rnal 'byor chen po rnams drod sgong mngal rdzus so/ /rnal 'byor ma'i dang po sbyor ba/ rjes chags/ dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog las rgyal mchog rnams/ drod rdzus mngal sgong ngo / /de ltar rgyud sde bzhi las bla med gnyis thun mong gi

dbang bzhi ka re re yang cho ga bcu bdun bcu bdun tshang bar gsungs so/ /sa btsal/ brtag blang / bzung / bcad/ sbyang / rtsig pa ste sa chog bdun tshang bar sta derdzon la/ sa/ lha/ bum/ slob ma sta gon te bzhi / thig tshon/ rgyan/ sgrab/ 'jug dbang bskur ba ste dngos gzhi la drug rnams so/ /bcu bdun po bsdu na/ sa chog lha ga gnas/ sgrub pa/ dbang bskar ba ste bzhir 'dus/ dbang bzhi'i dkyil 'khor ni bum dbang spyi dang mthun / gzhan gsum la/ slobi dpon gyi lus dang / mkha' gsang dang / sertekhus kyi dkyil 'khor rnam sa so/ /bum dbang si cho ga bcu bdun po'i gzhan rnams spyi 'a༄ku+o bzhin/ sa bcad pa ni/ gsol gdab dang bka' bsgo stang stabs sogs so/ khyig pa ni/ dkyil 'khor khang pa'am sa stegs brtsis/ pa'o/ /cho ga de rnams kyi phan yon la bum dbang gi sa chog bdun gyi rim pa bzhin/ yul dbus kyis phyogs ming bkra shis par skye ba dang / zhing khams dang rgyal/ srid dag par skye ba dang / bar chad med par sa 'a/ dbang zhing bcud rgyas pa dang / rnam snang bi sku 'grub cing sa thob pa dang / dgos pa 'i sa zin zhing khams lnga thob pa/ dang / gzhan don 'grub cing dag pa'i zhing myar du 'grub pa dang / kun tu 'gro ba'i dag pa'i 'ing 'chags phong mi lums pas yid dga' ba rlams so/ /sta gon ba'i'i phan yon ri/ bar chad med par sa la dbang ba'i snang ba 'brung ba dang / dam tshig gtsang 'ing chos 'khor bsor ba'i 'a~Xde san nus/ pa ngang / dbang yis/ rgyung brlar

ra༅༅/ /zhing sngags spyod ston nus pa dang / bdag nyid chen por gyur te 'bor bsdus nas byang chub pa'o/ /dngos gzhi drug gis ni/ sgom 'chad mi nor ba dang / shes rab gsal zhing 'phel ba dang / sdug bsngal spong zhing snod bcud kyi zhing mdzes sdug rgyas pa dang / lha dang gsang sngags myur du 'grub cing 'bras bu rgyun chad med par 'byung ba dang / 'dod don la nye zhing chos kyi dzol srid du lung sten pa dang / sgrib pa byang zhing chos rnams skad cig la 'char ba'i rig 'dzin grub pa rnams so/ /gsang dbang gi sa chog bdun ni/ brgyud pa ldan pa'i slob dpon btsal ba dang / de'i yon tan brtag pa dang / zhu ba 'bul ba dang / mchod pas mnyes pa dang / gnang ba thob pa dang / rtsa sbyong ba dang / rtsa 'bor 'gengs pa'o/ /de bdun gyi phan yon ni/ dbang thob pa dang / byin rlabs 'byung ba dang / bar chad med pa dang / tsho+ogs rdzogs pa dang / lam du bde bar chud pa dang / ye shes dbab pa dang / nyams myong skye ba'o/ /sta gon bzhi ni/ rig ma la gsol ba gdab pa dang / de la lha bskyed pa dang / ye shes pa gzhug pa dang / slob mas gsol ba gdab pa'o/ /phan yon ni/ lha mos bar chad sel ba dang / lhas bdag gi grogs mdzad pa dang / bde gshegs rnams dang ngo bo gcig tu 'gyur ba dang / mya ngan las mi 'da' ba'o/ /dngos gzhi drug ni/ yab yum gyi mkha' gsang dang rtsa sbyang ba dang / lha bstim nas rtsa khams gsal ba dang / sbyar thabs legs par bya ba dang mkha' gsang bsrub pa dang / mig phye ba

dang / gsung rdo rjes bde ba myong ba rnams so/ /de dag gi phan yon ni/ 'khor ba sngags su bsgyur ba dang / spyod pa 'i don dang ldan pa dang / snang ba bde bar 'char ba dang / de gong nas gong du 'phel ba dang / sngags kyis 'tshang rgya ba dang / snang ba ma spangs par longs skar grwab nas byang sems la snang ba ston pa'o/ shes rab ye shas kyi sa chog bdun ci/ bla ma rig ma brje ba ma gtosas snga ma bzhin te phan yo/na dzi+o/nga ngo / /sta gon bzhi ni/ rig ma gtad pa dang / gsang gnas blta ba dang / lhar bsgom pa jong /ga dga' ba bskyed pa'o/ /dngos gzhi drug ni/ ma/kha' gsang bsrub pa dang / dkar dmar 'phel ba dang / dga' bas me dngas/ gsal ba dang / lhan cig skyes dga' shar ba dang de nyams su myong ba dang / de ngo 'phrod pa'o/ /de dag si phan yo/na ma bshad do/ /bzhi pa'i sa chorgo bdun ni/ ye shes mthong ba dang / log pa'i dbang dgag pa dang / de kun tu basbom pa dang / snang ba der shes pa dang / rgyas gdab pa dang / de las lhag po med par rtogs pa dang / sa la sbyor ba'o/ /sta son bzhi ni/ bde ba myong ba dang / kun dzob lhar snang ba dang / don dam/ spros bral du shes pa dang / ska bzhi'i slob ma rim par brgyud pa'o/ /dngos gzhi drug ni/ gdul bya la ska so sor ston pa dang / gsal bar snang ba dang / 'dod pa'i 'ing khams thob pa dang / 'gro ba sku bzhir bsgrub pa dang / gzugs sku rgyun chad med pa dang / chos (rmis cad sku bzhir gnas pa mthar thug pa tshams so/ /de lta ra na su+ob dporno de gnyis kyis

༄༄༄/ /dbang bzhi ka la sa chog sta gon/ thig tshon sgrub 'jug sogs kyi rnam gzhag bshad rnga/ ni gzhan la ma grags shing / de dag gi dgos pa'am dag pa rnams ni rgyud don la nges pa khyad par can rnyed pa'i sgo chen por snang bas bris so/ /dbang rnams kyi 'bras bu'am dgos pa phreng ba rjes 'brang dang bcas pas bshad pa ni/ me tog phreng bas gang du 'tshang rgya ba'i rigs kyi nus pa 'jog pa dang / chu dbang gis de la sgrib pa'i dri ma 'khyad pa dang / cod pan gyis dbu rgyan rigs bdag gi dang / rdo rjes thugs dang / dril bus gsung dang / ming dbang gis mtshan gyi nus pa 'jog cing / spang bya ma rig pa'am nyon mongs pa lnga spong / rig pa ye shes lnga bskyed/ bya spyod kyi rgyajo 'chad pa la dbang / dam tshig gsum sbyin pas rgyal ba'i thugs gsung sku'i de nyid gsum dran/ chos bshad pas/ rten dkyil 'khor/ brten pa lha/ slob dpon las rim gyi de nyid gsum shes/ sngags dbang gis zhi sogs bkrab stong don dam pa'i sngags kyi nus pa 'jog mig sman gyis lha'i mig 'grub/ me long gis snang ba spyi dang khyad par lhar snang la zhen pa 'gog rjes gnang lung bstan dbugs dbyung gis rang rang gi bya ba dngos rnams myur du 'grub/ mdor na sa bcu'i byang sems la sa/ngas rgyas kun gyis 'od zer chen po'i dbang bskur ba dang 'dra bas/ phyir mi ldog pa'i dang slob dpon gyi dbang zhes bya zhing / dbang drug ka la bum chu'i bya ba dgos pas bum pa'i dbang zhes bya ste lus kyi sgrib pa thun mong dang thun mong min pa sbyong / bskyed

rim 'khor bcas bsgom zhing rtsa ltung bcu zhi dang / sbom po brgyad de dam tshig nyer gnyis bsrang ba la dbang / sgos kyi 'bras bu sku rdo rje spal sku 'grub bo/ /gsang dbang ni/ dad pa dang shes rab kyi zhing du bsgrab/ snga ma bzhin ngag gi dri ma/ sbyong / rtsa rlung las rung gi mthus sgya lus 'grub/ nang gi dam rdzas khyad par can bsten dro la dbang / gsung rdo rje lo ngas sku 'grub beb/ /gsum pas ni/ bzhi pa'i snod du byed/ yi da sbyong / thugs bderā na 'od gsal gyi lam sbom pa dang / phyag rgya bsten pa la dbang / swās sku 'grub bo/ /bzhi pas ni/ gzhi'i sangs rgyas ngos zin/ 'bras bu'i zung 'jug la go ba skyes pas/ de bsgrub pa'i lam la nges pa rnyed/ sgo gsum gyi dri ma phra mo sbyong / drang nges kyi dam tshig bzhi bsten cing zung 'jug gi lam bsgom pa la dbang / zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang gi sku 'grub pa rnams gsungs so/ /dbang de dag gi ngo bo ni/ sngar bshad pa ltar/ rig pa'i dbang lnga ni/ bya spyod thun mong ba yin pas/ lha zhal sbyor bsgoms kyang / tha na 'byang ba'i bde ba tsam yang mi bskyed cing ye shes la dbang du ngo mi sprod kyi/ sngags dang ting nge 'dzin la brten nas dbang rdzas gtad pa sogs kyitsho mthu las slob ma'i rgyad la nus pa gsar pa re skyes pa la ngo spod pa tsam mo/ /slob dpon gyi dbang sno/ yo ga dang thun mong ba yin pas/ yum la 'khyud pa'i phyi re| la brten pa'i bde stong gi ye shes dang / gong ma gsum bla med kyi thun mo nga ma yin pa sa/ rtsa rlung zlos rung la brten pa'i nang reg dang / rgenyis pa la phyag rgya dang

ra༅༅/ /dbang po'i rtsa gnyis sbyar ba'i nang reg khyad par can la brten pa'i bde stong gi ye shes la dbang du ngo sprod cing / smin byed bzhi pa ni/ bla ma'i gsung la brten pa'i gzhi 'bras kyi sangs rgyas ngos zin pa'i thos byang gi shes rab dbang gi ngo bo yin no/ /gnyis pa ni/ bla med kyi rtsa rgyud dang / bsdus rgyud las dkyil chog la sogs pa'i sngags kyi lag len gsungs pa ni/ dus 'bor las gsal zhing rgyas pa med la/ 'grel chen gyis shin tu gsal b.rarā dzad mod krita go rim 'khrags pa sogs dang gzhan nas kha 'gengs dgos cung zad yod pa rnams snga phyi'i dus 'khor ba mang po 'khral ba'i 'khor lo bskor ba rnams la bgos rtags dang bcas pa'i lag len cha lag du mas brgyan te rgyas par bshad zin pas 'dir mi spro'o/ ༄/'on kyang 'di'i rnam gzhag mdor bsdu ba ni/ le'u 'di'i mdor bsdus dang po las rab 'byams kyi rmitshan nyid dang bya ba bsdus te bstan pa las shes par bya la/ de yang gsang 'dus sgron gsal gyi le'u bcu bzhi pa'i mgor / bshad rgyud rdor 'phreng drangs nas bshad pa ltar/ gsang sngags gzhan las rdo rje slob dpon gyi 'phrin las thams cad zhi rgyas dbang drag ste/ khas chen bzhir bsdus nas las so so'i phyogs dang gnas dang dus dang chas gos sogs rgyas par gsungs mod kyi/ 'dir zhi rgyas gnyis/ dbang dgug gnyis te las 'jam po bzhi/ bsad bskad gnyis/ rmongs rengs gnyis te rtsub pa bzhi/ de ltar na las chen brgyad du rtsa ba las gsungs la/ 'di'i 'grel pa dang skabs

gzhan gyi rtsa 'grel du 'i rgyas la rims gzhil ba bsnan pas zhi rgyas gzhil gsum/ dbang dgug la rims bskyod pa bsnan pas dbang dgug bskyod gsum/ bsad bskrad la dbye ba bsnan pas bsad bskrad dbye gsum/ rmongs rengs la phur gdab bsnan pas rmongs rengs gdab gsum ste/ las chen bcu gnyis su lugs 'di la grags shing / de'i sbyin sreg gi thig rtsa dang cho ga sogs kyang rgyas par spo ba'i lag len yod do/ /de ltar na 'di pa'i rdo rje slob dpon gyi bya ba thams cad las chen bcu gnyis su dang / las phra mo la zhi rgyas dbang gsum la brten pa'i phan byed so gnyis/ drag las la brten pa'i gnod byed so gnyi sa te/ las phran drur+sha cu tsa bzhir grags di rnams su bsdu sa te/ shes par byas nas dkyil 'khor cho ga cha lag dang bcas pa thams cad kyang las chen bcu gnyis po gang rung skabs dang sbyar ba'i lag len phyogs dus gnas rigs ma 'phyags pa zhig bya dgos te/ ce rgyad 'bum lnga las/ rigs gzhan dang ni bya ba gzhan/ /dus dang de bzhin sngags kyi rigs/ /phyogs dang gnas dang rten gzhan gyi/ /las rnams kun la 'bras bu med/ /ces sogs dang / rgyud sde du mar rdo bzhin du gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ spa/cis te rnal 'byor pa shin tu mthon por gyur te rang bzhin lhan cig ske sa pa'i bde stong gi ro la rtag tu rol bar gnas pa la ni nges pa de dag med de/ 'bum lnga las/ ye shes smra ba po rnams la/ /ye shes gcig pus las kun byed/ /bzlas pa/ med cing bgrang 'phreng med/ /sbyi na sreg sngags dang mchod pa med/ 4/bsam

ra༅༅/ /gtan tsam gyis las kun ni/ /rnal 'byor rnams la grub par 'gyur/ /zhes dang / 'di'i mchog mi 'gyur du/ kun rdzob rtos bcas rten 'brel las ma 'das pa'i rnam shes kyi bya ba rnams nyi tshe ba dang / don dam rtog med rten 'brel las 'das pa'i bya ba rnams rnam pa tham/sa cad par gsal bar gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /'di'i rten 'brel ni/ kha cig 'dus byas sam dngos po tsam la byas nas/ rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong gzugs ni/ de'i rkyen gyis 'dus ma byas pa rgya rkyen la brten pa dang bltos pa ma yin pa'i dngos po rigs pas dpyad bzad gzhom med rtag brtan ther zug yin pas/ rten 'brel dang 'dus byas la 'khor ba'i chos kyis khyab bo zer mod sri rtag pa dang dngos po'i gzhi mthun ne+e / gtso bor mu /gas kyi 'dod pa yin la/ bden grub ni dngos por smra ba'i grub mtha' yin pas/ rang lugs ni/ ma rig pas bskyed pa'i rten 'brel la dgongs sgo ltos grub bam rgyu rkyen tsam las byung ba'i rten 'brel ma yin no/ /des na stong gzugs mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs pa de ni rgyu rkyen tsam las skyes pa dang / skad cig skye 'gag byed pa yin mod kyang / las nyon gyi rten 'brel ma yin pa dang / rgyun gyi skye 'gag mi srid pa dang / lam gyis gzhom mi nus shing gzhom mi dgos kyi steng du lam stobs kyis je gsal du 'gro ba dang / ngo bo dri mas gos ma myong bas 'dus ma byas pa dang / rtag pa dang gzhom med dang zhi ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa sogs su gsungs te gzhan du yang bshad zin to/ /lag len so sor

bshad pa ni/ sbyor dngos mjug gsum gyi sgo nas 'byor ldan la rgyas par bskur tshul/ lhag pa'i bsam pa'i sgo nas sems can spyi la snying rje'i dbang bsku ra tshul/ chos la sems pa'i sgo nas kun spangs kyi slob ma la tshig gis bskur tshul lo / /'di la cho ga so so'i skabs kyi khyad par ngos bzung / de dag la gzhan gyi log rtog dgag pa'o/ /dang po ni/ phur gdab sa sbyang ba'i skabs su byed pa dang / stang stabs rang lugs kyi dbus dang / phyogs kyi khams dang mthun par byed sa/ dang / lhag gnas la gzhan la med pa'i rdor dril dang / mal sta na lhag gnas byed pa dang / bum pa lhag gnas/ la dung chos chen po la rnam rgyal chen por btags te/ der dkyil 'khor rdzogs par bskyed pa dang / lhag nas kyi ye shes pa thams cad snying gar bskyed chog khyad par can las skyes pa'i dus 'khor yab yum gyi spyan 'dren pa dang / lhag gnas thams cad sngar bzhin sngags khyad par can gyis byin gyis/ rlob pa dang / slob ma lhag garnos 'a/ ye shes 'bebs pa lta bu'i rdor sems bskal ba dang / thig skud la ye theg zur pa med cing / gcig po de yang surmo sgril slob dpon gyi mthe bong gi brgyad cha'i nas / kyi tshad kyi sbom phra can khra brgyad la/sa ring thung mi rung ba dang / tshon la rtsig pa tshun la blos byas kyi mdzes tshon mi rung ba dang ༄/ 'jug pa'i skabs su brtul zhugs nyi shu rtsa lnga dang rigs drug pa'i sngom pa bzung dgos pa dang / bskyed rim gyi dbang la/ sku gsung thugs skyo zhal du sbo gsum sbyong ba'i dbang gnyis gnyis dang / nub phyogs ye shes kyi zhal du ye

ra༅༅/ shes sbyong byed rjes gnang ste dbang bdun rnams/ khams phung rlung rtsa dbang yul ye shes rnams bsgrub gzhir byas nas bskur ba dang / de'i mjug chog la thob dus go ba dang / bslab pa brjod pa dang / rdzogs rim gyi dbang la rgyud smo pa la dbang bar byed pa kun rdzob drang don slob ma'i dbang bzhi dang / 'chad pa la dbang bar byed pa don dam nges don gyi slob dpon gyi dbang bzhi de ma thag rdzogs nas dus kyi 'khor lo'i slob dpon chen por rjes su gnang ba rdo rje slob dpon bdag po'i dbang / khyad par nges don gyi dbang gsum pa'i skabs su dbang gi rab byed rgyas par ston pa rnams rags pa ste bla med gzhan la ma grags pa'i khyad chos thun mong ma yin pa rnams blo yul du shar/ de la rtog dpyod zhugs te gus pa chen po bskyed par bya ba yin no/tsho /gnyis pa ni/ cho ga'i khyad par de dag la rgya bod kyi dkyil chog mkhan po rnams kyis rang dga'i 'dod tshul sna tshogs byas pa rnams phal cher ni dkyil chog pad dkar dgongs gsal du rgyas par bkag pas der blta zhing / dkyil chog gi yan lag rab gnas sbyin sreg tshogs 'khor gshin chog sogs la brten pa'i log par rtog pa rnams kyang rgya mtsho bzhi la sogs pa'i steng du rnam gzhag rnams su bkag zin pas 'dir dbang la brten pa'i log rtog 'ga' zhig dgag par byed do/ /de la dbang bdun la dang / gong ma la log rtog dgag pa'o/ /dang po la/ thun mong ba'i dang / thal ba'i log rtog dgag pa'o/ /dang po ni/ mkhas rlom kha cig dbang bdun ni/ rig pa'i dbang lnga tsam

dang byed las gnyeg ste dbang bdun thob kyang rgyud nyid pa la mi dbang bar de'i ched du drang don dbang bzhi bskur dgos pa'i phyir dang / phyag rgya'i nu ma la reg pa'i bum dbang de la slob dpon gyi dbang du bshad pa'i phyir zhes zer ro mi 'thad de dbang lnga thob tsam gyis ni bskyed rim gyi 'a tshags tsam yang bsgom pa la mi dbang la/ 'dir dbang bdun rdzogs par thob nas bskyed rim yan lag dang bcas pa bsgom pa dang / 'og min gyi mthar thug pa'i dngos grub bsgrab pa la dbang bar gsungs shing rang gis kyang khas blangs pa'i phyir ro/ /des na dbang bdun rdzogs par thob pas ni/ bla med spyi dang / khyad par rgyad 'di yang bskyed rim dang 'brel ba drang don gyi bshad pa mtha' dag nyan pa dang / bsgomar ba la dbang mod kyi rdzogs rim ston pa don dam nges don gyi bshad pa zhib tu nyan pa la mi dbang bas de'i ched du drang don dbang zhi bskur ba yin la/ 'di jobang bdun la chu dbang zhes pa ma gtogs bum dbang gis dngos su ma gsungs kyang bum pa'i chu'i bya ba yod pas bum dbang gi sgra bshad dang phyir mi ldog pa'i dbang gi don legs par tshang bas rgyud sde gzhan dang sgo bstan gyi slob dpon gyi dbang yang rdzogs par yong mod kyi bskyed rdzogs kyi dbang mtha' dag slob dpon gsang ba shes rab dang / /bzhi pa de ya nga de bzhin no zhes bzhir bsdu sa / pa 'i tshe 'di pa 'i thun mo nga ma yin pa 'i bug si/ dbangari 5/rngachi slo/ba darngo/ོna dbang du sdung rngasos pa/sku de lta/riri sasu/nga sku/ kyi dbang bdumyo 'a slob ngarngo༈ོna gyi ngabang me nga pa/ ni rlo yin te risas/ drus sa'i chos/ 'khor

ra༅༅/ /bskor ba'i rjes gnang 'dogs dang bcas pa yod pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ gzhan dag na re/ 'di'i dbang bdun la rdzogs rim gyi dbang yang tshang ste/ rlung bcu dang rtsa ro rkyang la sogs pa'i sgrub gzhir byas pa'i bskyed chog khyad par can yod pa'i phyir ro zhes zer ro/ /'di ni gsang 'dus lta bu'i pha rgyud rkyang pa'i dngos bstan la 'khral nas/ rtsa rlung thig le'i sgom rim khyad par can yod na rdzogs rim yin no zhes pa'i grub mtha' gsar du bcas pa'i skon yin te/ de lta na bde mchog gi lus dkyil la sogs pa rdzogs rim du thal ba'i phyir dang / khyad par dbu ma'i rtsa 'bor ṣ+yo dbus su dmigs pa gtad nas sgom pa'i rnal 'byor la rdzogs rem gyis khyab pa'ang / de'i gtso bo yab yum gyi rnal 'bye+or gyis bzhig pa'i phyir ro/ /de ltar na bla med gzhir byas la'ang pha dang ma dang gnyis med kyi dngos bstan la sgom rim zab rgyas kyi khyad par yod par shes na log rtog rang zhi la 'gro bar shes par bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ dpal jo mo nang pa na re / rdzogs rim gyi dbang gsum yin te/ dbang bskur dngos dang / rdo rje slob dpon bdag po'i dbang dang / bdag po chen po'i dbang ngo / /ma gzhi ni rim pa bzhin drang don dbang bzhi dang / rjes gnang chen po dang / nges don dang nga bzhi rnams yin la go rim yang de bzhin du bskur bar bya'o zhes zer ro/ /'di ni shin tu mi 'thad de/ drang don dbang bzhi bskur nas rgyud kyi nges don thams cad kyang nyan/ rdzogs rim kyang legs par bsgoms/ myong ba ci rigs pa skye zhing rgyud

don legs pa ra khong du chud pa na tshogs 'khor mtshan nyid tshang ba dang bcas te/ nges don dbang bzhi rdzogs par bskur/ rgyud thams cad shes shing ston pa por gyur pa'i tshe na dkyil 'khor dang khras stegs legs par bris nas/ ston pa po'i dbang ngam rjes gnang chen po sbyin pa ni rigs pas legs par thob cing / da ni bdag gis rgyud thams cad shes so zhes gsol gdab kyi tshig la sogs pa'i lung rnams kyis grub pa'i phyir ro/ /de bsgon du sngon dang da lta'i dus 'khor nges don la gtso bor bshad sgrub byed pa por rlom pa mang po phyi dkyil du dbang bskur cung zad kyang ma thob/ bskyed rim gyi lha grangs tsam yang mi shes pa'o skya ser pho mo mang po bsdus te/ dbang gong ma'i cho ga tshang ma tshang ci rigs pa re byas nas/ dpal sbyor pa yan lag drug pa rdzogs pa ra 'bogs shing / snang ba za zi chos skur ngo sprod pa sogs kyi sgo nas dpon slob thams cad sa mtshams shin tu mtho sar slob pa'i mngon pa'i nga rgyal byed do/ /'di dag ni spyir bstan pa'i 'jug rim dang / sgos rdo rje theg pa'i 'jug sgo dbang bi rnam gzhag la rmongs shing / tshogs lam chung ngu yang rgyud la ma skyes bzhin du mthong lam skyes par 'dod pa'i gti mug dang 'dun pas 'gro ba yin pas/ rgyud don shes pa'i mkhas pa rnams kyis mgrin gakhog tu smad par 'os pa yin no/ /'on kyang dang 'byor dang lda na pa'i gang zag ngapal sbyo ra ba yan lag drug pa'i mtshan tsam gyis tshim zhing thabs gzhin gyis 'dul du mi rung ba dag la ni longs spyod la snying po blang ba'i phyir du tshogs gsog smo du ma nas byed du bcug

༄༄〉༅/ /ste/ zab lam bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyis byin rlabs tsam phog lam gyi rtsa ba skya bas 'gro dang gsol 'debs/ yig brgya maṇ+ḍal sogs kyis rgyud legs par sbyong du bcug nas sems gnas sna re tsam sgom du 'jug pa'i thabs mkhas ni bkag pa med pas sngon gyi mkhas pa dag kyang mdzad mod kyi/ de la ni dbang gong ma bskur don med do/ /'o na lugs 'di'i dbang gi ngo bo dang dbye bsdu dang khyad par ji lta bu yin zhe na/ dbang bdun phal cher ni sngar bshad pa ltar nus pa gsar pa nyid yin la/ rjes gnang gi 'dogs kyi gtso bo dam tshig gsum gyi phyag rgya'i dam tshig 'khrad pa'i bde stong spel nas phyi reg gi bde stong nyid rgyud sde gzhan dang thun mong ba'i slob dpon gyi dbang gi ngo bo yin no/ /gong ma la drang don dbang bzhi dang nges don gyi dbang dang po gsum ste bdun ni 'gyur ba'i bde ba yin pa sa dbang dus kyi bde dror ma zad/ de dag gi lam dngos rnams kyang so so skye bo'i lam las ma 'das so/ /de yang dang po gsum la drang nges kyi khyad par ni / rdzogs rim sgom pa sngon du ma song ba dang song ba'i khyad kyis rig ma re re'i nu ma la reg pa dang / gsang rdzas myangs shing gsang gnas bltas pa dang / tshogs 'khor gyi spyod pa khyad par can dang ma 'bral ba'i gnyis sbyor gyi bde ba tsam dang / rig ma lo bcu ma nas nyi shu'i bar bcu tshang ba la reg pa dang / 'khyud pa dang gsang rdzas myangs pa sogs kyi bde ba yin pas bde ba dman mchog dang / des stong nyid rtogs pa'i mnyam gzhag rgyun thung ba dang ring pa nyid yin la/ bzhi pa

gnyis kyi khyad par ni/ dbang gsum pa 'i mtha'i yas babs tha ma'i skad cig ni drang don bzhi pa ste/ 'das lam gyis bsdu sa pa'i mas brtan dang po 'gyur med bde ba'i skad cig dang po nas nges don bzhi pa dngos su 'jog pas/ smin byed tshig dbang ni de dag gi don spyi legs par shar ba'i go ba'am thos bsam gyi shes rab nyid do/ /de ltar na 'di ba'i dbang la rgyas par dbye na/ byis pa ltar 'jug pa bskyed rim dbang bdun dang / rdzogs rim gyi bzhi tshan gnyis te bco lnga yang dbyer yod mod kyi/ drang nges kyi dang po gsum gsum/ bum gsang shes rab ye shes zhes gsum du bsdu zhing / drang don bzhi pa'am nges don gsum pa las rdzas logs su med pas der bsnas nas rdzogs rim la 'jig rten pa'i dbang gsum dang / dbang gong ma'i gong ma nges don bzhi pa 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dbang gzhig ste bcu gcig tu gsungs la/ rtsa rgyud las/ dang por dbang bskur bdun po gang / /byis pa rnams ni gzhug pa'i phyir/ /rnam gsum 'jig rten kun rdzob kyi / /dam pa'i don ni bzhi pa 'o/ /zhes dang / 'grel chen du/ dbang bskur ba 'jig rten pa'i bcu dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i bcu brteg pa rab tu gsal bar byed pa zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /de ltar bsdu na/ 'jig rten pa'i dbang ngam 'gyu chari/ gyi rgyu'i dbang dngari 'jis rten 'a/sa 'das/ nga/'i ngabang ngam/ la/ra/ nga/ngos/ 'bras/ bu ngang bcas pa'i ngabang ces sanyis su bsdu sa/ te/ ye le ra/ nge ngas 'ams cad nges par 'jig rter pa ste ma/chos si snying rje yis ni lam gyi rgyu ru bstar/ 'jig

ra༅༅/ /rten 'das pa'i dbang gang mchog gi rgyal ba'i bdag po'i phyag rgya mchog la rjes su sbyor ba'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de ltar dbang re re yang smin byed rgyu dang / grol byed lam dang / thob bya don dam 'bras bu'i dbang gsum gsum du dbyer yod de/ dbang bdun la nus pa khyad par can bzhi 'khyud pa'i bde stong dang bcas pa ni dang po dang / rgyal mchog gnyis dang / rnal 'byor gnyis ni gnyis pa dang / sa bdun pa ring du song ba'i spang rtogs rdzogs pa ni gsum pa'o/ /gong ma'i 'jig rten pa gsum la/ dbang dus kyi bde ba dngos sam rjes mthun pa gsum ni dang po dang / sor bsam dang / srog 'dzin dang / rjes dran rnams ni gnyis pa dang / sa brgyad pa mi g.yo ba/ dgu pa legs pa'i blo gros sam rgyal bu gzhon nu/ bcu pa chos kyi sprin gyi spang rtogs rdzogs pa ni gsum pa'o/ /bzhi pa la yang / mi 'gyur ba'i bde chen stong gzugs la 'khyud pa gzhi lam 'bras bu gsum ga la yod par nges pa'i shes rab ni dang po/ ting nge 'dzin gyi yan lag nyi khri chig stong drug brgya ni gnyis pa/ sa bcu gnyis pa chos kyi dbang phyug sku bzhi rdo rje bzhi mthar thug pa ni gsum pa'o/ /zhes blo gros can gyis shes par bya'o/ /'o na mas brtan dang po 'gyur med bde ba'i skad gcig dang po ni nges don bzhi par 'jos na/ bzhi pa sku thugs zung 'jug la 'jog pa dang 'gal bar 'gyur rte/ 'gyur med kyi bde chen gyi thugs tsam yin pa'i phyir ro zhe na/ ma grub ste 'gyur med bde chen du skyes pa nyid kyis stong nyid rtogs pa'i rnam ldar du legs

par grub pas thugs su grub par ma zad/ rgya stong gzugs mtshan nyid tshang ba ma grub bar du 'gyur med du skye mi srid pas 'gyur med bde chen gyi don spyi legs par shar na stong gzugs dang zhal sbyor du mi 'chor ba'i thabs med pa'i phyir dang ye ler / shes rab ye shes dag kyang sems dadro de yi sngang ba dag li rnam pa bcu po nyid du 'gyur/ /dbang ni dri med ri bong can mtshungs me long gzugs brnyan lta bu 'di la zhugs pa gang yin pa/ nge las mya ngan 'das pa'i bde ba 'pho med lhan rtseg skyes pa 'gyur med nyid ni bzhi pa ste/ /zhes dang / mchog gi bde ba gzhom du med pa ye shes sku/ /zhes dang / dam pa'i bde ba bsgrubs nas lhan gcig skyes pa rgyal ba'i ska ni kun tu 'gro ba bsgrub par bya/ /zhes dang / dbang mdor bstan du / stong pa gzugs brnyan 'dzim la rgya/ /snying rje 'gyur med 'dzin pa 'bras/ /stong nyid snying rje dbyer med pa'i/ /byang chub sems de mi 'pho ba'o/ /zhes dang / rgyu larā bras bus rgyas btab cing / /'bras bu rgyu yis rgyas btab bo/ /gzugs kyis srid par mi 'ong ste/ /'argor med mya ngan 'das mi 'gro/ /phan tshun 'khyud bzhi pa ste/ /ma ning gi ni go 'phang mchog /ces sogs bde chen gang bshad du ye shes kyi sku ya/nga rgya cher gsungs la/ rje btsun btsong kha pas sngags rim du/ gsang sngags ga'an gyi bange stong dang dus 'khor ba'i bde stong mi gcig ste/ gzhin gyi ni yul can bde ba chen pos yul/ stong nyid rtogs pa'i thugs tsam la bde stong zhis zer la/ dus 'khor ba'i bde ba ni/ thags mi 'gyur ba'i bde

ra༅༅/ /chen dang stong pa ni sku stong gzugs phyag rgya chen mo gnyis tshogs la bde stong du byed pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes lan mang du gsungs pa yang don 'di legs par dgongs pa'i legs bshad yin pa'i phyir ro/ /de ltar na dbang bzhi pa rgyud 'dir gsal bar gsungs pa dang / rgyud gzhan du sbas nas ma gsungs pa yang mngon sum tu grub pa yin te/ gsang 'dus rgyud phyi ma dang / sam+bu ṭi la sogs par gsang ba dang shes rab ye shes bskur tshul rgyas par gsungs nas bzhi pa la/ bzhi pa de yang de bzhin no/ /ces skong pa re re las ma gsungs par sbas shing / brtag gnyis cung zad rgyas kyang / bde ba gnag dang bde ba ser/ /zhes sogs bde ba'i rten thig le la bde bar bshad pa sogs kyi sbo nas sbas la / lam la yang 'dus pa phyi ma dang / gur brtag tu dbye ba ngos 'dzin gsal gsal 'dra yang / spyi dang khyad par du ting nge 'dzin gyi yan lag mi gsal/ sems 'grel mnyam po la yang / bde mchog rtsa rgyud le'u dang por sbyor drug gi gsum dngos su ldang / gsum shugs la bstan par mdzad de legs par bkral yang / ting nge 'dzin gsal por ma gsungs pa sogs kyi cung zad lhag ma dang bcas la/ bzhi pa'i dbang lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa shin tu gsal zhing rgyas pa ni dpal dus kyi 'khor lo kho na yin te/ rdo rje bzhi pa'i rgyud dang / bden don bcu gnyis pa dang / de kho na nyid bcu drug pa dang / bsam gtan bzhi pa'i rtse mo dga' ba bzhi'am bcu drug pa/ rigs drug pa gtso bo rgyal ba'i bdag po nyid bstan bya'i gtso

bor mdzad pa lan mang du gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /rigs pas kyang 'grub ste/ rgyud sde gzhan gyi lam gyitsho mthar thug bsam mi khyab kyi rim pa dang / slob pa'i zung 'jug gi bde stong yang spyod pa gsum la brten pa'i 'gyur bange dang g.yo bde kho nar gsungs shing / 'gyur ba des na spang bya'i sa bon rdzogs par spong bar mi srid pa'i phyir ro/ /rgyad 'di nyid kyi yang dbang ler dbang bzhi pa rgyas par ma gsungs par ye le la zhal 'phangs shing / de'i mdor bsdus gnyis pa'i mjug dang / gsum pa mchog mi 'gyur du log rtog rgyas par bkag pa'i sgo nas rgya cher gsungs te/ rme+ogs rim gyi ngo sprod du rgyas par 'chad pas 'dir mi spro'o/ /lnga pa dbang de ltar bskur ba'i dgos pa ni/ spyir bskyed rim gyi dbang gis sdig sgrib gnyis su phye ba'i sdig pa'i dri ma sbyong zhing / de yang sgo gsum ye shes dang bcas pa'i dri ma rags pa phar phyin theg pa nas bshad pa dang / thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa sngags lam gyi 'gyur ba de'i dri ma rags pa yang sbyong ba'i nus pa thob nas bskyed rim bsnyen sgrub bzhi dang rdo rje bzhi mthar phyin pa na/ phar phyin theg pa'i sa bdun pa ring du song ba'i spangs rtogs yongaris su rdzogs shing / sngags lam gyi tshogs lam chung du mthar phyin par 'gyur ro/ /'di la kha cig bskyed rim thar lam dang mchog bsgrub pa'i kha/ma ma yin par 'dod pa ni dus kyi 'khor lo'i sgrub thabs ma yin par thal ba dang / rgyud kyi nying dgos dang 'brel ba'i dgos pa ma yin par thal ba la sogs pa'i sanong byed mang po mkhas pa das sis gsungs

ra༅༅/ 'ang / kho bos kyang dus 'khor gyi bsked rim bshad pa chen mor brjod zin to/ /yang kha cig gsang 'dus rim lngar/ dang po las kyi sbyor ba yis/ /sa brgyad pa ne+e thob par 'gyur/ /snang ba gsum potho ba pa yis / /sa bcu pa la rab tu gnas/ /zhes sogs bskyed rim larta 5sa dang po pa'i lam du gsung sa shing / de ni phar phyin theg par tshogs lam la bshad pas/ sngags kyi tshogs lam la bskyed rim gyis khyab cing rdzogs rim gyi ma mtha' sbyor lam drod nas 'jog dgos so/ /zhes zer ro/ /ma khyab ste/ rim lnga'i lus dben dang / sbyor drug gi sor bsam las dang po pa'i lam dang / sor bsam gyi rnal 'byor pa la las dang po pa'i gang zag tu lan mang du gsungs pa'i phyir dang / phar phyin theg pa'i theg chen tshogs lam chen po nas chos rgyan ting nge 'dzin thob pa bzhin du sngags lam gyi yang tshogs lam chen po nas sngags lam rang li mngon shes thob dgos shing / de ni bsam gtan gyi yan lag mthar ma phyin gyi bar du mi thob pas bskyed rim pa la yong don med pa'i phyir ro/ /bskye da jim mthar phyin pa nas sa bdun pa'i spangs rtogs 'grub pa dang mi 'gal te/ de la phar phyin theg pa dang thun mong gi mngon shes drug ka yod kyang / sngags lam gyi dbang shes phyi ma gsum la brtan pa'i mngon shes 'ong don med pa'i phyir ro/ /rdzogs rim gyi dbang bzhis ni sgrib pa'i dri ma sbyong zhing de yang sgo gsum ye shes dang bcas pa'i dri ma thun mong ba phra mo dang sngags lam gyi thun mong ma yin pa phra rags thams cad rin/ bzhin sbyong

la / bum dbang dang de'i lam sor bsam mthar phyin pas sa brgyad pa mi g.yo ba dang / gsang ba dang srog 'dzin mthar phyin pas dgu pa legs pa'i blo gros dang / shes rab ye shes dang rjes dran mthar phyin pas bcu pa chos kyi sprin dang / bzhi pa ting nge 'dzin mthar phyin pas sangs rgyas kyi sa la kun tu 'od dang zla ba'i 'od la sogs pa sa bcuganyis su phye ba'i spangs rtogs rdzogs par 'gyur la/ sngags lam gyis ni/ sor bsam 'bring mchog srog 'dzin sbyor lam thog ma/ rjes dran skad cig tha ma/ ting nge 'dzin skad cig dang po nas mthong lam/ de dang bcas pa'i stong brgyad brgya ba phrag gcig gis sa dang po kun tu 'od dang / de nas gcig gis sa gnyis pa mthar phyin zhing / byang sems nor bu nas gyen du log ste gsang gnas kyi bar du brtan/ de bzhin du mi 'gyur ba'i bde chen stong brgyad brgya pa phrag gnyis kyis sa gnyis gnyis rdzogs shing / lte ba dang snying ga dang mgrin pa dang dpral ba dang gtsug tor gyi bar du brtan te/ bem chos sam/ 'pho ba'i bag chags phra ba'i sa bon stong brgyad brgya pa phrag bcu gnyis spangs te/ sngags kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i snyoms 'jug gi sgrib pa las grol ba'i sa bcu gnyis mthar phyin pa'i mthar thug gi sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das theg pa mtha' dag dang lam mtha' dag la bltos pa'i spang bya thams cad spangs shing yon kho yongs su rdzogs par gyur pa ni/ smin grol gyi dbang mtha' ngas rdzogs par zob pa'i dasongs pa'i 'bras bu yin no /'di la sngon dngari da lta'i dus/ lālor ba tham/sa cad mgrin gcig tu bde

ra༅༅/ /chen stong brgyad brgya ba phrag dang po sbyor lam du 'jog pa ni so skye'i lam na spang bya'i sa bon spong ba'i dngos gnyen yod pa'am/ yang na spang bya'i sa bon stong brgyad brgya pa phrag gcig ma spangs pa'i mthar thug gi sangs rgyas yod pa gang rung du 'gyur ba'i skyon yod do/ /gnyis pa grol byed lam la kun rdzob drang don rgya chen gtso bor gyur pa bskyed pa'i rim pa dang / don dam nges don zab pa gtso bor gyur pa rdzogs pa'i rim pa'o/ /de gnyis so so'i ngo bo(ོ—/ma mtshan nyid ni rim pa bzhin/ sngags lam gyi gtso bo gang zhig snang phyogs sngags kyi sku la dmigs pa'i mos pa yid byed rjes dpag rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor dang / gang zhig stong phyogs ye shes kyi sku la dmigs pa'i de kho na nyid yid byed mngon sum rtogs med ma 'khral ba'i rnal 'byor te/ lha yi dmigs pa dag kyang mngon sum dang ni rjes su dpag pa rnam pa gnyis su 'gyur ba ste/ /mngon sum dag ni de nyid sbyor bas mkha' la skar ma bzhin du du ma longs spyod rdzogs pa'i ska/ /mngon sum min na rjes su da/ga pa shi ba'i lus bzhin de nyid min pa yis ni brtags pa gang / /zhes sogs dang / de'i 'grel pa dri med 'od dang / sems 'grel gzhan gnyis las kyang / /bskyed rim rtog sgom dang / rdzogs rim rtog rmed ma 'khral bar len mang du gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /de yang dngos sam gtso bo'i dbang du byas shing / 'khor ram phal pa'i dbang du byas na bskyed rim gyi sbyor 'jug rtog med dang rdzogs rim gyi sbyor 'jug rtog par skyes pa'ang yod de/ bskyed rim pas rgozugs

mdzes mthong nas bde stong sbyor ba na mig shes rtog med bde stong ye shes kyi ngo bor skyes pa'am/ ma skyes kyang dbang shes 'khor gyi bde ba stong nyid rnam ldan du 'char ba srid pa'i phyir ro/ /'o na des stong nyid mngon sum rtogs par 'gyur la 'dod na 'phags par thal lo/ /zhe na/ khyad par cha shas rnam g.yeng dang / /mngon sum gyis ni bzung ba la/ /khyad par gang la rtog pa yi/ /skyon yod de ni rtogs par 'gyur/ /zhes pa'i tshul gyis mthong yang ma rtogs pa du ma srid pas skyon med la / theg pa gzhan gyi 'phags par thal ba ni 'dod pa'i skabs kyang srid do/ /de bzhin du rdzogs rim gyi sbyor ba nan mkhar kun nas then pa'i sems kyi stong nyid sgom pa dang / rtsa dang rlung la dmigs pa'i zhen rig du ma/ rdzogs rim gyi sbyor 'jug 'byung ba yin no/ /de dag bskyed rdzogs dngos ma yin yang cha mthun pa'i sgo nas de'i phyogs su btu'o/ /de ltar rim gnyis re re la yang bsnyen pa/ nyer sgrub/ sgrub pa/ sgrub chen ste bzhi bzhi tshang la/ de dag la lus dbyebs kyi dang / ngag sngags kyi dang / sems chos kyi dang / ye shes dag pa'i rnal 'byor te/ rnal 'byor bzhi'i ming gis gsungs shing / sku gsung thugs ye shes rdo rje'i rnal 'byor dang rnam/ pa lnga dang / rnam pa nyi shu dang / skad cig ma gcig dang / sgyu 'phrul drwa bas byang chub pa ste/ mngon byang bzhi'i rtsal 'byor zhes kyang gsungs pa rngams tshang zhing jo+ogs par dgos te/ thob bya'am sbyangs 'bras la sku ba'i/ rdo rje ba'i/ byang chub ba'i/ mkhyen pa ba'i rnams la/ pad+ma'i 'dab ma rgyas pa'i spyan

ra༅༅/ /dang / nyen mor byed pa'i sku dang / ye shes kyi ska dang / thams cad mkhyen pa zhes pa'i mtshan gyis gsungs pa'i bzhi tshan tshang bar bzhugs pa bzhin du lam dus nas legs par sgrub dgos pa'i phyir dang / sbyang bya rags pa gnas skabs bzhi'i sgrib pa dang / phra ba kun gzhi rnam shes la rgonas skabs bzhi bskyed pa 'gyur ba de'i nus pa bzhi yod pa sbyang dgos pa'i phyir dang / sbyang gzhi sku bzhi ye shes su gsungs shing / mkha' khyab mkha'i rdo rje can dang / gtso bo srid pa gsum gyis btud cing gzhom med kun tu 'gro ba gang / /zhes dang / thub pa myed pa dpe med pa/ /mi mngon mi snang gsal byed min/ /mi 'gyur kun 'gro khyab pa po/ /phra zhing zag med sa bon bral/ /zhes dang / sangs rgyas thog ma tha ma med/ /dang po'i sangs rgyas rigs med pa/ /ye shes mig gcig dri ma med/ /ye shes lus can de bzhin gshegs/ /zhes sogs kyis dngos su bstan cing / kye rdo rjer/ lus la ye shes chen po gnas/ /zhes sogs dang / 'gro kun lhan cig skyes pa nyid/ /rang ba'in lhan cig skyes par brjod/ /sogs dang / ye shes 'di ni ches phra zhing / /zhes sogs kyi sa bstan don/ rang bzhin lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes dang / 'dus pa lugs gnyis sogs su/ shin tu phra ba'i rlung sems/ rnal 'byor rgyud du yang / thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dga' ba che/ /zhes sogs/ mdo phyogs 'khor lo tha mar/ zag pa med pa'i shes pa sbyang ma'i rtsidang 'dra/ /zhes

so gas kyis bde gshegs snying por gsungs pa'i tha snyad gnas lugs bzhi'i sangs rgyas su bzhag pa de'i steng du 'gyur med kyi thig le bzhi po ngo bo gcig tu bzhugs pa'i phyir ro/ /de ltar rim pa gnyis las bskyed rim gyi rnam gzhag spyi sgos dogs gcad dang bcas pa ni rgyas par zur du bshad zin cing / rdzogs rim gyi khrid yig ngo sprod dang bcas pa ni khrid ma thob pa rnams la bstan du mi rung bas zur du 'chad pa las shes dgos pas 'dir mi 'chad la/ 'dir ni rim gnyis dang 'brel ba'i gzhi lam 'bras gsum la log rtog chen po'i chen po dag dgag pa skabs su bab pas 'di ltar dgag par bya ste/ gzhi dang / lam dang / 'bras bu la log rtog dgag pa'o/ /dang po la tha snyad pa'i gnas lugs la skur ba btab nas sangs rgyas phyi nas btsal dgos pa'i log rtog dgag pa dang / don dam pa'i gnas lugs la skur ba btab nas sangs rgyas nang na rdzogs par grub zin pa'i log rtog dgag pa'o/ /dang po la spyir dgag pa dang / bye brag sangs rgyas gzhan la sgrub gzhi yod kyang dus 'khor ba la sgrub gzhi med pa'i log rtog dgag pa'o/ /dang po ni/ bka' 'khor lo bar pa'i dngos bstan tsam la 'dris par byas shing zhen nas zab gsal gnyis las gsal ba'i cha la skal pa zhen pa'i bstan 'dzin chen po dag na re/ bde bar gshegs pa'i snying po 'es bya ba ma yin dgag tu gyur pa'i dngos po'i chos yongs gcong du grub pa ni gto med nge/ yod na brtag dngos dang / bden grub dang / rigs pas dpyang bzod du 'gyur ba'i phyir/ des na snying po

༄༄༄/ /mdo bcu la sogs par de 'dra yod pa ltar gsungs pa rnams ni/ sems kyi chos/ nyid don dam pa'i bden pa la dgongs nas/ sems zhum sems can dman la brnyas pa la sogs pa'i skyon lnga spang ba'i phyir du gsungs pa'i drang don dgongs pa can kho na yin no zhes zer ro/ /'di dag ni lung don rigs pas gtan la dbab dgos pas lung gis mi tshim mo zhes rigs pa la gtso bor byed pa por snang bas/ thog mar gnod byed kyi rigs pa brngod par bya ste/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi rtogs pa phun tshogs de'i thun mong ma yin pa'i rigs 'dra khyad par can zhig gzhi dus na yod par thal/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi spangs pa de'i thun mong ma yin pa de'i rigs 'dra khyad par can zhig gzhi dus na yod pa'i phyir ro / /rtags gsal gnyis ka dngos 'gal yin la/ khyab pa la mi mtshungs pa'i rgyu mtshan rigs pa shes shing gzu bor gnas pa ni sus kyang brjod pa mi nus la/ mi shes pa'i rdol thabs smra ba dang / shes kyang 'du shes basbyar ba'i bsnyon tshig smra ba ni bstan pa la 'tshe bar zad do/ /gzhan yang sangs rgyas kyi sa bon nam/ nyer rlan phyi nas btsal dgos par 'gyur te/ sems can gyi rgyud la gzhi dus na sangs rgyas kyi sgrub gzhi dngos por gyur pa med pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ mdo sngags kyi lung du mas gnod par ma zad/ sangs rgyas kyi sa bon 'debs pa po su zhig gis byed cing / 'tshol ba po dag gis garngo nas 'tshol blo nang du khug la legs par soms shig rang bzhin rnam dag gi chos nyid yod pa tsam gyis sku ngas rgyas kyi nyer
