len yod par 'dod na/ snod kyi 'jig rten la yang yod par thal ba bzlog tu med do / /gzhan yang 'dod pa 'di ni snying po mdo bcu la sogs pa'i bka' 'khor lo tha ma mtha' dag dang / rgyud sde gong 'og khyad par sems 'grel gsum gyis gtan la phab pa'i rgyud kyi ༄75 po rnams kyi dngos bstan bstan bya'i gtso bo las rgyab kyis phyogs par ma zad/ 'khor lo bar pa nyid kyi dngos bstan la yang skur ba 'debs pa yin te/ sems la sems ma mchis te/ sems kyi rang bzhin 'od gsal ba'o/ /zhes sogs mang du gsungs shing / yul stong nyid don dam pa'i bden pa la ni 'od gsal gyi don ma tshang ba'i phyir ro/ /der ma zad 'khor lo dang po'i dngos bstan gyis kyang gnod de/ 'dul bar gtogs pa tshul khrims yongs dag gi mdor/ dge slong dag shes pa ni 'grib/ srog ni 'chad/ tshe'i 'du byed ni nges par 'dor bar 'gyur na zhes gsungs la/ khyed ltar na 'chi srid mngon du gyur pa na/ rnam smin skyes kyi srog dbang dang / tshe'i 'du byed rgyun chad pa bzhin du / 'chi srid dang / brgyal ba dang / gnyid 'thug pa dang / snyoms 'jug gnyis la sogs pa sems med du bshad pa rnams kyi tshe rig rgyun chad par 'dod dgos pa las/ shes pa 'grib ces gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /de bzhin du/ chos rtes dran gyi mdor/ rten yod pa rgyu ba chad pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa/ 'khor 'angs kyi rten/ rig rgyun shin tu phra ba ri ga'i lam 'bras gsum kun tu rgyun 'gyur med du yong la/ 'bras bu'i tshe rnam shes dang rlung si rgyu ba chad ces pa'o/ /de ltar na r+shan

༄༄༄/ /tu phra ba'i rlung sems kyi dwangs ma rang bzhin rnam dag rang gi ngo bo/ chu khams gser dang nam mkha' rnams dag pa bzhin dag paragasungs pa 'di ni tha snyad pa'i gnas lugs yin te/ thog ma med pa nas gnas skabs kun tu rgyun chad mi srid cing / don dam 'kho+od byed kyi rigs pas gzhom nus kyang mnyam gzhag ye shes la sogs pa'i lam du gyur pa'i gnyen po ye shes kyis kyang gzhom pa dang gzhig par mi nus/ nus na sangs rgyas pa'i ye shes thams cad dngos rgyu dang bral ba'i skyon du 'gyur ba'i phyir dang / bden bzhi mi rtag sogs bcu drug tu bshad pa yang 'di'i steng gi skad cig ma gtso bor byas pa'i de kho na nyid dam gnas lugs yin par ni/ bstan pa 'di'i shing rta'i srol 'byed chen po gnyis kyi nang nas 'phags pa thogs med zhabs kyis gtso bor gtan la phab pa'i don yin pa'i phyir dang / bka' 'khor lo tha ma dang / rgyud sde spyi sgos kyi gtan la dbab bya gtso bo yin pa'i phyir ro/ /des na 'di la skur pa 'debs pa ni/ thun mong ma yin pa'i lam dang 'bras bu'i ye shes khyad par can gyi snang ba'i dmigs yul la skur pa btab pas gzhi'i kun rdzobabaden pa'i gtso bo dang / lam gyi mnyam gzhag snang bcas dang / 'bras bu'i gzugs sku rgyu 'bras kyi rtsa ba bcad pa yin no / /ci ste tha snyad pa'i gnas lugs ni/ me'i tsha ba dang / bu ram gyi mngar ba la sogs pa yin par gsu ngas pa ma yin nam zhe na/ de dag ni re zhig pa tsam la dgongs sgo rgyun la mi bslu ba'i rang bzhin ma yin te/ me de nus ldan la bsil

bar snang ba'i blo lda 'khral shes ma yin pa'i phyir ro/ /'o na lung gi gnod byed dang / rang lugs kyi shes byed gang zhe na/ rgyas par snying po mdo bcu dang / sangs rgyas phal po che la sosas par rgyas par gsungs pa'i don rgyud bla rtsa 'grel du rgya cher gsungs pa soga~X su blta bar bya la/ 'dir ni dpal brtag pa gnyis pa las/ 'jig rten khams ni gang du yang / /sangs rgyas gzhan du rnyed ma yin/ /sems ni rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nyid/ /sangs rgyas gzhan du bstan pa med/ /ces sogs dang / sam+bu ṭi las/ rang gi lus la sangs rgyas bzhugs/ /gzhan du gang na'ang sangs rgyas med/ /mi shes mun pas bsgribs pa rnams/ /lus las gzhan du sangs rgyas 'dod/ /ces dang yang rtsa rgyud du/ lus la ye shes chen po gnas / /rtog pa thams cad spangs pa ste/ /dngos po kun la khyab pa po/ /lus gnas lus las ma skyes pa'o/ /zhes dang / bshad rgyud du/ rtog pa thams cad spangs pa yi/ /ye shes chen po lus la gnas/ /zhes dang / khyad par rtsa rgyud du/ dbang bzhi pa ston pa'i tshig ye shes 'di ni ches phra zhing / /rdo rje nam mkha'i dkyil lta bu/ /rdul bral mthar phyin zhi ba nyid/ /khyod rang yang ni de yi pha/ /zhes pas gzhi'i ye shes gsal bar bstan te/ /gzhi'i ye shes khyod rang yang ni dri ma zhi ba'i 'bras bu ye shes de'i pha'am nyer len gyi rgyu'o/ /zhes dgongs pa yin nges la/ 'grel ṭika mkhan po 'ga' zhig gis bshad pa ni rnge rje 'chang gi dgongs pa min pa'i phyir ro/ /de bzhin du/ 'gro kun lhan cig skyes pa

ra༅༅/ /nyid/ /rang bzhin lhan cig skyes par brjod/ /ces gsungs na/ phyogs snga smra ba po de dag gis ni/ lhan cig skyes pa'i sgra bshad shes thabs med de/ sems dri bcas dang lhan cig ma skyes par lam stobs kyis/ phyis gsar du 'byung bar khas blangs pa'i phyir ro/ /mdo rnyed de dag gi bstan don khyad par can de ni dpal sa ra has kyang gsungs te/ sems nyid gcig pu kun gyi sa bon te/ /gang la srid dang mya ngan 'das 'phro ba/ /'dod pa'i 'bras ribu ster bar byed pa yi/ /yid bzhin nor 'dra'i sems la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes sogs dang / dpal mgon klu sgrub kyis kyang / chos dbyengs bstod pa las/ sa yi dkyil na yod pa'i chu/ /dri ma med par gnas pa ltar/ /nyon mongs nang na ye shes kyang / /de bzhin dri ma med par gnas/ /zhes sogs mang du gsungs shing / gsang 'dus rim lngar yang / ji ltar chu la chu bzhag dang / /mar la mar bzhag ji bzhin du/ /gang yis rang gi ye shes ni/ /legs mthong gang gis 'di phyag yin / /zhes gsungs pa'i mthong bya'i ye shes dang / chu la chu bzhag rgyu'i ye shes gzhi la med na mngon rgyu dang sbyar rgyu ji ltar yong / de bzhin du rim lngar/ 'gro kun rang dbang med pa ste/ /rang dbang du ni 'byung ba min/ /de yi rgyu ni 'od gsal ba/ /'od gsal thams cad stong pa 'o/ /sems gang gis ni byis pa rnams/ /zhabor bar 'ching bas bcings gyur pa/ /sems de nyid kyi rnal 'byor pa/ /bde gshegs gnas su 'gro bar 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs shing / rnal 'byor

pa bde gshegs gnas su 'gro bar byed pa'i sems de gsar du bsgrub pa'i lam gyi ye shes la byed na/ des byis pa rnams 'khor bar ji ltar 'ching soms shig de bzhin du 'phags pa lhas kyang mang du gsungs shing / rgyal ba ma pham pas ji ltar chu rnyog pa las dang ba ni/ /dang ba de nyid de las skyes min gli /de ni de la dri ma bral par zad/ /de bzhin rang sems dag la tshul de nyid/ khebag so gas mang du gsungs pas kho bos ni/ shing rta chen po 'di dag gis dngos su lan cig min par gsungs pa'i lung gi dngos bstan las 'gongs pa'i rang bzo mgo phur byed mi nus so/ /gnyis pa ni/ gsang 'dus 'phags lugs la gakho+o bor 'dzin cing legs par sbyangs pa'i mkhas pa dag na re/ 'dus pa la ni/ ye shes lnga yi ngo bo nyid / /'byung ba lnga yi rang bzhin dbugs/ /zhes sogs dang / sems can kun gyi srog chen po/ /rlung zhes bya bas las kun byed/ khes sogs dang / rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas la bltos pa'i/ /phyag rgya chen por btags par ni/ /'od zer lnga ni 'byung ba dang / /nam mkha'i 'ja' tshon dag dang mtshungs/ /zhes sogs mang du gsungs pas/ shin tu phra ba'i rlung 'od zer lnga pa gzhi dus na yod pa ni longs sku'i bsgrub gzhi yin pas phyi nas btsal mi dgos kyang / dus 'khor la ni bsgrub gzhi sto nga gzugs la byed dgos la / de'i thog ma ra so ra sdu da ru na khang du rma thong ba'i du si+o gas mi na zhing / de phyi robai tu mthong bas phyi na mo da pa de rim gyis rlung rdo rje bzlas pa sa nang du spyan drangs nas ṭ+wāṃ tī'i nang du btsud de brtan par byed

ra༅༅/ /dgos pa'i phyir/ bsgrab gzhi phyi nas 'tshol dgos pa yin no zhes zer ro/ 'di ni shin tu mi rigs te/ spyir sangs rgyas phyi nas 'tshol ba mdo sde'i phyogs nas kyang ma bshad na/ rgyud sde'i mthar thug pa dbang bzhi pa gtso bor ston pa'i gsung rab las lta ci smos pa'i phyir te/ brtag gnyis su/ ye shes 'di ni ches phra zhing / /zhes pa'i ye shes gzhi dus na yod par gong du bsgrubs/ sems 'grel phyogs 'dir de nyid bstan bya'i gtso bor byed pa'i phyir ro / /gzhan yang shin tu phra pa'i rlung 'od zer lnga pa de sems can kun la med na ni sangs rgyas kyi nyer len nam rigs su mi rung la/ yod na dus zhabor gyi rnal 'byor pa la'ang yod la/ dus 'bor gyi lam gyis de 'bras bu'i sangs rgyas su bsgyur mi nus pa'i sgrub byed cung zad kyang med pa'i phyir yang 'dod pa 'di ni dus 'khor la skur pa 'debs pa kho na'o/ /'di'i sgrub byed rgyas pa ni/ stong gzugs dang mi 'gyur ba'i bde chen gnyis ka gzhi dus na yod pa rgyud gzhan dang 'grel pa spyi sgos su yang yang gsungs par gong du brjod zin pa nyid do/ /gnyis pa ni/ kha cig 'jam dgrangs kyi lta ba'i 'dod pa mdor bstan du/ phung po rnam bcad stong pa nyid/ /chu shing bzhin du snying po med/ /rnam pa kun gyi mchog ldan pa'i/ /stong nyid de ltar 'gyur ma yin/ /zhes sogs dang / dri med 'od du'ang / chad pa'i stong pa dang bems po'i stong pa ring du spangs pa/ zhes sogs mang du gsungs pas 'khrul nas/ bdag gnyis su 'dzin pa'i 'dzin stangs kyi dngos kyi ldog phyogs bdag

med rtogs pa'i shes rab kyi 'dzin stangs kyi yul lam/ des rnyed pa'i rnyed don mthar thug gam/ de'i gzhal bya'i gtso bor gyur pa chos thams cad kyi stong gi rang rang ngo bos stong pa'i stong nyid don dam pa'i bden pa ni bsgom bya'i yul ma yin te / chad stong yin pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes skur pa btab nas/ spyir 'khor lo phri ma khyad par stong gsum dar yug chen po'i mdo dang / rgyud bla sogs la brten nas gsal rdzogs mtshan dpes brgyan cing stobs sogs bral 'bras rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas zhig sems can thams cad la rang chas su yod pa de glo bur dri ma'i sbubs las ma grol ba grol ba'i phyir du rtog pa thams cad 'gag nas rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong gzugs bsgom par bya ba yin no/ /zhes zer zhing / bsgom bya de yang bsgrub pa rang dbang pa'i dngos por grub pa rgyu rkyen gyis 'dus ma byas pas rten 'brel ma yin pa/ rgyun brtan par ma zad skad cig gi skye 'jig kyang mi byed pas rtag brtan zer zug gzhom med ye nas gnas pas don dam pa'i bden pa dang rig pas dpyad bzod du grub pas/ rang nyid rang gis mi stong gi glo bur gyi dri mas stong pas gzhan stong gi chos nyid do zhes rgyu mtshan ltar snang du ma dang bcas te smra bar byed la/ shes byed rgyab skyor du 'khor lo tha ma'i dgongs 'grel shing rta'i srol 'byed thogs med sku mched kyi gzhung rnams ngangs nas slob dpon sde dag la dbu ma chen po thes mtshan dang sbyor thing / dpal ldan zla ba grags pa dang / 'i ba lha dang / seng bzang la sogs pa la rang stong pa thes skur pa 'debs par byed do/ /'ji

ra༅༅/ /dag ni lung rigs gzhan lta zhog rang gi shes byed du drangs pa'i lung rnams dang 'gal te/ de dag gi tshig zur du sangs rgyas kyi rang bzhin zhes dang / ngo bo zhes dang / dngos dang snying po zhes dang / sa bon zhes bshad pa sha stag yod pa'i phyir/ rang tshig kyang 'gal te/ ji ltar sngar bzhin phyis de bzhin/ /'gyur ba med pa'i chos nyid do/ /zhes bsgrub byed kyi gtso bo byas nas/ dag ma dag gi gnas skabs kyang med ces khas blangs pa gang zhig dag ma dag gi gnas skabs la khyad par yod par thal/ dag ma dag gi khyad par yod pa'i phyir/ de ni glo bur gyi dri mas dag ma dag yin sgo gnas skabs de gnyis ma'i rang bzhin la khyad med du bstan pas gzhi dus nas 'bras bu'i yon tan rdzogs par bstan pa yin no/ /zhe na/ 'jim pa'i dus dang rdza bum du grub zin pa'i sa'i rang bzhin la khyad med pas/ 'jim pa'i dus na rdza bum gyi yon tan rdzogs par yod par 'gyur bas mngon gsal smra ba'i grangs can gyi grub mthar 'gyur ro/ /khyad par 'dus ma byas kyi dngos po dang / rtag pa'i dngos po ni rang sde mdo sde pa sogs kyi grub mtha'i khongs su'ang ma 'dus so/ /yang sgos glo bur gyi dri ma de dag rang gi nang nas bzhugs pa'i spangs rtogs ngos skal gyi spang bya yin nam min/ yin na spangs rtogs de dag chos can/ spangs rtogs 'thad ldan min par thal/ ngos skal gyi spang bya las ma grol ba'i phyir te/ ngos skal gyi spang bya rnams rang rgyud ldan gyi gang zag gi rgyud la yod pa'i phyir ro/ /ma yin na su'i spang bya yin par soms

shig spang bya rnams phyi nas lam bsgom pa'i gnyen po gsar pas spong yang nang gi rnams spang rtogs ma yin par mi 'gyur te/ ko dmar gyis gtums pa'i ral gri bzhin no zhe na/ ral gri de skyes bu mkhas pas shing gi rtsa ba gdan lta bu'i steng du bsnun pa'i tshe ko dmar de gcod nus sam mi nus/ nus na ral gri de nyid kyis gcad byar 'gyur bas dpe don ma 'grig cing / mi nus par phyi nas gri gzhan pa zhig gis gcod dgos na nang gi ral gri la ral gri'i bya ba cung zad kyang med par 'gyur ro / /phyis gcad bya gzhan du ma gcod pa ltar/ dri ma las grol nas gdul bya'i spang bya spong zhe na/ gzhan rgyud kyi gnyen pos gzhan rgyud kyi spang bya spong bar 'dod pa las/ tha chad pa'i grub mtha' sngon ma byung zhing / 'bras bu'i sa na dngos gnyen yod par yang 'gyur te/ phyogs tsam mtshon pas mang du dgag mi dgos so/ /gnyis pa lam la rtog pa lam du gtan mi rung bar 'dod pa dang / spros bral lta ba'i mnyam gzhag tu yang dran rtog nges par dgos pa dgag pa'o/ /dang po ni/ mdo rgyud du ma dang / khyad par do ha skor la sogs pa sa mtshams mthon po'i rnam gzhag ston pa'i gsung rab rnams las/ rtog pa la dgag pa mang du mdzad pa rnams kyis 'khrul nas las dang po pa'i dus nas bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab la sogs pa'i nges rtog rig shes rjes dpag la sogs pa dang / khyad par bskyed rim zab mo rnams lam du gtan mi rung ste/ lam ni rtog med nam mkha'i rnal 'byor mnyam gzhag rnam par mi rtog pa so so rang rig pa'i ye shes kho na yin pas so

ra༅༅/ /zhes rgya'i mkhan po dang / rdzogs chen po dang / jo nang pa la sogs pa hwa shang gi rjes 'brang du ma smra bar byed de/ 'di dag la ni/ 'jig lta'am bdag 'dzin 'khor ba'i rtsa bar gsungs ba'i gsung rab mtha' dag gis gnod cing / mthong lam mnyam gzhag ye shes spong lam gyi gtso bo dang / rdzogs rim khyad par can sngags lam gyi mchog yin pas bden mod sri de dag la tshogs sbyor sogs kyi rgyu tshogs dang smin byed kyi lam gang yang sngon du gtong mi dgos par 'gyur zhing / rgya nag gi mkhan po la mkhas pa ka ma la shī las 'phangs pa'i thal 'gyur thams cad thal ro 'ba' zhig tu 'gyur ro/ /gnyis pa la yang / spyir tshogs sbyor la sogs pa sbyor ba'i gnas skabs na spang bya mngon gyur ba 'dzin stangs can gyi gnyen por nges rtog lan mang du bsgom dgos shing / 'dzin stangs brtan pos 'gal zla sun 'byin pa 'thad mod rdzi lta ba'am bsam byung gi shes rab rnyed zin nas rtse gcig tu 'jog pa'i tshe yang nges shes 'odzin stangs can brtan po'i rtogs pa ma bskyangs na zhi gnas dang ro gcig pa'i lhag mthong skye mi srid par 'gyur bas/ lugs snga ma 'gog pa la ha cang shugs drag pas mtha' pha rol tu lhung bar zad do/ /'bras bu la ha cang thal ba sangs rgyas kyi sa na ye shes med par 'dod pa dang / ha cang thungs pa sangs rgyas kyi sa na las snang yod par 'dod pa dgag pa'o/ /dang po ni/ don dam gtso bor ston pa'i mdo rgyud du ma dang / spyod 'jug tu/ gang tshe dngos dang dngos med dag /blo yi mdun na mi gnas

pa / /de tshe rnam pa gzhan med pas/ /dmigs pa med par rab tu zhi/ /zhes sogs rtsod spong dang bcas pas 'khral nas kha reg byang gzhon pa la sogs pa kha cig sangs rgyas kyi sa na 'dus byas kyi 'jug pa thams cad zhi bas ye shes tsam yang med do zhes smra'o/ /'di la ni dpal ldan chos grags yis/ rig pa'i phyi mtha' thug med du bsgrub pa'i rigs (rmi shin tu gnod de/ rig tsam du skye ba la ni rang rgyu rig tsam nyid kyis chog gi skyen gzhan la bltos pa med pa'i phyir te/ rigs gter mdzad pas/ sems las gzhan la bltos med kyis/ /rtags kyi phyi mtha' thug med 'grub/ /ces gsungs pa bzhin no/ /gzhan yang rigs pa gzhir byas la yul gyi gzhis dang / mi mthun pa dri ma'i chos rnams ni lam goms stobs kyis je 'phel du song ba'i gnyen po ye shes kyi stobs kyis rgyun chad par nges mod sgo yi shes rang nyid rgyun gcod byed kyi gnyen po ni/ rgyu med rkyen med rgyun 'gags pa yang mi rigs pas so/ shes phyin las lhag pa'i don dam gtso bor ston pa'i gsung rab med la/ der yang / de bzhin 'dir yang byang chub sems med bde gshegs sri /ye shes yon tan 'di dag kun tu ga la 'byung / /ye shes med na yon tan 'phel med byang chub med/ /rgya mtsho 'dra ba'i sangs rgyas gzugs kyang med par 'gyur/ /thes gsungs pa'i phyir yang ngo / /gnyis pa ni/ sems tsam rnam rdzun dri bcas pa man gyi dngos smra rnams dang / dbu ma rang rgyud pa phal cher rnams dang / bod kyi thal 'gyur bar grags pa kha cig sangs rgyas kyi sa na ma

ra༅༅/ /dag las snang du gyur pa'i snod bcud 'di ngag gzigs pa'i ye shes yod de/ med na 'di dag gzhi ma grub par 'gyur ro/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i gzigs pa log pa ni thams cad du med par go bar byed pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / gnas dang gnas min dang las kyi 'bras bu mkhyen pa la sogs pa'i stobs bcu la sogs pa med par 'gyur pas so/ /zhes gad brgyangs dang bcas te sgrog par byed do/ /rab rib can gyi gang zag des kho bo la snang ba'i skra shad 'di mig dag pa bas mthong dgos te/ ma mthong na med par 'gyur bsaso/ /zhes smras pa de rigs par 'gyur te/ ma dag las snang 'di thams cad ni/ rab rib can la snang ba'i skra shad dang 'dra bar rnam rdzun pa rang gis kyang yang yang smras pa'i phyir te/ byang chub sems 'grel du/ ji ltar skye bo sems rmongs pas/ /sgyu ma smig rgyu dri za yi/ /grong khyer la sogs mthong ba ltar/ /rmongs pas gzugs la sogs pa mthong / /zhes dang / rnam 'grel du/ ma rig gis bslad rang nyid la/ /ji lta'i rang rkyen la bltos nas/ /rnam rig de bzhin min rnam pa/ /skye 'gyur rab rib la sogs bzhin/ /zhes snang ba 'di dag med pa gsal snang du bshad pas so/ /gzhan yang rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas chos can/ las snang gi snod bcud mi snang bar thal/ las kyi nyes pa thams cad dang bral ba'i phyir / gzhan yang / sku 'byung lus mtha' dag dang bral nas ye shes kyi sku'i mthar son pa ma yin par thal/ thugs 'byung chos mtha' dag rang snang ngam rang ngor gzigs

pa'i phyir/ slob pa'i mnyam gzhag ye shes mtha' dag dang sngags kyi dkyil 'khor re re sgom pa'i sngon du yang chos can gyi snang ba 'gog pa dag mi 'thad par thal/ chos can mtha' dag gzigs pa'i ye shes de bsgrub bya'i gtso bo yin par mthong lam mnyam gzhag ye shes nas bzung ste rgyun mtha'i mnyam gzhag gi bar la chos can gyi snang ba je gsal du 'gro dgos par thal/ rgyun mtha' de ma thag tu ma dag pa'i chos can mtha' dag gsal bar gzigs dgos la/ de rgyu mthun byu༄ ñtsa las skye dgos shing / sems can gyi dus kyi rgyu mthun skyon can mtha' dag zad pa'i phyir ro/ /spyir gzugs skus gzigs pa dang mkhyen pa dang mdzad par gsungs pa thams cad ni sangs rgyas rang snang ma yin te/ gdul bya'i las snang yin pa'i phyir te / longs sku ni byang sems 'phags pa'i zag med las snang yi na la/ sprul sku ni so skye dang nyan rang gi zag bcas las snang gi sku yin pas/ sngon gyi smon lam dang tshogs gnyis kyi nus mthu dang gdul bya rang rang gi bsod nams kyi shugs kyis rang nyid ji tsam 'dod pa'i sku'i bkod pa dang gsung gi snang ba dang thugs kyi mkhyen pa la sogs pa 'bad med du 'byung ba rnams dngos po la gnas pa dang sangs rgyas dang ngo ru grub mi dgos te/ thun mong mchog gi sprul skus rdo rje gdan du 'tshang rgya tshul ston pa bzhin du de dang de'i tshul du gdul bya la snang bas de dang der grub par gdul byar ngangos nas rlom pa lge stag yin la/ khyad par sprul sku'i mdzang pa dang ra/byukhyen nga/ thar sa cad ni rgyu ma/thun gyi sku'i rnam rol yi na par gsu ngas

ra༅༅/ /te/ 'jug pa las/ thub dbang dus gcig kho nar de'i rgyu mthun/ /gzugs sku gcig la'ang rang gi skye gnas skabs/ /sngar 'gags gsal dang ma 'dres 'byung tshul ni/ /ma lus gyis bkra mtha' dag ston par mdzad / /ces sogs gsungs pa rnams la/ dbu ma rang rgyud pa man chod kyis bag chags kyi lhad ma zhugs par bslab par bya zhing / byang chub sems dpa'i 'grel pa rnams na ni shin tu'ang gsal lo/ /gal te snang ba'i snang mkhan 'di dag sems can yin na sa bcu pa man chad la bden par snang la/ sangs rgyas la bden snang mtha' dag bzlog pa'i las las grol yang snod bcud mi snang mi dgos so zhe na/ bangen snang med kyang tha snyad pa'i sdod lugs gang yod gzigs dgos la / de lta na me tsha bar gzigs shing gzigs pa ltar ma 'ukhral bas sangs rgyas rang la'ang tsha bar grub dgos la/ de bzhin du mun pa yang gzugs gzhan sgrib byed du tha snyad du grub pas sangs rgyas kyis gzugs gzhan sgrib byed du gzigs pas sangs rgyas rang ngor yang gzugs gzhan sgrib byed du 'gre(zlor 'gyur la/ de lta na me tsha ba la 'dzem dgos pa dang / mun khung du sgron me 'degs dgos par 'gyur ro/ /de lta mod kyi sangs rgyas kyis ni ting nge 'dzin la sogs pa'i nus pas tsha ba bsil ba dang / mun pa snang bar bsgyar ba yin no zhe na gardzigacig tu tsha grang gnyis ka dang / snang mun gnyis ka tshad mas grub par 'dod pa las tha chad pa'i grub mtha' ci zhig 'byung / chos gcig po de der song ba ma yin sgo gzhi de na las

dang ting nge 'khron la sogs pa'i nus pas tsha grang dang snang mun gnyis ka gsar du skye ba yin no zhe na/ tsha grang stobs ldan rgyun chags pa gnyis dang / snang ba mun pa gnyis lhan cig mi gnas 'gal gyi mtshan gzhi'i gtso bor rigs pa mkhyen pa dag gis yang yang gsungs pa mi rigs par 'gyur te/ sangs rgyas mi bzhugs pa'i tsha reg stobs can pa yod pa dang / mun chen gyis khyab pa'i gzhi mi srid pas so/ /de ltar na las snang gis bsdus pa'i tsha grang la sogs pa ni las mthun snang ba'i gang zag rnams la 'phral gyi 'khral rgyus ma bslad pa'i ngor snang ba mi 'gyur ba tsam la bsams nas 'jig rten na grags pa'i mngon sum la sogs pa'i tshad mas grub ces gzhan ngor ram 'jig lta lhan skyes dang mtshungs par ldan pa'i gti mug gi ngor khas len pa kho na yin gyi lir+shas par dpyad na lta zhog rnal 'byor kun rdzob kyi ngor cung zad dpyad na'ang tshad mas slu med tsam du gnas pa don dam pa'i bden pa dang / tha snyad pa'i gnas lugs skad cig ma dus kyi chung mthar grags pa tsam zhig tu zad de/ 'bor 'das bya byed las gsum thams cad ma brtags grags par gti mug las yin no/ /zhes dang / 'jig rten ngor byas bdag ni smra bar byed/ khes dang / rnam dpyad med par 'jig rten nyid las 'di/ /zhes sogs dang / /rmo nga sa pa/sa/ brtas pa sang yin pa'o/ /zhes dang / bden te 'on kyang rmongs la 'dod/ /ces sogs mang du gsungs pas thal 'gyur pa rang lugs la yang los rtos dbye ba mi 'angod pa ltar/ bya byed las gsum dang 'brel ba'i kun rdzob la tshad

ra༅༅/ /ma dang tshad min gyi dbye ba mi 'dod pas/ gnyid chung dang gnyid chen gyi rta glang gnyis mas 'khral rgyu ma zad kyi bar du rang rang gi bya ba byed mnyam dang / zad nas mi byed pas 'khrul ngor bden mnyam dang / gzags ngor med mnyam du 'jug pa dang / spyod 'jug du lan mang du gsungs pa ltar dbu ma chen po pa byed na khas blang bar bya'i/ spyar rtog ge dang sgos rang rgyud dang tha snyad 'jog lugs sgo bstun nas dbu ma chen po par mi byed de/ rtog ge'i rlung gis ma dkrugs gsal bar bya/ /zhes tshig gsal gyi bshad par dam bca' nyid nas brtsams te lan mang du gsungs pas/ las 'bras kyi rten yang 'jig rten rang dga'i blo snga phyi gcig 'dzin 'di ga'i steng nas byed pa po dang myang ba pa bzhag par bya'i/ rtog ge dang bstan nas skad cig ma'i dgrad pa khas blangs pa'i mjug tu zhig pa la sogs pa nan gyis bsgrubs nas bzhag par bya ba ma yin te/ rgya tshar gzhan du bshad zin cing spros te 'chad par yang 'dod pas 'dir ni 'phros don phyogs tsam bstan pa yin no/ /sangs rgyas pa'i bzhugs tshul rgyas par yang de dang 'dra la/ dus 'khor rang lugs kyang ye shes le'u'i sgrib bral gyi sangs rgyas thob tshul gyi skor dang / mchog mi 'gyur dang / khyad par le'u de'i tshi+ogs bcad brgya re gsum pa la sogs pa gsum gyis gsungs pas gzhung la legs par bslab par bya'o// //dge legs gser gyi sa 'dzin mgul du thugs rje'i chu 'dzin mtha' med 'khrigs/ /zab yangs mkhyen pa'i chu khur mang ldan sna tshags gzugs sku'i

glog 'phrong g.yo/ /tshangs dbyangs 'brug sgras sa gsum rab 'gengs 'aḥ〈gas lam yan lag brgyad cu'i char/ /skal bzang gdul bya'i gser gyi gzhi la lan gzhig min par phab pa las/ /legs bshad rin chen khams mang gis gtams gsung rab rin chen 'byung gnas che/ /thugs rje'i rlung gis legs par bsrub pas theg gsum ri gling gdul bya yi/ /bsam pa ji bzhin legs par grub pa'i thub bstan skye rgu'i nyer 'tsho che/ /kun gyi dbus na ches cher mtho ba dus 'bor ri rab dbang po yin/ /sa snyesnodzin mchog der g.yo med gnas bcas te/ /tshul khrims chos bzang dkar pa'i khri steng nas/ /legs bshad rtse dga'i rol pas dus 'da' ba'i/ /mkhas de bstan 'dzin nye dbang dbus na mtho/ /de phyir yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i lung rigs la/ /brten nas bdag nyid dge legs spel phyir dang / /skal bzang gzur gnas blo ldan don gnyer la/ /phan gdags thub bstan rgyas phyir ngas 'di byas/ /dus 'khor tshul las gzhan na bzhi pa'i lam/ /gsal rdzogs ji ltar med pa de bzhin du/ /'dir bshad tshul yang dus 'khor 'chad pa po/ /gzhan la med ces mkhas pas nges par mdzod/ /kha cig rtsod pa can zhes ring du 'dor/ /la la drang don yin zhes gzhan du 'chad/ /'ga' zhig gzhung lugs gzhin dang sre bar byed/ /phal cher mangs pas 'jigs nas btang snyoms 'jog /dus 'khor rgya mtsho'i gting mtha' ma rnyed nas/ /skye bo lugs bzang spang phyir gang zhig las/ /'ongs pa'i legs bshad pad dkar chu tshogs kyis/ /

ra༅༅/ /da lta stag tshong lo tsā'i re ba bskong / /bshad zin tshul lugs zab mo 'jigs rung 'di/ /sngon goms bag chags skal chen dang 'grogs pa'i/ /blos gros ra bar shong gi mchog 'dzin gyis/ /bskyod pa'i blo gsal mang du thos pas min/ /de phyir nyan thos pa dang gangs can pa/ /mdo sde'i phyogs dang pha ma phyogs re bar/ /zhen pa'i phyogs re'i blta tshul rings spongs la/ /phyogs med nam ma kha'i dbyings nas blta bar mdzod/ /thub bstan yongs rdzogs bdag gis bshad pas bsod nams nyin byed dbang po ni/ /bdag yid shar ri'i rtse mor son 'dis thub bstan pad tshal cher rgyas shing / /'gro kun srid zhi'i mun pa las grol phan bde'i lo tog 'phel bzhin du/ /blo gsal blo gros gling bzhi'i mkha' la mtshan mo med par bgrod gyur cig /phyi nang gzhan gsum gnas tshul dpag par dka'/ /byis pa'i blo mig gsal yang rgya khyon chung / /de slad legs par ma bshad log bshad sogs/ /nongs gang rgyal ba'i tshogs la bzod par gsol / /legs par bshad pa'i dge bas rgyal ba'i bstan/ /phyogs dus kun tu dar gyos phan byed ma/ /srid mtshor lhung ba 'di dag nyes skyon las/ /rnam par rgyal pa'i dpal de myur thob shog /ces dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i spyi don gyi sgo nas gtan la 'bebs pa'i legs bshad bstan pa'i rgya mtsho zhes bya ba 'di don du gnyer ba mang pos kyang bskul zhing / rang nyid kyang legs bshad la goms pa lhur blang bar bya ba'i phyir du sems dpa' chen po nam mkha' 'od zer pa dang / 'jam

pa'i rdo rje rin chen bsod nams 'phel la sogs pa'i bla ma dam pa mkhyen brtse nus pa'i yon tan rin po che mtha' yas pa la dbang 'byor ba du mas rjes su bzung ba'i dge slong lo tsā ba shes rab rin chen rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos thams cad 'dul gyi lo khrams kyi zla ba'i dkar phyogs kyi rdzogs pa gsum pa la dge 'phel chos 'khor sgang du legs par sbyar ba rdzogs so// //'dis kyang bstan pa rin po che spyi sgos mtha' dag dar zhing rgyas par gyur cig/༄yos/ /kā ci t+no tsā ra shu nā ru pa ru tsi ta ka kho ( nyu mā ya sa mu dro/ ku ṇa nā lā k+ṣa : stu su la ba lha su bha go dha rma te kā ya nā le/ra༅༅ / /nam yang 'pha sad sta nga gzugs mdze sa snga ga mkha' dbyi ngas sgu ma'o phyag rgya dang / /rtse 'ja ra ra la bas mi 'gyur bde byen dru /'o sgra gcan cha sa ska li sbubs// / rmi rba yo 'i ma tsa ji ga ma na dro pa tsi sto n+ta bi sba lha ma ṇ+ḍa/ tsā ཿ phye ( tabya tā ra pu tha ma na ya ka nywa : ba sa 4 rna ma ste/ra༅༅/ /las rlung nyi zla'i zlogro 'ong nub mthar gzugs sku'i dkyil 'bor spar 'char ba/ /e waṃ zung 'jug dus kyi 'bor lor dngos po kun gyis btud bya'i gnas/ /legs pa'i cha bsags grong khyer yangs par sa bcu mthar phyin kyang / /mi

ra༅༅/ /dbang tshul bzung chos rgyal rigs ldan rim par byon rnams dang / /bsdus rgyud 'grel chen dbus 'gyur 'chang du 'dren pa'i shing rta che/ /dus zhabs tsi lu pa sogs mkhas grub tshogs la snying nas dang / /ra 'bro shong sogs zhus chen mig sman gyis/ /dang po'i sangs rgyas bltar sgrib rab rib kun/ /yongs bsal rde rjes 'brang mdzad blo ldan rnams/ /rnam dag bstan 'dzin bgrang bya kho nar nges/ /na yams smra ba'i ca co rna ba 'tsher/ /grags skam ngur khyu ma yin rnam dpyod kyi/ /sgang sgubs legs bshad skang 'byin stag tshang pa/ /ka la piṅka'i ma chad zla khyod mi na su / /phyi nang gzhan gsum sbyar ba'i pad dkar tshal/ /tshig don nyi ma'i zer gyis kha 'byed kyang / /blang dor bltar rmongs phyogs 'dzin ku mu ta/ /zum pa dngos po'i gshis la gang zhig gzhung / /chos mig rgyal mtshan tog rtser yid bzhin dbang / /'dam dris ma sbags rgyad don dbyig gi char/ /'bebs pa'i skal ldan mkhas grub nor bu bzang / /mching bu'i khur lci'i gral las gcig tu yar/ /'dren byed theg 'chor tshig stog mkhar snyeg dpangs/ /ṭīka 'grel ming snyan snying po rnam bkra'i 'ja'/ /ma yin spya don yongs 'du 'di nyid las/ /rigs ldan zhal lung 'dod pa ci yang 'jo/ /gzu lums rags rtsis khung bur rtag nyal nas/ /rbad khams phud sgra nyer sgrog dug gi lce/ /mi skyong 'chol thub shes rab rin can sgo /rnam par thar la gzur gnas mtha' dag dang / /mgal dum skyor bzlos dong gzhog bstan bcos dbyings/ /bsnyed 'dod rdzu

bag pha wang rnga mtshang chur/ /lhungs kyang lung rigs sgro gdugs shes bya'i mkhar/ /'jal bar 'gran rnams rwa ba'i sbubs su nyol/ /dngos po'i gnas tshul gsong tshig phra mo'i zhugs/ /gzhan mtshang smra ba bsreg pa'i zhe snang me/ /sbar ba'i sgros rlung re zhig de tsam ste/ /smon lam chu klung sgra snyan sgrog la brel / /phra rab rdul grangs rgyud sde'i nor 'dzin steng / /phyi nang gzhan gsum lhun po rdo rje'i rwa/ /gdengs rtser rnam kun mchog ldan brgya byin dpung / /g.yul bshams sgrib gnyes sbyin skyes mthar byed shog/dang po'i sangs rgyas rgyud 'grel ā dar+sha/ /'khral nongs dri bral stong gzugs phyag rgya'i bzhin/ /gsal byed legs bshad bstan pa'i rgya mtsho 'di/ /skal bzang skye rgu'i 'jug ngogs dam par shog/dus kyi zhabor lor chos rgyal zla bzang dang / /'dra bar lung zin 'jam mgon bcong kha pablo/ /bzhed srol pad mtsho rjes 'brangs gnyis 'thung 'gas/ /ma brdzis legs bshad 'dab brgya rgod par shog /dga' spro'i dpal ldan sum rtsen 'chi med gakho'i/ /bsod nams 'jug pa bcu pa'i sgyu thabs rdzi /phyogs las rnam rgyal pho brang chen po'i lung / /'jig rten gsum gyi gtsug tu len par shog /sde bzhi'i gser sgong smon lam drod po ches/ /nyer smin sa la rgyu ba'i tshangs ris tog/gnam gyi she mong rtsibs stong 'bor lo'i rjes/ /snod bcud mtha' dag shugs kyis 'breng bar shog /dum bu bcu gnyis sa la rigs ldan che/ /drag po 'bor lo can gyi brtul zhugs ltar/ /mi srun kla klo'i sde dpung ma lus pa/ /bcopa pa'i rgyal rnga srid rtser

༄༄༄/ /brdung nus shog /chos sbyin mi zad par gyi sgo 'byed la/ /lus ngag yid kyis 'bad kun sham+bha lar/ /rigs ldan gyis smin grol lam sbyor drug gis/ /mkha' khyab mkha' yi rdo rje 'grub par shog /bod khams rgya hor lus phra'i mngal yangs por/ /dge bcu'i sa bon lde ba'i khur 'dzin pa/ /rab smin bde skyid khye 'u legs btsas nas/ /lang tsho dar drag bzhin ras ltar ngom shog /mkha' la mkha' yi sbyor ba ji bzhin thabs shes zung du 'jug pa las/ /stong chen yig lnga thig le yig drug ro gcig e waṃ bla na med/ /rdo rje nyi ma snang ba ches 'bar rdo rje zla ba dri med 'od/ /sku bzhi rdo rje tshe lus gcig la sems can yongs kyis mngon gyur shog /gtsang stag tshang chos 'bor sgang par skad gnyis smra ba'i paṇ+ḍi ta shes rab rin chen gyis mdzad pa'i dang po'i sangs rgyas dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud 'grel gyi dgongs don rnam par 'byed pa 'di nyid tshig don mtha' dag phul du byung ba yin zhes smon 'gro paṇa chen rig gnas rgya mtsho'i 'phreng ba 'dzin pas bsngags brjod lhag par che zhing / zhib mor dpyad tshe don la gnas par mthong ba nas yig cha'i rgyan rgya cher 'phel ba rgyud rgyal 'grel chen dang bcas par thos bsam 'grub 'dod kyi skal ldan mang por phan nam snyam pa'i lhag bsam gyis kun nas blangs te stod 'grel ba dume ti zhes pa blo ngan du 'bod pa/ rab byung bcu gcig pa lcags mo bya'i rnyir dga' ldan phun tshogs gling du par rkos kyi bkod pa bgyis par sa skyong sangs rgyas rgya mtshos bdag rkyen gyis khyab bya dang / zhus chen dang do dam

gnyis ga byed mi yar 'brog pa dge slong blo gros brtan pa / rtse skor ba dge slong blo gsal mkhas pa/ bkra shis gling pa dge slong smra ba'i dbang phyug gsum dang / yig mkhan blo bzang dam chos/ blo bzang nyi ma/ dga' ldan bstan 'dzin / thogs med rgya mtsho/ blo zang rab 'byor/ grags pa snyan grags/ rkos mkhan dbu mdzad dgos slobs/ dbu chung rgyal mtshan/ byings gras rab brtan/ gzhung rdor/ nam mkha' rab brtan/ grags pa/ nor bu lha skyabs/ a brtes / rab rgyas/ dpal khang dpal 'bar/ sgrol pa dbang rgyal/ yar 'phel/ 'om sbug dpal 'bar/ dpung sogs/ sum pa/ brag sna dbang rgyal/ rdo rje dbang rgyal/ smon 'gro kun dga' tshe brtan/ nor bu tshe brtan/ phun tshogs / tshe ring dar rgyas/ bde legs snying po/ tshe dbang dpal ldan/ rdo rje bkra shis/ bla ma rgya mtsho/ kun dga' tshe dbang / sum dar/ don grub/ lnga dar/ pad+ma/ dpal chen/ don grub dbang rgyal/ bla ma tshe brtan/ bla ma dbang po / gtsang pa kun dga' tshe brten/ g.yul rgyal/ rnam rgyal/ rdo rje tshe brtan/ tshe ring rab brtan rnams dang / dbu lha 'dri mi bzhed pa kun dga' mtha' yas/ shing bzo bsod nams/ 'phral gyi dgos cha sprod mi khang ser ma shes rab dpal bzang / ka bzhi smad pa bsod rnams nor bu rngams kyis 'bad pas bsgrubs pa'i tshe par byang smon lam dang bcas pa 'di ni za hor gyi rigs las tshangs sras bzhad pa'i rdo rjes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gsol dpon sngags rams pa ngag dbang

ra༅༅/ /dge legs kyis bgyis pa shrī kā la tsakra mya shā sa no da ye bha wan+tu// lnge //na mo mañdzu gho ṇa ya/ blo chen rgyal ba rnams kyi spyan snga ru/ /bzang po'i smon lam rlabs chen grub pa'i mthus/ /grags pa/'i sgra chen thub bstan 'gro ba'i dpal/ /blo bzang grags pa'i dpal la mgos phyag 'tshal/ /dpag yas tshogs gnyis kun gyi rtse mor soni/ /bgrangs yas rgyal ba kun gyi ring lugs 'dzin/ /mtha' yas 'gro ba kun gyi dge ba'i bshes/ /bsam yas yon tan kun gyi gter la 'dud/ /gangs can shar phyogs btsong kha'i skyed tshal du/ /dal 'byor yongs 'du'i rtsa ba rab brtan cing / /yon to yal gas phyogs kyi mtha' 'jal ba/ /snyan grags dri bsung 'phro ba khyod la 'dud/ /dri med mkhyen yangs 'jigs bral gzhon blo sogs/ /gangs can mkhas pa'i mkhas pa kun bsten nas/ /spyi dang khyad par gzhung lugs mtha' dag la/ /rmongs pa'i mun kun sangs pa khyod la 'dud/ /rnyog bral tshul khrims brtul zhugs rgya mtsho cher/ /mang thos lung rigs nor bus lhag par gtams/ /mkhas mchog klu dbang kun gyis gus pas bsten/ /rnam dpyod gting mtha' med la gsol ba 'debs/ /khyod blo'i nyi mas gzhon nu'i dus kyi tshe/ /mdo dang rgyan gyi pad tshal rgyas mthong nas/ /bdag blo khengs pa'i ku mud lhag par zum/ /zab yangs mkhyen pa'i gter la gsol ba 'debs/ /byang phyogs 'di na tshig tsam byang ba'ang dkon/ /don la sgro 'dogs chod pa de bas dkon/ /bstan don nyams su len pa srid mtha' tsam/ /'di

gsum mthar phyin khyod la snying nas 'dud/ /la la rigs bral lung gis grub mtha' 'jog /kha cig lung med rigs pa lhar snang brtsom/ /lung rigs gnyis gas rgyal ba'i gsung rab kun/ /legs par 'byed pa khyod la gus phyag 'tshal/ /kha cig 'dul ba gtsu+or byas gsang sngags spong / /gzhan dag sngags la mos blos 'dul ba 'gog /rgyal ba'i bstan pa mtha' dag 'gal med du/ /rdzogs par nyams su len mkhas khyod la 'dud/ /mtshan nyid phyogs bzung gsang sngags zab chos dang / /sngags kyis khengs nas mtshan nyid kha bshad tsam/ /mdo sngags mtha' dag ma tshang rdzogs byang du/ /bgrod thabs med par gzigs pa khyod la 'dud/ /la la spyod pa zhib mos lta ba 'gog /kha cig lta ba mthon pos spyod pa 'dor / /lta spyod phan tshun grogs su shar nas/ ni/ /don 'di lhag par 'doms pa khyod la 'dud/ /'ga' zhig bshad pa gtsor byed sgom la smod/ /la la sgom gyi chog 'edzin lung la smod/ /bshad grub gnyis gas lung rtogs dam pa'i chos/ /'dzin tshul gsal mdzad khyod la gus pas 'dud/ /mdo sngags mtha' dag khyad par rdo rje'i theg /rgyud sde mtha' dag khyad par bla med don/ /rim gnyis mtha' dag khyad par sgyu lus la/ /sngon med legs bshad gter chen khyod la 'dud/ /mdor na thub bstan mtha' dag ma lus par/ /bshad sgrub gnyis kyis ches cher gsal mdzad pas/ /gangs can 'di na bstan 'dzin mtha' dag gis/ /rtag tu bsngags par 'os pa khyod la 'dud/ /bdag kyang deng nas tshe rabs thams cad

༄༄〉༅/ /du/ /bdag nyid chen po khyod bzhin rgyal ba'i bstan/ /bdag pas gzhan gces lhag bsam phul byung lis/ /bdag gi srog ltar bsrang bar byin gyis rlobs/ /khyod la gsol byas ha cang mchog 'dzin gyis/ /phyogs lhung gdon gyis thub bstan 'khrags pa yang / /ngag snang phyogs med 'byongs pa khyod nyid kyis/ /myur du bsal nas bstan 'dzin mthun gyur cig /ces sgongs ri'i khrong 'dir phyis kyi bstan 'dzin chen po 'gran zla dang bral ba blo bzang grags pa'i dpal gyi ngang tshul mdo tshurmi du brjod pa/ dad pa'i pad ma rgyas par byed pa'i bstod tshig gi nyi ma zhes// //
ra༅༅/ /dpal ldan dus 'khor la mkhas pa red mda' ba chen po sogs kyis rtsod pa'i lan rtsod bzlog tu grags pa la bzhugs so//

ra༅༅/ /na mo gu ru shrī ka la tsakra ya/ khyab bdag dpal ldan 'gyur med bde ba'i dngos/ /rnam kun mchog ldan phyag rgya'i gzi 'bar zhing / /srid dang srid min dbyer med mgon de dang / /mi gnyis bla ma mchog la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gangs can 'di na dus 'khor la/ /dmigs pa'i log rtog chu 'dzin las/ /'ongs pa'i nyes spyod klog 'phreng dang / /log smra'i ser ba mi bzad pas / /phan bde'i lo thog 'joms byed pa'i/ /mkhas rlom du ma 'di skad du/ /rgyud 'di rtsod bcas yin pas na/ /mkhas pas blang bya ma yin lo/ /'di ni dpal ldan zhi ba lhas/ /theg chen rtsod bcas phyir zhe na/ /lung la mu stegs pa rnams dang / /lung gzhan la yang rang gzhan dag khyad bcas yin phyir dor byar 'gyur/ /zhes pa'i rigs pas legs par bcom/ /gzhung lugs gzhan la mkhas

ra༅༅/ /rnams kyis/ /blor ma chug pas skyon bcas lo/ /theg chen dbu ma chen po de/ /dbyig gnyen thugs su ma chug phyir/ /dbu ma spong bar cis mi byed/ /thig chen smo thos sde pa yis/ /sangs rgyas gsung du me 'dod pas / /byams pa klu grub zhi ba lha/ /legs ldan 'byed sogs mkhas pa yis/ /theg chen bka' bsgrub rig pa'i tshogs/ /mang du bkod phyir thig chen kun/ khyad bcas chos su cis mi 'dod/ /khyad par gsang sngags rdo rje'i theg /rgyal ba'i gsung du mi 'dod pa/ /'phags yul du yang du ma byung / /de phyir ma khas mchog shān+ti ba/ /sogs kyis gsang sngags bka' bsgrub mdzad/ /spyir yang dman pa mi mos pas/ /mchog tu grub ces byams mgon gsung / /de phyir mkhas pa gzhon blo yis/ /dus kyi 'khor lo'i rtsod yig tu/ /bkod pa'i rig pa ma lus pa/ /ltar snang kho nar kho bos mthong / /de yang legs par bshad kyis nyon/ /e waṃ yi ge med pas na/ rtswa rgyud rnam dag min zer ba/ /e waṃ gzugs don med zer ba/ /dang po khyab pa ma grub ste/ /bde mchog la sogs skyon du 'jug /gnyis pa gtan tshigs ma grub ste/ /sangs rgyas seng ge'i khrir bzhugs phyir/ /khyab ste bshad rgyud rdor phreng las/ /e ni gsang ba mkha' dbyings dang / /bha ga pad+ma chos 'byung dang / /chos kyi dbyengs dang seṅge'i khri/ /mchog tu med byung brjod par byed/ /waṃ ni rdo rje rdo rje sems/ /rdo rje 'jigs byed dbang phyug che/ /he ru ka dang dus 'bor ro/ /dang pore sangs rgyas la sogs mas/ /zhes pas

gsal bar gsungs phyir ro/ /'dis ni dus kyi 'khor lo'i mtshan/ /rgyud sde gzhan du ma smos zhes/ /mu cor smra ba de yang bsal/ /de phyir e waṃ ma smos zhes/ rtswa rgyud sogs su bshad pa ni/ /e waṃ gzugs la dgos pa yin/ /'dis ni dus 'khor bde mchog gi /gzhal yas khang la chos 'byung gi /gru gsum dbyibs can mi byed pa'i/ /rgyu mtshan de yang gsal bar bshad/ /mngon shes med pas rtsa rgyud kyi/ /dang po'i 'grel pa byar mi rung / /zhes gsungs pa la 'chad po yang / /mngon shes dgos par mtshungs zer ba/ /dang po'i 'chad pa sbyor na 'dod/ /mi sbyor khyab pa ji ltar mtshungs/ /skyes bu nyi shu rtsa lnga dang / /'byung pa 'gro ba'i skye gnas dang / /ljon shing dud 'gro'i skye bar bsdus/ /stong pa'i rdul gyis 'jig rten rtsom/ /'di rnams mu stegs gzhung lugs dang / /mthun phyir dam chos min no lo/ /des 'dul drang srong rjes gzung phyir/ /de lta'i tha snyad khas len kyang / /don rnams cung zad mi bzhed de/ /rtag dngos khas mi len phyir dang / /'byung pa nyer len min phyir du/ /ljon shing skye gnas bzhir bsdus pas/ /dud 'gror bsdus par mi 'gyur phyir/ /'jig rten bstan bzhag mngon pa dang / /'gal ba'i phyir na mi 'thad lo/ /chu 'bab klung la yi dwags rnams/ /rnag khrag shes pa skye ba bzhin/ /sems can so so'i las dang ni/ /bag chags stobs kyis dngos po gcig /tshad dbyibs 'gal bar snang ba 'di/ /lung rig du mas grub bzhin du/ /tshul 'di snang smras byed pa'i rgyu/ /bag chags ngan pa rtsis ma yin/ /

ra༅༅/ /'on kyang tshangs pa'i 'jig rten la/ /dpag tshad bye ba'i khyon yod pa/ /'gog pa lta bur mdzad pa ni/ /des 'dul drang srong gzung phyir yin/ /sgra mi snyan du kla klo dang / /rigs ldan 'byung phyir dge sdig gnyis/ /'byung la'ang mngon pas gnod zer ba/ /'du shes med pa'i sems can rnams/ sher phyin 'char par 'od 'gyur zhing / kher phyin mdo las bshad pa dang / /srog dbang chad pa slar mthud par/ /sman bla'i mdo las bshad pa dang / /bud med rten la 'tshang rgya bar/ /gsang 'dus sogs las bshad rnams la/ /mngon pa'i lung gis cis mi gnod/ /gling bzhi mtha' dag mngon pa dang / /mi bstun pa nyid nges bzhin du/ /sgra mi snyan la dod da byod pa'i/ /blo gros 'di 'dra e ma mtshar / /'dul ba lung las rgyal ba yis/ /rta chag rul pa bzhes pa dang / /seng dan tshal pa zug pa dang / /gyogs kyis sku rgyab gnad pa dang / /'khor lo'i dbyen gyis btsen pa sogs/ /las kyi lhag dmar bshad pa dang / /dbang po gnyis sbyor sogs bkag cing / /theg chen lung las gnang ba dang / /las sgrib zad par spangs pa sogs/ /'gal ba spong yang mi shes sam/ /'dzag bde 'khor ba'i rgyur bshad pas/ /tsha dpyal khams gong la sogs na/ /'dzag bde med pas mi 'thad lo/ /'dzag bde yin na khams drug can/ /rags pa yin pas ma khyab ste/ /de la yon tan lnga ldan nas/ /gcig ldan bar gyi phra rags su/ /phye nas mi dang lha sogs la/ /rim par sbyar nas gsungs phyir ro/ /de na de ni 'gyur

bde yin/ /mi 'gyur bde ba thar lam sgo ma bar nges bzhin 'gyur bde ni/ /'bor ba'i rtsa bar cis mi 'dod/ /des na don de drang don du/ /bshad pa'ang rgyud la bskur 'debs yin/ khrilda byang chub sems spong ba/ snya ltung yin na khrim pa yi / /rdo rje 'dzin pa mi 'thad lo/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa 'thad ldan gyis/ /kun+da spong ba mi srid de/ /gsang dbang sogs la 'byin srid kyang / /bde chen steng du mi dgos zhes/ /spong sems skye ba ga la srid/ /skyes na rtsa ltang 'byung nges te/ /lam gyi rtsa ba'i rten sa ni/ /dper na smon sems gtong ba bzhin/ /rig byed bzhi dang grub mtha' bzhi/ /mi rigs bzhi sogs dus 'khor gri/ /zhal bzhi po las 'byung bshad pas/ /tshangs pa'i gzhung dang 'dra zer ba/ /'bras bu'i dus 'khor lha sku yi/ /zhal las 'byung ba mi 'dod kyi/ /nges don gzhi yi dus 'khor gang / /gnyug ma'i thig le gzhom med la/ /gnas skabs bzhi po bskyed pa yi/ /nus pa'i sgo bzhi bskyed po de/ /lus kyi snying kha la sogs pa'i/ /'khor lo bzhi la gnas pa yi/ /bag chags sad pas phyi rol gyi/ /snang ba bzhi tshan 'char bas na/ /gzhi yi dus 'khor zhal bzhi las/ /'byung bar gsung phyir snang ba kun/ /phyi na tshugs thub med tshul la/ /nges pa ster bas mchog tu grub/ /gzung 'dzin dgos pas 'di mi go /bajo+od tu med pa'i gang zag sna/ /bye brag smra bas 'dod pa dang / /kha che'i gzhung lis bdag med par/ /'dod pa khas blangs 'gal zer ba/ /bye brag smra la kha che bas/ /khyab par 'dod pa bab col yin/ /de la thams

༄༄༄/ /cad yod smra yis/ /khyab ces zer ba'ang de dang 'dra/ /gnas ma bu sogs sde nga/ lnga/ /bdag 'di 'dod ces smra ba dang / /grub mtha' bzhi ru ma gtogs na/ /nang pa min par smra ba dang / /sde pa bco brgyad thub bstan la/ /gyes par smras rnams cis mi 'gal/ /rang gi nang 'gal mi rigs pa'i/ /sa bcu pa la nang 'gal 'dzin/ /mdo sde pa yi rnam rig min/ /las gzhan thogs med gzugs 'dod ces/ /zer ba'ang shin tu mi rigs te/ /yang na dbang don gang rung zhig /thogs med nyid du 'dod pa 'am/ /dbang don rig byed min pa las/ /gzhan pa'i thogs med gzugs 'dod pa'i/ /don smra de 'dra e ma mtshar/ /bsdud pos theg gsum bsdus pa dang / /glegs bam yi ger bris pa dang / /bod tu bod skad bris pa sogs/ /byis pa'i dgos pa bkod par zad/ /lwa ba pa yi 56 6na nas/ /blangs pa'i rgyud rnams tshad ldan du/ /nges nas dus zhabs la sogs la/ /sdang ba'ang snang shugs tsam du zad/ /mkhas pa nā ro paṇa chen gyis/ khye rdor nges don 'chad pa na/ /rgyud sde 'di nyid gtsor mdzad pas/ /tshad ma'i skyes bus 'di bzung ngo / shes rab rin chen lo ts+tsha ba'i/ /rnam dpyod mkha' shar nyi ma 'o/ /des na log lta'i rab rib rnams/ /yang dag rigs pa 'dis sel shog/ //maṅga lam̐/ bha wastu/ no/ r+ghaṃ// //
go༅༅/ /sbyin sreg cho ga dngos grub rgya ma②ོ bzhugs so//

ra༅༅/ /na mo mañdzu badz+ra ya/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga rgyas par bshad pa dngos grub kyi rgya mtsho zhes bya ba/ bla ma dam pa dus kyi zhabor lo'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /'gyur med bde chen chos sku'i mkha' dbyings su/ /stong gzugs zung 'jus longs ska'i cha shas rdzogs/ /dag pa'i mtsho la sna tshogs chu zla yi/ /sprul skus khyab mdzad dang po'i sangs rgyas rgyal/ /khyab bdag mchog des spyi dang khyad par gyi/ /rgyud las gsungs pa'i sbyin sreg cho bzhi / /rnam bzhag rgyas shing lag len mdor bsdus pa/ /mkhas rmongs kun la dga' bskyed 'dir bshad bya/ /de yang bya rgyud legs grub dang / 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud dang / don zhags cho ga zhib mo sogs dang / spyod rgyud rnam snang mngon byang dang / rnal 'byor rgyud kyi rtsa bshad kyi rgyud dang / bla med

༄༄༄/ /kye rdor dang / sam+bu ṭi dang / rdo rje mkha' 'gro dang / 'jigs byed rtog bdun dang / khyad par mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i nyer bzhi pa dang / sdom 'byung nyer gsum pa dang nyer brgyad pa rnams nas rgyas par 'byung ba / slon dpon nag po spyod pa dang / a bha ya dang / dar pan sogs kyi bsdus pa dang / dpal mgon klu sgrub kyi ye shes mkha' 'gro ma'i sgrub thabs su gsungs pa dang / ye shes zhabs lugs pa'i gsang 'dus rgyud 'grel rnams dang / mar me mdzad chen po'i dkyil chog bzhi brgya lnga bcu pa dang / de'i 'grel par shān+ti pas mdzad pa rnams dang / bod kyi sa skya pa rje btsun snga phyi rnams dang / bu ston thams cad mkhyen pas 'di dang / gsang 'dus dang / yo ga'i sbyin sreg bshad pa kun dang / lo chen gyis bya spyod kyi sbyin sreg mdzad pa rnams legs par brtags te rnam bzhag go sla zhing / dus 'khor zhi rgyas kyi lag len sgrub bde bar brjod par bya'o// //'di la rnam bzhag rgyas par bshad pa dang / lag len bsdus te bstan pa'o/ /dang po la/ spyi dang / khyad par phyi'i sbyin sreg go /dang po ni/ sbyin sreg rnam pa gsum yin te/ bla med nang dang phyi yi'o/ zhes smras te/ slob dpon spyod pa'i rdo rjes/ bla med nang dang phyi yi ste/ /sbyin sreg rnam pa gsum du 'dod/ /ces dang / sgrub thabs kun bzang las/ phyi yi sbyin sreg cho gas bsgre bya zhing / /yid kyi yang ni yid kyi bya ba ste/ /phung po'i bud shing bsreg par byed pa yi/ /ye shes me rtse bla na med par bshad/ /ces slob dpon mang pos

gsungs pa ltar/ ye shes la brten pa bla med/ bza' btung la brten pa nang / cho ga la brten pa phyi'i sbyin sreg go /bla na med pa'ang rnam gsum ste/ spros bral bsam gyis mi khyab dang / 'od gsal bde ba chen po dang / gtum mo rang byin brlab pa'o/ /bde mchog sdom 'byung las/ dgang gzar shes rab blugs gzar thabs/ /de gnyis sbyor ba gnyis med basbom/ /de las nges 'byung mar gyi r+ghan/ /ye shes chen po'i bdud rtsir 'dod/ /rgyu dang mi rgyu'i bdag nyid rtun /me ni de yis yang dag mchod/ /'di ltar sbyin sreg gang byed la/ /skal bzang dngos grub rab tu ster/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ shin tu gsal ba'i chos dbyengs skya thab khung du thabs dang shes rab kyi dgang blugs kyis rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes kyi me sbar te khams gsum pa'i phung khams skye mched ma lus par bsreg par byed pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i bsreg blugs dang / phyag chen thig le'i rgyud las/ dbang po gnyis ni sbyor ba las/ /rlung gi me ni sbar ba 'o/ /mar yod pa ni stong 'khor lo/ /de ni mar snod zhes su brjod/ /haṃ gi rnam pas blugs gzar bstan/ /dgang gzar de ni rdo rje 'o/ /bha ga hoṃ khung zhes su brjod/ /byang chub sems kyis mar ni bsreg /ces dang / rjes chags kyi me rab tu 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i bla ga'i dkyil 'khor yongs su sbyangs pa'i thab khung du haṃ dang rdo rje'i dgang blugs kyi byang chub kyi sems kyis bsreg rdzas sbyin pa bde ba chen po'i bsre ga blugs dang / rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i rgyud las/ phun tshogs yam shing ye shes me/ /las kyi rlung

ra༅༅/ /gis rab sbar nas/ /lte ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dir ni 'bar/ /tshangs pa'i me ni sum mdor gnas/ /la la na ni dgang gzar ste/ /blugs gzar na ni ra sa nas/ /dbyug pa rin chen rdo rje'i mtha'/ /thod pa bsreg rdzas snod yin te/ /bsreg bya rdzas rnams thams cad do/ /rim pa de ltar brjod par bya/ /sbyin sreg bla na med pa 'di/ /lha mo khyod la ngas bshad do/ /ces dang / 'od gsal rang byang gi me 'bar ba dang bcas pa rtsa 'khor rnams kyi thab khung du / ro rkyang gi dgang blugs bi+os dwangs ma khyad par can gyi rdzas sbyin par byed pa rang byin brlab kyi bsreg blug rnams ni gtso bor rdzogs rim pa'i sbyin sreg ste nges don rnam bla na med pazlo+o/ /nang ni/ ye shes thig le'i rgyud las/ kha ni hoṃ khung dgang blugs lag /tshul ni rang byung me yin la/ /zhes sogs dang / sgrab thabs kun bzang bi zas kyi rnal 'byor gyi skabs su ji ltar bshad pa bzhin no/ /phyi ni/ rgyud rnams su cho ga rgyas par bshad pa kun la grags pa bzhin te/ de na 'dir ni / bza' btung nang gi sbyin sreg ste/ /yongs su grags pa phyi yi 'o/ the/ sa smras pa yin no/ /gnyis pa la rgyud sde spyi'i dang / khyad par dus kyi 'khor lo'i sbyin sreg go /de yang / 'di la rgyud sde spyi dang ni/ /khyad par 'dir bshad gnyis rig bya/ /zhes smras so/ /dang po la mdor bstan/ rgyas bshad do/ /dang po la/ phyi la zhi rgyas dbang drag bzhi/ /phyogs dus chas sam 'dug stangs thabs/ skyonang me lha sngags mdog so so/ /gzhan kun spyi dgos thun mong yin/ /zhes

smras te/ rmongs rengs dgug bskrad la sogs pa las kyi dbye ba mang yang / bshad rgyud rdor phreng sogs nas 'byung ba sgron gsal le'u bcu bzhi'i mgor bsdus pa ltar gsang sngags spyi 'gro ba thams cad/ zhi rgyas dbang drag bzhir bsdus nas 'chad pas/ de rnams so so la/ gang du byed cing /ba blta ba'i phyogs dang / nam gyi tshe byed pa'i dus dang / sgrub pa po'i chas gos dang / bsam pa dang 'dug stangs dang / thab dang / bud shing yam shing dang / me dang / me lha dang / spel tshig gi sngags dang / skabs kyi kha dog rnams ni so sor nges shing / gzhan yang dgang blugs bzung ba'i khu tshur dang / me pra sogs kyang so so ba yod la/ rdor dril dgang blugs rnal 'byor sogs phal che ba ni thun mong ba ste/ de yang thams cad thun mong dang 'jam po gsum gyi dgos kyi thun mong yang yod/ gnyis pa la/ so so ba rnams bshad pa dang / thun mong ba rnam sa bshad pa'o/ /dang po la phyogs dang / dus la sogs pa ste/ phyogs ni shar byang nub dang lho/ /dkyil 'khor yod na dkyil zhabor de'i/ /phyogs der 'dug nas der kha blta/ /gzhan du grong sogs shar phyogs su'o/ /zhes smras te/ shar du zhi ba/ byang du rgyas pa/ nub tu dbang / lhor drag po'o/ /gzhung lugs la lar lho byang log par sagad kyang / dus ni sro da dang tho rang dang snga dro dgongs mo 'am gzhan du sa da/ /ces pa bya rgyud so gas nas sro da la zhi ba dang tho rang bya ros ska da mi grag pa 'i dus su rgyas pa dang / snga dro dbang dang / phyi dro drag las bya ba'ang bshad

ra༅༅/ /la/ gzhan du tho rang dang snga dro go rje ba dang / la lar snga dro zhi ba dang / srod la rgyas pa dang / nyin gung dang nam phyed la drag las bya bar yang bshad de/ phyi ma dus 'khor dang phal cher mthun no/ /chas ni gos dkar shekho sogs brgyan/ /gos ser gser dngul rin chen brgyan/ /gos dmar me rtog dmar pos brgyan/ /gos nag me tog nag pos brgyan/ /ces pa zhi sogs rim pa bzhin te/ gos bzhin du stan dang dar dpyangs la sogs pa rig par bya'o/ /bsam pa 'jam zhing dul ba dang / /dga' 'dun spro la gzengs bstod dang / /brtse zhing gcugs la chags pa dang / /khro zhing 'khrag la rngam pa 'o/ /zhi sogs rim pa ba'in no/ /'dug stangs pad+ma'i 'dug stangs dang / /bzang po'i 'dug stangs rol pa dang / /phan tshun mnan pa'am g.yas brkyang ngo / /rkang pa phan tshun mnan pa ste gzhan ni go sla la/ zhi ba la spus 'byed gcugs te bram ze rig byed 'don pa lta bu/ dbang la rkang pa'i mthil sprad pa pad+ma'i skyil krung la lar bshad do/ /thab ni zlum po khra gang dang / /khra bzhi khra ni do pa dang / /zla gam lta bu khra gang dang / /khra gsum sor mo nyi shu ste /zab su rang rang phyed phyed tshad/ /mu ran dang ni kha khyer gnyis/ /khra gang pa la sor bzhi bzhi/ /rgyas la nyis 'gyur drag po la/ /sor mo gsum gsum tshad yirno te/ dob khyer rnams la rdo rje dang / snyu/ na chen pad+ma rdo rje gyes/ /nang dbus pad+ma 'dab brgyad zhi /lte ba'i mtshan ma'ang de rnams te/ /zhi la 'khodro lo bshad pa'ang yod/ /'dab mar rigs bzhi

yum ba'i 'o/ /phyi rol rdo rje phyed pas mtshan/ /thab rgyas dal gyis bskor ba 'o/ /zhes smras te/ rgyud sde gong 'og kun nas thab kyi tshad gang bshad du 'di ltar bshad cing rgya bod kyi mkhas pa kun gyis kyang rgyas bsngas mdzad pa ma mthong la / 'phags pa rin po ches ji skad bshad pa 'di dag ni thab chung bsdus pa yin gri/ chen po ni zhi ba la khra do pa nas bcu drug pa'i bar te de bzhin du gzhan la'ang sbyar bar gsungs pa la ni khungs btsal bar bya'o/ /dbyibs sna rgyas pa la rin po che zur brgyad pa lta bu dang / dbang la phyag rgya'i chos 'byung dang pad+ma'i 'dab ma lta bu'ang mdo sde sogs su droshad do/ /mu ran dang kha khyer ni/ rje btsun gong mas snga phyi slog ste gsungs shing / mdo ste dang hṝ ya sa muts+tshar sor bzhi dor bar kha khyer zhes dang / sor bzhi spangs par zhes sogs ma gtogs mu ran gyi ming ma byung la/ dus 'khor du mu ran gyi dod du mchu zhes gsung mod kyi/ gang ltar nang lder 'gag gi nang khyer phyir la sgyed nas steng du ngos bstan pa lta bu ni snga ma dang / yang steng du langs pa de nyid spangs dang mnyam par phyir la bskyed nas ngos steng du bstan pa cig la mtshan mas brgyan pa ni phyi ma yin la/ phyi ma 'di'i skad dod la be dī zhes 'byung zhing / 'di snam bu la yang 'jug pas dkyil 'khor gyi kha khyer la 'dod snam du grags pa ngang 'dra ba'i phyir snga ma mchu'am mu ran/ phyi ma kha khyer du rigs so/ /'phags pas kha khyer gyi nang gnyis kyi bar du mu ran mdzad pa la'ang shes byed med la/ dus 'khor du mchu dang kha khyer gyi bar du re kha zhes pa cig 'byung ba ni

ra༅༅/ /de dang mi 'dra'o/ /kha khyer gyi mtshan ma/ ni zhi ba la 'khor lo dang / dbang gi dgug pa la lcags kyu 'dam khar bshad pa yang yod la phal cher ni rtsa ba bzhin no/ /kha khyer gyi phyi rol du dus 'khor las pad 'dab phyir la 'phyang ba cig bshad kyang gsang sngags gzhan du thab bsdus pa la rtsa thig lta bu gru bzhi pa cig byas pa'i rdo rje phyed pas brgyan pa nyid bshad la/ kha cig las zla phye dang bcas pa bya'o/ /de ni bsdus pa yin la/ thab rgyas pa ni rang rang gi skabs de'i dkyil 'khor gang yin me ri dang dur khrod kyi bar gyis bskor ba gru bzhi la sogs pa'i ma nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa ste/ thab kyi lte ba'i pad 'dab ni dbus kyi gshegs pa gshegs ma'am snying po'i lha dang kha khyer gyi de ma thag nas rim pa gnyis pa'i grwa bzhi dang lha snam sogs sam/ bde mchog sgo thurges gsung sku'i dkyil 'khor sgo mtshams ma dang bcas pa sogs su bya bar rje btsun gong ma rnams bzhed cing / 'phags pas dur khrod dang rdo rwa'i bar du khor yug byas nas/ shar du tshangs pa/ lhor dbang phyug nub tu khyab 'jug byang du gzhon nu gti ka 'khor dang bcas pa'i mtshan ma/ shar phyogs su/ pad+ma dbyu gu phreng ba dang / /spyi blugs ri dwags pags pa 'o/ /lhor ni rtse gsum zla tshes dang / /rgyal mtshan ral pa'i thor tshugs mig /nub tu 'khor lo dung dang ni/ /dbyug tho ral gri phub rnams so/ /byang du mdung dang dril bu dang / /ba dan rma bya ra skyes bri/ /zhes gsungs pa ni yo ga'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga 'chugs par snang la/ mthar mda' dgu dang me

long bzhi dang tshon skud phur bu bcus skor bar bshad pa ni bya rgyud 'ga' zhig 'chugs par snang bas bla med la dgos par ma mthong ngo / /dbang sga thab tu dgug pa dang / drag po'i thab tu bsad bskad dbye ba rmongs rengs la sobs pa go thams cad bya la/ spel tshig dang sgrub bya la dmigs pa'i ting nge 'dzin so sos 'grub par mdo ster byung ba bzhin bla ma gong ma dag kyang bzhed la/ gong mas sam+bu ṭi'i rgyud phyi ma'i don du mdzad nas/rgyas thab gru bzhi pa khra do pa'i dbus su zhi ba'i zlum po khra gang / de'i nang gru gsum du bcad pa ni drag po dang / bcad mtshams zla gam gsum po dbang ste/ las so so'i kha dog sogs byas pas las thams cad 'grub par bshad la/ rgyud rdo rje mkha' 'gro las/rmong na yid ni gang dga' bar / rā/ gang zlum po kha khyer bcas/ /pad+ma rgyas pa lta bu yi/ /kha khyer sor bzhi'i tshad tsam gli /kha ni pad+ma rgyas pa 'dra/ /zhes sogs kyi zhi ba'i thab nyid kyi dbus dang kha khyer gyi mtshan ma las so so bzhin du rje ba'am/ mdo snyer rang gi lhag pa'i lha'i sdug mtshan du byas pas las tham/sa cad par 'gyur bar bshad la/ grub na thams cad la grus pa 'am brtsigs pa'i thab bya zhing / ma grub na bri bar bya ste/ bris pa la ni dpangs rnams bsgom par bya ba tsam du zad do/ /bud shing kun la dgon pa'i shing / /zhes pa ni/ bad shing dang yam shing so sor phye ba'i bud shing ste/ thams cad la grong las rgyang grags kyi 'phags pa'i ri'i ljongs kyi gci ba smam po srog chags med cing gtsang ba ste 'i ba la ni yam shing gzhin med na 'di ning kyi

ra༅༅/ /rung ba mdo snye rjes 'brangs dang bcas pa bzhed par mngon la/ las gzhan yam shing 'di las gzhan pa nges par dgos shing / yam shing gis 'dang na ni bud shing yang mi dgos te/ bud shing ni dang por brtsig pa'i shing ngam phyis snon pa'i shing 'bul sngags la sogs pa med par rtsig pa la bya ste/ zhi ba la thab las rgya dpang cung zad chung ba dang / rgyas pa la mnyam po dang / dbang drag la ji ltar rnyed pa'o/ /yam shing 'o ma can gyi rtse/ /dri zhim dkar gsum sbags pa ni/ /mthe chung dang mnyam mtho gang tshad/ /'bras bu can gyi sked pa'i cha/ /ro mngar mngar gsum sbags pa ni/ /lag ngar dang mnyam khra gang tshad/ /me tog dmar pos rgyan pa skyur/ /pho mo'i dri chur snyugs pa dang / /dug tsher can gyis rtsa ba'i cha/ /khyi brun dug khrag sgra spu bsres/ /sor brgyad pa dang sor bcu pa/ /sbom phra ji ltar 'tshams pa ste/ /dang po gsum po drang zhing mthos/ /tha ma skur skyog dri ro nga / /zhes pa ste/ zhi ba la ni/ a shat+tha dang u du'i ra dang / pa la sha dang slak+ṣa la sogs pa ste/ bod na ba lu dang lcags skya la sogs pa 'o ma can gyi rtse mo'i cha las skyes pa lo ma gnyis dang ldan pa rlan dang bcas pa mnyam por bcad pa'o/ /rgyas pa'ang de rnams sam 'bras bu can gyi sked pa'i cha la skyes pa khu tshur dang chang ba'i tshad tsam ces bshad kyang lag ngar phra sa tsam mo/ /dbang la tsam pa ka dang / nā ga ge sar dang / a sho ka la sogs pa me tog dmar po can ro skyar ba ste/ bod na kham bu la zhi rgyas dbang gsum mas rung ngo / /drag po la nispa

dang seng ldeng dang myos byed sogs te bod na skyer pa dang skyi bar grags pa sogs kyi rtsa ba'am/ ro bsregs pa'i 'gal dum dang / bong bu dang rnga mo'i rbang la sogs pa rnams la dgra'i rkang rjes kyi sa dang bshang gci dang / yung mar dang / latsho dang / ke tshe dang / khyim bya'i tshil bu sogs kyang bsre bar bya'o/ /las phyi ma gnyis kyi shing tshad ni a bha yas bshad la/ dbang la zhi ba dang mnyam par sa lugs pa dag bzhed do/ /las 'jam po gsum la drang shing mdzes la tshad ldan dgos par ni/ rnying lci phra dang skyon po dang / /ring thung lo ma med pa dang / /srog chags kyis zos rul pa dang / khun bral chag dang bu ga can/ /rtse mo gnyis ldan sbom po spangs/ /zhes dang / ter dmigs ni/ rnying pa yis/ ni 'chi bar 'gyur/ /skyog pos bskal ba ngan par 'gyur/ /ring thung 'phral du rig pa nyams/ /lo ma med pas na tsha 'byung / /sbom pos phun sum tshogs pa nyams/ /sgam pos gzhan yang mi 'dod 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /drag po la ni/ drag po'i rdzas la dgra'i gzugs brnyan bya ste/ rkang pa g.yon pa nas rim gyis bcad pa yam shing dang bsre bar yang bshad do/ /me ni bram ze'i rgyun zhag gam/ /'o ma can gnyis btsubs pa'i me/ /nags che' tshig gam rgyal rigs me/ /smad 'tshong khyim mam rje rigs me/ /dur khrod me 'am gdol pa'i me/ /zhes te/ zhi ba la dgon pa'i me dang / rgyas pa la me shel las byung ba dang dge 'dun gyi tshang bang las byung ba dang / dbang la me tog dmar po'i shing btsubs pa dang / sprang rngo/sa lam du

ra༅༅/ /bus pa/ drag po la rngo dang lcags brdabs pa las byang ba rnams kyang bshad la gtso bor ni rtsa ba'i go rim bzhin no/ /me lha rgyud gzhan rnams su/ zhal gcig phyag bzhir bshad na yang / bla med phal cher zhal gsum dang phyag drug par bshad/ dang po gnyis/ /rang snang rigs 'khyud g.yas pa gasnyes/ /phreng ba mi 'jigs g.yon pa gnyis/ /ril ba dbyu gu 'dzin pa ste/ /sbom thung bsus 'phyang ral pa dang / /zhog tshoms 'bar shing rgyan gos ldan/ /zhi dkar zhal 'dzum cung zad gdangs/ /rgyas ser bzhad cing de las gdangs/ /dbang dmar chags shing 'dzum bag 'gying / /drag nag khros 'khrags khams gsum za/ /rim bzhin sa chu me dang rlang / /dkyil 'khor bzhi la gnas par bshad / /ces pa/ rgyu sde 'og ma gsum dang dus 'khor zhal gcig phyag bzhi par bshad pa bzhin/ bod snga ma 'ga' zhig gis bla med spyi la yang sgyur mod kyi/ 'grel pa rnams dang mdo snye sogs su lji skad bshad pa bzhin 'byang ba ni legs te / gsang 'dus rtsa rgyud las/ sngags kyi skyes bu thams cad ni/ /rdo rje gsum gyi ye shes rdzogs/ /dbang po gnyis kyi sbyor ba yis/ /dngos po thams cad brtag par bya/ /zhes 'byung bas so/ /sngags ni zhi sogs 'dodarmi 'i tshig /so so'i 'jug tu swā hā dang / /e dang hoḥ dang dzaḥ dang ni/ khā+e+o hū+oṃ phaṭa ni sbyar bar bya/ /zhes pa/ sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad shān+ti ku ru swā hā/ tshe dang blo gros dang dpal sbyor thams cad puṣ+ṭi ku ru e/ rgyal po dang lha la sogs pa wa shaṃ ku ru

ho'am/ ā dar+ṣa ya dzaḥ zhes pa dbang gi dgug pa la'o/ /drag po'i rmongs rengs la che ge mo'i sems mo ha ya dang / lus stam+bha ya hūṃ hūṃ/ bsad bskrad la ma ra ya dang / āts+tsha ya phaṭa/ ces sogs skabs dang sbyar ba bya zhing shes na/ rgya skad du bya'o/ /mdog ni thab dang bsreg rdzas sogs/ lta/na la dkar por dmar nag me/ /zhes pa las bzhi la rim pa bzhin te/ dkar rtsi dang / gur gum dang / bin du dang / sol ba lta bus so/ /gnyis pa ni/ gzhan ni rnal 'byor rngor dril dang / /dgang blugs bsreg rdzas mchod rdzas sogs/ /zhes smras te/ rnal 'byor ni/ mdun bskyed sgrub mchod dang ma 'brel na thab khung gi sa brtag blang sbyang ba sogs kyi sa chog dang / sung 'khor dang bcas pa'i bdag bskyed rgyas bsdus gang rung dang / 'brel na me tog gis lha thab tu spyan drang ba dang / gnyis ka la bsreg rdzas mchod rdzas dang thab dang yo byad bsham pa dang / 'dug nas rdor dril gzung ba dang / yo byad byirno gyis brlab pa dang / me blangs te sbor ba dang / thab dang me dang me lha bskyed pa dang / ye shes pa spyan drangs te chu bzhis mchod nas gzhug cing mnyes par bya ba dang / lce dang dgang gzar gyis kha byin gyis brlabs nas byon zan nam bsreg blugs 'bul ba dang / chu bzhi nyer spyod kyis mchod nas bsreg rdzas rdzogs par 'bul ba dang / me lha me 'bar ba'i rnam par bsgrar ba'am/ thab kyi me mtshams kyi kha khyer la bzhag ste me nang du'am/ yang na me lha nyid kyi thugs mar yang rung ste 'das pa dkyil 'bor dang ma 'brel na gsar

ra༅༅/ /du bskyed pa'am 'brel na spyan drangs nas gsal gdab pa gang rung gi sgrub pa la me lha bzhin du byas te rdzogs nas slar yang mchod bstod sor rtsi na bza' phul nas bzod gsol gsol gdab byas te gshegs su gsol nas / 'jug me lha thab tu spyan drangs pa'am gsal gdab pa la'ang de bzhin du byed pa rnams kyi gzhung shing la/ las bzhi khyad par med do/ /gong ma'i phyag len gyi khyad par la sa lugs pa dag me lha'i bsreg blugs kyi 'jug tu ku sha 'bul / gzhan me sbar ma thag tu 'bul/ kha cig 'das pa la bsreg blugs 'bul ba'i sngags rang rang gi gtso bo'i sngags kyis byed/ kha cig me lha'i sngags kyis byed/ kha cig gnyis mas byed do/ /bsreg rdzas rgya gzhung phal cher las / yam shing gi 'jug tu/ mar dang til dang zho zan dang / snga lu dang 'bru rnams zhes sogs mdor bsdus ma gtogs gsal po ma byung yang / rgyud sdom 'byung du/ mar gyi 'byor pa thams cad byed/ /yam shing gzi brjid rnam par 'phel / /bud shing lhag par rdepa' bar byed/ /ku shas thams cad bsrang bar byed/ /yung mar gyis bgegs zhi bar byed/ /'bras kyis rgyas par byed par bshad/ /til gyis sdig pa 'joms rig bya/ /so bas nor dang 'bru rnams 'gugs/ /sran mas stobs ni chen por byed/ /nas kyis rlung gi shugasaji ba ster/ /dur bas tshe ni 'phel bar byed/ /gro yis nad ni 'joms par byed/ /'o ma sbrang rtsis shes rab 'phel/ /zas mchog gis ni bde kun ster/ /mes ni 'dod

don dngos grub ster/ /rang 'dod lhas ni grol ba stsol/ /lhag mas las ni rjes mthun par/ /zhi sogs las byas shes par bya/ /zhes 'byang zhing / go rim kyang bod snga mas rgyud tshig gi rim pa bzhin byas pa'ang snang mod kyi/ mdo snyer / shing / mar/ til/ dur ba/ 'bras ma grugs pa/ zho zan/ ku sha/ yungs mar/ so ba/ nas/ sran ma/ gro/ me tog dang zlobras sna tshogs bshad pa bod phyi ma dag gi phyag len la yod pa bzhin bya'o/ /rgyud rgya gzhung kun tu mchod rdzas bsreg rdzas rang rang gi sngags kyis brgya rtsa brgyad du byin gyis brlab par bshad pa sha stag snang yang / da lta 'bul ba'i tshe brjod par byed de/ gzhin rnams des 'grub kyang chu bzhi'i byin rlabs sogs la sngags nyung ba'i skyon yod do/ /chu bzhi yang dgang blugs kyi sngon du ye shes pa dang / de bcug tshar ba'i yan lag bzhi rdzogs gnyis ka la bzhi ka 'bul bar mthun la/ 'jug tu mchod yon rkyang pa/'am/ zhabs sil med pa'i gsum 'bul ba shas che ba'i go rim kyang 'byung rmod kyi / bsang gtor thog mar 'bul ba skabs dang 'brel lo/ /de dag ni las bzhi spyi'i thun mong yin la/ dgos kyi thun mong ni/ 'jam po gsum la bsreg rdzas g.yas/ /mchod rdzas spre'am mchod yon g.yon/ /lag gnyis spus mo'i nang du gnas /drag po re las zlog par bshad/ /ces pa sam+bu ṭi las/ bsreg sngas rngams ni g.yas su bzhig /chu ba'i'i snod ni g.yon du ste/ /mar gyi snod sna mdun du 'o/ /zhes dang / gru mo spus mo'i bar bcug ste/ /blugs gzar gyis ni

ra༅༅/ /mar bcus te/ /dgang gzar byas nas bsreg par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ mdo snye sogs nas kyang bshad pas/ me tog la sogs pa g.yas g.yon mi gsal zhing / yo gar bsreg rdzas kyi khrod du 'jog pa ra bshad mod 7 bla ma snga phyi phal cher g.yon du shom pa bzhin bya la/ drag po la ni thams cad zlog par bya'o/ /dgang blugs 'dzin pa'i khu tshur ni/ byang chub mchog dang nor bu dang / /pad+ma mkha' 'gro'i khu tshur ro/ /zhes pa shrī ya sa muts+tshar/ zhi rgyas la sogs las rnams la/ /byang chub mchog dang nor bu dang / /pad+ma mkha' 'gro'i khu tshur bzhis/ /dgang gzar blugs gzar gzung ba bstan/ /zhes 'byung ste rim pa bzhin/ rdo rje bsdams pa las mdzub mo gnyis dang / gung mo gnyis dang / mthe chung ma gtogs pa gzhan gsum dang / mdzub mo'ang mthe'u chung rnams brkyang pa'o/ /gzung bya dgang blugs kyi rgyu ni/ gser dngul zangs lcags sogs rin po che'am/ mchod sbyin gyi shing rnams so/ /tshad ni gdan bzhi'i rgyud rgyas pa las/ yu ba khra do pa dang dgang gzar gyi mgo la khra gang pa'ang bshad ces rje btsun gong mas bshad kyang / rgyud dang rgya gzhung kun tu yu ba khra gang pa mgo bo mtho gang pa nyid bshad cing / dus 'khor dbang ler khra gang nang la sbyar ba'i tshad nges gad pa dang sbyajo nas/ de gakho yu ba khru re'i tshadami/ /mgo bor sor bzhi sor gokho pa/ /gru bzhi pad+ma'i stobs ༅ te/ /rang rang phyed de rābs su bru/ /lte bar rdo rje rtse lngas mas/ /nor bu rdo rjes spras pa ni/༄ /chu srin kha

nas dbyung zhing mdzes/ /yu ba'i mthar yang rdo rjes brgyan/ /zhes pa gnyis ma'i thun mong ste/ yu ba'i sbom du tshang par gzung du rung ba/ dgang gzar gyi mgo bo sor bzhi pa gru bzhi dang / blugs gzar gyi sor gnyis pa pad 'dab bam ba'i mig gi dbyibs can/ zabs su sor gnyis dang gcig pa/ gnyis ma'i lte bar rdo rjes mtshan pa/ yu ba phyogs su rdo rje dang nor bu gnyis ga'am gang rung sor bzhi dang gnyes pa chu srin gyi kha nas byang pa/ yu ba'i mthar yang rngo rjes mtshan pa'o/ /khyad par du dgang gzar la ni kha khyer la rdo rje'i phreng bas skor ba dang / rtse mor rdo rje rtse gsum pa'i/ /dbus rwa bug par khu bcud 'dzag /las rnams kun la dbye de gsungs/ /ces pa go sh+lau la/ de ltar bsdoms pa dgang gzar gyi mgo la sor bcu gnyis 'byang ba yin no/ /'di dag ni las bzhi ma'i thun mong du gsungs pas dbye byed du byas pas chog la/ las so so la cis kyang 'byed na lte ba'i ma mas dbye/ zhes pa thab kyi dbus dang kha khyer gyi mtshan ma ji bzhin las so so dang las thams cad kā la bla ma dag gis mdzad do/ /'di dag ni bakhong bor bla med la sbyar ba ste/ nang gi rnal 'byor khyad par ba dang / rdzas rnams la yang nang mchod byin gyis brlabs pas bran pa sal che la/ cho ga gzhan kun thun mong nyid / bskyed chos phyas rgya ba'is btab sosas/ /cung zad bsnar pas ba'i rka 'grub/ /ces pa/ bya spyong sbyir sres rnam snang mngotsha byang sogs ras 'byung ba lo cher bi+os bsdus pa la/ yang / cho sa phal cher 'ji bachin du yong pas thu rlo+o/nga du

ra༅༅/ /khas blangs la/ khyad par rgyud sde rang rang gi gnas dang yo byad dang lha bsang ba dang / bcing ba dang / rang rang gi bskyed chog dang / yo ga la phyag rgya bzhis btab khyad par ba byed tshul dang / me lha yum med pa'i phyag gnyis pa'am bzhi par byed pa sogs sbyar bas rgyud sde bzhi ma'i sbyin sreg gi rnam bzhag ni 'grub la/ 'di na rang rang gi rnal 'byor shes na 'don pa spos pas 'grub pa'i phyir 'dir mi spro'o/ /de bzhin du rtsa tshig gis dngos su ma bsdus pa / mchod yon sogs kyi snod kyang / las gsum la 6kho dang gser dngul zangs shing rdo rnams dang / drag po la rdza dang thod pa la sogs par sngags rnams kyi mjug tu swā hā dang / e sogs sngar bshad pa rnams sbyar te bzlas nas bsham pa dang / me ltas brtag tshul sam bu ṭi dang sdom 'byung nas rgyas par gsungs pa mdo snye sogs su bsngas pa ni/ 'od zer dang bcas g.yas su 'khor/ snum zhing dri zhim du ba med/ /gser dngul byi ru 'ja' tshon mdog /gdugs dang rgyal mtshan bum pa nya/ /dpal be'u pad+ma rnga yab dang / /ral gri rin chen rdo rje dung / /pad+ma dgang blugs rtse gsum dbyibs/ /rnga sgra pi wang snyan pa'i sgra/ /kha dog las bzhi rang rang mdog /me yi rtse mo gcig gnyis gsum/ /rab 'bring tha mar rim bzhin bshad/ /'bar dka' me lce 'chad pa dang / khub nag pa la sha yi mdog /me stag 'phro dang drag po'i sgra/ /dri nga de ltar mi dge'i ltas/ /drag po'i las la shis pa 'o/ /zhes par 'dus te rgyas par rgyud dang de rnams su blta'o/ /de

ltar mi shes na bgegs sbyangs ba'i sngags dang bsam gtan la sogs pa byas te bya'o/ /rgyud sde spyi'i sbyin sreg sgi rnam bzhag bshad pa'o// snye //gnyis pa dus 'khor 'dir bshad pa la las so so ba dang / thams cad pa'o/ /dang po rne / rgyad 'dir phyin las rgyas par phye na drug cu rtsa bzhi dang / 'bring du bsdu na las chen bcu gnyis dang / bsdu na brgyad de/ brgyad ni/ zhi rgyas gnyis/ dbang dgug gnyis/ rmongs rengs gnyis/ bsad bskrad gnyis so/ /'di rnams phyogs jim pa bzhin byang dang / lho dang / nub dang / shar du bya bar gsungs pa la sa kyi khams kyang phyogs de rnams dang mthun no/ /de yang snga ma snga ma rnams rang rang gi phyogs de'i mtshams ngang phyi ma phyi ma rnams rang rang gi phyogs nyid du bya ba yin no/ /bcu gnyis su 'byed na/ zhi rgyas gzhil gsum/ dbang dgug bskyed gsum/ rmongs rengs gdab gsum/ bsad bskrad dbye gnyis zhes bya la/ gzhil ba ni rims de nyid du zhi bar byed pa dang / bskyed pa ni rims gnas sam gang zag gzhan la dpes gtong ba'o/ /gdab pa ni phur bus gdab pa dang / dbye ba ni mdza' bo 'byed pa ste/ snga ma bzhi'am drug 'jam po dang / phyi ma bzhi'am drug drag po'o/ /des na/ 'dir bshad la/sa chen bcu bzhi po/ /brgyad du bsdus nas phyogs dus sogs/ /so so ba dang / tshes smra ste/ dbang le'i mdor bsdus dang po dang / ba'i pa gnyis legs par bsgrigs nas shes dgos la/ rgyas par byas na yi be mang par 'gyur bas gzhin lugs kyi 'dod pa phyin ci log dgag

ra༅༅/ /pa'i spros pa dor nas rang 'dod mdor bsdus te go sla bar brjod na/ phyogs sogs sngar bzhin las/ phyogs ni bshad ma thag pa ste/ rims gzhil ba sogs phyi ma bzhi yang rgyas pa sogs kyi gnas te phyogs rnams su bya la/ de yang dkyil 'khor dang 'brel na gtso bo zhal gang du gzigs pa la shar du byas pa'i phyogs de dang der bya zhing / rgyal po'i grong khyer chen po'i phyogs mtshams brgyad na dur khrod yod pas gang du yang zhi rgyas mi rung bas na/ nang ge rgyal po'i pho brang dngos kyi phyogs de rnams su dang / dur khrod med pa'i grong spyi'i phyi rol gyi de rnams su'o/ /dus ni brgyad po rgyud 'grel du byang nas g.yas skor du bshad pa ltar/ nyin zhag la thun brgyad du byas nas nyin gyi bzhi la rim pa bzhin zhi rgyas dang bsad bskrad/ mtshan gyi bzhi la dbang dgug rmongs rengs/ stan gcig la de tsam bya bar mi nus na nyin mtshan gnyis ka la thun brgyad brgyad du byas te nyin la brgyad rim /zhin sbyar ba dang mtshan la yang de bzhin du sbyar bar bya yi/ nyin phyed ma phyed dang nam langs ka dang sa srod mtshams te thun mtshams bzhi dang dus me la sogs pa'i gza' gdug pa dang dus sbyor gdug pa can 'char ba'i dus ni zhi rgyas la spangs par dngos su gsungs pa ltar 'jam po kun la yang spangs te drag las la shes par gsungs pas so/ /chas dgos kyang / zhi rgyas/ bsad bskrad/ dbang dgug rmongs rengs/ de rnams kyi phyogs dus kyi nges pa khams nges pa lta ra dkar nag dmar ser rnams te/ thabs la segos pa'i kha dog dang me

lha'i mdog dang / mdun bskyed kyi 'od zer rnams kyang de nyid do/ /bsam pa yang spyi 'gro dang 'dra bar sgrub ler gsungs so/ /'dug stangs ni brgyad po rim pa bzhin/ rkang pa g.yon pa bskum pa'i spus mo'i steng du g.yas pa gan rkyal du bzhag pa skyil krung dang / phan tshun gyi brla'i steng du gan rkyal du bzhag pa rdo rje'i gdan dang / spus mo g.yon gya steng du g.yas bzhag cing rkang mgo yang de bzhin dang zlog pa'ang rung ba lha min gyi gdan dang / rkang pa gnyis bzhibs pa'i rting par 'phong tshos su bzhag cing brla dang byin pa steng du langs pa'i tsog pu dang / g.yon skyil krung dang g.yas tsog pu dang / de las zlog pa dang / g.yon gyi ting par bshang lam bzhag cing ga yas tsog pu dang / de las zlog pa rnams so/ /thab ni zla ba'i rang bzhin zlum po khra gang pa dang / zla ba nyis 'gyur gyi rang bzhin gru bzhi khra do pa dang / sgra gcan ni rlung gi rang bzhin zla gam zur gnyis pa dang / rlung me gnyis ma'i rang bzhin zur lnga pa gnyis sor bcu gnyis pa dang nyer bzhi pa/ me'i rang bzhin zur gsum dro dang / me sa gnyis ma'i rang bzhin zur bdun pa gnyirā sor nyi shu pa dang bzhi bcu pa/ rlung dang sa'i rang bzhin zur drug pa dang / sa dang ri rab kyi rang bzhin zur brgyad pa gnyis sor sum bcu pa dang drug cu pa ste phyogs rngams rang rang li mtshams las nyis 'gyur du gyur pa ni/ 'dir mtshams thabs dang / phyogs shes rab tu byas la 'di ni bsam pas bzhag cing / gzhan kha khyer du zlog pa ni lus kyi dbang gis so/ /rang rang bi phyed sna zabs kyi tshad

ra༅༅/ /dang / mchu dang mtshan ma'i phreng ba'am re kha ni bcu gnyis cha dang / kha khyer ni drug cha dang / kha 'phyang ni de dang mnyam pa ste/ rang rang gi nang du shong ba'i zlum skor la pad+ma 'dab brgyad bya bar ni khyad med la/ khyad par ni/ mtshan ma dang kha khyer gyi phyi rol kha 'phyang dang / de'i mthar yang dgram bya'i rdzas kyis 'byed cing / mtshan ma ni pad+ma'i lte bar gang bgod pa de kha khyer gyi dbus kyi lnga gsum la'ang phreng bar bya bar gsungs pa ste/ de ltar na mtshan ma ni rim pa bzhin pad+ma dang 'khor lo dang / gri gug dang / ral gri dang / mda' dang / lcags kyu dang / sprul dang / lcags bsgrog rnams so/ /kha 'phyang ni/ zhi rgyas la pad 'dab/ bsad pa la mi lag gi phreng ba/ bskrad pa la bya rog gi sgro / dbang du dgug la pad+ma dmar po/ rmongs rengs la arka'i 'dab ma'o/ /rdzas dgod bya zhing / zhi rgyas la dur ba rtse mo sngon po thab kyi shar du bstan pa'i mjug ma rtse mo gzhan gyis bkris ste 'khor ba/ bsad pa la mo'i skra/ bskad pa 'byung po'i shing lo/ dbang dgug la me tog dmar po/ rmongs rengs la me tog ser po'o/ /'dir kha cig re kha'i phreng ba las thams cad pa la yin gyi so so ba 'di la bshad zer mod/ mdor bsdus dang por mtshan ma'i phreng ba mchu dang mnyam par bshad pa de so so ba'i skabs yin pa dang / de dang mchu bsdoms pas kha khyer dang mnyam pa ni gsang sngags spyi 'gro dang mthun no/ /brgyad po thams cad kyi phyi rol du khru do dor bar 'jam po rnam sa la nang nas bskyed rim dang drag po la zlog pa'i ra

ba'am rtsig pa gsum dang / rang rang gi nub phyogs su sgo gcig pa rta babs dang bcas pa skabs 'di dag tu bshad cing / nang ler sgo bzhi pa'ang bshad do/ /rtsig pa'i nang gis khra gnyis po'i sa la khro bo bcu'i mtshan ma dang / slob dpon dang / mchod rdzas dang / bsreg rdzas rnams kyi gdan thab kyi lte ba'i dbyebs dang tshad dang mtshan ma rnams ji bzhin byas la/ 'on kyang thab kyi pad+ma'i 'dab ma la ni rigs bzhi yu ma bsna'i phyag mtshan dgod cing / 'di gsum la dbus kyi mtshan ma baṇig pus chog go /gdan 'di dag zhi ba la lho nub dang / rgyas pa la lho ru dang / bsad pa la rlung du dang / bskrad dbye la nub tu dgod pa sogs rang rang gi phyogs kyi zlog phyogs su 'god par bshad pa ni/ kha cig 'jig rten spyi 'gro'i dbang du byas nas bshad pas ma 'grig pa shin tu mang la/ me lha dang slob dpon mdun spad du nges pas/ mdun bsked dang 'brel/ ba'i tshe zhi rgyas kyi dkyil 'khor gyi byang du thab byas/ sgo dkyil 'khor phyogs la bstan/ me lha de la rgyab bstan pas 'jig rten spyi'i byang la zhal bstan pa'ang yong srid cing ma byang na yang / slob dpon snyed dkyil 'khor gyi byang la ṅge bstan pa nges par yong zhing des skabs don yang 'grub pa sogs yin pas na mdun bskyed dang 'brel ba'i tshe thab kyi gtso bo me lha yin pas de'i zhil gang du bstan pa'i phyogs de/ mdor na rlob kyi shar phyogs kho nar sgodan tshams bya zhing / ma 'brel na grong bi byang shar du 'i ba'i thab byas te/ 'jig rten spyi la bltos pa'i sangan yong pa byang ra du 'byung 'ing sa na la'ang nge

༄༄༄/ /bzhin du sbyar bas bde blag tu 'grub pa yin no/ 'ang ni zhi rgyas la ā/ dusba ra a shatho dang n+ya gro d+ngha dang / sarka ṭi dang / dgun 'bram gyi ste 'o ma can no/ /bsad pa la ni mi rus mthe'u chung gi dbyebs can no/ /dbye bskrad la bya rog gi mjug ma'o/ /dbang la seng ldeng / dgug pa la stsa la sha rmongs pa la smyo byed/ rengs pa rnyi bel ba rnams las r+sās pa ste zhi rgyas kyi dpa / 'di bzhi sbom phra rim pa bzhin/ mthe'u chung nas mthe bong gi bar te/ ring thung mi rus ni mthe'u chung gi tshad dang gzhan thams cad sor bcu gnyis pa'o/ /rdzas kyang zhi ba la 'o ma durba til/ rgyas pa la mar dang 'bra lngaste/ bsad pa la dug dang mi'i sha khrag bskad dbye la ke tshe dang lañtsha zhag dbang la ka ra bi ra'i sogs me tog dmar po dang rngul/ dgug pa la bel ba'i 'bra 'dab dang gcin/ rengs pa la phreng ba rnying pa dang 'chil ma/ rmongs pa la dado tse ranā me tog dang chang rnams lhan cig ste/ yam shing sogs rdzas thams cad lnga brgya bzhi bcu ni 'das pa la dgos pas 'jig rten pa'i dang bcas pa'o/ /me ni t+t+waṃ rgyas sogs te tshan bzhi la rim pa bzhin bram ze dang / gdol pa'am dmangs rigs dang / rgyal rigs dang rje'u rigs kyi khyim nas blang pa'o/ /lha ni zhi rgyas la dkar po snang mtha'i dbu rgyan can / g.yas pad+ma dang shel phreng / g.yon ril ba dang dung 'dzin pa dang / g.ya sa 'khor lo dang mu tig rgi phreng ba/ ga yon pad+ma dang spyi blugs 'dzin pa'o/ /bsad bskad la nag po gos dang bcas pa don grub kyi dbu rgyan/ g.yas gri gug dang

rtse gsum/ g.yon thod pa dang kha ṭaṃ ka 'dzin pa dang / g.yon de bzhin la g.yas ral gri dang rtse gsum 'dzin pa'o/ /dbang dgug la dmar po rin 'byang gi dbu rgyan can g.yas mda' dang rin po che/ g.yon gzhu dang me long 'dzin pa dang / g.yas lcags kyu dang rin oṃ che/ g.yon zhags pa dang me long 'dzin pa'o/ /rmongs rengs la ser po rnam snang gi dbu rgyan can/ g.yas sbal dang dbyag pa/ g.yon 'alor lo dang tho ba 'dzin pa dang / g.yas lcags bsgros dang tho ba / g.yon 'khor lo dang phur pa 'dzin pa/ thams cad ral pa ser skya dang / gos dmar ser dkar nag dmar ser bzhi po chu rlung me sa'i dkyil 'char la garnom shing yi ge 'a/sa byang pa sa zhi khro chags 'gying rgi nyams can dubazhed la/ ra la zhon pa dang lus tsho ba sogs kyang gzhan nas kha skang / de lta bu'i dam tshig pa me'i nang dang rang gi snying ga gnyis shar du bskyed/ snying sa'i de ye shes pa'i tshul du snyim/ slar yang yeca shes pa spyan 'dren pa sogs zhi rgyas la sbyor ba ji bzhin kun la 'dra bar bya dgos te/ sngags ni dkyil 'khor gyi mchod sngags las so so la na maḥ la sogs pa'i mtha' so sor nges pa yod kyang / me mchod pa'i sngags thams cad swā hā'i mtha' can du gsungs pa ltar spel tshig gi mtha'i sngags kyang sbyin sreg li sabs su las thams cad la swā hā'i mtha' can du byed pa mngor bsdus ba'i pa'i rgyud 'grel gyi dasongs pa yin no/ /mngos ni brjong zir no/ /ma/chong pa'i snong ri brgyang po richa/ bzhin sne'/ ngangu'o/ thod lcasas/ gse ra zangs shing sa rnam sa la sa byas

༄༄༄/ /pa sor bcu gnyis pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi dbyibs can mchod rdzas kyang 'byor na so so'i rgyud las gsu ngas pa bzhin med na'ang mos pas 'grub bo/ /dgang blugs kya yu ba snyang ga nas gsang ba' dang /mdzod spu nas snying gzhi dbu ma dag pas khra re dang /mgo bo lag mthil dang mnyam pa sor drug pa dang /rtse mo rdo rje rtsegasum pa'i dbus ma la bu ga bshad do/ /gnyis pa ni/lam po rnams las kun pa zhes bsdus nas gsungs/zhes smras te/'di la kha cig las brgyad ka 'dir (r+shad pa'i las thams cad pa'i thab tu byar rung bar 'dod pa yod kyang / zhi rgyas kyi thab zlum po khra do dang khra bzhi gru bzhi gnyis las ni ma gsungs la/ zhi rgyas kyi thab tu drag las byed pa'ang skabs kyi tshul dang mi mthun zhing / 'di'i mdor bsdus dang por/las thams cad pa'i sgras ni zhi ba la sogs pa dang dbang la sogs pa'i las drag r+yā bsad/ la sogs pa dang phur bus gdab pa la sogs pa drug ni ma yin no zhes gsal bar bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /des na 'jam po drug po thab 'di gnyis su sbyar rung ba yin no/ /las so so ba'i zhi rgyas dang 'di gnyis kyi khyad par ni/'di nyes 'gyur gyi che ba dang /thab dngos kyi nang gi phyed la gtso tsho pad+ma ljang gu bder gshegs 'phar ma dang bawo pa ste zlum po la de rnams kyang zlum por bya zhing de dag la dgos pa'i mtshan ma bum pa sogs kyang chul 'khor ji bzhin bya ba dang / de nas dpang r+ṣa dpang chung lha snam lha rnams la ma' ma dgod pa yang don gyi thopa la/ de nas mchu dang ro kha dang ba rdzi
