'phyang rnams thab rang rang gi bcu gnyis cha gnyis dang drug cha gnyis su byed pa sngar bzhin byas pas kha khyer tshun gyi rtsig pa nas mda' yab kyi bar gyi tshad 'gro ba dang / kha 'phyang gi mtha' nas khra do bor bar rwa ba gsum pa nub kyi sgo rta babs dang bcas pa rnams snga ma bzhin du gsungs so/ /las 'jam po so so ba dang thams cad pa kun la bsreg rdzas g.yas dang mchod rdzas g.yon du bsham pa dang / drag po la de las zlog pa ni gsal dror gsungs so/ /las thams cad pa gnyis ma'i dbus kyi pad+ma ljang rgu dang de'i lte bar gtso bo'i sna tshogs rdo rje dang yum gyi chos 'byung gdam khar shong 'gyur las 'byung zhing / 'gyur gzhan las chos 'byung gi dbus su rdo rje 'god pa'ang bshad de/ sna tshogs rdo rje ni ljang gu'am sngon po rtse lnga pa la zer gyi rgya gram mi dgos so/ /lha ljang gu mi bskyod pa'i cod pan can g.yas gnyis rdo rje dang bgrang phreng / g.yon gnyis dril bu dang pad+ma 'dzin pa nam mkha'i sogs so/ /rgyas pa la gdan gsum khra do pa ste gzhan snga ma bzhin no/ /de ltar sbyin sreg byas pa'i dgos pa ni bden pa bzhi pa ye shes kyi me kun tu dga' ba'i chos sam/ ye shes me lce 'od rab gsal/ /zhes pa rang byang lhan skyes kyi me de nyid mngon du bya ba'i phyir du yin te spyir me ni rgosum ste/ lho'i me glog dang / khyim bdag gi me nyi ma dang / mchod sbyin gyi me sha za ste/ phung po thams cad bsregs nas za bar byed pa 'od gsal lo/ /'di la 'dod pa'i 〉'am 'dod pa'i lha zhes kyang bshad la/ nges don ye shes dang / drang don dkyil 'khor pa'i lha'o/ /nyi ma ni

ra༅༅/ /'dir kun rdzob pa'i sbyin sreg gi me lha'i gtso bo yin te/ rta bdun la gnas pa gza' bdun gyi bdag po lce bdun dang ldan pa'i phyir te/ zhi ba la zla ba'i lce/ rgyas pa la nyi ma/ bsad bskad dbye ba la spen pa/ dbang la pa sangs/ dgug pa la phur pa/ rmongs rengs la gza' lhag dang bkra shis kyi lce dang ldan pa gza' re re dag pas zhal gcig nyin mtshan dag pas zhabs gnyis/ thun mtsha mas bzhi dag pas phyag bzhi pa'o/ /bsad pa la mjug ring dag pas gri thod 'dzin pa'i phyag gnyis pa dang / dbye ba la spen pa dag pas ral gri dang thod7pa 'dzin pa'i phyag gnyis pa'ang phyogs gzhan la brten par bshad cing / las thams cad nga la/ zhi rgyas grangs bzhin du dus me dang sgra gcan rnam par das ste 'jog pa dang skye ba'i chos can nyid kyi phyir ro/ /zhes gsungs la gzhan dang rgyud rnams su bsnyen pa'i kha skong dang / cho ga'i lhag chad bso ba la sbyin sreg nges par dgos pa ཿ snang / de med na dngos grub mi 'grub par gsungs pas na 'di la nan tan du bya dgos so/ /'dir de ltar me gsum bshad pa'i mchod sbyin nam 'dod pa'i me rang gi lhar bshad pa tsam ma gtogs 'jig rten las 'das pa'i me lha bskyed chog sob/sa dngos su ma bshad pas 'khral nas/ kha cig thab tu bskyed pa mchod sbyin gyi dang / snying khar bskyed pa 'dod pa'i dang / phyi nas spyan drang ba khyim gyi me ste de gsum dbye byed du byas pa dus 'khor rgyud 'grel dang mthun pa'i sbyin sreg yin gyi sme lha 'das ma 'das lan gnyisarū da pa rgyud sde gzhan gyi rgyas bkab

yin no/ /zhes zer ro/ /mi lad de/rnal 'byor dang rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud thams cad la sngags pas shes par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pas gzhan nas kha skong dgos par bstan pa'i phyir dang /mchod sbyin gyi me dang 'dod pa'i me gnyis gcig tu gsung nas de la slar yang sngar gyi khyim gyi me la phul ba'i mchod pa dang bsreg rdzas thams cad 'bul bar gsungs pa'i phyir dang / de gnyis kyi bsreg bya 'dzin pa'i dam tshig gi sngags so sor gsungs pa'i phyir dang /gshegs pa gshegs ma sems dpa' sems ma khrobo khro mo thams cad la 'bul sngags so sor bshad pa'i phyir/ snying khar bskyed chog yod pas drang don gyi 'das par mi 'grub ste sa lha sta gon sogs la'ang yod pa'i phyir ro/ /yang bu ston rin po che dam tshig gi sngags dang dgang blugs 'dzin pa'i phyag rgya sogs rang la nges pa can yod bzhin du gzhan nas kha 'gengs pa yang mi 'thad cing khro bo yum dang bcas par 'dir dngos su gsung pas srang 'bor ji bzhin mdzad pa'ang mi 'thad do/ /rgyud sde spyi dang khyad par dus 'bor las/ gegs par gsung pa'i sbyin sreg cho ga rnams/ /tshigs bcad sum cus tshad las rdzogs pa ni/ /go bder bshad 'dis sgrib gnyis kun bsreg shog/ ༄7/ //gnyis pa lag len mdor bsdus te bstan pa la/zhi ba la zhib tu sbyar / rgyas pa la mtshon te bstan pa'o// /dang po ni// sdom du bsdu na ba'am sgom bskyeng/ sbar sbyor ba bzhi/ /sgrub mchod gcis gnyis dngos gzhi bzhi/ tshos bsangs gshegs gnyis mjug chos/ bzhi/ /rdo rje nyi ma'i cho ga 'o/ /nge/ yang

ra༅༅/ /mdun bskyed sgrub mchod dang ma 'brel na/grus rtsigs kyi thab kyi sa brtag blang dang /gzhan la'ang sbyang gzung rgyas bsdus gang 'grub phur gdab dang bcas pa byas la/'dir ni 'brel ba gco bor byas nas bshad par bya ba la/sbyor dngos mjug gsum gyi sbyor ba la bzhi'i bsham pa la thab dang yo byad dang chas 'jug go/dang po ni bris pa'i dkyil 'bor byang phyogs byang shar la cung zad nye bar khra do'i pha rol du khru bdun pa'i tshad zur bakha la srad bu mtho gang pa dang / de la sor gnyis dang bzhi dang bzhi mthud pa rnams kyis zlum skor byas pa'i nang du pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi lte bar pad+ma dkar po/'dab ma rnams nang ler gzhan bshad skyong shar dang shar lho sogs bzhir ral gri gnyis/ rin po cheganyis / rdo rje dang pad+ma gnyis/'khor lo gnyis rnams phyogs mdog dang /kha khyer gyi bar cha'i lnga gsum la pad+ma'i phreng ba dang de'i phyi ru pad+ma 'dab ma phyed pa rtse mo nyir bstan pa dkar po khri/ de nas khra gnyis dor bar rtsa thig nas mda' thig gi bar btab pa'i rtsig pa rnams nang nas rim pa bzhin nag dmar dkar ba/dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs la byang du byas nas der sgo dang rta babs tshul bzhin du bris shing /rtsig pa'i nang du khro bo bcu'i mtshan zlo ste steng 'og gnyis shar gyi shar dang nub kyi nub tu bri'o/ /thab kyi lho'am me lha sgo la rgyab bstan pa'i dbang du byas na shar du slob dpon dang / de'i g.yas su bsreg rdzas dang g.yon du mchod rdzas kyi gdan gyi pad+ma thab dang tshad dbyibs 'dra ba la 'dab ma'i mtshan ma dang mchu sogs med pa

bri'o/ /gnyis pa ni g.yon gyi gdan la mchod yon zhabs bsil zhal bsil gyi snod shes las byas pa pad+ma'i dbyibs can sor bcu gnyis pa gsum/ so so'i mdun du bzed zhal gyi snod dang bcas pa/ ku sha'i chun po/ gzhan yang tsan+dan dkar po'i dri chab/ dri zhim po'i me tog dkar po dang / a ka ru dang sih+la dang ga pur gyi spos sbyang rtsi dang sha ka ra dang bcas pa ste bsil ba'i spos/ mar dkar gyi mar me/ 'o ma dang / zho zan gyi lha bshos/ 'bras sa li ma chags pa'i 'bru/ gos gzung dkar po rnams rim pa bzhin dang / rnam rgyal chen po nang mchod rdor dril rnams dang / g.yas la dgang blugs dang de'i mthar u dus ra dang / a shat+na dang / n+ya gro d+ngha dang / sarka ṭi dang / dgun 'brum ste lnga'am ma rnyed na shug pa dang kham bu sogs 'o ma can gyi shing dri ro bzang po'i rtse mo'i cha las skyes pa mnyam par chad pa mdzub mo'i tshad tsam rlan dang bcas zhing lo ma gnyis dang ldan pa sor bcu gnyis pa de las ring thung dang sbom pa dang gas rul sogs med ba dri bzang dang sbyar ba'i mar gyis sbags pa lnga brgya dang lnga bcu me lha'i chas kyi lhag po dang bcas pa dang / til dang so ba dang 'bras ma chag pa dang nas dang / sran ma dang gro dang dur ba sngo ljang rnams kyang shing dang 'dra bar sbags pa dang / mthar zho zan sogs zas bzang pos bkang ba'i snod dang mdun du mar dkar dri ma med pa'i mar bzhu mi nyung ba dang bcas pa bshams shing shom pa'i tshe yang rang rang gi sngags rngams kyis ci 'grub dang / khyad par mchod yon sogs chu snams la yig drug la swā hwa btags pa

ra༅༅/ /brgya rtsa brgyad bzla shing bsham mo/ /gsum pa ni/ sgrub grogs dang bcas pa'i slob dpon rang nyid chas gos dkar po dri ma med pa shel rgyan gtsug tor mdun khebs thams cad dkar po dri zhim po'i phye ma sogs btab pa stan dkar po ha cang mtho ba ma yin pa rnams bsham/ dgon pa'i gci ba'am 'o ma can gyi shing sbom phra gang rnyed kyis 5 thab kyi rgya dpang las mi che bar brtsig go /sgom pa ni/ sgrub mchod dang ma 'brel na srung 'khor dang bcas pa'i bdag bskyed ci 'grub bya la/ 'brel na phyi rol pa btang nas snga dro'am srod kyi thun dang po dus sbyor rtsub po dang bral ba 'dzom ra dkar seng gi khyim 'char dus su slob dpon chas su zhugs te rkang pa byin gyis brlabs te rdo rje'i 'gros kyis thab kyi dkyil 'bor la skor nas sgo nang nas zhugs par mos te/ gdan la pad+ma'i 'dug stangs kyis 'khod nas/ rang nyid rdo rje'i shugs zhal dkar po gtso bor byas pa zhi nyams can srang 'khor gyi 'don pa cung zad spos pa'i dgral bar shes dkar po las 'od dpag med dkar po sogs rigs drug dgod/ rnam rgyal chen po'i chus bsang gtor bya zhing / e āḥ / hāḥ phaṭa/ rang dang thab dang bsreg rdzas dang mchod rdzas dngardo gang blugs dang rdor dril sogs pa thams cad bshegs dang bral bar gyur/ e shā n+ya tās / bris pa'i dkyil 'khor stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las 'byung ba rim bsnyugs ri rab dang bcas pa'i steng du bh+rūṃ yongs su gyur pa las gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sbo gcig pa rta babs dang bcas pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su

rdzogs pa'i nang gi khro bo'i ma ma rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ shar dang shar lhor yi yi 'a dang / ral gri las skyes pa'i bgegs mthar byed dang dbyus sngon can nag po nag dmar sogs dang / de bzhin du lho dang lho nub tu sti n+ni dang rin po che sogs dang / steng dang 'og tu ha hā dang rdo rje las skyes pa'i gtsug tor dang snod mdzes sogs srung 'khor ji bzhin la rang rang gi yum dang bcas pa/ nyi ma'i gdan la g.yas brkyang gi bzhugs pa badz+ra r+ghaṃ ra ba ya dzaḥ prarnyin+ta kṛ ta hū+oṃ/ ya mān+ta kṛ ta bam̐/ pad+man+ta kṛ ta hoḥ bisbyan+ta kṛ ta hi/ de thams cad kyi dpral bar i/ mgrin par āḥ thugs khar hū+oṃ: lte bar hoḥ thugs ma'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas gdan gsum tshang ba'i sogs nas/ rang rang gi rigs kyi bdag pos dbu rgyan / dbang gi lha rnams kyang rgenyis su med par thim/ mchod bstod bsdas pa bya/ bka' bsgo'o/ /bsted pa la rdzas dang / thab bskyed pa'o/ /dang po ni/ shā n+ya tās/ gdan dang mchod rdzas bsreg rdzas rnams stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las/ pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad pa pad+mas mtshan pa rnams kyi steng du bam̐ las grub pa'i shel gyi ṅgā+od yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du rdzas rang rang gi slong yig dang po thig les brgyan pa rnams yongs su gyur pa las mchod rdzas dang bsreg rdzas thams cad rang bzhin stong pa nyid bde ba chen po/ rngam pa mchod rdzas dang bsreg rdzas so so/ byed las dbang po nas bskyed par gyur/ e asnyi/ pā s+t+ya/ prok+ṣa ṇa/ e tsa ma ni/ gasbyi/ kā ma rnams re re'i 'jug tu e āḥ

ra༅༅/ ṇ+ḍaṃ/ e a swā hā/ zhes pas rdzas rnams bkru/ khyen āḥ swā hā/ e shrī swā hā/ skyes rdo swā hā/ e ku ru ku ru swā hā/ rnams kyi yam shing dang mar dang 'gru dang rdzas lhag ma rnams sbyangs/ byin gyis rlob pa ni mgor e dang mthar swāhā sbyang nas/ shing lnga dang / mar dang ku sha dang / til nas zho zan gyi bar la/ bo dhi bṛk+ṣa/ yañdza/ la ma ta ku be ra/ ma dhu na/ badz+ra asne/ a pra ti ha ta/ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badz+ra ya/ badz+ra bi dza ya badz+ra pus/ mahā be ga mahā ba la/ badz+ra ghasma ri/ badz+ra ā yu khe sarba saṃ sad de/ 31 āḥhū+oṃ gsum/ gnyis pa ni/ shu n+ya tā/ me thab stong pa'i ngang las zlo yongs su gyur pa las ye shes kyi thab kha dog dkar zhing dbyibs zlum po/ rgyar khru gang dpangs su khra phyed mchu dang re kha'i dkyil 'khor dang bcas pa de'i nang gi dbus su pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad pa mtshan ma dgu dang bcas pas brgyan zhidza khri khyer la pad+ma dkar po'i phreng ba dang kha khyer gyi 'og tu pad+ma'i 'dab mas yangs su skor ba dwangs shirjo thogs pa med par gyur/ e badz+ra satwa āḥ thab kyi mthar dur ba sngo ljang dgram/ sbar ba ni bram ze'i me'am 'o ma can gyi shing gi sbar ba'i me blang la/ e āḥlha gis snod du bsrungs/ oṃ āḥ/ ho haṃ k+ṣaḥ sa me mdung sbar / yig drug gi bsang / e dz+nyā la dz+nyā la hūm̐ haṃdzimalawaraya gis khas mi bu bar rlung g.yab kyi sbar/ gtso bo'i snying pos blugs gzar bdun gyis bso'o/ /sbyor ba'o// lto //dngos gzhi la gnyis kyi 'jig rten pa'i me lha sgrub mchod

re bskyeng sti ra drangs ge'us spo chod 'bu'i bzhu/ skyes/ pas bsdus te/ bsted pa ni/ shu n+ya tā/ me stong pa'i ngang las raṃ las byung ba'i me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum bkra shis kyi mtshan pa'i dbus su me lha'i gdan waṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po dang bcas pa/ rang gi snying ga dang thab kyi me lha'i gdan la bam̐ larme pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du woṃ dang pad+ma las skyes pa'i me lha dkar po/ snang mthas dbu brgyan cing zhi ba'i nyams can zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa g.yas gnyis pad+ma dang shel phreng / g.yon gnyis dung dang ril ba 'dzin pa/ na bza' dkar po bsnabs shing mu tig la sogs pa rirtsa po che'i rgyan dkar pos brgyan pa/ pad+ma'i 'dug stangs kyis bzhugs shing zla ba'i lce'i rang bzhin can du gyur pa'i thab kyi me lha khro bo bcus bsrang bar gyur/ snying kha'i me lha'i thugs kur dzaḥ yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje lcags kyu dri ma med pa'i 'od zer lnga 'phro bar gyur/ dzaḥ rang 'dra'i me lha ye shes pa spyan drangs/ hūm̐ dam tshig pa la bcig bo dbyer med du bcings/ hoḥ mnyes thor byas/ hi ro mnyam du byas par gyur/ rang gi snying ga nas dbugs phyir 'byung ba dang lhan cig tu nang gi me lha phyir 'phros nas thab kyime lha la thim/ 'dir mthe bong gis rdo rje khu tshar4 nan pa'i phyag rgya bstan / i e h+ye hi mahā ṭī tā de wa ri ṣi sdu dzaḥ sa〉 gro hi to/ a yu d+ngha mahā rasmi sasdi hi to byu ba badz+ra d+ngha ra ādz+nyā pa ya ti swā hā/ ces pa gnyis dang / de'i bod skad/ e tshur byon tshur byon 'byung po che/ lha yi drang sro nga rgenyis skyes mchog /

ra༅༅/ /'od chen mtshon 'dzin 'dir mnyes mdzad/ /rdo rje 'chang rgi bka' bzhin mdzod/ /swā hā/ zhes gsol ba btab pa dang / thugs kha nas spos pa'i 'od zer gyis ri rab lhun po'i me mtshams kyi rwa la gnas pa'i me lha 'khor drang srong gi tsho+ogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba spyan drangs te/ thab kyi phyi rol gyi dur ba'i gdan la 'khod/ bgegs bsreg pa'i sngags kyis phyi 'breng bskad/ rme rme lha 'alor bcas thab tu spyan drangs/ hūm̐/ bam̐/ ho/ hi rnams snga ma bzhin / i ma hā rasmi prok+ṣa r+ṇa pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ e pra wa ra satwa ka raṃ mahā rasmi pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ pro k+ṣa ṇi gyi gnas su/ māṃ tsa ma ni/ ga:/ nas/ kā ma/ pā blo/ sa pa ri wā ra ya na ma/ 'jig rten dbang phyug tshangs dbang mgon gyi sras/ /me lha'i rgyal po ṭak+kis dbang bskur ba/ shes rab mchog gis nyon mongs thams cad bsreg /'dzin byed me lha nyid la rnam par 'dud/ /tshangs pa 'jig rten mgon gyi sras/ /me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog /'byung po yongs su skyabs pa'i phyir / /thugs rje'i dbang gis sku sprul pa/ /rigs sngags grub pa'i drang srong mchog /nyon mongs bsreg pa'i shes rab 'od/ /bska la pa'i me ltar gzi brjid 'bar/ /mngon shes rdzu 'phrul zhabs dang ldan/ /thabs kyi sprul pa'i theg pa phyibs / /rigs sngags gsung ba'i bgrang phreng 'dzin/ /bdud rtsi'i bcud ldan gaṇ+ḍi bsnams/ /chos kyi bdud rtsiyongs la stsol/ /nyes pa'i skyon bral tshangs par spyod/ /'jig rten gnas kyang mya ngan 'das/ /zhi ba mnyes kyang thugs rje che/ /

de bas bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ /dgang gzar dang blugs gzar gyi kha la e āḥlha gi 'od zer dang bcas pas ma zhing me lha 'dzum bag dang bcas pa cung zad gdangs pa'i lce la raṃ gyis ma par gyur/ e badz+ra a na la/ sarba bha tai dz+wa la ya sarba bhasmi ku ru ku ru sarba dza na durni : phaṭa swā hā/ bsreg blugs bdun 'bul/ zhes phul bas zhal du gsol nas/ bsreg bya 'dzin pa'i dam tshig la gnas pas bsreg blugs len cing phrin las sgrub par zhal gyis bzhes par gyur/ smo pra rin na bgegs bsreg yig drug girme bsang / snying pos blugs gzar bdun gyi me bsos nas/ slar yang lha gsal gdab/ bsreg blugs bdun phul/ bzang na mi dgos/ e mahā rasmi bo rnyi bṛk+ṣa ya swā hā/ de bzhin du yam shing gzhi la sbyar / asne yis blugs gzar bdun/ de nas til/ so ba/ 'bras/ nas/ sran ma/ gro rnams re re zhing bdun bdun gyi mthar yang blugs gzar/ de nas dur ba bdun/ bsreg blugs bdun rnams re re'i mjug tu'am kun gyi mthar che ge mo'i tshe 'bor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa la sogs pa'i 'gal rkyen mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad shāsnru ku ru swā hā/ me lha tshim shing mnyes nas 'od kyi rang bzhin du gyur/ 'das pa'i sgrub mchod ni/ bskyed drangs mchod gsal 'bul tshan lnga/ /zhes bya ste/ rten bskyed pa ni/ me lha sngar bzhin bskyed pa'i dbus su 'byung ba rim rtsegs ri rab dang bcas pa'i steng du bye yig las skyes pa'i rdo rje gur gyi nas/ 'phro ba can te re re'ang gru bzhi slo bzhi rta babs dang

༄༄༄/ /bcas pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa gdan dang bcas par gyur/ mdun bskyed ma 'brel na mdun bskyed sgrub tshul bsdus pa bya/ 'brel na sangs rgyas yab yum bcas pa sogs kyi gsol ba btab / mtshan sngags sam 'chad 'gyur gyis bsreg sngags kyis dkyil 'khor nas spyan drangs pa'i mos pas me tog re re nas blangs pa thab tu'ang rim gyis sam cig char du dor nas/ gdan de rnams kyi steng du dus kyi 'bor lor zhi ba'i zhal gtso bor gyur pa'i lha drug brgya sum cu so drug mtshan ma dang bcas pa thams cad mngon sum du gsal bar gyur/ mahā rasmi'i gnas su shrī ka la tsakra sa pa ri wā ra bcug pa'i mchod pa'i me lha bzhin phul/ 'dud nyi shu sogs kyis bstod/ bsreg blugs / e sarba pā paṃ da ha na badz+ra asni badz+ra satwa mya sarba pā paṃ da ha da ha swā hā/ zhes pa bdun gyi phul/ gtso bo'i thugs kur zla nyi sgra gcan gyi steng du yi ge dzaḥ yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje lcags u de las dri ma med pa'i 'od zer lnga 'phros pas srid pa gsum po mtha' dag bkang nas des srid pa gsum po mtha' dag la khyab byed du gnas pa'i ye shes kyi 'khor lo spyan drangs te gtso bo'i gtsug tor nas zhugs/ a ba ñtsi ti'i lam nas 'khor lo drug rim gyis brgyud pas byang chub kyi sems su zhu ba rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyis pad+mar babs pa'i yab kyi dkar cha ā lis mtshan pa'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dang / yum gyi dmar cha kā lis mtshan pa'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor du gyur pa'i zla nyi kha sbyar gyi dbus su waṃ dang pad+ma las skyes pa'i

lha'i bu zhi ba'i nyams can zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyi g.yas skyabs sbyin dang g.yon pad+ma dkar po 'dzin pa/ na bza' dkar po bsnams shing mu tig la sogs pa rin po che'i rgyan dkar pos brgyan pa/ sgrub bya'i khyim du bskul nas des sgrub bya 'khor bcas bkug ste dkyil 'khor du bcug pa la/ gtso bos 'di la zhi ba'i las gyis shig ces bka' bskul/ yum rnams kyis bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis khras gsol/ nus ma rnams kyis mchod par byed cing sems ma drug gis tshe dang dbang thang la sogs pa nyams pa bsos/ sgeg sogs rnams kyis tshim par byed cing tsa rtsi ka la sogs pa rnams kyis 'jigs pa med par byed/ khro mo rnams kyis༄ skyong par byed cing klu mo rnams kyis 'o byed/ lha mo bcu gnyis kyis 'khyud par byed cing gtum mo rnams kyis bsrung bar byed pa'i sgo nas zhi ba'i phrin las la brtson par gyur/ yam shing nas/ mtha'i bsreg blags kyi bar sngar bzhin las bsreg blugs bdun bdun dang / gzhan rnams re re yang brgya rtsa brgyad re/ dang por yig drug dang / e āḥ/ ho lha k+ṣa/ de nas yan lag gi sa bon/ i ṭ+wāṃ hrī lha ngh+ru sh+lau hraḥ dang / a i ṛ u lo e dang / ༄a e ar a zhol i dang / ha ya ra wa la rnams ring thung ste sngags sde tshan lnga po re re la'ang tshang ma spel tshig rgyas bsdu sa gang rung dang bcas pa phul la / 'jug ni/ sngogs nas ngu'il 'khor khang pa'i phyi rol du phyin/ zas bzang po dang chu gartor te/ e byur byā ba swā hā/ na mo de we bh+yaḥ swa sti pra dze bh+yaḥ swā hā rā dze bh+yaḥ swa dhā pri tri bh+yaḥ a lam+bha te bh+yaḥ wa

༄༄༄/ /ṣaṭa in+t+ra ya/ zhes pa gnyis dang / de bod skad du/ e sa 'og sa steng legs sbyin pa'i/ /lha rnams la ni phyag 'tshal lo/ /skye rgu rnams la bkra shis dang / /rgyal po rnams la dbugs dbyung dang / /pha mes rnams la ra myangos dang / /'byung po rnams la tshim pa dang / /dbang po rnams ni dbang byed shag /ces 'thor shing / shis brjod bya/ e āḥhū+oṃ kā ya waka tsit+ta swā bha wa bi shu d+ngha swā hā/ ku sha'i chus rang rang dkyil 'khor pa la bsang e badz+ra waska swā hā/ i badz+ra tam+bu la swā hās gos gsar pa dang rngo thal med pa'i so rtsi phul/ sngar bzhin mchod bstod/ gang yang bdag blo rmongs pa yi/ /zhes sogs dang / gang yang bdag cag las dang po par gyur te/ bying rgod kyi dbang gis ting nge 'dzin mi gsal ba dang / snyigs ma lnga'i dbang gis yo byad ma 'byor shing ma rnyed pa dang / ser sna'i dbang gi mchod pa'i dngos po chung zhing ngan pa dang / gti mug gi dbang gis rgyad sde nas 'byung pa'i cho ga bzhin du ma lcogs pa la sogs pa 'khrul zhing nongs pa thams cad mgon po thugs rje sogs dang yig brgya brjod/ 'dod don la gsol ba gdab/ mdun bsked med na mngon rtogs bzhin rang la bsdu/ yod na/ e sbyad kyi sems can don kun mdzad/ /mtshan sngags sogs kyi me tog thab nas blang la/ mdun bskyed la bsdu/ de nas thab tu me lha gsal btab pa la bsreg rdzas lhag ma rnams dbul/sto mchod bstod/ bzod gsol/ gsol gdab byas la/ e dzaḥ gats+tsha gats+tsha ma hā rasmi swā hā/ baṃ sa1 sto hon/ su na

rā ga mi ṣ+ṭha si de ba su ya dā ā hā na ya mi swā hā/ gnyis dang / bod skad/ 'od chen yang dag tshim mnyes te/ /rang gnas gshegs gshegs gang gi tshe/ /lha 'dir spyan 'dren bgyid pa na/ /slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ swā hā/ se gol gtog ye shes kyi me lha rlung nang du 'jug pa dang lhan cig tu rang gi snying gar thim zhing / 'jig rten gyi me lha rang gnas su gshegs par gyur/ gang dag stong na sogs kyis shis brjod bya/ 'jug chog gzhan dkyil 'khor cho ga bzhin bya'o/ /sbyin bdag yod na/ 'das pa ma gshegs gong ngam shis brjod kyi gong du lag g.yon pa dgang blugs dang bcas pas de'i mthe bong g.yas pa nas bzung ste/ bsreg blugs bdun dang g.yas pas blugs gzar bdun de'i mgo bo'i g.yas su skor shing 'bul bar gzhan du bshad pa bzhin bya'o/ /rgyas pa la yang cho ga phal cher khyad med la/ thab dang 'dug stangs dang spel tshig zhi ba'i las mdzad pa'i gnas su rgyas pa'i las mdzod zhes sogs gzhug ste/ rnam bzhag la shin tu bltas nas 'don pa rnams ci rigs su spe zhing / dkyil 'khor dang grong gi byang drang po nyid du bya'o/ /de ltar rgyud sde spyi dang khyad par gyi/ /sbyin sreg rnam bzhag nyer mkho'i lag len dang / /bcas pa 'di ni stag tshang lo tsā ba/ shes rab rin chen zhes byas legs par sbyar/ /nyes cha'i bud shing mkhas pa'i me lha yis/ /slar yang rmongs pa'i yam shing dang bcas te/ /bsregs nas ye shes chen po'i snang ba yis/ /skyes rgu 'di yi mun pa sel gyur cig /'dir 'bad ngage dang rang

ra༅༅/ /gzhan dge ba kun/ /dmigs med ngang du rnam mkhyen kho nar bsngo/ /'gro kun srid zhi'i dpal 'byor cher rgyas nas/ /sku bzhi'i dpal la ring min spyod par shog /ces myos ldan gyi lo sgron gyi zla ba'i nyi shu drug rdo rje slob dpon chen po 'jam pa'i rdo rje rin po che bsod nams 'phel gyi zhal snga nas kyis zla dus kyi mchod pa la dmigs te sbyar ba'o/ /'dis kyang kunaci mkhyen rgyal ba'i bstan pa phyogs dus gnas skabs thams cad du dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas par :/ra cig /maṅga lam̐// //gangs can mkhas pa'i gtsug rgyan stag tshang pas/ /mdo sngags gsung rab kun la dgongs 'grel dang / /khyad par dpal ldan dus kyi 'khor lo yi/ /phyi nang gzhan gsum rigs ldan bzhed pa'i gzhung / /'gro ba'i kun dkris bag chags bsreg pa'ithabs/ /sbyin sreg cho ga dngos grubargya mtsho mdzad/ /mdzad pa'i 'od dkar phyogs kun khyab pa'i phyir/ yi/ mud 'dul bya'i tha chung dpon ching gis/ /sgo gsum 'bad pa chen pos bzhings pa'i mthus/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i thugs dgongs rdzogs pa dang / /'gro la phan bde'i snang chen rgyas par cesag/ //
